source_doc: Great product! I am very glad I ordered this product! I have lots of clear organizational types of jars and containers on my counter, which look very cute when displaying things like pasta and grains. I wanted smaller jars to display spices, such as peppercorns. These small jars are perfect for display. There are many jars to cover every spice I own, and additionally, they come with tons of labels. Some labels were pre-printed, and some were blank so I can write on them myself! They even included a pen for convenience. These glass containers will be easy to clean, easy to display, easy to stack, etc!When I opened the package, I was looking at the jars and noticed that the lids were off-center from the container. At first, I was irritated at the poor craftsmanship, but then I realized that the lids just needed to be adjusted to look right on the container. It was simply a matter of moving the lid around to make it look better. I thought I would include that note just in case anyone had the same thought!

source_doc: I Want To Learn To Play The Drums. I literally just told my mom I want to learn to play the drums. I'm old enough to get those senior citizen perks and looking for something new. So when I saw this on the vine list I giggled and ordered. I love how quiet this is even when I'm really pounding away. It has a nice pad on the back to keep it from scratching and also helps dampen the noise. When I learn the basics I'll move on, but for now I love my new drumming pad. It came with two sets of sticks and a zippered case. I love that I got it from Vine but would have paid what it cost. Can't wait to get good enough for a real set of drums! I'm signing up for a drum therapy thing to get going. Vine is an Amazon program where you get things free in exchange for your honest review. I will update this one to let you know when I get good enough to have broke a drum stick. Five stars because it's so inexpensive, well thought out and a great way to learn the basics.

source_doc: Auto headrest tablet and hat holder that works OK with an additional installation step. I had a bit of trouble installing this. Rotating the knob behind the tablet holder is not as easy as they make it sound in the instructions. I couldn't get it tight enough to keep my 11" iPad Pro from drooping, so I thought I had it cross threaded. Through my efforts to tighten it by hand, I broke the knob. I glued and tried again the next day, but this time I used a pipe wrench to grip the knob while hand turning the tablet holder, which worked well enough so that now the tablet does not droop so easily. It's probably best for use with cellphones or lighter tablets.I love the hat holder feature. I keep large brim hats in the van to protect against the sun when going out for walks. Before I installed this holder, I was constantly moving the hats around in the van because I didn't have a good permanent place for them. As seen in the photo, I have two hats in the hat holder, the one in the back is hanging by it's chin strap.I wish I could use the nicely collapsible tray AND the hat holder but one is forced to choose between them.Now that it's installed and working, I'm happy to have this auto tablet and hat holder.

source_doc: Beautiful. I love this little bowl and lid!  Two things I wish the makers could change, though.  One is that there is a little crease around the lid underneath.  I wish that was not there due to the difficulty to clean it.  Second, I wish the knob was easier to grasp and hold on the lid.  When this bowl is hot, you have to use a potholder to remove the lid.  That lid knob is too small.  I dropped it once because it slipped out of my potholders.  It could have broken, and my heart would be broken too.  I have tried to figure out how I can get the bowl out of the microwave, burning hot, rather than using potholders on each side.  I love it for its looks, but I want to use it, too.OK, sad news.  I could not find any way to remove the lid when it was very hot.  I tried gloves, mit's, and little pinchers.  Nothing worked.  I sadly sent it back.

source_doc: I can't deny, I love these bare limbed lighted trees. I have one the same height as this one but it is all white lights.  I still love it - it puts off more light that you would think and it's just really pretty when lit up at night.  This one, having colorful lights is just as pretty, but I do love that this one has several colors.  The only thing I might wish for is that this had a remote so that I could change the colors to a solid color, have it fade or pulse, or even have all the colors race.  See, I don't put up a Christmas tree and this would be sort of a substitute.  Other than that, I love this tree.  It was easy to put together and I used a smart plug so that I could turn it on with voice control through Alexa.  Love this tree!
hypos: Не могу отрицать, я обожаю эти светящиеся деревья с голыми ветвями. У меня есть такое же по высоте, но только с белыми огоньками. Я все равно его люблю — оно дает больше света, чем можно подумать, и просто очень красиво смотрится, когда светится ночью. Это дерево, с разноцветными огоньками, ничуть не хуже, и мне очень нравится, что у него несколько цветов. Единственное, чего мне, возможно, хотелось бы, — это пульт управления, чтобы можно было переключать цвета на один постоянный, настраивать затухание или пульсацию или даже запускать режим бегущих цветов. source_doc: Takes fabric pilling off sweaters, couches.... Well, I did it.  I read several of the reviews and took the plunge.  Usually I take a pair of old hair clippers and shave my sweaters but that has caused too many snags.  This little shaver DOES NOT create snags.  You charge this little bugger up and in no time you're digging through your closet and bringing out stuff you forgot you had and shaving everything down.  After that now I have sweaters ready to wear and a pile destined for a Lawn Sale.  What can I say... it's the cycle of clothing.  I like just about everything about this shaver.  It's small, rechargeable, fits in my hand well the only thing that I found a tad irritating is emptying out the collection of sweater lint/nubs. source_doc: They are OK. I've got a bunch of par lights, and I guess I was hoping for a little more with these. Most of my lights are about the same size. Their LEDs are in different patterns, but when I put them all on my truss, they look comparable. These guys are smaller. I guess you can call them compact. But they won't look right in-line with my other pars. They are bright... in fact, they are brighter than a name brand pair that I have. However, the blue had more purple in it. The red and green looked OK. The spread is wider when I tested these side-by-side with my name brand. The name brand gave me an even circle on my ceiling. This pair washed a larger area with a hot spot in the middle. What I do NOT like is the plug. It is ungrounded. If I use them inside, they will work OK. I will probably use them behind a scrim or façade since the brackets are extremely flimsy. I didn't expect name brand quality for sure. But I think I expected just a little bit better.

source_doc: Nice Scent. I love my fur babies but I do not want my house to smell like a litter box.  I got these OdorTrap refills to use with my Litter Robot because they are much less expensive than what I was using.  I like that the scent is not overpowering because I have found that if I use anything that smells too strong, the cats avoid the litter box…definitely not something you want happening lol.  These refills are made to go in the pod that goes in the drawer of the Litter Robot but I think they could even be used without that near any type of litter box.  I have another litter box that is in an enclosure.  I put one of these packs behind it and it is helping to remove the odor quite well.  I definitely will be stocking up on these.  Great product.  Great price.
hypos: Приятный аромат. Я люблю своих пушистых малышей, но не хочу, чтобы у меня дома пахло как в лотке. Я купил/а эти сменные картриджи OdorTrap для использования с моим Litter Robot, потому что они намного дешевле тех, что я использовал/а ранее. Мне нравится, что запах не слишком резкий, так как я заметил/а, что если использовать что-то с очень сильным запахом, кошки избегают лотка… а этого уж точно не хочется, ха-ха. Эти картриджи предназначены для специального блока в ящике Litter Robot, но я думаю, что их можно использовать и без него рядом с любым типом лотка. У меня есть еще один лоток, который находится в закрытом домике. Я положил/а один из этих пакетиков позади него, и он отлично помогает устранять запах. Я определенно буду закупать их впрок. Отличный товар. Отличная цена.

source_doc: A Practice Tool. I bought this transmitter specifically for practice.  I don't think I'd ever use a low-end wireless for a live performance.  There are too many cross signals that will cause signal drop.  I was surprised when I got some drop in my practice room.  To be fair, not long after it dropped a few times, the battery died about 10 minutes later. So that was probably the cause so kudos because it didn't drop more frequently.  The volume control is not linear, at least by my experience.  It went from to quite to booming with just a few touches.  I had to play with it a bit to get the level where I wanted it.  I also noticed the wireless is tonally different than the cord.  Actually, I like the sound a bit better.  I didn't notice that difference with my other wireless system.  I have only used this device in my practice room so, I don't know how it will react if practicing with a group, especially if there are other wireless devices in the room.  When I know, I'll update this review.

source_doc: Hard to say if it's the car or me or this part. I ordered this to replace the crankshaft position sensor in my 2011 Nissan Sentra. It was throwing a code for a multiple/random misfire and I replaced the plugs and all of the coil packs so this was next on the list. After I replaced the sensor I am getting lights on the dash and even more codes then before I replaced it (basically it made it worse). I don't know if it's the sensor, the way I replaced it, or anything of that nature because I am not a professional mechanic, which is why I'm giving it a 'neutral' review. The sensor was definitely brand new and looked fine before installation so I can't 100% say it's faulty right now. After I get everything worked out I will probably update this review.

source_doc: Overly sensitive - may need therapy! I love the individually programmable key light colors! Granted, the color/brightness varies a little across the keyboard, but most people would not likely notice. I like the volume control, contrary to other reviews. The keyboard is full-size but compact - like a Tardis! With light use, the battery has lasted well. The only thing I don't care for is that the keys are very sensitive - it is easy to mistype with a very light touch. I find myself making corrections or opening windows that I didn't intend. I could use the power cable to keep the backlight from sleeping, but that's not why I bought a wireless model. I wish I could extend the sleep timer. I don't think there is a competitive model with similar features for this price and I highly recommend this Red Dragon keyboard if you can train yourself to use the very sensitive keys.

source_doc: Great office chair! This seems like a nicely made computer chair. I am not very good at putting things together, but I managed to get this chair together all by myself! It suggests having two people put it together, and I agree that two people would make things much easier! I didn't have an issue until I tried to put the back of the seat on. I just couldn't get it in the right spot because I needed two hands to screw the bolts in. It took awhile, but I got it!The chair is very sturdy and the seat is very comfortable! The neck support is nice. The only issues I noticed were some of the wheels wouldn't roll as I pushed it back to my office. I assume with use, these wheels will start working. Also, I had planned on using it for my bar-height desk, but it is a few inches too short, so I will have to find another use for it. I think I assumed it would adjust that high, but I should have looked at the measurements.

source_doc: Easy to swallow vitamin E. I have tried in the past various Vitamin E products. I was looking for one where I only had to take 1 a day. I came across a company Kala Health that has a Vitamin E Ultra Tocopherols 1000 IU and you only need to take 1 a day. So I decided to give it a try. Since I had never ordered from them, I was anxious to see how big the capsules were. To my suprise they were long & slender caps, which made swallowing easier. The main reason I wanted to take Vitamin E was for my skin. As I have gotten older, it did not matter how much lotion I used my skin was still dry. So far I have to say my skin seems to be some better. I am going to keep taking this product. The price I paid was very reasonable. I would recommend this product.

source_doc: I like it! I had read that COQ10 is good for your heart, blood pressure and cholesterol so I decided to try it. I found the taste was not unpleasant although the consistency was a little thick. I found that after a couple of days I seemed to feel a little more energetic and I felt less anxiety.  I have never taken a COQ10 supplement in a form such as this, but since I hate to take pills, this works better for me. The only thing I dislike is that this has to be refrigerated after opening which makes it more difficult to remember to take.  The bottle is supposed to be used within 45 days of opening so if I miss a few days, the product will still be good.  I won’t know of course if consuming this supplement will help with my cholesterol levels until the next time it is checked so if there is a marked improvement, I will update this review.  In the meantime, I really like this supplement.

source_doc: Nearly useless. After receiving these, but prior to using them, I left a raving review, but now they are nearly useless. I followed the instructions for washing them, which I did, of course, before planning to use them. I placed the lids in the top rack of my dish washer, and when the cycle finished I TRIED to secure the lids onto the bowls. I was able to snap shut only one or two of the four sides in place. The only bowl that I was able to fully secure the lid onto was the smallest. Granted, I have arthritis in my hands, but never have I had this issue with a set like this from another manufacturer. source_doc: great for cat hair and taking on the go. my uniform for work is 100% black and having 6 cats, yeah my clothes get covered in hair. now, using a lint roller isn't anything new to me, but the one i had ran out of paper and i had no clue it was out. so ofc i ran to amazon to buy one that would arrive quickly. this one came up and i was intrigued by the design, i've only ever had the straight ones. so i took a chance on this one and omg i'm never going back. the design of this one somehow makes it easier to roll. and i love the fact that it has a cover, because a lot of the time i forget to lint roll before i leave, so it's nice that i can just keep this in my bag and use it once i get to work.it was a little hard to figure out how to peel the paper off but once i did figure it out, it became easy.

Overall, I found this set to be very user friendly and pretty self explanatory as far as getting them set up to use.  Right out of the box, I was able to figure out how to use them.  The sound quality is on point.  I am sure that there are others out there that are more professional, but I think better than using only the microphone on my iPhone and for an entry level priced product, I am very happy.  I didn’t use them at a distance so I cannot comment on how well they pick up sound from afar.  I think if you are looking for a something to get started with, this set would be a good place to start.

source_doc: Not a favorite. This is my second dock charger. I got it because it is designed for the headset to lay horizontal so there is no chance of the lenses getting damaged by light or scratched. Overall, I do not like this dock very much. I have a few aftermarket headset accessories that the dock doesn’t work well with. The controllers setting in the middle which means I have to adjust my strap piece to get my controllers in the charger.The biggest issue I had is my controllers don’t even charge. I thought there wasn’t an indicator light for the controllers, but it ends up they weren’t charging at all. I left my headset and controllers on the dock for a couple days thinking everything was charging but when I powered up the controllers were at 40% battery life. I even heard my controllers click into place. I never did get them to charge but the headset charges fine so I think my product may have been defective.

Unfortunately I cannot speak on how well it works, but I will say that the value for the amount that you get is decent.

source_doc: I love everything about this, except for the price. I'm 32, acne prone, with combination skin (oily tzone, but dry around my chin). I don't use social media at all, but I am in Korea and my family gifted me some of this. I've been here a month and just finished a stick of it (well there's a bit more, but it's at the bottom and I can no longer glide it over my face). I did not apply it sparingly, used it most days and most evenings as I had forgotten my normal moisturizer. I found that sometimes I'd feel a pimple coming on and I think it actually helped it heal much faster. I haven't noticed wrinkle reduction, but my skin feels healthier and brighter. I tried slugging over it with CeraVe healing ointment, but that's too heavy together, unnecessary. I really like the scent and the packaging, I think I will repurchase, but if you're looking for wrinkle reduction - microneedling and/or retinol products will be more affective. This would be a nice product to alternate when not using retinol.

source_doc: Excellent feed. I bought this for my green winged macaw because her other food went up $20 and I wanted something a little less expensive. Despite what some people said about their birds rejecting it I decided to try it anyways. It had a good pellet size, smelled good and had a nice crumble factor to it. My bird usually dives into her other food but only ate a little bit of it when I put it in her dish. Usually she eats all her food by 5 pm which is her second feeding time. There were pellets left over. I waited a few days for her to get used to it but she never did. I did not want her to go to many more days without eating so I broke down and despite the cost  bought her, her old food which is what I will keep her on from now on. I have nothing negative to say about this product except you have a 50/50 chance of your bird liking it. I didnt want this to go to waste so I gave it to my friend who owns a bunch of parrots.

source_doc: Good Soap; Very Fragrant. I got this dish soap specifically to take to the office. I work in a shared environment where dish soap is provided by the workers, not the organization, and I have seen a variety of soaps of varying quality run through. I have had good success with Amazon's store brands, so I had good expectations here. It's good soap that gets the job done. The most notable aspect of this soap is the fragrance.In use this soap works as well or better than the rest of the soaps I have seen in the kitchen. It clears grease and it gets dirty dishes clean, There's no mystery there. It rinses off well and I have not had problems with residue after using this soap.The fragrance is the most noticeable feature of this soap. It has a strong lemony smell to it that doesn't smell like fresh lemons, exactly, but it is much stronger than that of most soaps I have used. It's a pleasant fragrance and it actually makes the kitchen smell nice when I use it.This is fine dish soap that works well and smells nice. It's at least on par with name brand soaps I have used, and it is very fragrant. When it's gone, I will buy more.

source_doc: Nice low glow color ring. I wanted an adjustable light in my bedroom but I didn't have a ceiling mount (where I wanted to put it) in place with the wires to the breaker box. Since the lamp itself was very lightweight, I wired with old lamp parts that plugged into a wall socket. It worked out perfectly for me. I like that I can turn off the main light with the color ring on for the late nights and serves as a nicely dimmed nightlight. There are several light settings to choose from to please any mood or brightness needed. The main light is impressively bright and can be toned down to my preference at that moment. When I turn everything off and turn it on the next day, it remembers my last settings of both lights. To me at first, the remote was a little complicated to figure out and remember each buttons capabilities. Even after a week I was fiddling around with the remote to change the settings where I wanted. Now that I got the hang of it, I love this light and happy that I decided to order this one out of several different choices I was considering. This lamp has many setting option and I would recommend it for any room.

source_doc: Awesome oil. I for years I used to use only the Subaru synthetic oil in my 2018 forester. After reading reviews and friends telling me about this oil I tried it out.It is a little more expensive that the Subaru oil but I wanted to try it and I was willing to pay the price 1x. So for a little background my forester with clean oem oil was getting 14-15mpg city and my oil temp was 210F. When I used the royal purple I immediately noticed that the engine was running smoother and I was now getting 20-21mpg city and the oil temp was at 190F.This oil definitely paid for itself through the savings at the pump and the smoothness of the engine. I took the averages on both oils after I put 1000mi on.I will update if there’s any changes. On a side note it does say it’s a once a year oil but that’s only if you drive freeway. I drive stop and go in the city so I still plan to change it out in 5 months. I’m also going to put it in our HRV.Thanks royal purple!!

Оно немного дороже масла Subaru, но мне хотелось попробовать его, и я был/а готов/а заплатить такую цену один раз. source_doc: Nice breast massager. I wish I had discovered this for my first baby! I love the massage and heat function. It truly helps for engorgement. I haven’t tried it on clogged ducts yet.I tuck it into my pumping bra during pumping sessions and the heat feels so good. The silicone feels soft on the skin. The heat is only on one side, which makes sense. I never use it during breastfeeding and I don’t think it’s a good idea to have vibration with the baby attached to you.I wish the battery life were longer. I also think it would have been better that the inlet for the charger had a hole to begin with. I kinda created a slit while trying to pierce through the hole (see picture). So I guess it’s not waterproof anymore. I wasn’t planning to use it in the shower anyway.Overall, I’m happy with this product. Even though it says I’ve received it for free, I still need to pay about 30% tax on all products received for review. Regardless, that doesn’t affect my review.
hypos: Хороший массажер для груди. Жаль, что я не открыл/а его для себя со своим первым ребенком! Мне очень нравится функция массажа и нагрева. Он действительно помогает при нагрубании груди. На закупорке протоков я его еще не пробовал/а. Я вкладываю его в бюстгальтер для сцеживания во время сеансов, и тепло ощущается очень приятно. Силикон мягкий на ощупь. source_doc: EXCEEDS EXPECTATIONS. A friend suggested I purchase this pair of hand warmers before a ski trip I had planned with my family. In the past, I would typically buy disposable single-use "pouch" style hand warmers but wanted something that was reusable and would last longer. Boy was I impressed with these. As I was putting on all my ski equipment, I fired these up and put them in my boots. When I was ready to put my boots on, they were already nice and toasty so I moved the warmers to my jacket pockets and zipped them closed. Once I went outside the lodge into the cold, I put my hands in my pockets and they were nice and warm. I had the warmers on the lowest setting and they kept my pockets warm all day. It was great to take my gloves off on the chair lift, stick my hands in my pockets before each run, and it made the day a much better experience overall. I highly recommend these if you're a skiier, hiker, go to an outdoor sporting event, etc.!

source_doc: VERY STRONG FRAGRANCE!!!! Smell is extraordinarily fragranced. I left this box on my bathroom counter for a half day while I did other things. Returning to my bathroom area, I could smell it out in the hallway. I ended up double bagging it in ziplocks.I don’t like scents and I can have allergic reactions but usually shampoo smells are okay. So, I kept it. Finally tried it this morning. The black shampoo + the green conditioner. Worked okay but again, the smell was EXTREMELY STRONG. I felt my lips tingling in the shower so I was definitely having a reaction.Anyways, an hour later I got migraine. I get them very infrequently - maybe once a year or less. This one was only visual but the strongest visual one I’ve ever had. Kinda suspicious I got it right after using a new product. No one to know for sure.Long story short, everything was double bagged and put into the trash.I really, really would like to be doing better and using and discarding less plastic but not at the expense of my health.Definitely not a good product if you are sensitive to fragrances.

source_doc: Great aftermarket upgrade for you Sony Pulse headset. I decided to try these replacement earpads because I often found the factory pads getting too warm on my head, and they weren't exactly the most comfortable.  These new pads are noticeably cooler and are a decent improvement in comfort as well.  I really like them!I found the process of replacing the earpads to be a pain.  Taking the earpads off is simple, but for whatever reason I couldn't get two of the clips to snap into place, so there was a gap, which I knew wasn't right.  I didn't want to break anything either, as I thought I was pressing too hard already.  After failing to snap them in place I found the factory ones didn't want to go back on either.  So then I knew it wasn't the fault of these earpads, but the design of the headset.  Turns out you have to use more force than you are comfortable with to snap two of the clips of the earpads onto the headset.All turned out well, but man I really thought I was going to snap some plastic while installing the earpads.  Again, not the fault of these pads.  I love these and would recommend them to anyone.

source_doc: So disappointed. I am really disappointed. I contacted customer service because the vegan leather on my bag is pealing after just a few months of use. The best they can do is nothing? They said I must be rubbing it on rough surfaces. I am not rubbing or bumping it on rough surfaces. I have had another Itzy Ritzy bag and used it the exact same way and it has very little wear and tear on it after years of use. It was also vegan leather. The surface of the vegan leather is just peeling in places where there is not much friction. I am careful to take good care of my bags. I have really enjoyed being an Itzy Ritzy customer. As a mom of 7, I have carried their bags for years as well as used many other products including toys and pacifiers. I also recommend the brand because of the quality, however I have sadly learned that the customer care is lacking. For an item to peel like this is unacceptable and not normal wear and tear. I guess their quality standards have lowered as well, previous bags did not do this. If they will only stand by products purchased directly from their website and not other merchants such as Amazon, what is the point of selling there? I will no longer purchase or recommend Itzy Ritzy.

source_doc: Not the Quality I Was Expecting. Typically I love JRPG's. The ones published by Square Enix have often become some of my favorite games so I was surprised to find myself having trouble getting into this one. First off, I felt the player movement was too slow and to me it seemed pretty laggy on my PS4. I didn't feel any sense of flow in the movement or the battles and found this to be one of the few non first person games to give me motion sickness which greatly influenced my negative opinion of the game. The battles weren't anything super complicated which usually I would enjoy as I like to just enjoy the story on my first playthrough of a game. Unfortunately there was keeping me hooked on the story so I didn't feel the need to continue forcing myself to play hoping at least that would be worth it in the end. I also found the world itself didn't feel worth exploring as I wasn't finding anything notable in the treasure chests or making interesting discoveries along the way so I will admit I have not finished the game. If it were to get updated at some point I would consider trying to play again, but as of right now I don't feel it's worth playing.

source_doc: This does not do as it is advertised. I don't understand what people are raving about. I tried this and it did nothing. I tried this on my carpet, on my stairs, on my rugs and I didn't get any hair pulled up.  I have 2 100 pd dogs that shed profusely. I vacuum every 2 days to keep the hair up.  I know there is hair on my floors even after I vacuum because it comes up on my pants an d socks.  So this should be picking stuff up.Anyways, I am unhappy about the shipping. What happened to the shipping box?  I got my box today and it was crushed. I got several boxes today at the same time and THIS was the only box that was crushed. Like it had to be deliberately chosen to be crushed.  This is not the first time my deliveries have been crushed, ripped open, etc by Amazon or UPS. In fact, I had over $1000 in tile crushed on my last UPS order over the holiday. Which I watched UPS from my window as they threw each box of tile out of their truck and onto my pavement. So no wonder my tile was crushed. But what happened here?

source_doc: Incredible audio and customer service! I purchased this monitor in June of 2021. I use it for monitoring my mom with severe Alzheimer's. The sound quality is amazing! I can hear her breathing from across the room on this monitor. Sunday morning about 2 am, I started getting a notification beep that the battery was about dead on my monitor. I checked the cord, battery, everything. I emailed customer support at 2:30 in the morning on a Sunday morning, I had a response later Sunday. Long story short, they expedited a replacement cord to me and I received it just now (Tuesday morning). Free of charge. Wow!The picture quality is pretty good, just small on this camera, but as I said the audio is amazing. $49 is a steal for this camera! I have purchased a lot of baby monitors to find the best one. This has much better sound pickup than any of the others I tried- including expensive ones. Expensive price is not equivalent to quality. This is a great buy! I can't say enough good about them. Oh yeah, the monitor also will pick up across the street as well. I can carry it over to visit with a neighbor and keep an eye on my mom as she sleeps.Buy it!

source_doc: THE MEASUREMENTS/SIZE GIVEN ARE NOT CORRECT but a nice cover for the price. I purchase alot of car covers.  I usually purchase Budge because they are economical for what I need them for.  This review is not against the seller but the mfg.  I followed directions and measure this car from front to back, I also went online to confirm the length....204" or 17'.  I ordered 2 covers that the mfg states are 228' or 19" for extra caveats to the car itself.  Mind you I know this is a universal fit, the fit overall for a sedan is fine, however, this cover is not 19' long so I am very disappointed.  I cannot return because it was such a tight fit a small corner ripped.  I also used this cover on another car of same dimensions, it did not fit.  This is a lightweight cover which I knew that is fine.  Not happy spending $64+ dollars for something that didn't cover 100%.  Again, not made at the seller, just the mfg and to let people know that Budge misrepresents the measurements.  This is the first time this has happened to me on their covers.

source_doc: It's noisy but there's a cheap and easy fix. For the price it is a great elliptical. The resistance levels are good and I get a whole body workout on this thing. It's sturdy enough for the asking price, but the bolts on the main strut make an extremely irritating noise after a while due to the metal washer rubbing against the metal of the strut. I was pulling my hair out over this for a long time, because for a while I wasn't even sure exactly where the sound was coming from. Eventually I narrowed it down to the bolts holding together the two parts of the main support beam. I tried tightening them, lubricating them with WD-40, but nothing worked. I was about ready to throw the whole unit away until I had an epiphany one day. What if I put some rubber in between the metal washers and the strut? All I did was take a spare koozie I had lying around and cut 1-inch squares out of it. In the squares I cut a slit half way up the center and a 1/4" hole in the middle. I then loosened the bolts and slid the rubber koozie square between the washer and the main support and tightened the bolts again. Now the machine is silent! I couldn't be happier now.

source_doc: Very strong. This thing is so much better than the mighty mule I mean I’ve only had it working for a couple weeks now, but it is so much stronger and quieter than the mighty mule. I have a 14 1/2 foot gate that I made myself out of 2 3/8  thin wall pipe no I don’t know the exact weight of the gate but I’m guessing 250 maybe 300 pounds and this thing swings it like it’s not even there I like the soft close feature. and the electric lock takes a lot of pressure off of the actuator on a windy day. I’ve had two of the mighty mules granted they were the smaller models.3500 I believe is what the model was but I burn two of them up in one year like I said I’ve only had this one going for a bout a month so it’s a little premature I will give a year end review but so far, I’m really liking it. It’s faster than the mighty mule as well. The only thing I don’t like is the cheap ass remote control the damn buttons. Get stuck it’s just cheaply made but other than that I love the gate opener I can’t say much about tech-support because I have not had to use them. It is pretty simple to install and I’ve had no problems with it. I highly recommend it if you have a heavy gate well worth the money.

source_doc: Works great on my long haired Maine Coon. I have a Maine Coon cat with really long hair. This comb really helps pull the loose hair out of his coat. I use it about once a week on him and I am always shocked at how much hair I get, between a golf ball size to tennis ball sized clump of hair when I am done. You would think after pulling up that much hair that he would be thinned out, but every week there is more. I think it really helps with the fur ball problem because I don't hear him trying to cough up the fur balls as much since I started using this every week. You just have to go slow, don't pull to hard, and if it starts to have resistance just pull up away from the body. Just watch if he likes it or not, if he is purring I good to go but if I start getting the look and the wagging tail I had better slowdown or back off. He is 24 pound cat that you want to treat right. Afterwards I give him some freeze dried chicken as a treat and he is very happy with me. I like this comb, very happy with it, best out of the five I had prior to this one.
hypos: Отлично работает на моем длинношерстном мейн-куне. У меня мейн-кун с действительно длинной шерстью. Эта расческа очень помогает вычесывать выпавшую шерсть из его шубки. Я использую ее примерно раз в неделю и каждый раз поражаюсь тому, сколько шерсти собирается в итоге — комок размером от мяча для гольфа до теннисного мяча. Можно подумать, что после удаления такого количества шерсти он должен поредеть, но каждую неделю шерсти становится все больше. Думаю, это действительно помогает решить проблему с волосяными комочками, потому что с тех пор, как я начал/а использовать ее каждую неделю, я не так часто слышу, как он пытается их откашлять. Нужно просто действовать медленно, не тянуть слишком сильно, а если чувствуется сопротивление, просто потянуть вверх, в сторону от тела. Главное — следить, нравится ему это или нет: если он мурлычет, я могу спокойно продолжать, но если на меня начинают смотреть «тем самым» взглядом и вилять хвостом, мне лучше притормозить или отступить. Это 11-килограммовый кот, с которым нужно обращаться бережно. После этого я даю ему сублимированную курицу в качестве лакомства, и он очень доволен мной. Мне нравится эта расческа, я очень рад/а покупке, она лучшая из пяти тех, что были у меня до нее.

source_doc: I’m very happy with these hammocks. The only reason I’m giving four stars is because we’re I live at it’s so cold that our windows are very cold so the suction won’t stay on the windows. That to me that would not be a product issue. It’s just where I live at. It’s very very cold! It does indeed hold two cats each on each hammock. I have three indoor cats but right now I’m babysitting my best friends cat so I’m up to four cats so I can say it does hold two cats a piece.Every time I try to take a picture of any of the cats on the hammock they see the camera and then they jump off! They were very easy to put together, and they are very sturdy because two of my cats are pretty big and pretty sturdy! If I get any of the cats to stay on the hammock, when I have my phone out, then I will indeed take a picture and add the picture at a later date! I’m very happy with this product and I do believe my three cats plus the one that I’m babysitting is very happy with these hammocks! I was very surprised when I open the box and seen that there was two hammocks. I just assumed that was only one. They’re fantastic and again I’m very pleased with them. Thank you for letting me review these hammocks.

source_doc: Perfect extension for my camper sink! I could not believe it when I found this faucet extender.  It is the perfect size and design for what I wanted it for.  My wife and I are avid campers.  We have a small, old popup camper and have the “kitchen” outside.  We have one of those folding sink tables and use a drop in faucet with it.  The problem is that my existing faucet, while being tall, it does not extend far over the sink area and washing things is a hassle.  This extension is exactly what I wanted.  It goes out just far enough, but also allows the multiple angles of adjustment.  Wow, if I made it myself it would not be this good.5 stars and thank you!Note: I have been an Amazon customer for almost 20 years. I write all of my reviews to reflect my personal observations and opinions on a product. It matters not if I have purchased the item myself or if it was provided to me for review. My goal is to provide other potential customers as much real-world knowledge as possible to make an informed decision. In most cases I will return to my review in 6 months or less to see if I should alter my original observations. In no case will the cost of a product influence my opinions at all. In addition, I will try to include multiple images and or videos on each product, if practical.

source_doc: Great purchase! First just want to state that I'm new to cloth diapering but I am on my third baby LOL! I took a chance on these because there wasn't a lot of reviews at the time so I felt like leaving one myself will definitely help. These diapers are great for the price point, and I actually prefer this shape of wet bag that it comes with; much larger than other brands I've purchased but I use it to store the clean ready to go diapers. The diapers themselves are great the snaps are strong and have a good size range, the lining is soft and haven't had any staining thus far. The liners I feel like are basic microfiber liners I did wash them about 4 times before use to help with absorbancy but I still wouldn't use just one alone for overnight or long car rides etc I would put the microfiber in the pocket and use a bamboo or something that can be close to the skin on the inside for those long periods of time. It looks like there is a snap in the pocket itself so if you have liners with snaps you are covered. I honestly have no complaints and I love the prints haven't seen any like it and I'm obsessed!

source_doc: Not Enjoying All the Possibilities. In 2020 I bought this preorder from the manufacturer (before they were shipping). It came with no user manual. I found a manual on their internet site, but I wasn't able to find much that was helpful to me. My initial problem was that the app did not work on my i-phone 6 operating system. I set the amp aside until I recently bought an i-phone 14. I recently (2023) downloaded the App. First message was that I needed to download a firmware update for the Spark40. That required a computer. I tried a computer with Windows 11. Then I tried one with Windows 10 Pro. Neither computer recognizes the amplifier. After contacting customer service (very nice response), I connected to a different USB port on the Windows 11 computer and the update worked. This amp is supposed to do wonderful things, and many are happy with it. In my small amount of time using it, I found adjustments on the App difficult to make because of the small phone screen size. Maybe an i-pad would be easier, but that would cost a lot to gain that capability. I'm impressed by all the Spark40 is supposed to do, but not very pleased with the learning curve and the amount of supporting equipment needed (App capable phone or tablet, and a computer for updates of firmware). Make sure you have a phone with an operating system that can run the App.

source_doc: Like the semi transparent ones better ---- Fits Acura Sedan & similar model -- Read review. I ordered these sun shades during Amazon prime day, but since it is winter time I didn't use them. Well, I recently got some moles and freckles removed from my face, so I am in complete vampire mode. That means I apply globs of sunscreen on face and hiss at the sight of sunlight, that is ......... until my skin heals.Yesterday, I pulled out these shades, happy that there was a dark option to help me stay in vampire mode, but both of the dark shades would not stick to my window. Only the two transparent ones worked. The transparent one is ok, but not nearly enough shade for those who need to be out of the sun. The darker ones are much better.  In fact, I would rather have bought 4 semi transparent ones instead of 2 transparent and 2 semi transparent.I guess I received a defective batch, but I still give them 5 stars because I sent them a message explaining the above situation, and they promptly responded stating they stand by their products and will ship me 2 working ones. 5 stars for the amazing customer service. I wish all companies were like them. Anyway, don't be like me and use this a month later. Check to make sure all shades work right when you receive them.Hope my review helps!

source_doc: Absolute Garbage. These things are absolute garbage. I have had two now, one which I just threw in the trash last night, was a black HZ model. I bought two roughly same time frame about 5 years ago. The black one cracked one of the ball support tabs, so I wrapped string around it and glued the string in place to make a kind of splint. That got me about another 8 months then yesterday I see the snark on the floor all discontorted, I picked it up and saw it cracked at the jaw, so I threw it in the trash.Today I remembered when I bought them, I bought two at the same time, so I should have another new one essentially since I haven't used it. Well this picture is the second one, it's 5 years old yes but never even been taken out of the box til now and one of those tabs is cracked. Unbelievable. It's going in the trash and I'll never buy snark anything again. Done.On a side note, not sure what the material they make these out of but this blue one, which has never had hands on it, is sticky. I keep it in a box with guitar strings, plus it was in it's original box, and the little bag. My guess the material over time, off gasses, and the material just becomes weak and cracks or something.

source_doc: I LOVE This Pan. This pan is one of the most remarkable pans I have ever used in my life.  First, let's talk heat distribution, which is often a factor in cooking and also, often a problem with a lot of pans.  Whatever process they have for making this pan, they have figured out the best and truly, I need an entire set of them.  We have several, high-end expensive sets and I could replace them all with just a different plethora of these pans.  This pan, will sear, but not "burn" anything.  I have actually tried- it just won't do it.  I love that feature and it doesn't seem to matter which burner I put it on, the pan cooks evenly through it's entire surface.  The handle is not only a "stay cool" handle, it's comfortable to hold and the overall pan is just extremely well-balanced.  It's very easy to clean and this is one of, if not THE go-to pan I use for most things I am cooking unless I need a bigger pan.  Although, this pan is quite big.  This would make a good pan for any gift, and they would LOVE you for it.  I intend to buy several more in different sizes and I feel like this company has really figured it out, through and through. source_doc: Love the scent. First thing I do on any new shampoo or conditioner is smell it to see if it smells nice.  Both the conditioner and shampoo passed with flying colors.Shampoo first.  I like a squeeze bottle over a pump.  I just feel that I can utilize the entire bottle over a pump bottle.  Shampoo did lather nice.  Again, I liked the smell of it as I was washing my hair.Rinsed off and left my hair feeling clean.  Not the dry squeaky type of clean.  A nice soft clean.I then put on the conditioner before I washed up so it would sit in my hair for a few minutes before rinsing.  Like the shampoo, I loved the scent.Nice thicker conditioner.Rinsed off and towel dried my hair.  It didn't get every tangle out but I could tell I had less tangling.  I have very long hair so it's close to impossible to not have a few tangles.My hair felt soft and smelled so nice.  Even after blowing it a little dry, it felt soft.Once I straightened it, my hair feels like silk.  I love it.Price is a little on the higher end.  But ,the bottles are large and with not having to use as much as some other hair products this should last quite awhile.  So price can be comparable.
hypos: Обожаю этот аромат. Первое, что я делаю с любым новым шампунем или кондиционером, — это нюхаю его, чтобы узнать, приятно ли он пахнет. И кондиционер, и шампунь справились с этой проверкой на отлично. Сначала о шампуне. Мне больше нравится флакон, который нужно сжимать, а не помпа. Мне просто кажется, что так я могу использовать весь флакон до конца, в отличие от флакона с помпой. Шампунь отлично пенился. Опять же, мне очень понравился его запах, пока я мыл/а голову. Смыл/а его, и появилось ощущение чистоты. Не сухой чистоты до скрипа, а приятной, мягкой чистоты. Затем я нанес/ла кондиционер перед тем, как помыться самому/ой, чтобы он побыл на волосах несколько минут перед смыванием. Как и в случае с шампунем, я был/а в восторге от аромата. Приятный, довольно густой кондиционер. Смыл/а его и просушил/а волосы полотенцем. Он не избавил от всех колтунов, но было заметно, что волосы спутались меньше. У меня очень длинные волосы, поэтому совсем избежать запутывания практически невозможно. Мои волосы стали мягкими и так приятно пахли. Даже после легкой сушки феном они оставались мягкими. А когда я выпрямил/а их, они стали похожи на шелк. Я в восторге. Цена немного высоковата. Но флаконы большие, и благодаря тому, что расход меньше, чем у некоторых других средств для волос, их должно хватить надолго. Так что цена вполне сопоставима.

source_doc: Beautiful drawer handles! I was upset when I opened these because I had ordered the rose gold, and I was only going to give three stars for receiving the wrong color. However, after looking at these more closely and holding them up to my cabinets, I actually think I like these better. Not only are they gorgeous, they match all of my oil rubbed bronze fixtures throughout my house. My mailbox, house numbers, all faucets, towel racks, shower racks, and some decor are the rubbed bronze color, and these tie in perfectly with that theme. These handles have a nice weight to them, you can tell they are real metal. They feel so smooth and luxurious to the touch. The pictures really don’t do them justice, it’s so hard to tell from a photo but these really are extremely nice drawer handles. I’m waiting until I get my cabinets refinished to use them in the kitchen, but I tested out the screws and they fit seamlessly into the handles. Sometimes with screws they feel like they just don’t like up right and it’s a pain to get them in all the way but these fit in flawlessly. I like that the screws are cuttable too, depending on the thickness of your drawer front/cabinet. Overall these are what I would call deluxe drawer/cabinet handles, and I would highly recommend them.
hypos: Прекрасные ручки для ящиков! Я был/а расстроен/а, когда открыл/а посылку, потому что заказывал/а розовое золото, и собирался/ась поставить всего три звезды за то, что получил/а не тот цвет. Однако, присмотревшись к ним повнимательнее и приложив их к своим шкафам, я, честно говоря, думаю, что эти нравятся мне даже больше. Они не просто великолепны, они подходят ко всей фурнитуре из темной бронзы (oil rubbed bronze) в моем доме. Мой почтовый ящик, номера домов, все смесители, вешалки для полотенец, полки для душевой и некоторые элементы декора выполнены в цвете темной бронзы, и эти ручки идеально вписываются в эту тему. Ручки имеют приятный вес, сразу видно, что это настоящий металл. Они такие гладкие и роскошные на ощупь. Фотографии действительно не передают всей их красоты, по фото сложно судить, но это действительно очень качественные ручки для ящиков. Я жду, когда отреставрируют мои шкафы, чтобы использовать их на кухне, но я протестировал/а винты, и они идеально вкручиваются в ручки. Иногда с винтами бывает так, что они просто не встают как надо, и закрутить их до конца — целая мука, но эти подошли безупречно. Мне также понравилось, что винты можно укоротить в зависимости от толщины фасада вашего ящика или шкафа. В целом, это то, что я бы назвал/а ручками класса люкс для ящиков и шкафов, и я очень рекомендую их.

source_doc: Excellent mid-size carrying case. The reason I got this case for my Steam Deck is I wasn't happy with the velcro on the JSAUX case and had a couple other issues with it where I didn't feel like my deck was properly secured. This fella however solves all those issues. First, this case is a LOT bigger than the JSAUX case, the top is as wide as the bottom. There's a massive top pocket that you could shove a small Nintendo Switch carrying case into but otherwise it's perfect for batteries, controllers, docks, etc. I really wasn't expecting it to be that spacious! The bottom compartment isn't quite as big as the JSAUX one but I was able to cut out a slot for my charging brick using a boxcutter so no big deal, the interior material cut very easily. The protection for this felt wayyy better than the JSAUX case. The straps are excellent and the velcro is very good. The interior is also a bit padded which feels nice. It has microsd storage slots as well as fullsize SD storage slots. I was worried about the microSD's falling out so I kept them in their SD adapters anyways. The only feature I couldn't quite get working was the kickstand strap so I just shoved that down in the bottom and put a different kickstand in the top storage so I have one if I ever need it.

source_doc: Really Works to Prevent Color Bleeding. I usually separate my whites from darker clothing out of fear that the dye from the dark clothing will stain the white. So I was excited to try this product.Basically the sheets look like fabric softener sheets, only they're meant for "grabbing" the color shed by darker clothes and preventing them from bleeding onto the lighter ones. I dropped 2 sheets in my load of laundry, started the machine, and added detergent.To test the product, I threw in a pair of burgundy colored corduroy pants that explicitly said "Wash separate from light colors" and even stated "dye may bleed." I threw them into the same wash as my lighter colored shirts and socks.After the wash was done, I saw that the two "color grabber" sheets had turned gray (they were originally white). They had absorbed the color and when I checked my clothing, I saw no color "bleeds."Now, I haven't tested it with a hot water wash, but for the cold water wash, they definitely work. I love it. Usually I have to separate the whites from the other clothing and it wastes money because the all-white bundle is usually small and could easily fit with the rest of the clothing's washer. But I had always had to separate. Not anymore! I can toss one of these sheets in and it will prevent any color bleeding.Great product.

source_doc: Excellent guitar for beginner intermediate, minimal setup was required. The guitars fit and finish was perfect.  The fret ends were polished and smooth, the action was fine, there were no blemishes.  Upon tuning the guitar, I noticed the intonation was slightly off. Upon further examination, I found the one “holiday” , the setup man went on.  The bridge was pulling up, when the guitar was tuned.  I took off the back plate, the tension screws were tensioned too loosely and unevenly.  Two minutes I had it sorted, and this fixed the intonation.  I have included a picture of my practice setup. It included a Pock Rock, headphone amp, and effects processor(approx 40 bucks on Amazon), an old Fire tablet I had lying around, hooked into the line in, on the Pock Rock, and a pair of Vintage Sansui head phones.  I have a behringer ppa200(also available on Amazon approx 350 on Amazon), that I also use for my karaoke/movie night, senior charity,when I want to Amp the setup(also through the Pock Rock).  I know quite a few chords, but haven’t played in years.  Even though my next door neighbor says I’m not loud, and don’t bother her, the majority of time, I play with the headphones.  This little setup, is loads of fun, and I’m really enjoying it.

source_doc: Never Ever Again Using A Cync by GE product again. Unfortunately I have run out of patience. I had a Cync hub, the app says i can now only use light bulbs and light switches. I was having a lot of trouble keeping the hub connected to the WiFi. Which is why I wanted the no-hub plug. That's okay I'm within 15 ft.App failed to connect to WiFi.Move within 8ftApp connects to WiFiPlug turns off during "Adding to your home"App fails to add plug to homeApp tells me to factory reset plug and try againI tried 4 times. I should've known better, but hey at least it was worth the try, right.... No, no it wasn't.

source_doc: Fluffier than expected. It is hard to order something online and know if you will like it or not, even if you base your decision on the reviews. I must have spent a week almost daily searching for a comforter. So, I took a chance on this one because my old comforter was flat and faded. And hello, I like being spoiled by two day shipping with Prime!The comforter arrived in a vacuum sealed tight bag and looked pretty thin. No weird smells, either. It was late and I wanted to use it that night, so I overlooked the instructions and tossed it into the washing machine. (The instructions state to air it out over a 24 hour period outside, but it is winter here and I have nowhere to safely hang it or leave it.) I washed it on "warm" on the delicate cycle and the tag said to "line dry" but seriously, who does that anymore? source_doc: Great for making some 'fancy' coffee. I really like this brother.  It's easy to use, and quicker and easier to clean than the frother cups (although, I do love my frother cup when I want heated milk).The frother itself is very nice quality, and the digital display is nice and clear.  I've had it for a few months now, and I haven't had any issues with it.  I've only tried the wisk attachment, because I can't for the life of me find the other attachment. I don't know if I didn't get it, or if I misplaced it.  But, the wisk does a great job at making some fluffy milk foam for my lattes!  Operation is smooth, and it's easy to adjust the strength of the mixer by twisting the little ring with the ridges.I keep this on the coffee station, in front of my frother cup, because I use this one more because of its ease of use when I'm in a rush (which is always).The stand only works for me if I remove the wisk attachment, so that's what I do.Overall, I'm really happy I got this.  It's been saving me a lot of money that would have gone to Starbucks.  Now, I have my own coffee shop in my home.  The price is comparable, and in my opinion this one is a better deal over others because of the smooth operation of it, along with the digital screen.
hypos: Отлично подходит для приготовления «изысканного» кофе. Мне очень нравится этот капучинатор. Он прост в использовании, а мыть его быстрее и легче, чем чаши-вспениватели (хотя я очень люблю свою чашу-вспениватель, когда мне нужно теплое молоко). Сам капучинатор очень хорошего качества, а цифровой дисплей четкий и понятный. Он у меня уже несколько месяцев, и никаких проблем с ним не возникало. Я пробовал/а только насадку-венчик, потому что хоть убей не могу найти другую насадку. Не знаю, то ли мне ее не доложили, то ли я сам/а ее куда-то дел/а. Но венчик отлично справляется со взбиванием пышной молочной пены для моего латте! Работает он плавно, а мощность миксера легко регулировать, поворачивая ребристое колесико. Я храню его в кофейном уголке, прямо перед чашей-вспенивателем, так как пользуюсь им чаще из-за простоты использования, когда спешу (то есть всегда). Подставка подходит мне только в том случае, если я снимаю насадку-венчик, поэтому я так и поступаю. В целом, я очень рад/а, что приобрел/а его. Он экономит мне кучу денег, которые иначе ушли бы в Starbucks. Теперь у меня дома своя собственная кофейня. Цена сопоставима, и, на мой взгляд, этот вариант выгоднее других благодаря плавной работе и наличию цифрового экрана.

source_doc: I love these. These are perfect for me. I have a small coffee machine and my current coffee mugs, ( aka: run out the door making coffee in the last minute) are too large for the machine. I also needed some smaller ones so I didn’t have to drink so much more liquid when I work at a manufacturing place and don’t want to have to go to the bathroom so soon after I get to work… anyways, I like the colors and the simple lid. They seal very tightly and the coffee comes out nicely. I have had ones with the small holes be very difficult to get the coffee to come out.The only problem is the lids are a bit difficult to turn when putting them on or taking them off. I put the “over” the lid, lid up and use it to help turn the whole lid. I still want to buy more of them. I even use them at home just so I don’t spill.
hypos: Мне очень нравятся эти кружки. Они идеально мне подходят. У меня маленькая кофемашина, а мои нынешние кофейные кружки (из серии «выбегаю из дома, делая кофе в последнюю минуту») слишком велики для нее. Мне также нужны были кружки поменьше, чтобы не пить так много жидкости, когда я работаю на производстве и не хочу бегать в туалет сразу после прихода на работу… в общем, мне нравятся цвета и простая крышка. Они закрываются очень герметично, и кофе отлично льется. У меня были кружки с маленькими отверстиями, из которых кофе лился с большим трудом. Единственная проблема в том, что крышки немного трудно крутить, когда надеваешь или снимаешь их. Я поднимаю верхнюю откидную часть крышки и использую ее как рычаг, чтобы прокрутить всю крышку. Я все равно хочу купить еще таких кружек. Я даже пользуюсь ими дома, просто чтобы ничего не пролить.

source_doc: I have owned this now for just over 3 years. So, I kind of forgot where I bought this. I was going through my "buy it again" list to try to remember what something I bought was called, and discovered I bought this on February 23rd 2020.Now, due to the pandemic, I actually spent a lot of time both on the road in both truck and motorcycle. In that time I've used this countless times for both air variation at elevation and temperature due to changing of seasons as well as being high in the mountains. I also use it nearly 3 times a week simply to check my motorcycle tire pressure.I've also used this for various reasons like getting myself or others off the highway, mounting new tires on any of the 3 motorcycles I use and even for limping 200 miles down the highway on my Africa Twin until I got to a shop with the correct sized tire for my bike.Shockingly, this cheap feeling and clunky mess of a product never once let me down, nor did it ever give an inaccurate reading on the pressure I have selected.Honestly, I've recommended this to multiple other riders as well as bought them for several friends and family members, all who have had zero problems with them.10/10 would spend $60 again.

Из-за пандемии я на самом деле провел/а много времени в дороге как на грузовике, так и на мотоцикле. source_doc: Finally a mirror that works in my Honda! I was struggling greatly to find a rear facing baby mirror for my Honda Civic.  The reason? All of the backseat headrests are NOT movable! The headrest is part of the seat. Most mirrors with attached straps and gadgets direct you to strap the mirror under the headrest which does not work for my type of backseat. I was trying my best not to purchase a suction cup mirror to place on the window because I knew it would fall off depending on the weather, condensation and so forth. Luckily I came across this mirror, and even with reading reviews, I could not come across anyone who had my same type of backseat issue but gave it a try anyway. I was hesitant because just like the others, it came with straps to go across and under the headrest. Fortunately, I was able to strap the mirror around my attached headrest seat without using the strap used to go under the headrest. I pulled it tight and was able to maneuver the mirror to angle down on my baby perfectly! It works so well and doesn’t move! The mirror is very large so as I looked in my rear view mirror, I am able to see my child fully and clearly! She loves looking at herself too!I am very happy with this purchase- I just wished I bought it sooner!

source_doc: Spendy in my opinion, even though I love them. I am 5*3" 170lbs. I was worried that these shorts would sacrifice comfort for absorbency, but I was wrong. These shorts are comfy that I would definitely wear them even when not on my period.They arrived at the end of my period so I can't yet talk about functionality... But from what I can tell I really think these will be better than all the other methods I've tried. Each method has their own setback. Even with every thing I've tried I have never in my 29 years been leak free during a period. Some products work better than others, like the cup... Less leaking, but still leaking. And inconvenient.I'm hoping this will address the issue.One thing I need to say is I love that they have pockets, but one of the pockets have a big hold in them. Their are threads where it could be closed. I just think they didn't sew it together. That was disappointing, but fixable.I just need to mention it because these are expensive... source_doc: Thin and lightweight. I first started sleeping on a memory foam pillow some 20+ years ago. It radically changed the way I sleep. Though I fell asleep on my side, I always woke on my back. It was so much more comfortable for me that I won't use anything else. I got this pillow so I would have a spare. I was a bit taken aback by how small, thin, and lightweight it is compared to standard bed pillows. Even so, it is pristine, with a very nice quilted zippered case that can be removed for cleaning. It is firmer than the pillow I am used t, and I had my doubts that I would like it. But I slept on it last night and it was great! It will take a few more nights to determine if this is my new pillow of choice, but at the very least it will be a close second and will certainly be the one I take along when traveling!

source_doc: This battery delivers its rated capacity of 100Ah. I have a Bluetti AC200P connected to a 6 circuit manual transfer panel and this works well.  I was looking for some extra battery capacity and watched many reviews of the different brands of 100Ah LifePo4 batteries.  Power Queen was a highly rated battery and their price was equal to about all the others.  However, Power Queen was running a promotion where you would get a 12.8V 6Ah battery for free with each battery purchase so I took advantage of that.  I decided to go with 2 of the Power Queen 100Ah batteries.  I use the smaller battery in my electric start gas generator.  I was able to test their capacity to ensure that I was getting the advertised 100Ah from them and I am pleased to say that each one delivered about 101Ah.  I now have them wired together in series to get 24V and then attach them to the solar generator through an adapter.  This works well although the solar generator only charges at about 340W.  I can't speak for the life cycle of these batteries but with a 5 year warranty, I am not to concerned about that.  I did have the opportunity to ask a question via email to Power Queen and they responded within a day.  I think that they were a good value and would buy again.

source_doc: Great option for a wireless lav mic without breaking the bank! I had middle of the road expectations for this wireless last mic, compared to some other brands that I am more familiar with. But I saw that there was an excellent Black Friday sale, and I was desperately in need of a new wireless microphone like this, And it was recommended on one tech YouTube channel I saw, so I decided to give it a shot. I’m really glad that I did! A lot of times I am filming in an area where I am away from my phone, and the way this plugs into the charging port on the bottom is super convenient. The sound quality is also very good for what it is, and is  impressive to me more than I thought it would be. I would definitely buy this again, and I would recommend it to others.

source_doc: Nice Fit and Look but Having to Replace the Washer Nozzle with OEM Disappointing. I really liked the look of this and it was a perfect replacement. I ordered the black version to accent my Black Jeep which I was really glad I did for the look!However there is where my problems came and why I only gave 3 stars. It comes with a paper saying to replace the Washer Nozzle that comes with it with the old OEM version from the one you are removing.YOU MUST DO THIS because The Nozzle that comes with it is terrible and basically squirts a stream of water down the back instead of spraying it. I found this out the hard way.First, because I ordered the Black version it would look real goofy with the Red nozzle on it. That’s why I ignored the manufacturers direction. So I had to mask off and paint my old red nozzle to match black.Second, because the original OEM nozzle was old the plastic was brittle and one of the securing clips molded into it was broken in the process. You cannot buy just the nozzle and have to buy the whole light assembly so I had to do some engineering to make it work.The manufacturer needs to fix this functional nozzle issue and not make Customers have to hassle with this. If it weren’t for this I would have given it 5 stars!

source_doc: Excellent so far. The box came in good condition. There were not a whole lot of pieces to assemble. I put this together myself in about 30 minutes and only because I did not look at the directions as carefully as I should have. I always look at the pieces in the box compared to the directions of what is to be be sent in the box. What I didn’t notice was the fine print that said some of those pieces came pre-assembled. I scratched my head at some of the other directions, but if you think it through, it will make sense.This machine is smaller than a magnetic rower and the arm motions are like rowing on water as opposed to just pulling back and forth. I used it the first time last night after putting it together. I could only take the number 1 setting in the tension as I have gotten out of shape except for indoor biking. I ended up using my VR headset to play Holofit and lost track of the time. It ended up being about 40 minutes. Today, I am sore all over, but a good sore. This machine really works the arms, back, and legs. After a few months, if this machine is as good as it is now, I will give it 5 stars.

source_doc: Good for quick cleaning. This electric spinning scrubber is really good for quick cleanings. I'm not a fan of cleaning the tub and this helps to move things along. It's a good quality handle with various types of brush heads. Right out of the box I could use it because it was charged which I like. I put the large brush head on to tackle the tub and turned it on...well hold on because I wasn't ready for the brush to take off once it made contact. It's spinning so it kind of spun right along on it's own, I had to get used to it to hold the brush down to clean the area I wanted. The main thing is you have to hold it at the right angle for the brush to make solid contact because the tip of the handle where you attach the heads is at an angle. With the attachment I have been using it's a little difficult to keep it in full contact so I feel like I am missing areas while I'm cleaning. That's why I say it's good for quick cleaning, not necessarily a thorough cleaning. The power also lasted awhile for me, I've used it about 4 times and it still has a charge. I like having this tool but at $75 the price is high in my opinion.

source_doc: It’s fun and enjoyable. I’ve never picked up a guitar in my life until this was delivered so I can’t attest to playability or quality. I did swap out the strings when I got it but more because I wanted to learn how to do it than any perceived problem with the strings that came with it. I can say I have enjoyed experimenting and learning with this guitar.  I paired it with an “Orange” amp and despite not having a clue what I’m doing have been able to replicate sounds like ‘old school’ heavy metal to clear/clean tones that could pass for country or blues if played by someone who knew more than 2 cords. I suspect in trained or experienced hands this guitar would be a good, but not great, guitar.A few things I did notice…1. There are some exposed wires coming out from under one of the pickups and the middle pickups are not level. 2. There is some discoloration on the body of the guitar  3. The tuning peg for the high E is finicky and sometimes feels unresponsive which can make tuning a pain.For what I paid, I didn’t expect perfection, and I have no idea if the uneven pickups impact playability or sound quality, the remainder are cosmetic or just frustrating. I think this probably represents a solis starter guitar or a good rehearsal/travel guitar for more experienced players.

source_doc: I Don't Know How I Ever Lived Without! I had to buy myself one after I babysat a baby who's mom had packed this for her! I HATE putting cream on with my fingers. I love the suction cup feature so that I can suction it while I finish changing the diaper, to prevent the cream from touching anything else until I can get it wiped off. 10000000% recommend.

source_doc: Couldn't tell any difference in my curls.. I've heard so many good things about Olaplex so I thought I'd give it a whirl. Given how expensive it is, I was expecting a drastic change and moisturized curls. I literally could not tell any difference in my hair. I have 3a curls, shoulder length. I washed my hair like normal and followed with Okaplex. I even kept it on for about an hour (each product) then rinse and style as usual. My curls weren't moisturized, shinier, and weren't as defined as I was expecting. I used the products twice to make sure and followed instructions from a few YouTube tutorials. No luck. I ended up returning both products because I didn't want to waste $63 on hair products that didn't even work. I don't recommend for tight curls - it might do better on straight hair or waves.

source_doc: In LOVE!! I have the rucksack (small) Gootium to carry groceries in but I wanted something that was just for me.  Soon as I opened the package I was in love!  I bought the "khaki" color but it looks golden to me.  It's gorgeous!!  I love all of the inside pockets, internal key clasp, the secret zip pocket on the back of the bag and the big zipper pocket on the front. source_doc: Good wireless earbuds. These are nice wireless earbuds. They fit pretty good, I have had one fall out a few times at the gym (I may need to change to a different ear cushion, which are included). I think the sound is very good, I like the bass-heavy music while working out. They seem to hold a charge a long time. The controls are a bit sensitive and I’ve accidentally skipped the controls I wanted. I have not used this for phone calls, so I cannot comment on the quality of talking on the phone. When I first connected my phone to these, the Bluetooth for the ear buds came up twice, and I only could hear out of one speaker (depending which one I chose, the left or the right) and I couldn’t get them to sync. The way I resolved it was “forgetting” both and shutting my Bluetooth off, then after turning it back on, it was only listed once, and they’ve worked fine ever since.

source_doc: Don’t hold their shape. These diaper inserts are very nice when you take them out of the package. The material is soft and a really nice off-white color. I was thrilled to receive these because I took a chance buying them without reviews. I really thought these were going to be amazing, especially as my first hemp inserts (the rest of mine are bamboo). However, after the first wash these inserts just shriveled up and I cannot straighten them back out. Feels like they’re just going to rip if I tug on the sides. I attached a photo, from left to right - Nora’s Nursery (bamboo), these inserts (hemp, and super wrinkly), then Thirsties (hemp). I actually bought another pack of these right when I first received them because they seemed thick and amazing, but now I’ll be returning them. I can still use the ones I’ve already washed, but I double them with a bamboo insert to make sure the wavy edges don’t bother baby. The wavy edges are also pretty rigid and not ideal. I’m a little disappointed, I really thought these were a hidden gem.

source_doc: Simple plug and start using. Was getting tired of using my earpods for video calls on phone. The mic just wasn't clear for those on the other side.I was curious about these and well, decided to try them.  WOW... worked great right out of the box.  My iPhone quickly connected and I was able to start using.  I did a voice recording so I could hear the quality. It was sharp and crisp.Now I have no excuse to podcast off my phone other than I don't like hearing my own voice.I at times have a friend with me and we do video call and have to position phone to get both our voices or hand it back and forth.This came with TWO lapel clip mics so now we can each wear one and keep the phone propped for video call.Will need to get proper cable adapter to try and get this to connect to my laptop. It doesn't have iphone or usb-c ports so I will have to get back to y'all once I get proper cable.  I expect it to work.I'm wondering if I can get a small speaker to connect this to when I am working the company booth. I usually end up almost yelling and losing my voice at days end.  That is my next project for these.
hypos: Просто подключил/а и пользуйся. Надоело использовать наушники Earpods для видеозвонков по телефону. Микрофон был просто нечетким для тех, кто на другом конце провода. Мне было любопытно попробовать эти, и что ж, я решил/а их протестировать. ВАУ... заработало отлично прямо из коробки. Мой iPhone быстро подключился, и я смог/ла начать пользоваться. Я сделал/а запись голоса, чтобы услышать качество. Звук был четким и резким. Теперь у меня нет оправданий не записывать подкасты с телефона, кроме того, что мне не нравится слушать собственный голос. Иногда со мной бывает друг, и мы совершаем видеозвонок, из-за чего приходится наводить телефон так, чтобы были слышны оба наших голоса, или передавать его туда-сюда. В комплект входили ДВА петличных микрофона, так что теперь мы оба можем надеть по одному и держать телефон на подставке для видеозвонка. Нужно будет приобрести подходящий кабельный адаптер, чтобы попробовать подключить это к моему ноутбуку. В нем нет портов для iPhone или USB-C, так что мне придется вернуться к вам, как только я получу нужный кабель. Я ожидаю, что все заработает. Мне интересно, смогу ли я подключить это к небольшому динамику, когда буду работать на стенде компании. Обычно в конце дня я почти кричу и теряю голос. Это мой следующий проект для этих микрофонов.
