source_doc: Pretty Good. I haven’t been in a sleeping bag in a long time.  So I got this and tried it in the back yard.  Well, I picked a cold night with wind, below 30 on the mercury, and it did good.I had no tent which might have been ok if I had no wind.  It was cold.  But I did sleep, about as good as I could expect for the conditions.  I used my field coat to cover my face but the wind woke me up many times.I’m a little over 6 foot and medium build, I fit in the bag.  I feel like my head could have a little more room but it wasn’t a problem.Most importantly for me was having a very thin foam filled self inflating mattress.  it kept me off the cold ground.  And it was much better than being directly on the lumpy ground.  Again, a tent would helped a lot with the wind.Not that I needed it, but the bag has snaps that let it shut without being closed, or maybe there’s another purpose.  The zipper worked great.  The sleeping bag rolls back up easily to fit the carrying bag.I think with a blanket and a tent I would do just fine camping for a weekend.  Hope this helps you.

source_doc: Not very good quality. I doubt this is truly a therapeutic grade oil. I wasn’t expecting the best oil, at the price…but I was disappointed. It had an unusually greasy feel to it for an essential oil, the smell is basic, and if the sting of clove oil is any indicator of its purity, this is not pure. I’ve put clove oil in my armpits a few times and regretted it. I actually put this one on to test it, and eventually I did feel a little heat. But I wasn’t sure I would at all. I do like the dropper feature though. I bought it to use under my finger nails while fighting a pinworm infection with a toddler, so I didn’t care if it smelled great, I just wanted something I could use frequently after diaper changes. Hmmm, perhaps latex gloves would have been a better choice.

source_doc: Requires you to close your doors into it. I have an older car (Toyota Solara), and wanted this to protect it from the times I can't park in the garage. I've used another cover previously however it has gotten worn down from seasons so I wanted to give this one a try.The good news is that the clips are plastic, which I LOVE. The old cover I used had metal clips, and if one isn't fastened properly, that'll scratch up the car in the wind as it shakes around. I prefer plastic or rubberized clips any day.The bad news, is that they want me to close the doors into this in order to hold it in place. I did not realize that is how it is supposed to work, and I have a major problem with that- The Solara doors don't have a top frame, it is glass against the rubber gasket of the car's top. With material in between like this, you are asking for leaks into the interior of the car around the door seams. I don't like that at all. It fits fine on my other car (Honda Odyssey) but I'm disappointed I can't use it on the car I wanted to.

source_doc: Tore My Skin - Also NOT Returnable. Sadly this “gentle” tape stuck too well. After changing my bandage only twice my skin tore as the tape was removed. I do not have thin skin. I’ve used a variety of tapes over the years, and yes skin can tear after multiple bandage changes, it happens, the skin just gets worn down. But I’ve never had it happen on the second change. The tape was really really stuck after just four hours on my skin. I slowly removed the first piece, when that gave me trouble I tried soaking the second piece. It didn’t work. I definitely don’t recommend using this product if you DO have thin skin. And I would think twice about getting this if you’re going to have to change the dressing multiple times.Worse, I had bought two different widths of this tape. When I went to return the unopened one I learned that it is not returnable. If you look at the return policy on the side bar it says it IS return or replaceable. But when you actually click on it the message pops up that says you can’t return it. No, I do not usually click on it when I see you can return it. I guess I will have to do that from now on since it is misleading to say the least.Lesson learned.

source_doc: Great auto feeder for those that work long days! This is a great auto feeder for those that work long days! I just changed jobs recently, and I'm now working 12 hr shifts. I was worried about how I would keep my 2 small dogs on their feeding schedule, as I leave before their breakfast time and get home after their supper time. This has been a lifesaver knowing my little fur babies are being fed on a regular schedule. It is simple to set up and very simple to use. The portions that dispense are perfect for my dogs. Now I can control when and how much they eat when I'm away working. I also love the fact that I can watch them and speak to them. Although they get a little excited when they hear my voice, I see disappointment when I am really not there. So I keep the speaking very limited. But sometimes they want to fuss with each other when the food comes out, so I can tell them to stop, and they typically will at that point. All that said, this is a great auto feeder with many features and will provide peace of mind knowing your little fur babies are getting their food, and seeing how happy they are when they do. I highly recommend this feeder.
hypos: Отличная автокормушка для тех, кто работает подолгу! Это отличная автокормушка для тех, кто работает подолгу! Я недавно сменил/а работу и теперь работаю по 12 часов в смену. Это стало настоящим спасением, ведь я знаю, что мои пушистые малыши получают еду по регулярному расписанию. Ее просто настроить и очень легко использовать. Выдаваемые порции идеально подходят для моих собак. Теперь я могу контролировать, когда и сколько они едят, пока я на работе. Мне также очень нравится, что я могу наблюдать за ними и разговаривать с ними. Хотя они немного волнуются, когда слышат мой голос, я вижу их разочарование, когда меня на самом деле там нет. Поэтому я стараюсь говорить очень мало. Но иногда они начинают ссориться друг с другом, когда насыпается корм, и тогда я могу сказать им «нельзя», и в этот момент они обычно прекращают. Я очень рекомендую эту кормушку.

source_doc: A remake that feels more like two steps backward than a step forward. I grew up playing the original Diamond and Pearl, and besides the notoriously slow engine run, I had really enjoyed those games and looked forward to the remakes. I found BDSP faithful to a fault, while not introducing enough new spins to qualify as a breath of fresh air. The Grand Underground held my interest for only a brief amount of time. Everything else feels stale, rigid, and uninspired. I’m not a fan of the chibi aesthetic, which I’m especially disappointed about since I liked the direction the new games were going with more detailed and realistic models. I have played Pokemon since I was in preschool, over 20 years, and this is the only Pokemon game I have not finished. I stopped playing after getting the eighth badge and couldn’t feel bothered to continue any further. (I did, however, help my sister beat Cynthia on Brilliant Diamond, and I appreciate that they’ve made the notoriously difficult Champion even more difficult. From the remastered music to the competent AI, hands down the best battle in BDSP.) When Pokemon Legends Arceus came out, I dropped Shining Pearl like a hotcake and didn’t look back. Arceus was the breath of fresh air I was craving.

BDSP показалась мне верной оригиналу до глубины души, но при этом в нее не было внесено достаточно новых идей, чтобы ее можно было назвать глотком свежего воздуха. source_doc: So far, so good. I received this yesterday, so I cannot speak to its long-term reliability.  However, I would like to make a few points.  It is smaller than described. About 4 inches wide instead of the 6.3 inches in the description, which fits nicely on my dash.  I chose the "warm light" color.  Gold really, and this fits well with my other dash lights.  The more popular green would have looked much more like an added, non-factory accessory.  It started working right out of the box; however, I did charge it further before installing.  It took about two hours.  Yes, the instructions are poorly translated  from the Chinese.  As with many other consumers, I wish that the Chinese manufacturers would simply find a native English speaker to write their instruction manuals.  Too proud, I suspect.  In any event, If you have trouble with the directions find a 14 year-old to do it for you.  I'm 72 and I managed.  I set it so that only the time shows.  I would have included the temperature, but it will only show that in Celsius.  I don't need the date and year, so I passed on that, too.  My car does have a factory clock, but it is small and poorly placed.  This does the job.  I'll post a follow up in a year or so if I have any further comments or problems.  If you don't see a follow-up then so far, so good.

source_doc: Black and Gold Luxurious Dining Setup. I got sold on this table cloth’s color combination.  A black table cloth with a separate gold sequin table runner is a clever idea.  I thought that the gold fabric was attached to the black cloth, but when I opened the package, I saw that they were two pieces.  Please see the photos I posted.This table cloth is a perfect size for my kitchen's island marble table.  I love that I can decorate my table with just black cloth or spice it up, and I can lay out in the middle of the gold sequin runner.  I could even use a different table-runner.  I think I will buy this company's rose-gold variant, so I can mix and match them.The fabric had no toxic odor.  The black cloth would be easy to clean, but the gold sequin I believe needs careful and gentle methods for removing food stains.  This table cloth plus the gold sequin runner appears luxurious, except for the gold runner edges.  The easiest, fastest, and cheapest way to prevent fabric from fraying is to use sergers and form a zigzag pattern across the edges that this table runner utilizes.  I wish that the manufacturer fold the edges of this table runner and create a seam that would make it perfectly nice.For the kitchen/dining aesthetic, it will bring for a reasonable price, and I would say this gets my thumbs up approval!  Highly recommended!
hypos: Роскошное черно-золотое оформление обеденного стола. Я купился/лась на цветовое сочетание этой скатерти. Черная скатерть с отдельной золотой дорожкой из пайеток — отличная идея. Эта скатерть идеально подходит по размеру для мраморного стола-острова на моей кухне. Самый простой, быстрый и дешевый способ предотвратить осыпание ткани — обработать края оверлоком зигзагообразным швом, что и сделано на этой дорожке. Мне бы хотелось, чтобы производитель подогнул края дорожки и сделал полноценный шов, чтобы она выглядела безупречно. За ту эстетику, которую этот комплект привносит в интерьер кухни или столовой за весьма разумную цену, я определенно одобряю этот товар! Очень рекомендую!

source_doc: Too Much Fun! When I first ordered this drum I didn't know what to expect, I mean I saw people playing it and it looked cool but now I know.  I LOVE sitting on this box and just banging away! I think it's therapeutic.  You learn how to play it as you experiment with it. There are different ways that you that you can hit it the drum, or cup your hands differently that gives you different types of sounds.  To let you know how solid this box is, I weigh 250 pounds and this drum holds me up with no problems. I don't feel like it's going to break underneath me. I would say it's commercial grade, and the fit and finish is wonderful.  It really is fun to play, and even my adult kids want to play on Dad's drum.  When I'm not using it I use it as a small table for a one of my speakers. It is well worth the money and something that I could see lasting forever if not abused. I highly recommend!

source_doc: Careful... I bought the 64oz which has a seam in the mouth (the 40oz doesn't) and I looked in there today, not even a week after it arrived, to find rust so just be sure to check every once in awhile that everything is kosure. I'm used to working with cast iron so I know I can scrub it out but it's not really something I want to have to worry about constantly.Other than that I feel like I haven't really been able to give this a fair shot but as mentioned, I bought a 40 oz as well which I'm hoping will be better.Also, I'm rating this as "not easy to drink from" (next section of review asks for a star rating on this feature) because I very much want a super fast, super smooth flow so I can chug like my embrava (not insulated) water bottles but I don't think that I will ever get that from any hot drink lid. Still a pita to have the lids be so... Gluggy and slow pour just because I prefer warm water.

source_doc: I was unsure at first BUT... I was unsure when I first took this out of it's box. I needed a carrier because I realized I really can't carry my newborn and do other things around the house at the same time. I forgot how useful carriers were with my first son. It's intimidating at first to see all the straps, but once you get this adjusted for your body and baby it's a breeze to snap it right on you. My 6 week old currently loves being close to me and sleeping on my chest. In fact this is his favorite place to take naps in during the day. It gets him settled down real quick when he gets a little fussy. It's so durable and sturdy I don't worry about baby in here when doing anything around the house. I even take this with me at the office, fortunately I own my own business so I can take baby with me to work. For the price it's great, it's worth every penny and more. I plan to use this the whole time baby can stay in a carrier. I love this better Tham the bjorn, which I had with my first son. This is so much more versatile and transforms as the baby grows.

source_doc: Just What I Needed. I was looking for a bread cutting guide that cut all the bread the same size, easy to store in a small space and easy to clean.  I did not want the lovely bamboo guides because  they were spaced to accommodate 3 sizes of slices on a somewhat small grid so then I would have to move the bread after every so many cuts in order to have them be the same size.  The key word I was interested in is "easy".  With this guide if I want thicker slices all I need to do is skip a space -- easy! Used this bread cutting guide today and am quite happy with it and would purchase it again. It cleans up easily -- just a quick wipe with soap and water.  However it's crumb catching ability is not great. I just place it on a jelly roll pan and cut away.  If one is giving this item as a gift it, comes in a very nice box.  If you order a white bread guide do not be alarmed if the box shows the red guide on the outside.  I think the red guide just shows up better on the box.  This guide is so much better than the Presto one I had before. I would purchase this guide again.

I guess I'll buy a different brand so I have something to use until they respond.  The way the manufacturer is giving me the run around is the reason for the 2 stars.

source_doc: I finally found the perfect one! Here is my story. I've been looking for a heating blanket, when I found one, I really liked it. However, the middle of the blanket would not warm up. I sent the blanket back and asked for a replacement since I reasoned that there might just be a problem with it. The identical action was taken by the second blanket. I subsequently bought another blanket, but I didn't like it because the coils only allowed it to heat up in the middle, not on either side. Even when I bought a fourth heating blanket, it still would not become hot enough. I was about to give up when I decided to give this one a go.  I am very happy I did!! Only setting number three on this heated blanket keeps me toasty. It becomes unbearably hot if I go above seven. Not only is the temperature control excellent. It's incredibly soft. I sincerely hope you enjoy the blanket as much as I do and my four-legged luvies.

source_doc: On the Fence….Good Microphone With Flaws. My wheelhouse is electronics and security so I have used my share of microphones either in security equipment or setting up electronics for a band. The problem I had with this was volume. Maybe it was the App I tested it with, maybe it bugged me that there was no way to monitor the volume. I don’t do YouTube, so maybe this can be tweaked in editing but this did not give me enough volume for the App I was using even at max. I gave it a generous 4 stars because the sound I heard I guess sounded good but I would not use this anyway as it has to be unplugged to hear what you recorded. I don’t know why anyone would go through that pain. Points for quick set up and instant pairing. I guess I’ll leave the rest to the professional YouTubers but I see no use for this unless you are a pro blogger or something. I thought it would work on calls and I could clip it on and walk around but does not work for that. A niche product for video bloggers.

source_doc: Exactly what I needed in my closet. These are great! There are two different sizes you can order and I chose the smaller ( I think its like 7 inches)  since I wanted to use them in a sliding door closet with limited wall space. I put one on each end, at two different levels and now I can see my clothes so much better when I slide the doors open. My bedroom is dark and its impossible to tell black from navy and I was having to take them out into the next room for better lighting to see what I wanted to wear. Now, I slide the closet door open, the lights come right on and so much easier! And I can make it hand-held if I want an even closer look. They have a magnetic strip that attached them to the wall and it just pops off and on. The bigger size would probably give even more light, but for the space I had to use them, the smaller size work just great. I have mine set at the auto setting so they turn on activated by motion and shut off automatically once the door is closed again after like 20 seconds. But you can also just use the on/off switch if that’s better for you.
hypos: Как раз то, что мне было нужно в моем шкафу. Они великолепны! Можно заказать два разных размера, и я выбрал/а тот, что поменьше (кажется, около 7 дюймов), так как хотел/а использовать их в шкафу-купе с ограниченным пространством на стене. Я установил/а по одному светильнику с каждого конца на двух разных уровнях, и теперь мне гораздо лучше видно свои вещи, когда я раздвигаю двери. В моей спальне темно, и невозможно отличить черный цвет от темно-синего, поэтому мне приходилось выносить одежду в соседнюю комнату при более хорошем освещении, чтобы понять, что я хочу надеть. Теперь я раздвигаю дверь шкафа, свет сразу же включается, и все становится намного проще! И я могу снять его и держать в руке, если хочу рассмотреть что-то еще ближе. У них есть магнитная лента, которая крепит их к стене, и они легко снимаются и вешаются обратно. Больший размер, вероятно, давал бы еще больше света, но для того пространства, которое у меня было, меньший размер подходит просто отлично. Мои светильники настроены на автоматический режим, поэтому они включаются от движения и автоматически выключаются примерно через 20 секунд после того, как дверь снова закрывается. Но вы также можете использовать обычный переключатель «вкл./выкл.», если вам так удобнее.

source_doc: 2012 RAM 2500 ST 6.7L  Transfer case switch perfect  replacement. I was stuck and put my truck 4low, and a service 4wd light came on. Once I was no longer stuck, I shifted it back to 2wd hi, and the dash said I was in 4 hi. So I wanted to see if it was in 4wd. I put my truck in my yard and stomped it, and of course, I was actually in 2wd. I placed it in 4wd and stomped it I was in 4w drive. My truck is a manual floor shift for the transfer case if that helps anybody, which means no electronic actuator to replace for 529.00, just a sensor (Dorman 600-555 ) for 83.00 at Autozone or 60.00 at amazon. I would purchase it again and I suggest going to Harbor freight tools for a 1-1/2-inch spanner wrench or the spanner wrench set for 65.00. the Spanner wrench would fit in the space much better than huge combo wrench. it took only 25 minutes to remove and install please use dielectric grease in the switch plug to keep water out.

Я бы купил/а его снова и советую заглянуть в Harbor Freight Tools за накидным ключом на 1-1/2 дюйма или набором накидных ключей за 65,00. source_doc: Great, until it fell apart! I am in a nursing home, and I had it sitting on a table at the end of my bed. I reached for it with my grabber tool, to pull it towards me, and the side literally just popped off. There are two miniscule nails holding it together, which are as thick as office staples. As soon as that side came off, the rest of it started to come apart as well. I started to do a return, but it said it had to be returned in original packaging, which of course I didn't keep. Or I could get an exchange, but I what if that falls apart too? I noticed that beside the tiny, insignificant nails, there is a trail of wood glue that is about the width of a human hair. I think if they had used bigger nails or more wood glue, it would have stayed together. I'm just going to try and hot glue it back together. If that doesn't work, I have elbow joint brackets I can screw on to each corner. If not for it falling apart, I would have given it 5 stars. The concept is awesome to store your different sizes of zippy bags in. Just wish it had been put together better.

source_doc: Expensive. After watching a few videos I purchased this lacquer to refinish an old Gibson guitar.  I applied gloss black lacquer over automotive primer.  I bought two cans @ $35 for each can.  I followed the instructions and warmed the cans before use. The first can applied fairly evenly but the second can I had all kinds of problems with splatter.  I had to sand out some big globs of paint and put on another coat.  I tried shaking the can, heating warmer and lower but the splatter would not stop.  I had to spray for a couple of seconds then clean the nozzle with a rag to stop the splatter. The other problem was orange peel.  I have used other brands for 1/3 the price and gotten better results.  If I had to do this over again, I would use a less expensive lacquer.

source_doc: As flimsy as paper. I was looking to replace a wonderful bass clef magnet I'd had on my car for many years. I liked the romantic look of this treble/bass clef design, and was excited to get it. It arrived in a regular envelope, and I had no idea what was in it. I almost didn't open it, because the return address was not familiar. When I did open it, the magnet slid out like a piece of card stock paper, and the 2 "dots" that rest on the outer edge of the bass clef were 2 loose little black circles --- not in any way what I expected, and I certainly can't put it on my car. The first rain would wash them off. The extension at the bottom of the treble clef is flimsy & weak. I don't really know what I can do with it. I put it on my refrigerator, because I can't use it for what it was intended, and it won't stick to anything else.

source_doc: Nice trimmer and accessories. I am normally a clean-shaven guy I like keeping my sideburns clean and sometimes I get a bit of a scruff that I need to keep clean.  I didn't have any clippers that I could use to keep the scruff from looking too bad so I decided to get this.  The clipper itself is nice and heavy and made up of almost all metal so it feels like it could take a beating if needed, I also nerd that I am like the design of it.  It comes with a bunch of normal clipper accessories such as guards, nose trimmer, etc, all of these were fine and fit and cut as expected.  Using the clippers was easy and charging it took almost no time at all.  It was able to at least make this mess on my face look presentable and not like I was homeless.  All said in done I like these the thing that stood out the most was the all-metal heavy design of them.

source_doc: It turns off, Glitchy, connection keeps cutting off... Bought it about a year and 6 months ago. I first started noticing that the headset would randomly lose connection and or it would turn off. Usually I would turn it back on and that would solve the problem. This usually happened when I would try to connect to my xbox. I also noticed that in the middle of a game it would drop connection even though it was on and I had not moved anywhere. This started to happen more and more frequently about 3 moths ago. Now as of yesterday it kept turning off over and over again and or dropping connection. At first i thought it was because it might be low on battery. I plugged it in for about 1-2 hours. That did not solve the issue. So i thought maybe the cable does not work right. I checked the cable it was good. but just in case i used another cable as well. It still did not work. When i plug the cables in it shows a green light meaning it is fully charged or close to fully charged. Well it is still turning off randomly at intervals of about 1-2 mins. Yes I even tried keeping the cable on (charging) while the headset was on. It would still turn off. I am no longer within warranty. I guess I will go back to my other headset from  2013 lol. Do not buy they are glitchy!!!

source_doc: Beautiful flute, but… This is a very beautiful flute and I was so excited to get it. I hadn’t played in about 30 years and wasn’t sure if I could still play. I was pretty good way back when and really wanted to start playing again.When I started playing, I thought some notes seemed sharp. Well, as I said, it had been a while and I thought it was me. I continued to practice and did not see an improvement in the sharpness. In fact, the flute just got more out of tune as time went on. No amount of adjustment would correct this. Sadly, I was unable to continue to play this flute. It was too hard on my ears. I have returned it and will look at an intermediate flute to purchase. I am glad I tried it however because it sparked that part of me that always loved to play.

source_doc: Amazing quality for a low price. I tested this lavalier microphone on a Zoom call where I wanted to stay connected with audio but leave the room completely. I was connected to the meeting through my cell phone, which I left in my office aimed at a chart when I roamed around my house. (Of course, I could have carried the phone with me during the Zoom meeting, but I was testing the audio at various distances.)  My Zoom meeting partner reported I sounded like I was sitting right in the room. Installing the receiver and microphone was a snap - the receiver plugs in to the charging port of the iPhone, and the light on that receiver blinks red until the microphone is turned on. When paired, the light on the receiver is a steady red (not blinking), and the microphone shines a steady green. The foam windscreens aren't necessary in the house but can be left on if that's the look you want. I am looking forward to using this lavalier when I record voice-over on my next PowerPoint lecture using my iPad.

source_doc: Love This Air Fryer. I was hesitant to buy this air fryer because I wasn't familiar with the brand. I used to have a name brand air fryer and it died some time ago and I wasn't sure I needed to replace it because I wasn't using it much. I finally decided to try this one because of it's size and price. It's a perfect size for feeding 1 or 2 people. I also like the color. It's a big bigger than I had imagined before it arrived but it fits fine on my counter. This air fryer is easy to use and even easier to clean up; the non-stick interior just wipes right up. I still don't use an air fryer a lot on my whole food plant-based diet but I'm glad I got it. I think the price was reasonable and if you are looking for an air fryer, I highly recommend this brand.

source_doc: Nope. I've never used a product like this before, so for all I know they're all like this, but my overall experience was not a positive one.  I tried the Lavender first, which is a hot pink disk, and as soon as I turned the shower on what i got was hot pink coloring all over the shower floor, soaking into the tile grout.  (As instructed, I had placed it out of the way of the main shower flow.)  I was hoping it would all rinse away, but it didn't so I ended up having to scrub the floor.  Not exactly the relaxing spa-type experience I was hoping for.  On top of that, there was  virtually no aroma to the aromatherapy.  The scents of my shampoo, conditioner, and body wash were all stronger, though none of them are that strong themselves.  I was really surprised.  When I was all done--hair dried, etc.--I did notice a hint of lavender in the shower, but nothing while I was actually showering.  All in all it was definitely not worth the magenta mess.

source_doc: Saved my back and knees! Hurray! I am at that age where sometimes I have to put off chores because I've used up my back or knees or feet for the day.I probably should have gotten something like this a few years ago.  This really is super usefule.  We have a small shower stall, but it was still super hard to get down to clean the floor.  Last time, I sort of tipped over after crouching down to scrub, I was kinda like a turtle on it's back, my leg muscles spasming as I tried to get up.This is so much easier, so far, I have only used the more abrasive scrubby attachment, I pour a little soft scrub, then cleaned the floor while leaning against the wall.  It was probably the most lazy shower clean I have ever experienced.The scrubbie is good at flat surfaces, but if you really need to get at a corner, you have to press really hard to get in there.  I don't know what the solution to that is.  After I was done cleaning the shower, I cleaned and rinsed the attachment and set it  on the top of the washing machine to dry before I put them away.The soft shamm-y attachment is a real conundrum.  I guess it could be used to clean mirrors or windows.  I will give a whirl next time.

Пожалуй, это была самая ленивая уборка душа в моей жизни. Жесткая губка хороша для плоских поверхностей, но если нужно добраться до самого угла, приходится давить очень сильно. Не знаю, как решить эту проблему. Закончив уборку, я вымыл/а и сполоснул/а насадку и положил/а ее сушиться на стиральную машину, прежде чем убрать. Мягкая замшевая насадка — настоящая загадка. Думаю, ее можно использовать для мытья зеркал или окон. Попробую в следующий раз.

source_doc: Some are good, some STANK. I'm a flower person, I love all things floral scents and I came at this knowing what I want. What I don't understand is why the seller doesn't group up the flower scents and the musky [really, musty] scents in one pack? I bought the green variety pack after returning the pink one and I'm still not 100% satisfied since I can't just choose a set with only floral scents.The Jasmine is great, skydive too, but the open and Darbar stink to high heaven! It doesn't make any sense to put a scent so masculine with primarily floral scents. I tried to get in contact with the seller but couldn't, either.Not all the oils were filled the same amount too. I get there's an inflation going on but this is stingy.For the price I wouldn't buy this again unless the seller is more flexible in how they're bundling the scents together. Makes no sense and I don't like that I paid for scents I hate and won't use.

source_doc: I have a few gnomes... Most of them are solar.  I have a couple of Halloween gnomes that aren't solar and while I like them, I do wish they had solar and maybe red eyes considering they are Halloween figures.  So this guy tracks with the solar garden gnomes, but because he is all clear with lights inside he is different.  I like him, but I think I would have liked a more traditional garden gnome.  By that I mean a little painted gnome wearing a Santa suit and holding a Christmas tree that lights up.  Again, I like this clear gnome, but I still think I would prefer a more traditional garden gnome with a lighted tree.
hypos: У меня есть несколько гномов... Большинство из них на солнечных батареях. У меня есть парочка хэллоуинских гномов без солнечных батарей, и хотя они мне нравятся, мне бы хотелось, чтобы у них были солнечные батареи и, возможно, красные глаза, учитывая, что это хэллоуинские фигурки. Так что этот парень схож с садовыми гномами на солнечных батареях, но из-за того, что он полностью прозрачный со светящимися огоньками внутри, он отличается. Он мне нравится, но, думаю, мне бы больше понравился более традиционный садовый гном. Под этим я имею в виду маленького раскрашенного гнома в костюме Санты, держащего светящуюся елку. Опять же, мне нравится этот прозрачный гном, но я все же думаю, что предпочел/чла бы более традиционного садового гнома со светящейся елкой.

Он мне нравится, но, думаю, мне бы больше понравился более традиционный садовый гном. Под этим я имею в виду маленького раскрашенного гнома в костюме Санты, держащего светящуюся елочку. Опять же, мне нравится этот прозрачный гном, но я все же думаю, что предпочел/чла бы более традиционного садового гнома со светящейся елочкой.

source_doc: Not soft, smelt like burnt plastic, lots of fuzz after the first wash. Despite others reviews, my set came completely the opposite (in a bad way). I got the gray set, and was super excited to use some new, soft towels. That didn't happen.First off, after taking them from the box, removing the bag, they stunk. Like burnt plastic stink.. I HAD TO wash them, because no way was I about to use that on my clean body.Secondly, after washing (cold, light detergent, low spin), and I threw them in the dryer (low heat, light tumble, fabric sheet)... there was so much lint. I am not certain that is normal, but it shed worse than my husky in the middle of July. They aren't losing any stitching, tassels, but it must have been there - somewhere. I know the lint I saw in the catcher was from it because I clean it before each dryer use.Thirdly, they are thin. This might be a good thing in terms of drying times (after bath/shower and leaving on a rack).. but we're talking see-through thin.So overall I am not happy, and I would not recommend INK+IVY Nova 100% Cotton Terry Bath Towel Set. The other reviewers like it, so it is possible I just got a defect. Hopefully so.

source_doc: Good lock for the price. I like this lock so far.  I attached the mount to my bike via the water bottle bolts, but I decided to move it to my bike bag instead.  The mount worked fine, I just missed having my bottle there.  This lock is pretty heavy, which is to be expected.  It is large enough for any bike rack and most poles I would use to lock up my bike.  It is too short for locking down your frame and front wheel to a thick pole.My only complaint is that the coating might end up scratching or wearing the paint on my bike.  This has not happened yet since I don't lock my bike up often, but I really wish there was some rubber on the parts that contact the bike.  I am considering adding some foam tape or something similar to limit the wear.All in all, this is a great folding lock for the money.  I like to budget about 20% of the bike's value for its lock so this falls well within that range for most of my bikes.  I will still use higher-security locks for any very expensive bikes, but that is just due to the higher risk involved.  This lock is far more secure than most cable locks I have seen and is much easier to carry than a U-lock, so this gets my recommendation.
hypos: Хороший замок за свои деньги. На данный момент этот замок мне нравится. Я прикрепил/а крепление к велосипеду с помощью болтов для флягодержателя, но затем решил/а перенести его в велосипедную сумку. Крепление работало нормально, просто мне не хватало фляги на привычном месте. Этот замок довольно тяжелый, чего и следовало ожидать. Он достаточно большой для любой велосипедной парковки и большинства столбов, у которых я бы припарковал/а свой велосипед. Он слишком короткий, чтобы пристегнуть раму и переднее колесо к толстому столбу. Единственная моя жалоба заключается в том, что покрытие может со временем поцарапать или стереть краску на моем велосипеде. Этого еще не произошло, так как я нечасто пристегиваю свой велосипед, но мне бы очень хотелось, чтобы на деталях, соприкасающихся с велосипедом, была резина. Я подумываю добавить немного вспененной ленты или чего-то подобного, чтобы уменьшить износ. В целом, это отличный складной замок за свои деньги. Мне нравится выделять около 20% от стоимости велосипеда на замок для него, так что этот вариант вполне укладывается в этот диапазон для большинства моих велосипедов. Я все равно буду использовать замки с более высокой степенью защиты для очень дорогих велосипедов, но это связано исключительно с более высоким риском. Этот замок гораздо надежнее большинства тросовых замков, которые я видел/а, и его гораздо удобнее носить с собой, чем U-образный замок, поэтому я его рекомендую.

source_doc: For Curly Hair. My experience…it’s okay but results are not instant. I like the scent. It does make your hair soft however when you rinse it out, I don’t feel that the product made a difference. I have left the mask on overnight and again, didn’t leave my hair soft once I rinsed it off. I will continue to use the rest of the product and hope it can help. I don’t know what I was expecting for my curly, colored, bleached, damaged, frizzy hair. I was hoping it would help so I wouldn’t have to cut a few inches off but so far, it’s not helping. I found a hair mask very similar to this at Dollar Tree made by Salon Selectives (old product line, hidden gem) and I am really surprised at how similar they are. Just saying.
hypos: Для кудрявых волос. Мой опыт… нормально, но результаты не мгновенные. Мне нравится запах. source_doc: This product has changed my life. I care for my elderly father who is confined to a wheelchair but can get himself on the toilet. He is constantly bumping his feet and his toes are always bleeding. As a result when he goes to the bathroom there's always blood on the floor. I take a diuretic and when I have to go, I have to go. I use these pads to stick to the floor in front of the toilet so that if I go in the bathroom and he has been in there bleeding, all I have to do is rip the mat up off the floor, and I can go to the bathroom without stepping in the blood. This product has changed my life and probably saved my kidneys. I will be subscribing to regular deliveries of this product. There are probably so many other uses for these wonderful pads. If I could give 10 Stars I would. Also the price is reasonable for such a quality product.
hypos: Этот продукт изменил мою жизнь. Я ухаживаю за своим пожилым отцом, который прикован к инвалидному креслу, но может самостоятельно пересесть на унитаз. Он постоянно бьется ногами, и его пальцы всегда кровоточат. В результате, когда он ходит в туалет, на полу всегда остается кровь. Я принимаю диуретики, и когда мне нужно в туалет, то это нужно сделать срочно. Я использую эти коврики, чтобы приклеить их к полу перед унитазом: теперь, если я захожу в туалет, а он там был и у него шла кровь, мне нужно всего лишь сорвать коврик с пола, и я могу спокойно сходить в туалет, не наступая в кровь. Этот продукт изменил мою жизнь и, возможно, спас мои почки. Я оформлю регулярную подписку на доставку этого продукта. Наверняка у этих замечательных ковриков есть еще много других способов применения. Если бы я мог/ла поставить 10 звезд, я бы поставил/а. Кроме того, цена вполне разумна для такого качественного продукта.

source_doc: So convenient! My old pill organizer broke so I needed a new one. After comparing so many, this was my choice and I have been very happy with it. I don't actually take meds 3x daily, but in the morning I take vitamin C and biotin that are both chewables. So I put those in the center compartment. I love that the containers can be removed for travel when I might not need to pack the entire week's worth. I have had to come up with a way to easily fill these with my pills which is a little less convenient with the individual containers, but still worth it. I actually purchased 2 of these so that when I am filling them, I do both at the same time and don't have to deal with it as often.

source_doc: Not a fan. I liked this keyboard at first.  I work from home and although my employer happily provides me with a keyboard that functions just fine.  I don't like cords.  My old Logitech wireless keyboard was still going strong but I wanted something you could actually see letters on the keys on, I'd worn the writing off of most of my keys.  So I picked this one, I didn't notice that it was rechargeable until after it arrived.  I thought oh that's kind of cool no more batteries.  Then about day four middle of a phone call with a client my keyboard just stops working.  I tried quickly plugging it in to my phone charger hoping it would allow me to keep typing, but no it didn't. There was no warning that it was about to run out battery life 🔋, no battery power warning or anything.  I tried it again after being plugged in for a while and it worked again.  However I can't have my keyboard just stop working mid work day.  So I returned it for something without flashing keys and something that ran off batteries.  In the 5 years my Logitech was in use I only put a new battery in it once.  If you can remember to charge it daily it might be great.

source_doc: great for walking, a bad back makes it harder to move. I use this daily while watching TV.  My other half uses it to keep moving on rainy or otherwise lazy days.  I love it.  The remote came with a cheap and possibly old battery - it died quick.  Replaced it with a new and expensive one and it is happy as a clam.  Invest in a good battery if you want it to work with only one button push. I have a bad back and I was hoping I could move it easily, but that was to much to expect of my back I think. source_doc: Weak Sandalwood - Not For My Sensitive Skin. I shave my beard but leave my mustache alone.  I have never used beard oil before.  I just apply whatever facial cream is left on my hand to my mustache.  So decided to try this.The bottles are small and as per the label, each one contains 20ml of various oils.  I uncap each one and use my sensitive nose to check the fragrance.  I love sandalwood soap so the first one I checked was the one in the middle - Sandalwood.  The fragrance of this is disappointing.  I can smell a slight presence of sandalwood but there is also something added that turned my nose off.  The unscented is neutral.  I prefer the chemical composition of cedar wood, vanilla, and sweet orange.Each bottle has a built-in dropper.  The dropper design is not pipette tipped but with a small circular tip.  I guess this is their way of measuring a dab of oil.I dropped a small quantity of sandalwood on my skin to test.  I felt a warm sensation at the beginning.  After a minute I felt a need to scratch my skin.  Hmmm, something in this oil my skin is complaining for.  I will not use this for my mustache since the skin around my lips is more sensitive.I cut my hair short and sometimes I can see that it needs moisturizer.  I may repurpose this beard oil for that.

source_doc: Worth the price. I hate chapped lips but I'm particular in what I want in my chapstick. Yes, it's cool that treat beauty offers cool flavor options and I really like the gummy bear flavor. However, there are other qualities in a chapstick that I find more important. 1) I hate when you apply chapstick and then it leaves a residual chemical/chapstick flavor on your lips. I am happy to report that this chapstick doesn't do that. It's slightly sweet, but not with a weird chemical taste. 2) I hate reapplying chapstick every 30 minutes or so. For me a good chapstick will linger on your lips until you eat. I drink water throughout the day and I don't want to reapply chapstick every time I take a sip of water. Yes, I know it will wear off, but a good chapstick wear off slower. This is a good chapstick by my standards.Added bonuses are the variety of flavors, cute packaging and huge size. I just ordered more from the treat beauty website because my daughter loves the gummy bear flavor and I told her she could have it.

source_doc: Fine 4 daytime but will leak. I use these for daytime because I used them 1 time during the night and they leaked as though he didnt have one on at all. source_doc: Nice. I have lots of long thick hair.  I am particular about how I wash and dry it.  I didn't realize this was rectangular when I got it so when I opened it I was a little disappointed.  I've been using those ergonomic head-shaped twist ones for so long I was skeptical (you know, like turbie-twist).  So when I tried this I was really surprised.  It's really big and fluffy but it actually stays better up on my head than the contoured ones.  It isn't as heavy as it seems and it doesn't pull on my hair as tightly as the ones I was using before.  I actually get more volume in my hair with this because y hair isn't compacted down as tightly and it doesn't pull my hair backwards into a tight little towel.  It's a single piece of fabric with very tough elastic sewn onto it for your tuck.And as I discovered just the other day, if your kids spill a jug on the floor then use every bathroom towel to clean up their mess right before your shower, this towel wrap is big enough to dry your whole body, cover you as you duck down the hall and still dry enough to use on your hair afterwards.

source_doc: Very sturdy! I have high hopes for the longevity of this dish drainer. What do we moved to a smaller place I decided to use just a draining mat figuring I would roll it up between uses. So 2 and 1/2 years later there are still always dishes on the mat so I decided to just get an actual dish drainer like I should have done when we moved okay. It helped with the decision that every time my daughter's boyfriend helps wash dishes he breaks something from making a leaning Tower of Dishes.When I took this out of the box I was surprised and pleased at the weight of it.  There is no flex in it, the metal is strong and sturdy, stainless steel not plastic coated cheap metal.There is also the added advantage of extendable arms on either end so you can position it over to the sink to drain directly into the sink. I'm not sure I will use that aspect very often, but I am very pleased with this product.It is a little smaller than I expected, but that's on me because I didn't check the measurements before I ordered. Just a heads up to check the dimensions.The only thing that I don't love is that the silverware caddy is a bit shallow.Great product, highly recommend!!

source_doc: Very easy install. I purchased this timer from a local store, just because I was afraid it wouldn't work and could take back. With that being said, this 62 year old female who is not an electrician had no trouble installing this switch. It helped that whoever did the original wiring had the box nice and neat. The only thing I had to figure out was which black wire was the load wire that you connect to the red on switch. Planned on using my tester, but it no longer worked. So I did the next thing I saw when googled. It was the wire that came in from top of box. Wasn't sure I was right, but figured if I was wrong all I had to do was change around. Turned power back on and it worked!!! The worse part was connecting the white to my whites, there were a lot wrapped up together, but I managed. Now for the operation of switch. The buttons are really tiny so not the easiest to push, but I use 40 minutes most of the time for after showering. Have it set so just push the big rocker switch and it starts on 40. You can easily override by pushing any other button. So didn't get 5 stars because of the button size, but I am otherwise very happy with this switch, better than leaving fan on all day cause forgot to shut off.

source_doc: The Strings I Didn’t Know I Couldn’t Live Without. When I first tried these strings I was highly skeptical because they are a fairly heavier gauge than I’ve always used on my stringed instruments.  But when I started playing a friend’s guitar I noticed quickly how incredibly BEND-Y they are!!!  It’s honestly hard to describe how smooth these strings feel.  I ordered some and put them on my favorite Strat, and I loved them so much that they are now on almost every stringed instrument I own!  They last a really long time too because they are pure nickel.  I was ride or die for the vintage nickel fender strings for the longest, but these are BETTER.  I would recommend them to anyone for electric and acoustic stringed instruments.  I like to build and mod guitars for my friends sometimes and I always put these on and even include an extra set because as someone who’s been playing guitar for over 20 years, I want them to experience what I finally “discovered” a couple years ago.  As I mentioned, they last a really long time, but I still subscribe for a new set every month because I like to stock up and I have way too many instruments 🤣

source_doc: Incredible speaker cable. I was looking for a speaker cable for my system. I had a pair of basic Nordost, so I started looking cable from different companies, if you are looking for 10 awg cable 15 feet length price starts from 5000$ a pair from AudioQuest, Nordost Kimber Cardas etc. I always look to Amazon before I look elsewhere, and I found this 10 awg 15 feet cable. I said what the hack, I will give a try, only 70$ for a pair. OMG no other tweak made this much improvement in my system. I felt like I have new amplifier and speakers. Everything improved unbelievably. Base is tight, fast, accurate, mind blowing. Mids opened up, vocals clarified. Sound stage and dept improved. Layering widened. You can hear everything, every cymbal every note. This is really a remarkable cable. Literally saved me 5000$. I can say best cable for the price. You will not believe your ears.

source_doc: Excellent protection, no white cast, but sticky. I put Zinc Five-O Baby Mineral Sunscreen to the test against the mid-afternoon Arizona sun which is still super strong, even in winter. I can verify that it provides excellent sun protection with spf 50. Considering it is a zinc product I was surprised it didn't leave that tell-tale white cast that nobody likes but everybody puts up with to get that great protection. The product is thick, non-irritating, and has no real scent to speak of. After applying, it doesn't absorb into the skin (typical of zinc sunscreens), but it leaves a somewhat oily and sticky film that I found super annoying. Because it was a windy day, my long hair was blowing around and sticking to nearly every surface that I had applied sunscreen to. I also had some blowing sand and dirt stick to my arms. Despite this, the sunscreen provided excellent protection for the entire 60 minutes that I was outdoors. The second time I used it, I applied the product only to my face and neck and I followed up the application with a face powder to cut the stickiness, which seemed to do the trick. Because this is a sunscreen for babies, I imagine parents could apply corn starch afterwards if they find the stickiness to be problematic. I, however, will save this product for use poolside this summer because it provides excellent protection and that is really what is important.

Я могу подтвердить, что он обеспечивает отличную защиту от солнца с SPF 50. Учитывая, что это средство с цинком, я был/а удивлен/а, что оно не оставило того самого характерного белого налета, который никто не любит, но с которым все мирятся ради хорошей защиты. source_doc: Cleans well, no water splashes. This mop cleans well. I wasn't sure if water would be splashing all over with the spinning of the mop head but it doesn't, it is contained in the bucket. I like that this comes with so many microfiber mop heads so I can keep some in rotation until I wash the used ones. It is fairly simple to use once assembled, you just have to flip the lever one way when you are mopping and the opposite way when you are spinning the mop. There is no foot pedal like on the original spin mop, this one works by pushing on the metal pole after you flip the lever to rotate the head that you put in place in the metal basket. The basket, mop head and handle spin and the water splashes out of the holes in the basket into the pail. The only thing I don't like is that as I was mopping I kept scraping the floor with the mop as the microfiber yarns moved to the side, I think they need to be a little shorter and fuller because I don't like the feel or sound of that. It also comes with a scrubber brush that you can attach, instead of the microfiber head, which I have not tried yet.This mop cleans well and I like the color too.

source_doc: Everyone should have one of these. I went out Christmas Eve (Subzero temps outside) to go to my bother's house and my car didn't start. Fortunately I was home and my neighbor was able to help me. I realized that I didn't want to depend on someone else to keep my car running  so I ordered this. The day after I got this I went out again (now much warmer) and my car wouldn't start again.  I hooked this up, turned it on and my car started right up. It was easy to use and its great peace of mind to know I'm safe if this happens when I am out and about. This is something everyone needs in their car but especially women.  My only "complaint"  is I wish the cables were just a few inches longer. This would make the hook up a little easier.  I have tried several other brands that had good ratings and they didn't work.  This one is great!

source_doc: Awesome keyboard for those that loved the IBM Model M. I have been looking for a new keyboard for a while. I have been using a Logitech model that supported 3 computers. It was OK, but the keys were very mushy. I downsized to one computer so I thought why not switch to a new keyboard too. I knew I wanted something similar to my old beloved IBM Model M keyboard, but something without the large size and also had wireless capabilities. After MUCH searching for a decent mechanical keyboard, I focused on the Royal Kludge models. Mostly for the excellent price, as some mechanical keyboards can be costly. I got the 90% model, and I couldn't be happier. The feel is very similar to the Model M, but definitely quieter (although not exactly silent.) What I love most besides the feel is the magnetically attached wrist rest. That feature alone is pretty neat. There are plenty of other options I have yet to explore of fully utilize, such as the lighting of the keyboard. I have yet to play with many of the key mappings either. But I mostly just type, so these features aren't very important to me. Note: I am running Linux (Pop! OS to be specific), and the keyboard works great with Linux out of the box.

source_doc: Sounds Great in the Mix. First, please know that I'm not a great drummer- basic beats, keep it simple, minimal kit, that sort of thing. But I've been singing, guitaring, and songwriting in bands for 25 years, and I'm also a studio engineer, so I know what I like when it comes to how cymbals sound. I recently bought this Wuhan Crash Ride to round out my own small kit for jamming with my buddies, and I didn't really think it was going to be anything special for the money... to me it seemed like buying a Squire rather than a Fender. I do have to say, though, after hearing this thing in a pretty decent live recording of a show we played the other night, I really dig it. It sits in the mix just right, lots of dark wash but not so much sustain that it takes over past where it should fade out. I have a more traditional ride (Zildjian vintage blah blah) that I like, so the Wuhan functions as a crash... but I do find myself riding it a bit, especially on louder songs where I want it to really cut. I love it when the affordable option turns out to be really fun and sounds great.

source_doc: Advantage 2 For some reason my indoor cats keep getting plagued with fleas (my BFF thinks it's from the vet). I ordered Advantage 2 for my socialized cats and for my ferals I ordered an oral medication. Once I put the Advantage 2 on my adults, shortly afterwards I started noticing that one of my cats started scratching alot less. He seemed to be the one most plagued anyway. I read from another reviewer that it will take a while to break the cycle. In the meanwhile make sure all laundry is done, floors are cleaned, etc. I don't have rugs, so that's a plus. I use blue Dawn to mop my floors (it kills the fleas on contact). I just recently bought RAID for fleas too. Seems that it kills fleas on contact according to another reviewer (I agree. No sooner I sprayed the RAID I noticed that the fleas stopped biting.) Will be spraying all surfaces that I can't wash. It surely pays to read other reviews!! You learn alot from it. I don't buy anything unless it's a 4.5 stars review or better.UPDATE: 2 weeks later and I see my cats scratching again. I'm disappointed 😞.

source_doc: I Love This Shampoo! I am always hesitant about purchasing beauty products online. I stumbled across this Biotin because I was looking for something with a nutritional value instead of just stripping my hair of oils. I had been using Suave for years and noticed my hair was breaking much more. My hairdresser recommended that I get away from shampoos with sulfates. I switched the following week and I noticed a HUGE different in my hair feel, texture and VOLUME! I have received so many compliments on how healthy my hair looks. The only thing I changed was the shampoo. The video shows a guy squeezing a lot of shampoo on his head. My hair length is below my shoulders and I only use about the size of dimer amount. A little goes a long way.I have been convinced that this is the only shampoo for me. I will be adding the conditioner to the hair care lineup.

source_doc: Perfect for small pet food cans. The wet food that I feed my cats comes in small cans and these lids are perfect for saving any leftovers in the refrigerator. They fit perfectly and create a good seal which keeps my refrigerator from smelling like cat food. They’re very easy to wash with soap and hot water. I believe they can even go in the dishwasher but I’ve never tried it. I just wash them when I wash the cat food dishes every night. I’ve had these for nearly a year and they still look and work like they did when I first used them. I highly recommend them for any pet owner that needs to save leftovers.I should mention that I took one of these over to my Mom’s house after Thanksgiving because she wanted a top for leftover canned cranberry jelly (you know the type of gross wobbly cranberry stuff in a can that is somehow a staple of Thanksgiving every year) and she hasn’t returned it because she really likes it. I can’t fault her for that so I guess I really should buy another pack of two. Life is easier when you have more than one of these so I suppose what I’m trying to say is that you should buy more than you think you need. :)
hypos: Идеально подходит для маленьких банок с кормом для домашних животных. Влажный корм, которым я кормлю своих кошек, выпускается в маленьких баночках, и эти крышки идеально подходят для хранения остатков в холодильнике. Они сидят идеально и создают хорошую герметичность, благодаря чему в моем холодильнике не пахнет кошачьим кормом. Их очень легко мыть мылом и горячей водой. Думаю, их можно мыть даже в посудомоечной машине, но я никогда не пробовал/а. Я просто мою их каждый вечер вместе с мисками для кошачьего корма. Они у меня уже почти год, и они до сих пор выглядят и работают так же, как когда я использовал/а их в первый раз. Я настоятельно рекомендую их любому владельцу домашнего животного, которому нужно сохранять остатки еды. Стоит упомянуть, что после Дня благодарения я отвез/ла одну из этих крышек маме, потому что ей нужна была крышка для оставшегося консервированного клюквенного желе (ну, вы знаете этот тип противной дрожащей клюквенной массы в банке, которая почему-то каждый год является главным блюдом на День благодарения), и она до сих пор ее не вернула, потому что она ей очень нравится. Я не могу винить ее за это, так что, думаю, мне действительно стоит купить еще одну упаковку из двух штук. Жизнь становится проще, когда у тебя есть больше одной такой штуки, поэтому, полагаю, я пытаюсь сказать, что вам следует покупать больше, чем, как вы думаете, вам нужно. :)

source_doc: Super soft exactly what I was looking for. I bought this bc I have a hole in one of the cushions of my couch and I just don't have the money to buy a new couch. Anyway. This cover is really nice. It feels super soft like a brand new couch and super stretchy. I got a large for my couch and I think I could've used an extra large since my cushions are very big. I'm 8 months pregnant and i got it on by myself in maybe 10 minutes after I figured out how it was supposed to go. It's mostly walking circles around your couch pulling on it until it doesn't look weird. I also obviously didn't care too much about that, it covered a hole. I got black because it was the cheapest, if you don't like obvious pet hair or dirt marks, obviously black is a bad choice for you, be aware of that. Overall it's super nice and I'll probably buy more to keep rotating until I can buy a new one but I'm super happy with this. I haven't tried the water resistant factor but even if it's not, I'm not mad about it.

source_doc: If you have a UV manicure light, you need these gloves! I am not one to get my nails done frequently. But since my daughter got a UV light and some gel nail polish she's been doing my nails. The one thing I noticed was that I could almost feel the skin in my hands shriveling while under the UV light. Okay really more like sunburn, but all the time I was thinking, "that can't be good!"  It bothered me so much that I bought some cheap fingerless manicure gloves to use when she did nails. When I saw these pop up as available on Vine I grabbed them. I'm really glad I did because they are night and day compared to the other ones. I mean the other ones do the job but these ones look, and feel, and are constructed so much better. This seams on these ones are secure. There's better movement because each finger has an inset sewn into it which creates more flexibility. This seams on the inside are soft and non irritating. The material is a much better quality. Plus, how cute are those adorable little doggies!I am so glad I chose these, I would buy them again and recommend it them wholeheartedly.

source_doc: Haven't even had it 3 months... This mattress was great at first, but I got it for my son on November 14th for his Graco Solano crib. I loved that I didn't have to purchase a protective cover for it, as the material covering the foam allowed me to wipe it clean easily. But this is a terrible mattress for toddlers - for infants, it should be fine. My son is 16 months old and is walking around and loves to jump like a maniac in his crib. He grabs the side and goes to town like it's a trampoline. This mattress was not made with that thought in mind, as you can clearly see in the pictures that it busted open. I was getting my son ready for a bath and put him in the crib stark naked for only a moment, and he proceeded to immediately pee on the mattress. I figured, no big deal, I could just wipe it clean after his bath and change the sheets while he played in his playpen. When I removed the sheet, I saw the damage, and he happened to have peed over the hole and the urine had been absorbed by the foam. Now I have a peed on mattress whose inside I cannot clean, and I'm not about to let my son sleep on a mattress that is damaged and unsanitary. I will just have to purchase a different mattress that possibly requires a mattress protector.

source_doc: Awesome 8 inch stainless steel fry pan. I have been looking for a well built 8 inch stainless steel fry pan. I did not want something heavy and it had to have a sturdy handle. I came across a company named Babish that has everything from pots & pans to knives & cooking utensils. I noticed they had a 8 inch tri-ply stainless steel frying pan. When reading all the information about the pan, I decided to give it a try. Upon receiving my pan I could not get over how light it was which I loved. The handle fit so well in my hand. I knew right then I had made the right choice. I also liked the fact it was dishwasher safe, but they recommended hand washing which was fine with me. I read the information that came with the pan on how to clean your pan before you use it for the first time. Upon cleaning the pan I decided to give it a try. I fixed one of the best veggie omelette I have ever made. The pan cooks so evenly-no hot spots. I let the pan cool before I washed it. Clean up was a breeze. I am so happy with my pan, I am planning on ordering more items. I would HIGHLY recommend this pan. It exceeded my expectations.

source_doc: Make the clay bar process much easier. So when I picked up my car from an overnight stay at the service center, I was beyond livid.  Some ‘genus’ left my pristine black car parked by their sprinklers and it left horrible water spots.  After the tried to wash them off with no success, I took it home expecting a long tedious day of detailing to try to get my paint back to normal.  While I know that using a clay bar does not usually remove water spots, I decided to try these clay mitts anyway because nothing else was really working.  I made sure to keep the area of the paint and the clay mitt well lubricated with the aerocosmetics wash/wax spray I use.  I used no pressure because Tesla black paint scratches extremely easily.  After two times, the spots were almost gone - even the deep ones.  I then used a polish to make sure I had not swirl marks and now my car looks even better than it did before.  The process took a fraction of the time I expected to spend.  The quality of the Ragnify Clay Mitts are really good and saved my paint.

source_doc: Awful Taste, no noticeable positive results.... I bought these, despite the reviews on how bad they taste.  I thought I could hold my breath and chew it.  I was wrong.  These are the worst thing I have ever tasted (vanilla probably makes it worse) and they do clump up in your teeth.  I barely got one down and would not try a second.  I blended two more to a smoothy and drank it (in the evening).  I have to admit, I slept quite well that night, but no help after that.I then ended up crushing the rest with a meat tenderizer and put them into capsules myself.  I had to take quite a few at once, but I could swallow them.  I did not notice any improvement with sleep, anxiety or energy after taking it this way.  I will not buy again, as I am not convinced they help with any of the things I needed them for.I would like to add that my not liking this particular product would not prevent me from purchasing from Dr. Berg's shop in the future.  I trust his advise completely and get a lot of valuable information out of his videos.

source_doc: Please save yourself the trouble and just skip this one! I can't make this up, I had to buy this headset 4 times before it actually shipped. Not just Amazon, I tried GameStop as well, twice. It didn't ship out until about 2 weeks and when I FINALLY got it I find out all these headsets are BROKEN! Always check Reddit first!!! You can't trust ppl on Amazon or YouTube because they're paid to LIE! I use a stealth 700 and it's not perfect but atleast it WORKS. Not only was the mic completely trash out the box, and I mean like did not work, constant buzz, voice going in and out. I tried messing with settings, restarting it, using the app on PC, Mobile, and Xbox. None fixed the issue. But also I must mention the awful sound connectivity as well. When you speak into the headset the audio starts going in and out and sometimes completely out, you cant hear your game, your music, or your party. The colors are pretty but not at the cost of being able to actually USE the damn thing! What a joke, I really did expect better of Razor. If you like razor I suggest you bite the bullet and use a wired headset. The Kaira Pro is completely unusable and a huge waste of money, will be returning it shortly.

source_doc: great buy. this was a good purchase. i covered my car and got about 4-5 inches of snow in upstate NY. i used my joe snow brush and the snow fell off effortlessly. and then i uncovered my car and it was clean and ready to go. it was about 34 degrees out and i didnt need to heat the car up before i pulled off. this is great and i cant wait for it to snow harder (yes i can) so that i can put this baby to work. the only downside is after storage. it was still wet and i didnt have a practical place to store it, im in an apartment. i balled it up and threw it in my room. its not saturated but was still wet enough that i wish i has somewhere to hang it. it does come with a bag to hold, once dry its a great addition. overall happy with it. and it fit my mercedes cla perfect and came with a lock but i didn’t need it since i just use it for overnight snow falls.

source_doc: One glaring issue for my instance. I really like this. My only issue that I ran into was corrosion on the battery whip side. They do not have any sort of protective heat shrinking where the wire is crimped to the metal connector. I mounted my quick connect to the front diver side of the bumper of my truck this past June and it corroded this winter. I live in Western NY where road salt was certainly a factor. I bought loom to encase the wires and taped it but, never looked at the original wires at the connection point. Luckily, I had enough extra wire that I was able to cut off the corroded wire and I soldered new connections, put dielectric grease on the area where the wires were reconnected and then used heat shrink over the section where the new connection was made. source_doc: Great for smaller mums but. So after almost a month trying this product, I have a love hate relationship with this item. It runs on USB-C which is great since i bought a power bank to charge these on the go after I used them.  It's easy to clean.  I use odorless baby bottle soap to clean it so it's not masked with heavy soap oder.Now like others have mentioned, its not very quiet. I mean I really don't mind, but if a baby is sleeping and baby is sensitive to noise then it's an issue. Also I'm a 36FF. After trial and error 6 bras, ace bandage and even trying a corset I couldn't accommodate the product to stay on my chest. I feel this product is more accommodating to small/med chested women. I even tried to micky mouse and place a different suction funnel to it to accommodate my large chest but to no avail.So I had a friend use it for her new baby and it helps her. She's a 36B and it works perfectly for her which is why I'm fine and love the product because it's helping a another mum. To avoid milk spillage we had to get a big bowl and then funneled the bottles which was just too much.Overall I give the product a 3/5
hypos: Отлично подходит для мам с меньшим размером груди, но... Итак, спустя почти месяц использования этого продукта, у меня сложились двоякие чувства к этому товару. Он работает от USB-C, что здорово, так как я купил/а внешний аккумулятор, чтобы заряжать его на ходу после того, как использовал/а. Его легко чистить. Я использую детское мыло для бутылочек без запаха, чтобы помыть его, так что он не пахнет резким мылом. Как уже упоминали другие, он не очень тихий. В принципе, я не против, но если ребенок спит и он чувствителен к шуму, то это проблема. Кроме того, у меня размер 36FF. После проб и ошибок с 6 бюстгальтерами, эластичным бинтом и даже попытки примерить корсет, я так и не смог/ла приладить это устройство, чтобы оно держалось на моей груди. Мне кажется, этот продукт больше подходит женщинам с маленьким или средним размером груди. Я даже пытался/лась смастерить что-то на ходу и прикрепить другую всасывающую воронку под мою большую грудь, но безуспешно. В итоге я отдал/а его подруге для ее новорожденного, и ей он помогает. У нее размер 36B, и ей он подходит идеально, поэтому я рад/а и люблю этот продукт, ведь он помогает другой маме. Чтобы избежать проливания молока, нам приходилось использовать большую миску, а затем переливать в бутылочки, что было слишком хлопотно. В целом я ставлю продукту 3/5

source_doc: Okay cheap grinder. I've been getting into whole bean coffee here recently and I wanted something that I could fine-tune better than an electric grinder so I got this.  It came packaged just fine and I didn't see any defects or dings on the grinder.  It is basically 3 main pieces the handle which has a plastic knob, the grinder which has all the guts, and the collection bin which catches your grounds.  I got a whole bean that I hadn't tried before and loaded it up and got to grinding.  The grinding while okay didn't feel that great and I had to put a bit more muscle behind it than I had to for my other grinder.  Cleaning it was a breeze, it says not to get it wet so I took it most way apart (I left the grinder guts in) and took my electronic duster, and just blew it out.  For how cheap this is it does its job well I'll probably take this one with me when I go on trips because if it gets lost or broken eh no big deal, but if you want one for home I would spend a couple of bucks more.

source_doc: Wish I got this fan sooner! This fan was a little bit larger than I had expected. It is still a small handheld fan but definitely bigger than the ones we used to take to theme parks when we were younger.The battery life seems pretty decent. As I was trying it out I kept it running in my kitchen while I was cooking and it ran until I turned it off with no decrease in the air flow.I love the fact that you can bend the legs to wrap around and hook onto things so it’s pretty versatile where you can use it. When I first turned it on, I thought the power was pretty low, but there are actually three settings, and the speed does turn up.I wish I would’ve had this last summer for my newborn son at the time when we went to a theme park! This truly works great and I am excited to hook it onto the stroller this summer for walks, or even set it up outside while the kids play. Not only was a well packaged, but I love the fact that it is rechargeable and it really does seem like it’s of decent quality.

source_doc: Best Travel Acoustic. Great Sound. I am planning a trip and I have my guitar, as I will be playing for a family gathering outside.  So, I need to travel on an airplane with it.  I need portability to the outside venue and I need a good sound.  After reading so many reviews, and looking at options for several hours, I finally decided on the Mark III.  I received it yesterday.  I have been playing it for several hours and I have to say, I love this guitar.  If you plug into a decent amp, the sound is great.  It does not have the full sound of my Fender.  It's a solid body, and it's better than I expected.  Also, it feels the same. With headphones, it is very quiet. I highly recommend the Mark III.  I am also using the Donner Mini Guitar Amp for portability.

source_doc: Initial thoughts are good. I went from a hard folding cover to this one due to the weight of taking the cover on and off. I just always kept the hard cover on but I bought an ATV that will be riding in the bed of the truck. I like having something over the bed when driving around. I've never had a soft cover before, but that was the only option to get away from the weight. I went with this one as I needed the bed rails free for a removable rack I use with the tonneau. This one sits nice and flush. The only reason I took a star is the cover is completely flat, it has some ripples in it that run the length of the bed. I'm thinking this will probably settle, but for now I'm taking a star. The only other slight issue is the front clips are harder to snap in place than I expected. Again, I think this will probably resolve once it's been installed a while.Update: Had to return it. Maybe it's the tailgate mat I have installed or the way it fits on the rails, but the tailgate hits on the rail and makes it really hard to close. I have the rail all the way forward and it's still hitting on the drivers side. I can close it, but it's much harder.

Раньше я просто никогда не снимал/а жесткую крышку, но я купил/а квадроцикл, который буду возить в кузове грузовика. Мне нравится, когда кузов чем-то прикрыт во время поездок. source_doc: Unable to assemble. Requires much more strength than I have. Impossible to turn screws into place. I really wanted to be able to use this product. I was excited when it arrived to discover that it is a much more sturdy and heavy duty metal construction than I had expected, and tried to assemble it immediately so that I could start using it. Unfortunately, i was unable to assemble it. I started by following the instructions which showed how to screw the first standing rod to the cross bar that the tp roll slides onto. I spent more than 20 minutes trying to get that one screw in place but it was not possible for me. It requires much more strength than I have. The screw did not seem to properly fit into the hole it was supposed to be screwed into. They provide a lever to use to screw it in more tightly. But it didn't work. I tried and tried but was unable to get it to budge no matter how much strength and force I applied. I was finally forced to give up. Bummer. IF u can find some strongman with way more strength than I have who can actually get the parts screwed together into their proper place, I would think it would provide u with a useful and durable stand/storage for your TP. Good luck with that.

source_doc: Two months later I finally got this device to work! Update January 29th, 2023. Since I could not get this device to work a month ago, I ordered another brand and had the same issue. However, with the new device I accidently figured out how to fix the issue, so I thought I would try those same steps on this device and it work!Before I go into the fix, I wanted to use this mic to record math lessons on an iPad. After attempting to record the lessons, I could not hear any audio on the playback. Obviouly I need the audio to work during a math lesson. To fix this issue, I first had to remove the receiver of this device before the playback, then I had to swipe down from the top of the screen (I discovered this accidently) on the two different iPads I tried this device on.If this device adverstises it can be used to make recordings, maybe the manufacturors should consider including better documentation on use of the device, including playing back the recordings.

source_doc: Batteries. So far I do like this wet vac. I've discovered that if I don't run a dust mop over the floors first, the "suction pipe needs cleaning" command is given. If I dust mop first, I totally avoid needing to stop, dump dirty water, flush out dirty water tank, and then resume. If I don't dust mop first, I need to rinse the "suction pipe" maybe 4-5 times. After self-cleaning, I do take a rag and hand dry the rollers, they're pretty wet! Also, I find every time that there's material that needs to be wiped out of the roller compartments, and where outlet where the dirty water is conduited into the suction pipe of the dirty water chamber. I have a question in to the seller as to how to change out the rechargeable batteries. I looked everywhere, called Amazon, and they gave me a link to do this. All that being said...it's STILL steps above my old mop and pail! I am not regretting the purchase, which was made a couple of months ago...
