source_doc: Excellent product. I purchased this product in hopes it would help with scratch marks from my English Bulldog jumping on and off my large leather sectional couch. I had read all the reviews and decided to give it a try. I am so glad I did, I followed one of the reviews given by GingerInkc and did one section at a time using microfiber cloths to put the product on using circular motion. When dried I went over the area with a barely damp microfiber cloth...(I forgot to mention before starting this project I used my leather cleaner to clean the sectional). I finished with the leather conditioner provided in kit. I wish I had taken before pictures but l didnt. I can tell you my leather sectional looks brand new!!! I too had only used maybe a third of the of the coloring balm if that! A little amount goes s long way! Very pleased with this product!!By By scratches!

source_doc: Condominium life assurance. I live in a condo and one thing I learned FAST was that pug + beagle + separation anxiety = howling and barking all day.  I've tried the citronella collars, thunder shirts, and standard bark collars but keep on the lookout for something that's user friendly and effective.This was priced right where I look for and seemed to have a nice interface.  I don't use it often but when I do, I know whether or not it's working thanks to doggy cams.  I like that I can disable shock mode - usually the vibration are enough to correct the barking and even the beeping is a good warning that a vibration is next.  I also like that unlike other collars I know when I should charge it before it dies on me.  It's good looking and effective and has a bunch of little features like longer prongs and prong covers.It worked for my dog without hurting him so yes it's been a game changer for me.

Playing this is my decompression after a long day.

source_doc: Pretty good just watch out for the fleshy parts of your feet they can get caught. I have intermittent dry soles on my feet where I can just peel strips off (woo boy this review started well)  so I got this to help me get all that gunk off my feet.  It comes with the machine, 3 heads, and a charger (a double barrel charger I wish it was USB c but oh well).  The first charge took about 2 hours so that wasn't too bad.  Before I fired this up I looked at it and it has a small flashlight on the bottom so I guess that's good if you are working on your feet in the dark.  It has 3 speeds 0 (does not move), 1 (goes at a decent clip, and 2 (really gets going.  I decided since it was my first rodeo to use 1.  IT works pretty well and stripped the dead skin off but I did notice if I got to a fleshier part of my foot it could catch and that didn't feel the greatest.  I chalk that up to my not being careful.  All in all, if you are looking for a way to pamper your feet or just take off dead skin this works pretty well.

source_doc: Do not use two days in a row when starting out. I have fairly sensitive skin, and was careful when reading the directions about applying daily. I tend to get milia under my eyes, my cheeks and chin so I was hoping this would keep it from developing. I used the first day and had no issues so I thought I was safe to use it again the second. Again, I was ok. Third day, I was working out and sweating quite a bit when I felt my face start to burn. It was annoying but nothing alarming. I immediately thought of the retinoid. I took a shower and washed my face. Afterward it was burning so so bad. Even applying my regular moisturizer stung. The next day I realized it had completely destroyed my t zone. The corners of my mouth, under my eyes and nose were so raw and peeling. Even applying light make up hurt so bad. It’s been three days and I am still trying to put as much moisturizer on my face as possible just to get it back to normal. I hate to completely bash a product that may be a god send to someone else. It’s just not for me and I highly advise not using it daily in the beginning even it feels fine.

source_doc: Awesome product for the $18 I spend for it. Especially since I have a 44 oz thermos. This was one of the few insulated pocket carriers for drinks that I could find in the 44 oz plus. The short story is at my local Ross I bought a number of drinking thermoses because I do a lot of rollerblading, hiking, and outdoor activities. Yet, it's rare that I can find an insulated carrying case for such drink containers. I felt very fortunate when I found this particular product for its price. I appreciated this product so much that I purchased one for a friend and gave it to them for Christmas and I purchase one more for myself so that I had one on my camping bag and one on my rollerblading bag to carry my insulated drinking container.

source_doc: Not as advertised plus pickup did not work. I ordered list item based on the pictures that show it has the built in tuner with bass, mid and hi controls- the item came without the advertised electronics - what arrived had a volume and tone controls- what is worse that when I plugged it into a Fishman Model G preamp even with all volume controls at full, there was barely any signal - not enough to be useable- so I returned it with comments as to why it was unacceptable- I received the replacement and it had the sale controls as the one I returned - the replacement also did not have a useable output - I returned the replacement as well - I also purchase an Eastroc tenor ukulele with the same electronics as advertised by Vanphy for the concert ukuleles I returned - the Eastroc tenor has great output and plays well- the vanphy ukuleles came with an Eastroc tagOther then the unusable pickup and controls- the vanphy concert ukulele looks amazing, is well built with great fit and finish and it plays well and sounds great acoustically - if I could get this vanphy concert ukulele with the pickup and controls as advertised - the same system as the Eastroc tenor I bought - I would buy the vanphy otherwise forget about the vanphy if you desire to plug it in

source_doc: Made a believer out of me! I've been dealing with dry feet, cracked heels since I was a teenager. Pedicurists would make comments, get me to go for the premium service every time. I got this product to try but honestly with very low expectations. Nothing else did any good.With book in hand, I sat on the edge of the tub with my feet in the pouches filled with the solution for a good hour.  I took care to follow the instructions carefully. Over the next few days, I soaked my feet daily in warm/hot water for 10 minutes each night.Since it's winter, I have my feet in socks most of the time.Photos are unaltered and with no filters.My feet because even drier and cracked looking. I never had big pieces falling off or peeling off.  I just kept my feet in socks most of the time since I didn't want skin flakes all over the place.Two week after the fact, I went to get a pedicure and the pedicurist DID NOT comment about how dry my feet were nor did she ask about an upgrade from the basic service. She used a pumice stone to de-skin as usual. These "after" photos were taken after the pedicure and a warm bath.AMAZING!!!Still have another set that I can use later.

source_doc: Well worth the price! I love everything about this slim eyeliner by Eco Soul! Since I have aged, eyeliner has become more difficult to apply. It is either too thick or too thin going across my eyelids as they seem to have become “bumpy” as I have gotten older. I also tend to have watery eyes for no apparent reason and my eyeliner will run. None of these prior problems with eyeliner has occurred with the new Eco Soul Super Slim Eyeliner.  The eyeliner applies very smoothly without tugging and I can have a very thin line, or bolder if I choose without any struggle. I love being able to just twist the tube just a little to get the point come out further when needed. I have not noticed any loss of my eyeliner when my eyes water as it stays put all day until I remove it at night. I especially appreciate the brown color of the eyeliner as it is more subtle than a harsh black. I am really enjoying using this new powerproof slim eyeliner and I would definitely recommend this to any age, but especially to older women who struggle with eyeliner.

source_doc: Looks can be deceiving.... I really hate this clock.I'll start with what I like about it (which isn't much).It looks beautiful, very elegant and classy. Nice and large, easy to see from a distance.It keeps the perfect time. Doesn't make a sound.That's it. That's all I like.Now what I hate about this thing...It's super flimsy! I thought it might shatter just by putting two AA batteries in it.It's made of acrylic which is no big deal, it just makes it really lightweight. I doubt anyone who sees it on your wall would know that it wasn't real wood, but still feels like cheap plastic to me.The pendulum.... ohemgeeeee I really HATE that thing! It doesn't move AT ALL! I have tried everything under the sun to get that thing moving and nope, it just sits there staring at me like it's claimed it's victory by not budging. It honestly makes no sense, it only goes on there one way. And the pendulum is the only metal component in this clock. Everything else is plastic.Overall, it makes me mad just looking at it. I'm glad I got it on the vine because I definitely wouldn't have paid $50 for it. That would have been an instant return! It's all plastic, super flimsy, but looks really nice and does keep time. That's the only reason I gave it two stars. You can definitely find something much nicer for the same price elsewhere.
hypos: Внешность бывает обманчива... Я просто ненавижу эти часы. Начну с того, что мне в них нравится (этого немного). Они выглядят красиво, очень элегантно и стильно. Хорошие и большие, их легко увидеть издалека. Они показывают абсолютно точное время. Не издают ни звука. Вот и все. Это все, что мне нравится. Теперь о том, что я в них ненавижу... Они суперхрупкие! Мне показалось, что они могут расколоться, просто когда я вставлял/а две батарейки типа АА. Они сделаны из акрила, в чем нет ничего страшного, просто это делает их очень легкими. Сомневаюсь, что кто-то, кто увидит их на вашей стене, поймет, что это не настоящее дерево, но для меня они все равно ощущаются как дешевый пластик. Маятник... о божеееее, я просто НЕНАВИЖУ эту штуку! source_doc: Did not work with my cats. I have a 10 year old cat and just adopted a kitten. I was hoping the Relaxavet would help ease the transition while they got used to each other. If this calmed my cat down, then I don't want to know what she would have been like. After I unplugged them, I saw no change in her behavior.I've used Feliway in the past for different situations, but thought I would give a different product a try. I can't say if the Feliway would have been better, I did not switch. I just stopped using the Relaxavet when I felt it wasn't working.Fact is that she is slowly (very slowly) adjusting to the kitten's presence. I even noticed her playing with him the other day when she thought I wasn't looking. So I think the real solution here is time.

source_doc: FINALLY a diffuser I love. I have been on the search for a diffuser I can really enjoy in my private practice.What I disliked in the past about other diffusers: I am extremely sound sensitive and smell sensitive. The plastic diffusers often have a weird chemically smell at some point. And other glass ones I have tried had this awful loud hum/screaming sounds that are hell for my sound hypersensitivity.Ok, enough of the negative - Here's why I love this diffuser: you can control the diffusion rate (HELLO! I LOVE THIS!!! Why isn't this standard?) //  I love how quiet it is. There's still sound, but it's so quiet, I really appreciate it/ / / lastly, NO chemical smell. I've wanted this particular diffuser for years now, I'm so glad I finally got it. I love it. My only complaint is that once my wife sees it, she'll want it too.

source_doc: Good fit but ear loops break through mask. Be sure you are carrying another mask! First impression: Great fit, love the chance to be able to tighten or loosen the ear loops. I was impressed enough to recommend this mask to several friends. Now I have to tell them about how the area where the loops go through needs to be reinforced by the company.  I really love this mask but now I have to carry others because the first one I used only 3 times failed.  I wasn't being forceful with tightening the loops. I saw it was somewhat iffy so I was careful. Put it on the 4th time and it immediately fell apart at the right ear loop. Luckily, I had another different kind in my purse so I wasn't left in the lurch. If they would reinforce the area where the loop goes through, this would be a 5 star mask for me. I was planning to take these on a cruise next month but will need to take the old kind also. I can't be without a mask. I usually will wear a mask 4 to 5 times depending on where I have been or the circumstances.

source_doc: Works great. I have several remote control switches and bulbs around the house.  I got this one for its small size.  I use it for my cordless phone.  I got this thing about rechargeable batteries.  I believe if you keep them on the charger they don't last long.  I have experienced this myself with power tools.  I want the batteries to last as long as possible so I charge them and then let them discharge to a point then recharge.  I am told this is not necessary but again, I have seen several devices die early on constant charge.  So I have this cordless phone on my landline and it is in a cradle and constantly charging.  I got this device and plugged the cradle into it.  When the phone  is charged, I turn off the device till it needs charging again and turn it on.  Very convenient.

source_doc: The company Graciously replaced my racquet. I really like the racket. It plays well. This racket was recommended to me and I love the way looked so I ordered it. I got it in September, but I didn’t begin playing until the second week of December of last year. I was playing yesterday and realized that it was beginning to tear away from the frame at the top of the handle. Today I was playing and it literally just shredded while I was playing and I had to go over and borrow someone else's  racket to finish the match. Even though I’ve only played with it a month and a half I am unable to return it because the window has closed. I loved playing with it and would’ve probably given it a five star at the beginning but, this is very sad because it was not cheap.UPDATE: I contacted the company about my racquet and they were very understanding and sent a replacement. After playing with it I can say that I like it. It feels good and has a comfortable grip. I'm hoping my first racquet flaw was just an isolated case.

source_doc: I put this thing through the ringer. Reviewing "Wahl Color Pro Cordless Rechargeable Hair Clipper & Trimmer – Easy Color-Coded Guide"I'm a gym rat / exercise buff with bodybuilding background that puts this thing to full-body use.  I've now bought four of these things over the past 3-5 years (same exact one I'm reviewing here), and it's fantastic.  I keep the blade cleaned and oiled, and I *always* keep a blade guard on it when not in use so as not to scratch or full the metal blades.  My main point is that if you take care of it, it will last pretty decently.  The reason I've bought four or five of these is because I use them like crazy (yes, full body shaving, including haircuts).  Compared to older products that I bought in my youth, I like the wide blade for greater surface area (faster job done), and the variety of guard sizes (as I also cut the kids' hair).  Oh, as to why I've bought several of these it's because they don't sell just replacement blades--at least not that I can find.  Therefore, for the cheap price, I just go ahead and buy a new one.  Anyway, I like them and recommend them.  If you're a professional barber, you probably would use something else, but I wanted battery powered so no cord.  I also try not to get water into the mechanism.

source_doc: MICROPHONE COMPLETELY UNDETECTABLE. Microphone is completely undetectable out the box! headset itself is perfectly fine, audio sounds real good but the microphone won’t work at all. source_doc: Wonderful! I absolutely love this product! The older I get the more trouble sleeping I seem to have. For the longest time I was taking an acetaminophen nighttime formula, but I was getting concerned about taking that every day and decided that it was time to try a melatonin supplement and I am so glad that I did! Not only are the gummies very tasty, but within 30 minutes of taking two of these at bedtime, I feel the need to sleep. Although there is a small amount of sugar in these gummies the sugar does not seem to bother me, and I am very sensitive to sugar especially when trying to sleep. Not only do I fall asleep faster, I stay asleep except for the occasional times I have to use the bathroom due to an “old age” bladder.  The jar is rather big as it contains 100 gummies. Suggested use is 2 gummies at bedtime so this jar will last me 50 days if I should need to use them every night.  From the makers of Nyquil, this formula works great for me, and I plan on having these in stock at my house for as long as they do.

Эта формула от создателей Nyquil отлично мне подходит, и я планирую всегда держать её в запасе дома, пока они её производят.

source_doc: Stay away unless you are short. I loved the way the windshield looked on my 2020 rebel 500 but, when I went above 50 mph the wind hitting my helmet made it vibrate so bad that it blurred my vision and gave me a headache. I tried different riding positions but nothing worked unless I stayed ducked down. I am only 5’8” so I’m not that tall to begin with. I tried to return the windshield and they declined the return stating that since I used the windshield they wouldn’t accept it back. I only had the windshield attached for one week So buyer Beware. If I was only riding in town and never over 50 mph then I would recommend it but since I am more of a daily driver going 40 miles one way and the average speed is 60 mph there is no way I would recommend this windshield to anyone. Plus I would not recommend this seller for any purchase since it looks like they will find any excuse to not refund. This is my two cents on this product so take it or leave it.

source_doc: Slight Odor in the Bags. I am not as impressed with this PAMI brand of gallon storage bags as I was with their quart-sized double lock bags.  There are 100 bags but NO twist ties were included with my order even though it states it on the box.  I have a ton of extra twist ties, so I moved on.  The bag is wider and shorter than my store bought ones.  So, it probably is still gallon sized.  I do like that the top is slightly uneven for easy opening.  I also like that there’s multiple suffocation warning prints on the front.Why did I give it 3 stars?  When I opened one to place prepared vegetables, I noticed a slight odor.  It’s not unpleasant or plasticky.  My store bought ones don’t have an odor.  Even though the bags are BPA-free, I decided to use it for storing non-food items, just to be safe.  For storing craft items, they are quite useful.  Each bag is about 8 cents, so twice as much as generic store-bought ones.  I would give it a resounding five stars, if it weren’t for the odor.

source_doc: Finally, I found the right ones! I was asked to find and order wind screens for the microphones in the drive-up window at the bank I work at.  I never thought it would be so difficult to find the right ones.  The mics we have are very old, so I wasn't like I could go to the manufacturers website and order replacements.  They don't make the model.  I Googled over and over and tried many different sites and searched on here.  Just measuring didn't do any good.  For one thing, the ones we had were missing the tops (did someone chew them off?) and they were stretched out, and it was hard to tell what size they really were.  I tried measuring the size of the mic and trying to figure out what would fit.  I looked at pictures, descriptions, measurements, all of it.  And I ended up with several purchases that didn't even come close. It seemed that most of what was out there was designed for lapel mics, which I guess would be very small, and gaming headsets, and most of those looked too big or two small. Finally I ordered these.  And they fit!  They seem nice, I mean they're just little pieces of foam-not much to screw up there.  Now I can quit looking and move on to the next odd thing they ask me to order.

source_doc: Versatile and the perfect size, I wish the keycaps were transparent. I really like this size in a portable keyboard. It's small enough that it'll fit easily in a backpack but big enough to have cursor and function keys. All it's missing is the number pad and I can always get a standalone one of those for the occasions that I need it.This keyboard connected very easily with the included cable, dongle and also over Bluetooth. I noticed no typing lag in any mode, but I wasn't using it to play games. The dongle slips into a little pocket underneath the keyboard to reduce the chance that it gets lost. The included instructions are brief but comprehensive.The keys feel great to type on. You can definitely tell you hit the key but it's not super loud like some other mechanical keyboards. The spacebar makes a different and louder sound, but I like that too.There are plenty of backlighting options, and the keyboard remembers the last one you set. My biggest complaint is that the keycaps are not transparent, so it's harder to identify the keys in the dark. A minor quibble is that I don't like the side-by-side notation for shifted keys, I prefer when the shifted key shows up over top of the non-shifted key.Overall, I think this is a great portable keyboard with a lot of versatility in connections. I only wish the keycaps were transparent.

source_doc: My dog started using this as a chew toy. I purchased this because slip leads seem to be recommended and my dog was pulling a lot. My adopted dog was like a completely different dog once out of the shelter. When I first saw her at the shelter, she was calm, no pulling whatsoever. I sign the papers and she immediately started pulling and running up to each thing.I noticed that the leash they use for the shelter dogs was a slip lead and the leash they give you upon adoption is a standard. I thought it must have something to do with the leash and ordered this one.While she walked better on this leash, she would also rile herself up and decide to start attacking it and playing tug of war. I saw a video on how to turn your slip lead into a harness - it worked better, but wasn't perfect. I ultimately switched to a short leash and harness because I can almost hold the leash loosely without problems with that combination. Even if I hadn't gone that way I wouldn't still be using this leash - someone else walked her for a few days with it and I didn't notice till later it has been chewed through - if she did decide to run I could not trust the leash in its current state to restrain her.

source_doc: Deathadder without the wire! I've tried different brands/models of mice but have cumulatively used a Deathadder for over 7 years. I've always been too scared to pull the trigger on wireless mice because I had a bad experience with one and I'm not a fan of charging things constantly but the feel, the performance, everything, is amazing. I absolutely love it! It's exactly like my Deathadder Elite but without the wire.The only thing I will say is that I was disappointed with the battery life. I game much anymore and just casually hang out on my computer on days off from work. I also have the power saving mode set to 5 minutes because I'll go AFK to clean or hang out with my dogs often, so I'm not using it a ton. I guess I just expected a little more. The product advertises a "70 hour life", which I know is on the high end, but I expected more. Overall, I love this mouse and don't mind charging it for the convenience of not having a wire anymore.

source_doc: Medical Esthetician’s Two Thumbs Up! I am a retired medical aesthetician with a license for 20 years! Believe me I am a skin care product junkie like none other than I do have to say this mask is a game changer! It might be a teensie  bit reactive to extremely sensitive skin but I believe some of the reviews here are from people who use skin care cleansers with ammonia, Laureth  sulfate which is extremely drying so when a product that is nourishing and cold is applied to the skin it can sting! I recommend a 5.5 pH balanced cleansing bar such as the one by 100 senses  or cleanser perhaps from JLo’s line about which I can’t say much I love you, because I haven’t used her cleansers! Regardless, hyper sensitive skin that is sensitized will always sting until rebalanced no matter what you use on it.Regardless, I have been using this mask consistently  since October 2022  and it’s now March 2023 and I will say consistency is truly key and will pay off! Unlike what the instructions on the mask say I rinse the serum off after doing a facial massage and apply my own serum, but I there’s an option to leave it on all night!  If you have a normal skin that is aging a highly recommend this mask, it truly is a game changer!

source_doc: English bully-approved. Great harness for English bullies.  Sizing is spot on, I got the large for my pups that range from 25.5-27 inches.  Quality is great too.  I do want to say that my bullies aren't 'pullers' and are pretty chill, so I can't say how durable it is in regards to more aggressive dogs.  But, I've taken them on their walks with this, and I don't feel like it may break or anything like that.  I have been using this harness for a few weeks now exclusively for one of my pups, and I haven't seen any fraying or rips on the harness.Most importantly, my pups like it.  They're pretty picky when it comes to harnesses, when they don't like one they make a point of running away when I would take ones they didn't like out, or try biting it off their bodies.  This one has passed all the tests!  One of my pups even TOOK A NAP with it on.The leash is just okay.  The handle is nice since it has the plastic piece, but I already have a leash that I like so I'm keeping this as a back up.  I mainly got this for the harness.It's a crazy good price, especially when you compare it to the name-brand ones.  This is a fraction of the price.  My pups and I are glad that I got it.

source_doc: I can't believe how cheap this was. Because it certainly doesn't feel or look cheap. It looks higher end than it is.I've been using it for a little while, before deciding to write a review, and I love it just as much now as when I first got it. The keys are clacky, in a pleasing textile-ish kind of way, if you like that, but also not obnoxiously loud at the same time. I did notice the space bar is a bit springier sounding than the other keys like others have said, but I honestly don't even think about it when I'm using it anymore. The contrast of the white keys against the stainless is very aesthetically pleasing. I wish it had dedicated volume buttons, but I'll live. Because the keys are raised, I find it very easy to dust when cleaning--it even includes a cleaning brush to get between the keys, which I thought was a nice touch. The different light modes are fun, though I usually just keep them stationary. It just makes my work area a little more playful, and I love that because it's so me. I don't know much about gaming keyboards or what actually makes a keyboard a **gaming** keyboard, so maybe those who are more hardcore might be able to pick it apart. But I bet a kid would absolutely love this. I'm 38 and I sure do!

source_doc: I like this shampoo...just one thing. I am very picky about shampoo, having been in the hair business all of my life. I am retired now and often try different shampoos. The shampoo I love from Neutrogena has been discontinued so I have been trying to find another I like. I do like the Biolage shampoo, but have a hard time finding the genuine kind. So I decided to try this. I do like it. I will probably get it again. However, I typically wash my hair under the kitchen sink and water tends to run in your face and sometimes near your eyes. I don't know what it is that was in this shampoo, but it burned the skin around my eyes.

source_doc: Okay, this filter is no joke. When I first found this filter, I was skeptical. A good filter, for a 75 gallon tank, that's under $30? No way. Not when we paid $100+ for our AquaTech. I was on the phone with my husband and he almost laughed when I told him the price and that I was going to try it out. He told me not to get my hopes up, there's no way it could be good. I was doing a partial water change and I knew I'd be disturbing a lot of sediment and our old filter was on its last legs, so I decided to take a chance.Y'all. When I tell you this little thing WORKS. It cleaned my filthy tank water overnight. Within the first hour I could see a massive difference and by morning? Almost crystal clear. All the filters were filthy within a day from just how much crap they'd sucked up. Oh, and the output is so strong I had to use the little L adjuster pipe to aim the output flow at the side of the tank, because it was creating too strong of a current for my littler tetras. This thing is amazing. I'm buying another one just to put two in my tank to keep it even cleaner. Please note, I've had this thing for almost three months now and it's still going strong.

source_doc: Is okay - not good for long-term. I bought this because I wanted a clicky keyboard for when I WFH (I know - a silly reason but I prefer the aesthetic of it). It wasn't hard to set up - The mouse and keyboard function with a USB inserted into the computer/laptop and no batteries are involved. The downside to this is having to re-charge your keyboard every so often. The first time I charged the keyboard (using the cable they provided) it worked fine and I was able to use it for a couple days (maybe 3?) There's no real indicator that tells you how much battery is left - if you turn it on and the battery symbol is red that means it needs to be charged again but other than that nothing. The second time I tried to re-charge it I had plugged in the wire and had it charging for 12 hours. When I went to go unplug and use it though it was completely dead. I figured that the wire might have been faulty so I tried again with another micro-USB I had in the house that I knew worked. Still nothing. Because I couldn't replace batteries or resuscitate it really I had to toss it, which was unfortunate because the mouse was still fine.

source_doc: Refused to connect. I had a lamp I wanted to use Alexa with and I have other older Kasa smart plugs that work fine.  My other bulbs were Lumiman and I thought I would try to make everything just Kasa.  So I ordered a Kasa smart bulb but it refused to connect.  I thought that maybe it was because the lamp was one of those metal swing-arm things, so I thought, well, I'll just get another Kasa plug instead and ordered a used set of 2.  They both refused to connect.  Thinking it was because they were used, I ordered 2 more new ones.  And, guess what, they refused to connect, too.  I tried everything with all of them.  Multiple tries and resets, moving the lamp all over the house and even right next to the router.  None of them would connect.  So I ordered another Lumiman bulb and, lo and behold, it connected right away with absolutely no issues.  2 stars is for the old plugs that actually worked.

source_doc: Works with all Dr. Brown Wide-Neck Nipples. I have a 4 month old baby who is quickly outgrowing small bottles. He is combo-fed. Our small Dr. Brown bottles (wide-neck) only go to 150ml, whereas he drinks 160-180ml. I had already purchased the level 2 nipples only a month ago and didn’t want those to go to waste.While these bottles come with Y-cut zippy cup nipples, these won’t work for him until 6m+. No problem there, as the level 2 wide-neck nipples I have fit perfectly. There is zero leakage and the transition is seamless. As a bonus, I will not need to buy the next size up nipples because I now have them. I ordered the vents for these bottles, as well, since my baby is very gassy and I feel he still needs them.Another reason I chose these bottles were the rubber handle on the side. My son is always trying to hold his bottle but is unable to grasp it. These handles are perfect. Right now he’s still learning, so I place his hands on the handles to show him how it works. I then hold the bottle from the end to give him support. Occasionally, I let go for a couple seconds to gauge how he’s doing.I really like these bottles and may possibly buy a couple more when he’s older and using the 6m+ nipples.
hypos: Подходит для всех сосок Dr. Brown с широким горлышком. Моему ребенку 4 месяца, и он быстро вырастает из маленьких бутылочек. Он находится на смешанном вскармливании. Наши маленькие бутылочки Dr. Brown (с широким горлышком) вмещают только 150 мл, в то время как он выпивает 160–180 мл. Всего месяц назад я уже купил/а соски 2-го уровня и не хотел/а, чтобы они пропали даром. Хотя эти бутылочки идут в комплекте с Y-образными сосками для поильника, они не подойдут ему до 6+ месяцев. Но это не проблема, так как имеющиеся у меня соски 2-го уровня с широким горлышком подошли идеально. Бутылочки вообще не протекают, и переход прошел гладко. В качестве бонуса мне не придется покупать соски следующего размера, потому что теперь они у меня есть. Я также заказал/а вентиляционные системы для этих бутылочек, так как у моего ребенка сильные газы, и я чувствую, что они ему все еще нужны. Еще одна причина, по которой я выбрал/а эти бутылочки, — резиновые ручки по бокам. Мой сын всегда пытается держать бутылочку, но не может ее обхватить. Эти ручки просто идеальны. I have tried so many different foods and it is always the same result.  After doing a bit of research, I learned that using an elevated bowl that is tilted can help cats that vomit after eating.  When I saw this one, I ordered it because it looks really nice.  I love that it is ceramic so that clean up is easier.  I also prefer to not feed my cats from any type of plastic.  The quality of this bowl is excellent.  The height is perfect and it is tilted.  After using this for a few days, I wish I had discovered it much sooner.  Since I have been feeding my fur baby from this bowl, she has not vomited once!!!  The price is good so I will be ordering a second one.  I cannot even tell you how happy I am that this bowl has helped her.

source_doc: Does this company even have quality control! I can't believe what I received. If I buy a new product, I expect it to come in good condition. This thing is full of nicks and the paint is chipping off already. This should have never been shipped. It's not like I just got one bad piece, I also ordered my daughter a toy organizer, same company l, and that also came all scuffed up. My daughter of course fell in love with it and she's a toddler, I know she's going to ding it up, so that's why I decided to keep it and it was cheap. It was also horrible to assemble, the pilot holes were drilled crooked inside the trunk and I struggled to get the spring piece attached. Ended up stripping one of the screws. I was going to order a chest and toy organizer for my son's room, from the same company, it was just outer space themed, but not after this.I will be telling all my mom friends and family members to not purchase this brand. It is adorable, my daughter loves the princesses, but it's not worth it and I wouldn't want to support a company that can to this to it's customers. So please learn from my mistake and don't buy anything Delta makes.

source_doc: Just what I need. I have just gotten it all set up in our bedroom, so haven’t had a chance to really see how it is in the long run, but I am hopeful. We both use CPAPs and of course living in the Midwest, the furnace has been running for months, and it is dry as a bone in the house. I also have Autoimmune Dry Eye Disease, with an overlay of moderate TED (Thyroid Eye Disease), so the dryness is kind of a big deal.I got a different one last year and after I got it i went over instructions. Dear sweet Jesus, it was the most picky, intricate, PIA humidifier-thing I have ever seen. Use special water (not just distilled), and fill this other hole with whatever-the-hell (more special c**p) and be sure to run this, flip that, push this and dance around it in goatskin chaps in hopes of getting humidity.I have very high hopes for my dry, scratchy eyes, mouth so dry my tongue has to be peeled from the roof of my mouth, cracked lips, dry skin, and itchy face and hands. I haven’t had it long enough to to fall to my knees in joy and say “OMG it is the miracle I was looking for” but I bet I will in about two-four weeks.Humidity for EVERYBIDDY!!!

source_doc: I wish I found this sooner. I’ve had my leather couch for about a year and my bulldogs had put a few scratches on it and I knew I had to do something to protect it fast.  I ordered several different kinds of covers and had to send them all back because my cushions are connected to the couch.  This doesn’t move very much and so far I’m not having to constantly adjust it even when I recline it, they go back pretty much like they were.  My frenchie is crazy and she runs and flies onto the couch like a tiger is chasing her and it has stayed put for all those shenanigans so far.  The rubber grippers on the back work well.  I haven’t washed it yet but when I do I will air dry it because I know from past experience that a dryer will ruin them.  I wish I had found this cover and started using it when I first bought the couch but better late than never.

source_doc: This really works! I have suffered from neck, shoulder and upper back pain for years now. I get massages and use massage guns to get relief, but it still exists. When I saw this device I was a little skeptical, but I started using it nightly while watching television. I set it up behind me and let the infrared lights do their work. After using this for about a month now, I can say I feel a difference. The warmth, heat has made the pain minimize and I feel great after using it for about 15-20 minutes. Afterwards, I use it on my face to help activate collagen (my spa uses a similar light on my face as well and my skin looks great). I highly recommend this device for anyone with pain (especially).

source_doc: Love it! My old knob had been slipping on my genuine leather Wheel Skins cover, even though I used the optional rubber strips. I replaced this cover with a wonderfully plush, inexpensive leather-like cover. The ad for the XL spinner urged me to measure before I ordered. Out of laziness, I did not, and I had to return the regular-size knob for an XL. Installation was a bit of a hassle because the supplied small L-shaped Allen wrench had to be used upside down and out of sight. I wished I had a tool like a screwdriver handle with an Allen wrench attached. I think I did the final tightening by attaching the Allen wrench to a vice grip. I am male, but I have never been as strong as some. I love the XL knob! It operates so smoothly, like a precision instrument with ball bearings. The large, flat head provides secure, excellent control. It does NOT slip, and I wouldn't hesitate to bet it never will. This product is the cat's pajamas!

source_doc: Great. I haven't put together many things in my life and I did this so I would say it was fairly easy.  It was harder logistically to get it together than it was to figure it out (getting the screws in odd places and holding bars until I could get the screws on and tightened enough that things weren't falling).  I read some reviews about not tightening all screws until the end and that helped.One thing I found odd, when I went to tighten the screws, the metal frame bent from the force of the screws.  I'm not all that strong and didn't torque on them as hard as I could so I didn't expect that.  I was a little nervous that I had messed up (I still am), but I loaded it up with weights and it seems OK.  It's not super strong, like I can push on it and feel it move a little, but it's not wobbly so I'm hoping it's OK.

source_doc: Cute🤩🤩 This Headset replaced an old Logitech USB wired headset that I had for a few years.  I'm not a gamer so I can't speak on how it works in that aspect.  I use these for my work from job, I was skeptical if they would work at first but I decided to purchase Anyway because Amazon has a great return policy.  Soon as I plug these into the USB port on my work computer it immediately recognized them.  I noticed the ears lit up, and  so did the mic, but I didn't hear any sound at First but then I realized I had to turn the volume up 😂 Lol, I love the sound quality more clearer than the Logitech one I had.  This headset works great with the VOIP software used by my employer my customers can hear me I can hear them.  I love that mic light turns off when I put the headset in mute.  And the background noise cancelation feature is a awesome plus!  This headset works great with Teams when we have our bi-weekly Team meetings but it also works with Zoom when we use Zoom for any uptrainings, Since we're on camera for meetings and Zoom I've gotten lots of compliments from friends and co-workers.  I highly recommend you won't be disappointed!

source_doc: Not for my sensitive skin. I liked the concept of this dry body brush. I thought the bristles would be much harder but they aren’t. They are softer which I thought would be a positive for my sensitive skin. It’s designed so it’s easy to hold. I initially used it as a dry brush but my skin had a bad reaction so I felt I could benefit by using it in the shower after my skin had moisture from the water. After about 10 minutes in the shower I began to use it & still my skin just didn’t like it. I brushed slowly, softly but despite the soft bristles redness was formed & I had to stop. From my personal experience I’d say this isn’t suited for sensitive skin. I feel it would greatly benefit one who doesn’t have sensitive skin. For the price it’s a nice quality brush. I would suggest, due to the nature of the wetness the bristles would get, that if you do use it in the shower that you put it in a location in your bathroom where it can fully ventilate to prevent mold.

source_doc: I love the thickness and double sided design of this bib. I really like this bib. In our household we go through bibs and always have a pile on hand as backups. My little one uses bibs as his lovey and comfort. I've gotten numerous bibs on here but this is definitely one of the thickest, if not the thickest bib I've gotten. I (and my toddler) prefers thicker bibs over the super thin ones. This one feels even slightly thicker than the bibs I usually get, which is the type with the fleece underside. I do love that the design is on both sides, but of course it is going to cost more. I only wish this was slightly a bit more affordably priced, but I also understand this is better quality (thickness, double sided design, etc) than most bibs, which is why it is priced at this amount. This is great for heavy droolers, especially if your little one is at the height of teething and drooling non stop. I still recommend it even if your little one is not a heavy drooler. I got this yellow safari animal design and the color is beautiful and vivid. I noticed there are also other designs available, and they are all equally adorable and have vivid colors. Overall I am very happy with this bib and highly recommend it if you can splurge a little.

source_doc: Can I give these more than 5 stars?! I love the convenience of using a Swiffer for quick clean-ups.  I have four rescue dogs and foster frequently too so I definitely use my Swiffer a lot.  But let's face it, the Swiffer doesn't really do a great job of cleaning.  In one area of my house, I have tile that was put down years ago before it became more popular to use the larger tiles (my tiles are probably only 12" tiles so I have lots of grout).  The Swiffer doesn't seem to really get down in the grout to clean.  I bought these reusable pads mainly because I thought they would be cheaper in the long run.  An unexpected huge bonus was finding how much better they actually work than the disposable Swiffer pads!  These pads are thick and absorbent.  They make it a tad bit harder to push your Swiffer around but the results are so much better and worth the extra effort!  I haven't tried to wash them yet. I have only just rinsed them off and reused them but will wash them soon and update if I have any issues (but I don't anticipate any problem with them). They do come with instructions telling you not to use fabric softener on them - just an FYI. So glad I ordered these and I will definitely order more!

source_doc: Not quite as sharp as expected, doesn't stick as well on textured wall, lion version limiting. source_doc: AMAZING! It literally melts my press on nails! I’ve never been able to get professional acrylic nails because all that filing of the nail bed to prep, would traumatize my nails to the point of creating pockets of fungus. Then I discovered press on nails and with some trepidation I tried it. I took them off after three days to make sure that my nails were clean and to my relief there was no sign of trauma. A whole new world of beautiful nails  just opened up to me! I came across this little gadget and I thought I tried it. I had nothing to lose because if it didn’t work as expected, I could always return it. I followed instructions and then soaked my nails for 5 minutes. When I took my hand out I couldn’t believe my eyes! They fake nails had just disappeared! I didn’t even have to use the scrapper. I used a cotton with acetone to finish taking what little was left. Then I soaked them again for an additional 3 minutes and I was done. I rubbed tea tree oil on my nails to help with the dryness and prevent fungus. This little thing is worth every penny. Healthy nails  have no price. Now I can safely become addicted to beautiful press on nails.

source_doc: Excellent lunch bag! When shopping for some type of lunch bag item, I stumbled across the Eco-Friendly lunch bag. I liked everything I read about it so I decided to order. I cannot begin to tell you how much I LOVE it. First I was amazed how big it actually is. The depth is so nice. One of the reasons I bought this was because I needed something to keep my Grandson’s milk & juice when we are out running errands. To tell you how much you can fit in the lunch bag. I had 2 bottles of milk, 2 bottles of water and a 16 oz soda in the main section. On the inside upper lid there is a section (with a zipper to close the section off) I was able to put 2 small box juices and a small ziploc bag of grapes. If needed I could have placed more items in that section along with a outside zip storage where you can keep your phone etc. The whole inside is lined with what looks like aluminum foil that keeps items cold or hot. Also if u should spill something, all you need to do is wipe it off with a damp cloth or paper towel. To bad something like this wasn’t around when my 2 were growing up. It is so light weight and the outside material reminds me of denim. I truly believe you will love it as much as I do!

source_doc: All I can say is "WOW"!!! I was skeptical of this type of product and its claims of moving dust/dirt out of my car's interior versus a standard blowgun. I always thought it was the same PSI getting to the gun, how can it possibly be better? I finally broke down and bought this version as it was cheaper than the recommended one I see in all the car detailing groups. I hooked it up the day I got it and did a side-by-side comparison with my metal blowgun. My standard blowgun blew up a little dust on the floorboard of my wife's Jeep for the first test, and then after I attached the Vortex and went to it, it was literally a dust storm. I had to move away from the vehicle to get fresh air. I am literally blown away by this product and time will tell for the longevity of the product.I highly recommend this to anyone looking to up their car interior cleaning game. I will be bragging about this to my friends & family, it truly is a great product, and I would buy it again if ever needed.

source_doc: My preferred pick, I like both the nylon and ceramic. I have been using these picks for a little over 30 years.  Picks are a personal preference so I can't say these are perfect for everyone.  i am always trying out other picks, but I still haven't found anything that i like better.  For me I find these to be the easiest to hold onto, they don't slip around in my fingers as much as other picks.  I like the points on these too they work best with my picking style.  I play a lot of rhythm metal on guitar, and metal and rock on bass.  I like the .7mm for guitar and the 1.0mm for bass.  I jump between the nylon and the ceramic depending on how I am feeling.  They hold up well too I find they show less wear than most other picks too.  I would say they last about 2 or 3 times longer than other picks, especially on bass which can really chew up a pick.

source_doc: Quality feels well made. This feels sturdy and strong. I love how tall it is so I don’t have to bend over to get this out like a my other baby gate. This does come with some wall caps that screw in but they aren’t necessary so I didn’t use them that way I can move it if I want to. The gate is easy to open for an adult with a button on top of the handle and below that have to be pushed at the same time so a baby wouldn’t be able to open it. I had my husband help me set it up but I could’ve installed it alone but easier with two people. The gate also can be left open which I like as I don’t always need it closed. I’m happy with this gate I just need two more I can close off my main living area.

source_doc: Love THIS PRODUCT!!! :) I love this new shampoo and conditioner !!I normally use bed head shampoo and conditioner and periodically I have used Ola Plex. I started using BedHead during the pandemic, because I had tried all other shampoos and conditioners, at a value price, and found them not to be as great as bed head ..however, I stumbled across this shampoo and conditioner and I absolutely love it. I love the smell ..I love that I don’t have knots in my hair.. I  have long thick hair, I also use this on my 6 year old and 8 year old girls and they love it too.. my 6 year old has natural curly hair, so it’s super important to use a quality shampoo and conditioner.. I love That it lathers nicely and I love that when I have my hair in a bun and I take the bun out  it smells so wonderful a little bit like oatmeal raisin cookies.. or soft brown sugar sent.. I would definitely recommend this product if you were looking for something that has quality results at a value price ..like I said, it’s even better than bed head  shampoo and conditioner :)

source_doc: Absolutely brilliant device. I am an instant fan of this adorable egg cooker. I found out about it only a few days ago and I am so happy I got this.To start, my boyfriend suffers from a highly sensitive egg allergy, to the point where if he's in the kitchen while someone is frying eggs he will feel unwell from the fumes. As a result, I gave up cooking eggs for myself for over 5 years.This device is a blessing because I can finally eat eggs again without worrying about bothering my boyfriend. I might not ever make fried eggs again but being able to enjoy them boiled, poached, or as a tiny omelette is more than enough for me.The domed lid keeps the "fumes" contained pretty well until I have to open it, but since all the cooking is steam powered it's really not bad. This morning I attempted soft boiled eggs and as you can see I think they turned out wonderfully. My boyfriend didn't notice any discomfort in the kitchen either.So so happy this is in my life. It's very easy to clean and I love that you can set it and forget it, since it plays a little tune when it's ready.
hypos: Абсолютно гениальный прибор. Я мгновенно стал/а поклонником этой очаровательной яйцеварки. Я узнал/а о ней всего несколько дней назад, и я так рад/а, что приобрел/а её. Начну с того, что мой парень страдает от тяжелой аллергии на яйца — вплоть до того, что если он находится на кухне, пока кто-то жарит яйца, ему становится плохо от запаха. В результате я отказался/лась от приготовления яиц для себя более чем на 5 лет. Куполообразная крышка довольно хорошо удерживает запахи внутри, пока мне не приходится её открывать, но поскольку всё готовится на пару, всё действительно не так плохо. source_doc: This is my second purchase of these. I originally purchased this belt when I had an iphone 8+ back in 2018.  I used it every other day when I ran.  I constantly pulled my iphone out of the belt 2 - 3 times a run (for pictures).  When I purchased an iphone 13 pro max I was happily surprised that it still fit in my old belt.  The belt fit me fine (I wear size 8 women's pants) and never "bounced" during the time I used it (although from time to time I did have to tighten it a bit as it sometimes came loose).Finally after many years of service, the zipper broke in December 2022.  I purchased a replacement and the quality is still as good as the original.  Not planning to upgrade my iphone any time soon, but I hope this still works in future.I highly recommend this product for those who don't like to carry their phones in their pockets when running.

source_doc: It is better than i expected with a small cabinet!!! I have a sub that is a 6" that I paired with a set of Presonus Ceres 4.5BT monitors. The bass was lacking and I wanted something a little stronger. I ordered it and It was delivered in 24 hours on prime. It is much smaller than I expected. It’s just 2” deeper than the 6" cabinet it is replacing. I connected it to the system with the Presonus Ceres 4.5BT monitors. It turns on right away. And it has strong smooth bass not muddy bass. I actually had to turn it down 5-7db below 0db on the gain control to match the monitors. Now, I have a complete Presonus system, that is very impressive for the cost. I have several other systems, A KRK VXT system and a Blue Sky system this is smallest system and it is very impressive compared to the KRK and Blue Sky systems I have in head to head comparison using the Mackie Big Knob 3. Very happy with this sub. highly recommended.

source_doc: Sturdy stainless steel utensils. I was looking for some large stainless steel spoons and forks. I noticed one day that I was missing several spoons & forks. If anyone has teenage boys like me, you know silverware seems to disappear. When I finally decided to purchase some spoons & forks, I knew I wanted stainless steel. I looked and found some made by a company called Keawell. I purchased a box that contained 6 large spoons and 6 large forks. When I received the utensils, I washed and dried them by hand. I love the fact they are also dishwater safe. They are not real heavy to hold like some I have used in the past. Very durable you can tell the spoons will not bend easily unless you force it to. So far I truly have enjoyed them and hopefully these will not end up in the garbage can. I would highly recommend this product to all my family & friends.

source_doc: it works! I had a rash on my arm that wouldn't go away.  I had tried all the normal creams like Neosporin and Lotrimin.  I saw this California Baby Cream, and loved the ingredients, so I thought I might as well try it. It smells very nice, natural, and mild.  I was amazed that it made a huge improvement the first day. And was almost gone after a few days.I also tried it on my granddaughters diaper rash.  It stung at first so I wiped it off, but tried it again the next diaper change, and she didn't seem to notice it at all.  It helped but I wasn't with her the next day to keep using it, so I can't say if it would have cured the diaper rash.I have used it on various little bumps and things since then, and it makes everything feel better. I love it. I want to keep it around.

source_doc: Battery life has room to improve. I use a Glorious gaming mouse as my primary mouse. My only complaint is that I don't own the wireless version. I tried out this pwnage mouse in hopes that it would be everything I like plus the wireless aspect. In terms of customization, weight, accuracy, and feel, everything is very similar to my glorious mouse. I love it. It has a nice grip, it's very lightweight, and I can make the rgb pink. I fully charged the mouse and was gaming away until I hit about day 3 and the battery had to be recharged. Asking around my gaming group and reading online, 3 days is not very long for a wireless mouse at all. I really wish that the battery lasted longer on this mouse, but as it is I would rather deal with a cord and not have to worry about charging my mouse every 3 days. I am back to using my glorious mouse.

source_doc: LOVE. I saw one like this listed on Lowes for like $250 so when I saw this I knew I wanted to try it out. I really love incline walking and I didn't want to get something with the bulkiness of a normal treadmill that most likely for the price wouldn't have incline. When I read manual I was hesitant but now that I got it all set up (easy by the way) I love it! Once you get the oil on there its like skating on ice & I have tried it with and without shoes and I would say it is MUCH easier with shoes on in my opinion. Anyways, for the price, the weight & size, and the way my calves and thighs are burning ..... makes me believe again its great!

source_doc: So HAPPY with this roll!!  Delighted! I have a Cuisinart Steam Toaster Oven and its very difficult finding pans that fit correctly. They are usually half an inch too long in one direction. Being my only oven, I want as large as will fit.  Before now, I buy a roll of  Parchment Paper and cut it to size each time. The one with already cut sheets are too big. The ones I tear off I always have to adjust and fold over the edges and so on. A real Pain. I cut a piece off this roll to size first and then one a little bigger that goes up the sides a little. Sometimes I only need to wipe it with a wonder sponge and its clean! I am Happy beyond words!  I found once in a while it stains, however, not often. I simply remove it, wash with a Wonder Sponge and its Clean! No grease left over like my other ready made silicon mats. I imagine the Wonder sponge would clean them too. (I only use it for specific things like this.) I have baked several things on the first sheet and it still looks new! Very Happy with this purchase. Just rolled the roll back in the paper and tucked in the ends for the next thing I think of to use it for! Perhaps rolling out pastry?

source_doc: Have to use force when plugging or removing from switch. I figured it would be great alternative for my switch that I can travel with for my system, but it makes me feel iffy when I plug it into my switch. I have a hard time unplugging it and even plugging it in. As if it's tougher to insert into and remove from the c-port. I figured with decent reviews it would have been perfect but I just don't feel good about using it when I have to use force to even use it. I don't want to ruin my switch or the cord itself, but mostly my switch. I use it as a last resort. Maybe I would have better luck using it with my dock? Or maybe my cord was just not that great? Either way, I recommend looking for a better one or even the real Nintendo cord since I wouldn't want to recommend any cord that could possibly ruin someone else's system.

source_doc: Keyboard is too tall? Never thought I would have this complaint about a keyboard, but this thing is way too tall. I have had a Corsair K70 for the past 10 years and I am at a point of needing to replace it. Thought I would give this one a try and see if I liked the optical linear switches which I do really like.The problem is the actual height of the keyboard itself. It sits at least twice the height of my old mechanical keyboard. I tried adjusting my chair but found that it was a big enough difference between my mouse and keyboard that my armrests had to sit at two separate heights. Doing this hurts my shoulder and ruins my posture, but if I keep my armrests even like I would normally my wrist is bent just enough to cause pain.If you really cannot live without this keyboard for whatever reason, I would recommend raising your mousepad to match the height of the keyboard. I am tempted to do that just to keep this keyboard, but this is just dumb design in my opinion.

source_doc: Replacement to another Inspire. I had/have an inspire that is just fine except that where the band clips in, it broke and there is nothing to attach the band to. It is no longer under warranty. I really did not want to buy another one, but I couldn't come up with any way to fix it.  I did buy the little attachment so you can put it on your belt, but I use this as an alarm to remind me to take a med that has to be taken very early in the morning.  I was not going to wear the thing on my PJs because first of all I would probably lose it in the bed.  I tried another inexpensive smart watch, but the step count was really bad, and the silent alarm was one very short vibration and that was all.  So, I broke down and bought another Inspire.  I really hope this one doesn't break.  Other than that, I love this thing.  It isn't huge like most of them, and it works for what I need, counting steps and as a silent alarm.

source_doc: I have thought about buying like 10 of these. I am a nail girly - I spend a lot on at-home nail products. So I have spent quite a bit on nail drills that always end up breaking. I usually buy the ones that are around $80-$100. I can honestly say, none of them have ever been anywhere as great as this one. I've had this for a few months and it is still going strong. I am not sure how long it'll last, but my others usually only lasted this amount of time. If this broke I wouldn't be upset, I would just order a new one because it is worth every penny. I LOVE that it is cordless, but ESPECIALLY that it isn't bulky like most cordless nail drills that are attached to a big block. It is legit perfect. Another thing I LOVE that makes this so much better than others, is that it can go fast, but more importantly, it can go slow. Even on the slowest setting every other nail drill was too powerful sometimes, but this one is perfect. Power when you want, but gentle when you don't. I would spend $100 on this and it would still be worth it.

source_doc: I bought this for my two dogs excessive itching. -This was nicely packaged.  No breaks or leaks.  Also came with three different pumps.  A screw on/off, pop top, and a pump.  I personally like the pump.  It’s the easiest.-Make sure to read directions.  I was giving my dog too much out of habit from another brand I was using.  She starting getting runny poops and I think it was making her feel sick.  I skipped it a couple days and just started giving her one pump and I have no more issues.-It doesn’t seem to bother the dogs at all.  I do a pump over their food and they eat it all!  It doesn’t smell at all.  Makes their bowls greasy but I expected that.The reason I give it a three star is because the other brand I was using seemed to work better.  It definitely helped the itching but they still do a bit as where the other brand seemed to stop it completely.  Noting that.  I wouldn’t buy this again I would stick with the other brand

source_doc: I like it a lot. I had an old one I bought years ago that was smaller. This one is large enough to easily accept a paper shopping bag, and it’s a little taller than my old one, so if I have a bunch of plastic shopping bags, I can pile them up higher.  It’s pretty cool that I could fold it up if I needed the room for something else, but I never do that..  I don’t understand why some people complain that it slides around. The back of my SUV is plastic, and it doesn’t slide around (and I am not the most gentle driver either, but if I had to slam on my brakes, I would say all bets are off and I would not blame this product).  I’ve heard some of them fall apart, so I pulled on mine from different directions, and it’s not falling apart. I don’t doubt with automated manufacturing that some of them would be defective. (check them out before the return window closes)..

source_doc: Good for kids (and very good for adults ears) These are very, very light weight. I was desperately looking for foam mallets because they just sound nicer on steel tongue drums and mid class vibraphones. I bought these, not caring that they looked like a lollypop( probably not a good thing because it may entice little ones to chew on it) So I gave them a try and even though the foam was the density that I was hoping for, the handles are so light that I can’t get the sound I want, without whacking really hard,,,,and then all you hear is the thudding and no music. I thought the handle might be hollow and I that I could somehow add some weight but the ends are sealed ( I may chop it off & see if I can add weight and then sand the ends, so they’re smooth. Hmmm….may have to update later.Pros: For parents, whose so called friends, have gotten the kiddies a xylophone, this may save your sanity…Even though the munchkins may bang away, at that thing,,,the sound will not pierce a hole in your eardrum & make you long for their 18th birthday..lol

source_doc: Not just a pregnancy pillow! I had 2 major abdominal surgeries and was absolutely struggling to find a comfortable way to sleep. When sleeping on my non surgical side, I rolled to my belly in my sleep waking me up in terrible pain. I gave this pillow a go. I wish I’d have gotten one of these years ago! It comes vacuum packed, I tossed it in the dryer on air fluff for about 30 mins and left it out to form as suggested and washed the cover in my sensitive detergent (dried cover on very low heat because of the fabric type). It formed beautifully! I couldn’t wait to try it out. I did add a bit of extra poly fill on one side to make it more firm only because I wanted a firm barrier to prevent me from rolling on my belly. It worked perfectly! I never rolled on to my belly once. I’ve been using this all week now and I have noticed that my incision sites aren’t anywhere near as painful and it’s even helped with painful joints from fibromyalgia. I wish I could give it far more stars. It wasn’t flat like many other pillows and their reviews, it was truly perfect. This is a fantastic investment. Now I just have to work on getting the hubby to stop resenting my pillow for replacing him lol

source_doc: Seems like a good collar. My cats needed new collars and I thought I'd give this one a try.  I ordered the cloud print and it's cute.  No issues with sizing the collar to what I needed and I did try pulling apart on it to ensure it would "break away" if need be and it did come apart with a fairly good tug.  My cats are indoor cats so I doubt it will be put to the test, but would want to make sure it would just in case.  I do have to say I don't care for the bell.  My cat's last collar had a bell and it really wasn't noisy unless he was really running.  This bell is very noisy.  It's a smaller sound, kind of a tinny sound.  But I could tell my cat did not like it.  At least for the first few days he was constantly messing around with his neck like he was trying to find the bell.  He never did that with his last collar.  I was actually getting ready to take it off but it's been about a week and he seems used to it now so I'll leave it be for a bit longer and see.  But I do wonder if it's still driving him nuts.  I may still remove it at some point.

source_doc: Glittery. I’m not using this product again because it is glittery. I don’t think i saw glitter in the description, so I was not pleased to put this on my skin and find I look like a preteen. Luckily I tested on an arm before putting it on my face - I’d hate to go into work all glittery. Just for kicks, I did try it on my face on a day when I knew I wasn’t going out, and indeed I did look like I was getting ready for a glamour shots session.That said, it is a nice skin oil, if you don’t mind the glitter. I could definitely feel a difference in softness in the patch of skin I tested and my skin felt nice when I did put it on my face. So it works, for what it is, I just wouldn’t use it.

source_doc: Works well while I work. I love this treadmill so much. I use it with my standing desk while I work. The only two things I wish were slightly better are 1- I do wish it had even a small incline option and 2 - I do wish I could store it standing. It seems to potentially want to stand while “folded” but it doesn’t for me at least. Luckily, I have room in my office for it to sit out of the way flat. But I will say it arrived quickly, was easy to get unpackaged and going, and has worked very well. I keep my remote in a container on my desk to prevent losing it and it’s all going well. Super happy with this purchase.

source_doc: Pretty Good. The first time I started looking for something like this, I just gave up due to too many options.  Since I had the chance to try this, and I figured it met my first requirement of not being plastic, I was happy to give it a try.It fits the bill pretty nicely.  It saves a bit of room by getting some of the tiny stuff off the cabinet floor under my half bath sink, and then gets some of the larger bottles cleaned up and in one place as well.As I suspected, for every bit of space you gain, you also gain some complications - and I'm sure this is true for almost every device like this unless it was engineered specifically for your EXACT cabinet.For example, I like that it pulls out, but then I have to leave some space in front of it so it can do so.  And then I can't put anything too tall on the top because those things could hit the top of the door and stop it from pulling out all the way.  So it helps, but it's not making an astronomical difference under there.  I still like it.  I wouldn't bother with almost any of the plastic models.  At least this does NOT seem cheap or flimsy at all (anything cheap and flimsy trying to help you save space always makes more problems than they solve).

source_doc: In anticipation of using, I'm going to say it's right up there with Hydroflask. My family owns too many water bottles and most of them are hydroflasks. We've got a few eco vessels and a few generic throw around ones. But I wanted to be different so that I would know it's mine... My wife might try and claim it as hers like she did with another hydroflask bottle I bought.I really like the size and the wide mouth opening and the chug cap. The wide mouth when you have the chug cap off makes it super easy to fill with ice and drink. It's wider than the hydroflask wide mouth bottles. The chug cap is really easy to take off. It has a grippy edge to it.Having had the handle cap for the hydroflasks, I think I can honestly say I like the yeti design better. A solid shape as opposed to having it swivel. I prefer the solid shape.Even though I haven't used it yet I have no doubt that it will perform as well with hot and cold as the hydroflask bottles. I plan on using this for travel and of course those hot summer days on the golf course.The picture doesn't do the color justice. It looks better than the picture. I'd definitely get another so I can have 2 in a rotation... Just a different color.

source_doc: Pumps well and came with 21 mm as well. I really enjoy using this hands free pump in addition to my other pumps I have from last couple of years. I just had my 3rd baby and hands free is the way to go if you have little ones. It's easy to use and cleaning is not hard, basically same as other pumps with cups. I got this because I wanted to have other options when pumping middle of the night. Also, I didn't see it mention in the listing but 21mm came with it as well.As for the cons, I noticed the actual pumps on top falls off and is not as secure as I would have liked. I wished it had a bit of a screw on so it would remain in place. Sometimes when I angle it to put them on my breasts, the pump (top) parts comes off. Also, I am not sure if they sell the actual cup for this pump but it would be a good idea since there are special and spectra cups would not fit here. The noise level seems a bit louder than my willow 3.0 but  since they work fine, I am pretty much used to it now.

source_doc: I would describe the fram brand as barely adequate, if that. The build quality feels just really cheap. Everything about it is cut rate. That's probably why it's priced right around $4 right now. I don't know about all the people that say it's destroyed their engines and whatnot. I guess that would happen if pieces came off at and it came apart in some way and started to clog up the oil passages. But from what I've seen no one's ever been able to prove that that has happened. Now that's not to say it hasn't happened I just don't have the time to do extensive research. But everything about these is just cheap. I have no idea how well they filter. For a few dollars more you can get something that feels really good quality. So I decided not to use cheap oil filters anymore and so I find these unacceptable. Like I say I'm not going to make claims that they ruin engines because I have no idea. I know the nickname for these is orange can of death. It's pretty funny but I haven't seen that to be really true at all like I said above I haven't seen proof about it. Anyway yeah I'm just not going to use filters this cheap and low quality.

source_doc: Great for Price, Better after Tweaks. Loved the lamp. I am particularly fond of the design which is why I got it. As a student moving from dorm to dorm it folds nicely. Great Student lamp. It has two different strips of lights that cause the change in color. It is not the best light I have had but for the price it is pretty decent. Lumens I provides enough light for the tasks I perform at night which are normally just computer work, occasional solder, tiny tool usage and eating at my desk. I was really annoyed with where the switch was so I cut it off and reconnected close to the base of where the clamp is. I can now easily reach the on and off and lumen adjustment. I would have preferred the switch be closer to the head or arms of the lamp but I am happy with where it is now. I added a rubber pad to the clamp so I don't get charged for damages to the desk. I also had to un hinge a spring and tighten a few of the screws. The springs are unevenly strong that it pulls the light in funky ways and after removing a few and then tightening screws the lamp still adjusts and moves and stays where I want it. I have been pretty happy with it.

source_doc: Works great for my very fine thin fragile hair, but it's a bit sticky... This TRESemmé Hair Mist Texture Mist works great for my very fine thin fragile, and somewhat curly hair. This spray mist is a bit sticky, but I guess that's what gives it its grippiness.Whenever I go out, I always wear wigs, but at home I sport the little bit of hair I have, as it's just more comfortable. This works as a double duty product. It provides a bit of texture and volume to my natural hair, making it look like I have more than I do.It also gives it more grip for keeping my wigs in place. I'm unable to wear a wig cap, only wig grips. This gives them something more to hold on to than just my wimpy looking hair. When I remove my wigs, I can just spray with water, scrunch, and let my hair dry to revive it.This is not the type of spray or mist that you can easily spray onto your hair, as it actually doesn't create a mist. I just spray it into my hands, rub them together, and apply it throughout.Even though it is not technically a mist, I still like this texture, volume, and grip it provides to my natural hair, and would absolutely recommend it!
hypos: Отлично подходит для моих очень тонких, редких и ломких волос, но он немного липкий... Этот текстурирующий спрей TRESemmé Hair Mist отлично подходит для моих очень тонких, редких, ломких и слегка вьющихся волос. Этот спрей немного липкий, но, думаю, именно это и обеспечивает фиксацию. Каждый раз, когда я выхожу на улицу, я всегда ношу парики, но дома я хожу со своими немногочисленными волосами, так как это просто удобнее. Это средство выполняет двойную функцию. Оно придает моим натуральным волосам немного текстуры и объема, благодаря чему кажется, что их у меня больше, чем на самом деле. Оно также обеспечивает лучшую фиксацию для удержания моих париков на месте. Я не могу носить шапочку под парик, только ленты-фиксаторы. Благодаря этому средству им есть за что зацепиться, помимо моих жиденьких волос. Когда я снимаю парик, я могу просто сбрызнуть волосы водой, взбить их руками и дать им высохнуть, чтобы вернуть им прежний вид. Это не тот тип спрея, который можно легко распылить прямо на волосы, так как на самом деле он не создает мелкодисперсного облака. Я просто распыляю его на ладони, растираю и распределяю по волосам. Даже несмотря на то, что технически это не совсем спрей-вуаль, мне все равно нравится эта текстура, объем и фиксация, которые он дает моим натуральным волосам, и я однозначно рекомендовал/а бы его!

Даже несмотря на то, что технически это не совсем легкий спрей-дымка, мне все равно нравится текстура, объем и фиксация, которые он дает моим натуральным волосам, и я абсолютно рекомендовал/а бы его!

source_doc: Works great, so far. It’s very sturdy and seems well-made but I can’t speak to the adhesion, yet.  I bought this during the winter and I prefer to wait until it’s warmer so I can clean the garage floor and use the adhesive stickers for exactly where I want it.Currently I have it on an old area rug so it doesn’t slide around.  I really like how I can feel the slight elevation in the front so I know it’s close then I feel the higher back which signals me to stop.  I don’t have to guess at all; it’s like my tire fits into a perfect little trough.  I have about 3 inches between the front of my vehicle and the garage wall and maybe another 3 inches of space in the back so my garage door will close.  This device works great and saves me from guessing or getting out of my vehicle and checking clearance.  If I had one suggestion it would be that it should be a little wider but I’ve gotten use to it
