source_doc: Love the ladder hardware, screws are horrid. Love the hardware, the screws are worthless.  I used oak sides and rockler steps.  (Saved enough on the rolling hardware I decided to splurge on the steps).Be careful planning the alignment of the top rail as the wheels only clear the mounts at the operational angle.I read how bad the screws were bug figured I could be careful.  They're horrible.  I predrilled, new bit, gently installed, and the heads still stripped.  I complained and was sent smaller screws.  I ended up replacing them with others from Amazon.  Pain in the neck because I had to use an easy out on 3.The wheels and rail are fairly straightforward to install.  I built my ladder, then put it up to figure out where to screw the top in.  The hardware seems fairly well made.  I did have trouble putting the caps on the rails and between the rails, the o-rings wanted to tear themselves up the fit was so tight.  That was annoying and I replaced one, but I ended up deciding they weren't that important and didn't worry if the others tore.Would have preferred that the bottom locks, but the ladder rolls smoothly and I'm really happy with it.I replaced the screws with:https://www.amazon.com/gp/product/B00GI8BVKG/ref=ppx_yo_dt_b_asin_title_o03_s00

source_doc: You're paying less for a reason. I've used wood glue many times. But in the past I've used gorilla glue, which has never disappointed me.  When I found myself needing wood glue again and saw this at half the price and with great reviews, I thought I would give it a try.  I learned the hard way that there is a reason it's so inexpensive.  It simply doesn't hold for very long.  I'm talking days.  The longest hold I was able to get was a couple of weeks, but only because I avoided touching what I had used it on for a majority of that time.  I'm grateful it was only about $5 that I wasted as this will be going in the trash when I finish this. And I just purchased gorilla glue .... which I should have done in the first place.

source_doc: Totally worth it! So, I know you're supposed to clean the humidifier daily - that's all well and good when you're a) not disabled; b) dealing with Stage 4 Cancer ; and c) just too dang tired.  I wanted to wait and see just how well they worked before writing my review.  Each time I refilled the humidifier I would add 6-7 drops.  Normally, I clean them once a week - and I have 2 humidifiers so it takes some time to clean them.  Well, I have been very sick for 2 weeks, and I knew the chambers were probably gooky so I turned them off for about 2 1/1 days.  I cleaned them today expecting some kind of science experiment gone wrong - even cleaning them weekly I'd get a ton of gook.  Well, there was gook, but surprisingly not nearly what I expected.  I am now using 10 drops because I realized I have an almost 2 gallon tank so I'm hoping next week when I clean them I'll see even less gook.

source_doc: It worked. I’m not a veterinarian, but homeopathic remedies typically do more than just treat a symptom. My dog has collapsing trachea, which causes her to cough after she drinks water. I well, when you get enough water that went the wrong direction and into your windpipe you’re going to have a dog that’s coughing on a regular basis. I tried this stuff not really expecting anything and boy was I wrong. Within two days the cough was drastically reduced. She still coughs after drinking water, but all the coughing in between is gone. I ordered a second bottle and miss placed it, and the coughing came back after about three days.  I ordered a third bottle and started the drops up again and had the same positive results. This stuff is staying in my arsenal. I find that you can reduce the dose as the cough subsides. I don’t stop it anymore. I just drastically reduced it. The cough is still gone. I have little porous dental treats that my dog loves. I put the drops on those and she doesn’t mind at all. If I run out of treats, I put a couple of drops in her bowl and squirt a little bit of whipped cream on top and that does it as well. This was a miracle for us.

source_doc: I should have bought this years ago. I love this thing.  I love hard boiled eggs but often don't eat them because of the hassle of making them.  When I do make them, I tend to not eat all of them, or by the time I do, they have lost their flavor.  With this egg cooker I can make them on demand with pretty much zero effort.  I also love fried eggs over medium but it's such a pain to always get out the frying pan etc... I just make medium boiled eggs with this and it's pretty much the same!  I tried doing the poached eggs, but could not find the best amount of water/time to get them cooked right.  I could get the yolk perfect, but the underside of the egg white was still runny.  Added more water and the yolk was almost completely cooked and the underside egg white was till runny.  Not a big deal because again, I get exactly the cook I want with the medium boil and can do more eggs at a time.I would have paid triple for this item it's that good.  I don't really understand the negative reviews about the timer.  It is loud, but not obnoxious and I can hear it anywhere in the house.  The melody is fine, it took me a few times to realize it was the egg timer and not my phone ringing.
hypos: Мне следовало купить это еще много лет назад. Я обожаю эту штуку. Я очень люблю вареные вкрутую яйца, но часто не ем их из-за возни с их приготовлением. Когда я их все-таки готовлю, то обычно съедаю не все, а к тому времени, как я собираюсь их съесть, они уже теряют свой вкус. С этой яйцеваркой я могу готовить их по первому требованию, практически не прилагая усилий. Также я люблю яичницу-глазунью средней прожарки, но всегда так лень доставать сковороду и все такое... Я просто готовлю в ней яйца всмятку, и это практически то же самое! Я пробовал/а делать яйца пашот, но не смог/ла подобрать оптимальное количество воды и времени, чтобы они приготовились как надо. Желток получался идеальным, но белок снизу оставался жидким. Добавил/а больше воды — желток почти полностью приготовился, а белок снизу все равно остался жидким. Ничего страшного, потому что, опять же, при варке всмятку я получаю именно ту степень готовности, которую хочу, и могу приготовить больше яиц за один раз. Я бы заплатил/а за этот прибор в тройном размере, настолько он хорош. Я не совсем понимаю негативные отзывы о таймере. Он громкий, но не раздражающий, и я слышу его в любой точке дома. Мелодия нормальная, мне просто понадобилось несколько раз, чтобы понять, что это таймер для яиц, а не звонок моего телефона.

source_doc: No complaints with quality. I got this for an emergency pull rope / strap for the trunk of my car.. 4" did not really register as to how wide that actually is, or how thick this strap actually is, until I got it in.. One of those (brain fartt) moments where you could kick yourself in after thought.. In any case, this is way more then I need for an emergency strap, so I am going to look for another.. I have one that is thinner and not as wide in my one vehicle, and I wanted one for my other vehicle.. If you want one for something like that, this is going to be much thicker and heavier then most people will ever use..With that being said, the testing I did do with it, it worked fine.. But let me be honest when I say.. 16,000 pounds is like towing a semi.. I have nothing that will use or need that kind of a heavy duty strap to tow.. But then again, I have seen smaller one break trying to pull out bushes and stuff.. So better too heavy then not heavy enough and breaking.. Just know, if you are looking for compact, this is not for you.. But from what I can tell so far, it is nicely made and I have no complaints about its quality.

source_doc: Very Sturdy. I have bought what feels like a ton of these over my adult life for all kinds of different, practical applications not just for hanging a shower curtain and this one has to be one of the sturdiest ones I have ever purchased.  I wasn't so sure about the black as I normally stick to white, off-white or a light tan but for the purpose of my purchase, I was indifferent because I just needed a sturdier rod in my laundry room.  I use this rod to hang the clothes right out of the dryer and sometimes, the weight of clothes can be so much that a regular, cheaper rod, will buckle under that kind of weight.  I was hoping that this rod would solve my worry about that because I had my other one fall on me, a couple of times by that buckling under the weight of the clothes.  This one is absolutely the answer.  It is really easy to install and extremely sturdy, I can easily hang about 3 loads before I have to put them in their respective closets.  That's a LOT of laundry, and an amount that my other rod couldn't even dream about holding.  The price is very reasonable as well, so if you are in the market for a really sturdy rod, this is it.  I hope you find this review helpful!

source_doc: Simply Beautiful. I got these lights in with no idea of what exactly I was really ordering. Which is very odd for me because I don’t spontaneously get products without reading every little detail. When they arrived and I saw that the strand was 400’ long,  I was surprised and then a little disappointed in myself for ordering them. Until my brain started to click. I decided to take the forever long, flexible and sleek looking strand and I literally wrapped each branch of my Christmas tree from the top to the bottom and still had plenty left over. They were so pretty, blended right in and had people asking me if my tree was a pre lit. I didn’t have to worry about gaudy light string’s being seen, lights never got hot and I was able to change them from being on steady to blinking, twinkling or fading in and out. I also loved how it came with a remote control as I was able to change the brightness level. I do recommend that If you do use these and decide to wrap them up afterwards, take your time and go slow or you’ll end up with a big birds nest as I did. I was able to get it straightened out but it took some time!

source_doc: Works well, seems well made. Ok, I hate cleaning my shower. I mean it's not gross, but it's not spic-and-span either. I was glad to receive this and as soon as I got it, I plugged in the included charger and charged it for an hour or so. (It shows a red LED when charging that flips to green when fully charged.) As the pic shows, it consists of the head, where the brushes attach, along with 2 other sections, one of which contains the battery, the other is an extension piece that also telescopes to provide more length. You also get 4 brushes of various sizes.After charging it up, I sprayed down the shower with a soap scum cleaning spray and let it sit for about 5 minutes. Then I went to town on it with this little baby. I made the mistake of trying the large, flat brush, and I quickly realized the large rounded brush is a much better option for shower cleaning. Otherwise, it's a little hard to control and it dances around a bit.It worked well, and made the job simple - no awkward bending, reaching, standing in the tub, etc. Glad I purchased it. I've not tested the battery duration yet, but it didn't slow down, and still had plenty of power after I used it.

source_doc: I thought I would use it more. This UV light for nails is very lightweight and as simple to use as any I've ever used. I got this for when I do my nails, so I could cure my nails all at once rather than one at a time, and it definitely works good for that when it's the finished nails. I have nerve damage in my right hand,  so I actually find that initial gluing of nail to finger works better for me if I just stick with the single nail at a time. So, unfortunately, this has only been used 1 time. I really thought I would use it more,but it's too hard for me to keep my hand straight long enough to put all nails on then under the light. I just bend them and they come off and it becomes a mess. But, having said that, it is a decent light for anyone who will not have issues like I have. Or great for even curing nail decor that needs UV light after the nails are already glue on. I wish I could have given a better review of this product, but from what I can tell, it does what it says, and works as good as it says. So I am going to give it a 5 star based off it being exactly as stated in the description.

source_doc: Operation money Grab. I needed this cord so badly that money was not an option for me. I didnt even look at my bank account when I bought his cord so I said to myself why not, I needed a rope for mountain climbing and this was probably the most affordable. So I gave it to my wife, by the way is my X wife now, somewhere hiding at the bottoms of some valley but that's not important whats important is this review. We started off on a beautiful mid summers day camping and my wife had a climbing rope but it was her birthday so I surprised her with this state of the art $1000 dollar futuristic rope tested by Nasa. She was hooked! although we didnt have internet so she couldn't look up the information but she trusted me and it looked pretty legit. As we climbed up the mountain I told her to save the special Nasa Strength Rope for the highest peak because that's when we will need it and she agreed. I can not believe she did not hold on correctly so it was user error but the cord is still intact. I will not be returning the Technologically made cord just incase I may need it for my next date. Thank you so much in selling me this incredible gold digger saver.

source_doc: Outstanding ironing board! I never thought I would use ironing board and outstanding in one sentence, but this one definitely stands out.I was hesitant to order it because of the higher price. I never paid anything near this much for an ironing board lol.So why did I order it?First I saw the nice attachment with the little compartments. I immediately thought I could use it for scissors, tape measure and pins since I usually cut fabric on my ironing board due to lack of space in my craftsroom.Then I read that the ironing board is extra wide, another plus for cutting fabric or doing other crafts.I also noticed that you can pull it up to 36 inches which is counter top height and is easy on my back when I'm ironing.Of course I also read the positive reviews and eventually decided to order it.After unpacking and admiring the awesome attachment, the great quality, the sturdiness and the extra cover, I set it up in my craftsroom.I noticed that it was a little wobbly (it's our floor) so I put a piece of styrofoam underneath one of the legs.I read the description which came with it to make sure I didn't miss anything and guess what!The feet have built in stabilizers which are adjustable so no need to put anything underneath!It really can't get any better!An outstanding product for sure!5 stars from me. ☆☆☆☆☆

source_doc: Inexpensive, but with cheap construction. I got this shelf/rack for my basement exercise room. It was inexpensive which is good because it is also somewhat problematically constructed.The first one they sent me had a piece soldered upside down. So I wasn’t able to assemble it. The second one had all the pieces soldered correctly but when I hung them up, the one side was longer than the other. So I couldn’t make it level. I had to Jerry rig it to make the bottom racks be level. (Second picture) I also had trouble with the mollies they included—they were super weak so I wasn’t able to successfully hammer them into the wall even after I pre-drilled holes. I got them partially in and then the top would just cave in and I had to cut them off.I found the installation instructions difficult to follow and incomplete. Thankfully I’m handy enough to figure out how to do it. But it took a fair bit of time. So just prepare yourself for that.Because it’s attached with six screws, it feels pretty solid. I think it’s going to do the job well.

source_doc: Cuts down excessive barking. I got this to prevent my guy from eating and drinking the unknowns outside as well as handling his barky butt. I specifically did a search for a doberman muzzle because my 1st attempt failed. I followed their measurements which lead me to a medium. I should have gone up to a large. The neck strap is out as far as it goes. I was afraid it was too tight but i can get my fingers between any area without effort. I let him stand at the window and “attempt” to bark at passersby. He can growl and whine but no bark. I sent him out to play and immediately heard the neighbors yippee dog, but no doberbutt barking. I was spying from the garage door and was happy w what I saw and heard. Doesn’t interfere w his play. With no barking, I don’t believe I will have any problems w him eating the unwanted.

source_doc: About 2/3 shades lighter than picture so order wisely. This hairpiece is very beautiful. It’s long wavy and light. It wraps around your bun really well and cascades down your back very beautifully. The only problem is that the color between what you see in the picture and what you get when it arrives is way off about 2 to 3 shades lighter than expected. I ordered the blonde color and I thought based on the picture that it would be a dusky darker blonde and it ended up being a lighter blonde, lightening towards the tips into an almost platinum blonde, so I can’t use this hairpiece, but that doesn’t mean I didn’t like it. It’s a really well-made piece. I wish that the colors were more true to what you would expect when you order so please keep in mind the difference in color I’m attaching two pictures one is with flash and one is without, and then you can see the difference between what I ordered and what I got. I did order another piece that I hope is closer to my hair color so that I can use it because I really did like this. Took a star off for color variation, and kept the 4 stars for the quality, fit, and price.

source_doc: Sublime now vexed, dismayed and disappointed. I waited until I had the perfect place for it. I unfurled and inflated with ease and speed. It slept beautifully! You could not tell it was an air mattress. I thought ok. I’m good until I find my bed! At least two weeks of sleep when I can as a birth worker.  I come home from an extended and taxingly long birth (DAAAYS!). My sister is surprising me with fresh linen. As she crawls to the center to get the final corner… the seam.. TEARS! She sinks. My nephew goes flying at 19 months. I literally broke into tears grabbing him. The absolute JOKE of a patch (note the square) Sticks then blows away as we begin to think of refilling. I am soul weary at730 pm this evening. So instant bond glue and duct tape to the rescue.  30 mins in. It’s filled and holding. So having no choice I will pray I can sleep on it and rest. And have to figure out what the hell to do next. I don’t know about anyone else.. but I done happen to have a spare amount of cash just waiting to purchase a bed on the fly.  I’m so very disappointed.

source_doc: Not Just for Babies! I always like to sleep with some sort of sound going and I usually like the sound of a fan noise blowing however, when I go away which is a lot, I never have any sounds I can take with me besides what I get from an app on my phone. When I saw this popup in my feed, I knew this would make the perfect addition to my travels.The product itself is small and compact. I can throw it in my suitcase and use it when I get to my destination at night in my bedroom for when I sleep. There are about 5 lullabies you can choose from and also nature sounds which is what I use to help me fall and stay asleep.

source_doc: Disappointment. Bought these based on the reviews that were like "Oh my god these damaged my stairs when I removed them!" because I didn't plan on removing them and I wanted them to stick as good as possible.Well... they don't. These are old stairs. Still though, I prepped them as I would anything that I plan to stick with adhesive. They were very easy to stick down but unfortunately they're not that sticky. I've walked over each piece on each stair back and forth multiple times to get as much pressure on every point of contact and they just won't stay stuck. I don't know what to do other than maybe some contact cement around all the edges.These are cheap and look alright. I'd be more upset if they were priced higher but I should have figured this would be the outcome for what I paid. I guess I was just hoping that the reason other reviews say they damage stairs when they're removed is because they stick SO well. Not the case, actually.

source_doc: Bought ultra healing in lieu of regular version due to availability/pricing. Same overall quality of the ultra healing product vs the regular Curel moisturing lotion.  The former's viscosity is a little thicker, so as you apply/rub it on, there is a less fluid/liquidity feel to it as the regular Curel.  I would not characterize it as 'tackier' application feeling but definitely thicker and not as smooth/slippery.  If this bothers you, get the  regular blend Curel.  I don't have any comment (yet) if the ultra healing works any better/quicker than the regular moisturizing version as this is my first/earlier use.  I will say the regular version works fine, so I expect to have improved, quicker results from the ultra healing.  I love Curel as I have very low oil and very dry skin.  I apply the lotion in the morning and in the evening, and it resolved some significant skin cracks (actual severe that had some light bleeding) and fingertip ends very rough/dry/abrasive skin in about a week.  So now I use it regularly twice a day and have had no recurring dry, rough, or breaks in the skin.  I don't perceive either ultra or regular Curel as oily or leaving a long-standing film.  I just rub and spread it thoroughly over the skin and in a minute or two I don't even think about whether my skin is greasy, don't notice it.

Скажу, что обычная версия работает отлично, поэтому я ожидаю более эффективных и быстрых результатов от версии «экстраувлажнение». Я обожаю Curel, так как у меня очень мало кожногo жира и очень сухая кожа. Я наношу лосьон утром и вечером, и примерно за неделю он устранил довольно глубокие трещины на коже (реально сильные, которые немного кровоточили) и очень грубую/сухую/шероховатую кожу на кончиках пальцев. source_doc: Good Keyboard for a Beginner or Novice. this is a nice keyboard for beginner.  It's not quite the full piano keyboard size but better than a 66 key offered on some.  I am an adult beginner, and this works fine.  There are way more bells and whistles then I need and the manual that comes with it is thick, I hope to get to it someday.  I have noticed that the keyboards and the song playback option are just a bit off.  One or the other is sharp or flat by just a little so it is a bit annoying.  I went with Yamaha because of the name and the PSR-EW310 is near the bottom of their price range, and I am glad I bought it.  It does not include a stand or a bench but the small table I have it on works fine for now, no sustain peddle either.  I did buy some headphones because I live in an apartment and so glad I did because it helps shut out other noises and I can concentrate better.  Yes, I'm a little ADD.

source_doc: they are ok, not the best. I tried these, as I am always in a hurry and need to eat my fruits and veggies. They were not too too bad.  I guess I just don't like the taste of the greens in them. But other than that , they are perfect for a snack and to get those fruits and veggies in, which play an important part of my diet.  I am 52 by the way.  I do have a grandchild.  but I specifically bought these for me.  I also like the way I can screw the top back on.these are nice to carry in my pocket when I am on a walk.  sometimes I get light headed from not eating enough, and these seemed to help that "hunger" feeling in between meals as well.

source_doc: Very lovely fragrance- Jamilla. I am a bit of a tomboy but I love my perfumes and I love getting compliments on my perfumes. I have a ton but I will be wearing this a lot. It is a floral sweet smell  with just a touch of sensual news to it. The floral is not over powering or, believe me, I wouldn’t like it. The gentle blend of citrus and sweet is just perfect. I couldn’t stop putting my wrist to my nose,,,It literally made me feel comforted, to smell this fragrance. My husband wanted me to put some on his pillow, so he could smell it as he went to sleep. It’s not watery, like standard perfumes, it is an oil so it will last a long time. It has a dropper applicator. The bottle is beautiful,,,you’ll feel elegant, just opening this.  I’m going to transfer some of it into a small roller bottle to travel with. I put it on this morning, as soon as I got it, and it’s 12 hours later and I can still smell it. Not crazy strong,,,just enough to make me smile.  Read the notes of the perfumes, from this creator, to find one that suits you, and I’m sure you will, I know I will most certainly be purchasing more. Thank you for such a heavenly fragrance.

source_doc: Brings sound down a notch and are super comfy. I work from home and have a couple of dogs a toddler and various other distractions around the house, usually when I want to tune them out I throw on some headphones but sometimes I just want quiet so I got these to help with that.  It came packaged well and I didn't see any defects in them.  In the box you get a case, two rings to put the ear tips on, and 6 different ear tips to use.  I chose the large double-flanged and got to it. Getting the stock tips off was fairly easy and putting the new ones on was too after that I stuck them in.  It isn't complete noise cancelation I can still hear most things fine but it's like the volume got turned down a bit which I love.  Also when Im wearing them I can barely feel them so I might actually try sleeping in them.  All in all, these are fantastic 5 starts not notes.

source_doc: Wow was I surprised when I opened this! I purchased this but thought maybe I should have bought glass instead. When I saw it it looked so much like glass and even felt and sounded like glass. It wasn't just me I bought one as a gift for someone else and she couldn't believe it was not glass either but best of all, it fell off the counter the other day. I was sure it would crack or something. Instead it bounced! That sucker hit the ground hard on a hardwood floor and not even a scratch. I don't know about the floor though LOL! I highly recommend. If you're going to make triple layer cakes go for something a little taller but it is great for a double layer cake and I use lots of fluffy whipped cream icing. Fits right over the top and I also cover the bottom with the cardboard cake rounds. I don't know if that's necessary but I figure if I ever want to use the bottom as a charcuterie tray I don't want to mix my meats and cake so as a precaution I use the cake rounds. Excellent item!

source_doc: Bright, Easy to Aim, Easy to Install. These plug in linkable lights are a great answer to any dark corner in your garage or shop. I know they have fixed MY dark corner problem. I really like that these lights have "petals" that can be aimed any which way I need. And they stay once I have aimed them.One of these lights was dead on arrival but the manufacturer was quick to respond to the issue and make sure I was satisfied with their resolution.So these lights are BRIGHT. Did I mention that? It is relevant because I cannot look directly at them. Not that I'd want to, but that gives you an idea how bright they are. Also, conveniently, I was able to link these lights to existing shop lights I have that also have a two prong outlet. I flipped the switch on these to "on" and left it because the outlet everything is plugged into is on a switch I can reach. Having to switch these lights on individually each time just wasn't practical but I appreciate the option.These lights are really an easy way to improve any lighting you are missing not to mention the manufacturer that cares about their customers. Truly a win all the way around!

source_doc: Not the best for spices. I bought these to store some of my dry spices however I noticed that the jars had a strong chemical smell when opening them. I did not want these chemicals to seep into my spices. After a bit of tinkering with the jars I realized that the chemical smell was coming from the white styrofoam seals in the lids—once I took them out the jars smelled fine. I choose these jars specifically because they screw shut unlike some others jars that just have a cork/plunger type lid. For my purposes since I use my spices frequently and I don’t live in a very humid climate I don’t need the airtight seals which I took out. With that in mind this was a good purchase for me however it may not be for others who are looking to store spices.Edit————After removing the chemical smelling seals that came with these jars I decided to buy rubber gasket seals online to replace them. Cheap and very effective and now my jars are air and water tight. Unfortunate that I had to go to this extra step but these jars are nice enough for me to go the extra mile.

source_doc: I love it. I did significant research before pulling the trigger on the Honbay modular sectional. I’m so glad I did. My family and I absolutely love it. As other reviews mentioned, 5 out of 7 boxes arrived earlier than expected. The 2 remaining boxes arrived the next day. Once I had an idea of what I was working with in my space, I ordered two additional ottoman pieces to create the sectional I had envisioned. I have a weird space in my living area so many traditional sectionals would be too large. It was super easy to assemble, I did it myself over the course of the two arrival days. I love the storage in each piece, which really helped to declutter my living area and eliminated the need for two storage baskets, freeing up floor space in the process. I love the firmness of the seats. I would agree with other reviews that the back cushions could be fluffier but I added a lot of my own pillows which solves that problem for me. My kids and my dog have bounced around on it and I haven’t noticed any instability. With the layout I chose, I love the little cutout which makes it easy for kids or dog to climb in. I’m so thrilled with my new sectional. If you are on the fence, do it!!

source_doc: Poor Quality. On the positive side, the lock is easy to install. The directions are clear and the lock has a voice menu. After following the directions and installing the lock, I added batteries and set the administrative passcode. I then programmed the lock for a left hinge door - all very easy following the instructions. Beware, after making these settings, the door locked. I wasn't able to unlock it with the passcode. I had to retrieve a spare key and enter through another door. After deleting the default passcode, I set up my own passcode. So far so good. I then tried locking the door by pressing the # key for 2 seconds. I heard the motor whir and the voice stating that the door was locked. Unfortunately, door was not locked. The deadbolt hadn't moved. Whether I tried locking or unlocking the door, the motor would whir and the voice would announce door locked, BUT the deadbolt never moved or engaged. It would not lock or unlock. I was disappointed because the features of this lock were exactly what I was looking for. Quality is just not there.  I returned it.

source_doc: Feels SO wonderful on my scalp! I have kinky/coily 4b/c hair. I have routinely oiled and massaged my dry scalp with my fingertips 2-3 times per week. I just received my massagers and washed my hair yesterday. Because my kinky/coily hair is VERY difficult to detangle when wet, I did not use while shampooing (YET! I plan to try that later). I wanted to try it 1st with my regular routine - oiling and massaging my dry hair. I began massaging 1st with my fingertips (as usual), then immediately switched to my new silicone massager. The feeling on my scalp was instantly different and wonderful. The massager felt so much better than my fingertips!  I finished at 5:10pm, it is currently 6:10pm and my scalp is still tingling from the excellent blood circulation results of the massager. NEVER felt this when used only fingertips. Also, I saw that one person gave a low rating, stating that the massager hurt scalp and tangled hair. I massaged my scalp gently and it felt SO GOOD! I also noted that, as with fingertips, I always have to detangle with my fingers after massaging. After using massager, my detangle process was about the same and actually seemd a little easier. I love the massager! I will send an updated review if/when I try on my wet kinky/coily hair.
hypos: Ощущения на коже головы ПРОСТО чудесные! У меня жесткие кудрявые волосы типа 4b/c. Я регулярно, 2–3 раза в неделю, смазываю маслом и массирую сухую кожу головы кончиками пальцев. Вчера я получил/а свои массажеры и вымыл/а голову. Поскольку мои жесткие кудрявые волосы ОЧЕНЬ трудно распутать в мокром виде, я не использовал/а его во время мытья шампунем (ПОКА ЧТО! Планирую попробовать это позже). Сначала я хотел/а протестировать его в рамках своего обычного ухода — при нанесении масла и массаже сухих волос. Сперва я начал/а массировать кончиками пальцев (как обычно), а затем сразу перешел/шла на свой новый силиконовый массажер. Ощущения на коже головы мгновенно изменились и стали потрясающими. Массажер ощущался намного лучше, чем кончики пальцев! Я закончил/а в 17:10, сейчас 18:10, а моя кожа головы все еще покалывает от отличного кровообращения, вызванного массажером. Я НИКОГДА не чувствовал/а подобного, когда использовал/а только кончики пальцев. Кроме того, я видел/а, что один человек поставил низкую оценку, заявив, что массажер травмирует кожу головы и спутывает волосы. Я массировал/а кожу головы аккуратно, и это было ТАК ПРИЯТНО! Я также заметил/а, что, как и в случае с кончиками пальцев, мне всегда приходится распутывать волосы руками после массажа. После использования массажера процесс распутывания остался примерно таким же и даже показался немного легче. Я в восторге от этого массажера! Я отправлю обновленный отзыв, если/когда попробую его на своих мокрых жестких кудрявых волосах.

source_doc: Really considering this: I don’t usually write a review when I havent bought something, and I will up/down grade when I do 🤪.  I have been looking for 24+ hours for something that I can transport my 4 legged kids, they are both under 20 #, but tend to get into a battle with each other when they see ANYTHING!  I looked at single dog pack packs, which means one will need to walk, then trying to find a twin pet stroller, but it seems the weights don’t work OR they didn’t seem very good quality . So I have found this ! ! !  I know I will need to make some modifications to keep them inside, like putting an additional screening/net over the top to secure the “canopy” and they not get out;  I’ll also need to put some kind of divider between them.  Apparently per one of the video reviews I think it was the Pivot vs ? Another brand, it has a “panel” that will close off the foot well so that can make the “floor” a full solid piece.  I won’t need it for a while, but it’s sitting in my shopping cart !

source_doc: Not A Bad Alternative For Cat Litter. I wasn't so sure about this litter but I was surprised that it was not so bad. I have 3 cats and 2 litter boxes so the main issue I have with cat litter is the strong smell that the boxes leave around the house. I've tried all kinds of litter and while they do work it doesn't get rid of the smell entirely. I started using this mixed litter and it works really well. I know the litter is flushable but I feel better just throwing it away when I clean the boxes. The cats took a bit to get used to the mixed litter but I was surprised that it did handle the odor really well. I would have to get more bags to handle my 3 cats but I would use this Mixed Litter again because it did get rid of the odor and easy upkeep.

source_doc: Honest review. So I'm a PP mom. I for sure have a mom pooch and I need the stretch and comfortness. But as any mom knows, you feel less than desirable and you hurt in so many places. I ordered the wine colored red leggings. They are more purple than I would have liked but I absolutely hold my samsung 23 ultra well in the pockets. I am currently 5ft6in and about 187lbs. I ordered the Large and I agree with everyone that they do run large (which is rare and kinda a breath of fresh air). So I have the absolute pleasure to return for a smaller size. With the size I have now my underwear is visible ehen bending over but I tested with black and flower undies. Will update with the smaller size.
hypos: Честный отзыв. Итак, я недавно родившая мама. У меня точно есть послеродовой животик, и мне нужны эластичность и комфорт. Но, как знает любая мама, ты чувствуешь себя не самой привлекательной, и у тебя всё болит в стольких местах. Я заказала легинсы винно-красного цвета. Они более фиолетовые, чем мне хотелось бы, но мой Samsung 23 Ultra отлично держится в карманах. Сейчас мой рост около 168 см, а вес примерно 85 кг. Я заказала размер L, и я согласна/сен со всеми, что они большемерят (что редкость и своего рода глоток свежего воздуха). Так что мне безумно приятно вернуть их, чтобы получить размер поменьше. source_doc: Love them. I just purchased for a second time.Pros:I like these because they have a size 0 that is wide. These nails are durable and lasted me two weeks. (Of course that depends on how you apply your nails.)They come with a lot of nail sizes, which I like. I have wide width nail beds and their size 0 fits great. (Since I repetitively use the 4 & 5, I wish you could just order your sizes versus having extra sizes I cannot wear, but I get my money’s worth by using the extra nails to practice designs.)FYI, I use gel polish so it definitely makes them look professional. They are thin by the cuticle and thicker at the end so it makes it easier to file to fit your nails and look like acrylics.The price is great for how many nails you get and for the quality. I did crack a nail after I took them off, but this was me putting a heavy object on them. Please do not think these nails are unbreakable, because they can. They are still very strong (not fragile) and did excellent for the two weeks.Lastly, I did not have any issues where I had to contact customer service so I cannot speak to that, but the product is good. I will buy again.

(Конечно, это зависит от того, как вы наносите ногти.) В комплекте идет много размеров ногтей, что мне нравится. У меня широкое ногтевое ложе, и их размер 0 отлично подходит. source_doc: Nice, Slim. I had my doubts.  But I like these.  The one I use most is holding olive oil.  I like the very thin spout, I have good control of how much oil I add to the pan.  The slim design makes it fit nicely into my cabinet and I like the way it feels and fits in my hand.  The little gravity stopper is very nice, I must say.  No dribbling, the top is always back on as soon as you tilt the bottle back up, not sitting in an oily puddle on the counter.  The other we use for my kids mouthwash. They were having problems opening the locking caps and this is perfect.  I was worried they'd destroy it immediately, I really was hesitant about having kids handle it daily, but it holds up just fine, it has resisted their destruction so far.  The glass seems fairly thick and it has a silicon boot to keep the bottom from chipping, thank goodness. This set includes two adorable little shot glasses meant to fit atop each bottle.  Obviously I don't need the one from the olive oil bottle so I use it to start plant cuttings, but "someone" in my house was enjoying it as a liquor shot glass before I co-opted it for horticultural use.

Мне очень нравится узкий носик: я отлично контролирую, сколько масла добавляю на сковороду. Благодаря компактному дизайну бутылка отлично помещается в шкаф, и мне нравится, как приятно она лежит в руке. Маленькая гравитационная крышка — просто прелесть, надо сказать. Никаких потеков, крышка сразу же закрывается, стоит лишь вернуть бутылку в вертикальное положение, и она не стоит в масляной луже на столе. Вторую мы используем для детского ополаскивателя для рта. У детей были проблемы с открыванием крышек с защитой, а этот вариант просто идеален. Я боялся/лась, что они сразу же её разобьют, и очень сомневался/лась, стоит ли давать её детям для ежедневного использования, но она отлично держится и пока успешно противостоит их разрушительной силе. Стекло кажется довольно толстым, и у бутылки есть силиконовый чехол, чтобы защитить дно от сколов, слава богу. В этот набор входят две очаровательные маленькие стопки, которые должны надеваться поверх каждой бутылки. source_doc: Best Wipes - From a Preschool Teacher! I’m very fortunate in that I teach a class of twelve toddlers who all require diaper changes throughout the day. I’m fortunate because while I was pregnant, I was able to test out ten different kinds of wipes! These were by far my favorite. Most wipes are too dry to really get anything clean. I felt like I was scrubbing some of the kids’ bottoms to get them clean, which obviously isn’t very comfortable. These wipes are a dream! Wet enough to get the job done, and thick enough that I have never felt like I was going to get anything on my fingers. (Granted, I wear gloves at the preschool. I mean with my new daughter!) My girl has never had diaper rash, and while she has eczema on her little face cheeks, her booty remains clear! I had 3 boxes of these wipes, and she is ten weeks old. I still have 3 packs from the second box, and I’m only opening the third to send some to daycare. They last a while! Just get them!
hypos: Лучшие салфетки — от воспитателя/ницы детского сада! Мне очень повезло, так как я учу класс из двенадцати малышей, которым всем нужно менять подгузники в течение дня. Мне повезло, потому что пока я был/а беременна, я смог/ла протестировать десять разных видов салфеток! Эти оказались моими самыми любимыми. Большинство салфеток слишком сухие, чтобы действительно что-то очистить. Мне казалось, что я соскабливаю грязь с попок некоторых детей, чтобы очистить их, что, очевидно, не очень приятно. Эти салфетки — просто мечта! Достаточно влажные, чтобы справиться с задачей, и достаточно плотные, так что мне ни разу не показалось, что я могу испачкать пальцы. (Конечно, в детском саду я ношу перчатки. Я имею в виду со своей новорожденной дочкой!) У моей девочки никогда не было опрелостей, и хотя у нее экзема на щечках, ее попка остается чистой! У меня было 3 коробки этих салфеток, а ей сейчас десять недель. У меня все еще осталось 3 пачки из второй коробки, и я открываю третью только для того, чтобы отправить немного в ясли. Их хватает надолго! Просто купите их!

source_doc: These are great! I ordered these when the time changed (we live in an area that does Daylight Saving Time) and it started getting dark by 5:00pm. I didn’t like pulling up at home after work and getting out in the dark, so I got these bulbs to put in the fixtures on the front of our detached garage. They work like a charm!! I was so pleased the next day when I came home and had lights on! We’ve had these all winter now, and I purposely waited to write this review so I could be sure of how well they work. They come on at dusk and go off at dawn - just as advertised! I actually like that they stay on all night because then they function as security lights. I have absolutely no complaints about these bulbs, their brightness, their dependability, nothing. They are fantastic and I wish I’d bought them years ago. I would certainly recommend these to anyone.
hypos: Они великолепны! Я заказал/а их, когда перевели часы (мы живем в районе, где действует летнее время) и в 17:00 уже начинало темнеть. Мне не нравилось подъезжать к дому после работы и выходить из машины в темноте, поэтому я купил/а эти лампочки, чтобы вкрутить их в светильники на фасаде нашего отдельно стоящего гаража. Они работают просто волшебно! Я был/а так рад/а на следующий день, когда вернулся/лась домой, а свет уже горел! Они у нас уже всю зиму, и я намеренно подождал/а с написанием этого отзыва, чтобы убедиться в том, насколько хорошо они работают. Они включаются в сумерках и гаснут на рассвете — точно как и заявлено! Мне даже нравится, что они горят всю ночь, потому что в этом случае они выполняют функцию охранного освещения. source_doc: Love these so much!! Let me start off that I haven't used the decals. My walls are textured, so I already know they probably wouldn't stick. The shelves look great even without the decals though so I'm not worried about it. I know they were for a nursery, but I didn't need them in my son's room. So I put them in my bathroom behind my sink area to hold my lotions and perfumes. I love that they have the bar infront to hold things in, easy to clean, the perfect size for what I needed them for, and SOMEWHAT easy to put together. The only reason I gave it a 4 instead of a 5, is the reason why I said somewhat easy to put together. I had one end piece that the holes were not done correctly for the bar piece. So could only use one dowel to hold it in place instead of two. Which shouldn't effect it at all, but you expect something to come in with no defects at all. With that being said, I would get these again in a heartbeat and highly recommend them.

source_doc: The formula has changed. I bought this product because I have used it before and loved it.  However something changed and it caused a mild allergic reaction.  I know that I have some allergies that often get labeled as “fragrance” in skin products so I normally test a new product on my wrist first.  I didn’t this time because I had used the product before, so I just immediately applied it to my whole face. I did notice that the scent was stronger and the ingredients have changed slightly (I looked after I had the reaction).  I normally would not leave a negative review on a product for an allergic reaction, but since this was something that I have been able to use without issue in the past and can no longer use, I felt that people should know.

source_doc: Bright Lights. Short Length. I ordered these to add some lights under my cabinets. I am currently using battery operated puck lights… which need battery replacement often. I don’t want to keep replacing the batteries or forgetting… and then they corrode. ANYWAY, these were my solution. However, I am not handy, and I have zero clue how to install these. You would think it’s as easy as sticking them up and boom you’re done. But I’m afraid to cut the wire and then they don’t work. My boyfriend is an electrician, and I am hoping he can help ease this process and make it worry free for me… but for now, I’m not so sure what to do. There are detailed instructions, but I am scared to do something wrong… and how do they connect between cabinet spaces? However, I am happy this came with all the pieces necessary for the job. And as you can see the lights actually work and are pretty bright. I can’t blame the lights that I don’t know how to install… but to me, personally, it’s not very user friendly. I “pretend” hung them in my kitchen, and they weren’t long enough any way. I would consider hanging them in my closet, where no cutting would be involved, but I don’t have an outlet in there. Hopefully one day I will be able to provide an update with a more positive review.

source_doc: This worked so good!!! I just bought a new to me 2020 Charger. Dont forget to roll your window down slightly to get the top. But this stuff worked wonderfully!!!!

source_doc: Love it! Very sturdy little stool. I hate to say it but I am 420lbs and getting one of these I was worried I would break it when I sat on it but this little handy dandy stool is pretty darn sturdy. I work as a after care teacher in early education, I have a bad knee and plantar fasciitis in for feet so standing for to long sometimes is kinda difficult. I have to sit with my leg extended out so holding any of my weight up off the stool isn't something that happens. Also my kiddos at school are always wanting to sit on it and of course they try playing with it and it's held up very well! As for comfort, I mean it doesn't have a cushion so it's not like super comfortable but it gives me a place to sit and it holds me up so yeah its good enough. Another good thing is is that i am a tall girl and this isn't so short like other stools like this one where I snap crackle and pop when I go to sit down so that's definitely a plus. It's most definitely worth the money if you need a portable stool.
hypos: Обожаю его! Очень прочный маленький табурет. Не хочется признаваться, но я вешу 190 кг, и, покупая его, я переживал/а, что сломаю его, когда сяду, но этот маленький и удобный табурет чертовски прочный. Я работаю воспитателем в группе продленного дня в начальной школе, у меня больное колено и подошвенный фасциит на обеих ногах, поэтому долго стоять мне иногда тяжеловато. Мне приходится сидеть с вытянутой ногой, так что переносить часть своего веса с табурета на пол никак не получается. К тому же мои детишки в школе вечно хотят на нем посидеть и, конечно же, пытаются с ним играть, и он отлично все это выдерживает! source_doc: So sadly disappointed. I bought this sticker for my son’s wall above his computer where he plays his computer games. I thought that the pattern and the writing style were super cool and I knew my 10-year-old would love it. I ended up ordering this item twice because the first time it never arrived the second one that I got. I cleaned my wall before sticking it and  made sure it was dry before placing it where I wanted it. Once I stuck it on, I could tell there were going to be problems because it immediately started peeling on the sides where the first letter is and the last letter is the next morning after the day I put it up the entire sticker had fallen off my wall. I wish I could send it back, since I have it stuck to a piece of cardboard in case the company will work with me and returning it but please don’t buy this unless your walls have no pattern or any type of raised parts to it. I’m not sure if that’s why it didn’t stick but I cleaned it and ride it so I don’t see why the sticker did not stay on my wall.

source_doc: Made me break out, scent is a bit strong for me. This has a sticky texture and doesn't quite absorb into the skin, but rather, sits on top of it. I'm not hanging it in my house anywhere, and I'd rather none of this was included, it just gave me more to discard (I recycled the b0x, its filling and the note). But even if I were giving this as a gift (which I wouldn't), it felt a bit overdone and wasteful.

source_doc: Really liked them, but they would not charge. I really liked these lanterns. They flashlight option was extremely bright. The big downside is the charging. Upon receiving them, I plugged them both in. A blue light came on for about 5 seconds and then disappeared. I assumed this meant that they were fully charged. I took them camping and they started fading before the end of the first night. The next day I plugged them both in for about 3 hours apiece. The same thing happened when I plugged them in, a blue light for about 5 seconds then it disappeared. No indication if they were actively charging or fully charged. After 3 hours of charging apiece, I tried using them for my 2nd night of camping. As soon as I turned them, they died within a minute as if they hadn’t been charged at all. I returned them. These lanterns failed me on my camping trip. I can’t have an unreliable light source that doesn’t given any indication at all of charging or battery status. It’s a shame because I really liked the outside of the charging issues..

source_doc: if you use festool, with makita vac…it’s a must. it has taken me a long time to work with multiple tool platforms.  Not having a money tree and moving among trade work, construction, and wood working it is also a fact that festool doesn’t make every tool under the sun.  I like the makita vacuum and have really enjoyed it, but bouncing back and forth between AWS gear and plugged in festool devices I got the idea to get this product and velcro a festool power chord to it.  Now when I use my festool planer or sander, I swap hoses (which is easy unlike other extractor or shop vac platforms) and attach the one with the chord.  No it’s not the festool system, but it works for me and has made my desire to get another dust extractor not be a hot button issue.  The older I get the more conscious I am of what I am breathing in.  I can’t say I gave much thought into sanding walls in my fraternity house 30 yrs ago. What I can say is that while I work alone in a job, I will have several extractors, but as far as I am concerned this hose has at least temporarily saved me $900.

source_doc: Just what I wanted. I had a jump rope but I didn’t like the super light jump rope cord on it. I needed something a little heavier that I don’t have to spin at a thousand miles an hour to make it track straight. This kit is fantastic, I trimmed the medium cord (the black one) to the size in needed with the included tools and took off using it like I’ve owned it forever because it felt so natural. The medium is perfect for me but I will also trim the other two cords to the same length so I can mix it up now and again. I have nothing but good things to say about this set, the handles are comfortable and spin well, the quick release system works well, all three included cords seem high quality and the case is nice. The extra set screws and Allen wrench were a nice touch and the cable cutters are so nice they are going right in my tool box after I get my other two cords sized. In my opinion this jump rope set is a great value and I can recommend this without reservation.

source_doc: So great for travel. This is such a creative idea for a traveling mom. I got it for an upcoming cruise because I thought I would be pumping and this would be perfect, but I ended up drying up too early. I was still able to use it for little visits to grandma's house, etc. I like that it has little separate branches for all the parts. I probably could have used a couple more, but it worked well. I did not personally like the silicone bottle brush that was included so I just brought my own regular bottle brush. I did really like that it came with a small soap bottle. I think this would be perfect for a working mom who is pumping and doesn't want to leave their pump stuff all over the icky shared kitchen or something.
hypos: Отлично подходит для путешествий. Это такая креативная идея для путешествующей мамы. Я все равно смог/ла использовать его для коротких поездок в гости к бабушке и т. д. Мне нравится, что у него есть отдельные маленькие веточки для всех деталей. source_doc: The shrimp are healthy! The shrimp are beautiful and healthy and so fun to watch.  DO NOT put them in a tank with a betta, guppies or Harlequins.  I have 2 tanks, and at first, I thought it was the betta that was eating them, so I removed him to my second tank. They still kept disappearing, so I removed the harlequins, because after hours of observation, I saw them get aggressive to the helpless shrimp. All that was left was guppies, and they still got eaten. I loved the shrimp so much, they were so fun to watch, but if I try again, I will have them in their own tank with nothing else.  They all arrived alive, healthy and very active.  Their color is so striking.  I feel terrible the research I did online was wrong.  I do wonder if you can keep different colors of shrimps together?  The red and white ones are so cool, too.  So learn from me, people, and don't put them with other fish or they will become a very expensive appetizer!

source_doc: Awesome thermometer. I love this thermometer! I never worried about a thermometer until the RONA hit. The first time I caught it was right before we could get vaccinated and I have Fibromyalgia so even the CDC told us that I was going to have a rougher time of it than my mom. And I did, I fought with a fever for over a week while she never had a fever. (That's just the pertinent symptom here) We had gotten 2 thermometers one for the temple and I got a regular one because I had to be able to use it simply and in the dark and didn't want to fumble with it. But they both used button batteries. Guess what, a couple years later when I got it a second time (proving I was more prone to it because I didn't pass it to my mom as she had passed it to me) Both thermometers were dead and we couldn't check my temp, though I didn't have a fever. So when I saw this one and saw it took normal every day run of the mill always on hand batteries and that it displayed the same as the ones we had I grabbed it right up and it didn't disappoint. And while I don't need it yet, I did try it and it works perfectly. I'm so happy with this thermometer.

В первый раз я подхватил/а его прямо перед тем, как мы смогли вакцинироваться, а у меня фибромиалгия, так что даже CDC (Центры по контролю и профилактике заболеваний) предупреждали нас, что мне придется тяжелее, чем моей маме. Так и вышло, я боролся/лась с лихорадкой больше недели, в то время как у нее температуры вообще не было. (Это единственное имеющее отношение к делу проявление здесь). Мы приобрели два термометра: один бесконтактный для виска, а себе я взял/а обычный, потому что мне нужно было иметь возможность пользоваться им просто и в темноте, не желая возиться с настройками. Но в обоих использовались плоские батарейки-таблетки. И угадайте что: пару лет спустя, когда я заразился/лась во второй раз (что доказало мою большую предрасположенность к вирусу, ведь я не передал/а его маме, хотя она в прошлый раз заразила меня), оба термометра разрядились, и мы не смогли измерить мне температуру, хотя лихорадки у меня не было. Поэтому, когда я увидел/а этот термометр и понял/а, что он работает на обычных, повседневных, банальных батарейках, которые всегда под рукой, и показывает результаты так же, как и наши прежние, я сразу же схватил/а его, и он не разочаровал. source_doc: Great bulbs! I had a lamp I wanted to use Alexa with and I have other older Kasa smart plugs that work fine.  My other bulbs were Lumiman and I was thinking I'd switch to all Kasa so I'd have just the one app on my phone.  So I ordered a Kasa smart bulb but it refused to connect.  I thought that maybe it was because the lamp was one of those metal swing-arm things, so I decided I'd just get another Kasa plug instead and ordered a used set of 2 minis.  They both refused to connect.  Thinking it was because they were used, I ordered 2 more new ones.  And guess what, they refused to connect, too.  I tried everything with all of them.  Multiple tries and resets, moving the lamp all over the house and even right next to the router.  None of them would connect.  I thought it was me.  I decided last resort to try a Lumiman bulb just to eliminate a Kasa hardware factor and maybe my WiFi was an issue and, lo and behold, it connected right away with absolutely no issues.  Plus, these have no color which I rarely use on any of my smart bulbs.  So win win.  Too bad it seems there are no Lumiman plugs.  I used the second bulb in a lamp where I was using a Kasa plug.  Anyone have any recommendations to replace my other Kasa plugs?

source_doc: My GPRO TKL Replacement. I hate to admit this but I'm a Logitech fan, and all of my peripherals, until now, are Logitech hence why I have a GPRO TKL and a G604... Both of which have problems after 2 years.. Anyways, goodbye Logitech, and here I come Keychron. I originally bought the K3 v2 since I wanted a little bit more space on my desk and improve the ergonomics. Summary is it didn't work out. I kept hitting the LED and Page Up keys so I got these instead. For the price, this keyboard has A LOT to offer especially since I outgrew the RGB trend. I also don't care for the software or custom macros. For the past 2+ years I've owned my GPRO and G604, I never touched custom macros and key binds.As a Logitech fan, it hurts me to say that the quality of this keyboard is probably better than their G lineup. Only time will tell if this will hold true for me, but it probably doesn't matter because I can just replace the switch and keycaps when this dies, unlike the GPRO TKL (you can desolder it...).

source_doc: I hesitate to say how much I love this guitar but…. I sent mine back. It was said to have a blemish on the body. It did not. It was gorgeous and beautiful and I love the feel and pickups. It had a warped neck. It needed a fret job and a nut job. I can do fret jobs but I can’t fix a warped neck. I almost cried sending it back. It had a wonderful vintage feel and tone. I plan to get another. I love this guitar and I have a lot of guitars. I can’t recommend this to anyone other than luthiers who appreciate the 70’s.To new players get a new guitar with perfect action and half price. Eart. There’s so many.

Она была великолепной и красивой, и мне очень нравятся ощущения от неё и звукосниматели. Но у неё был искривлён гриф. Ей требовалась шлифовка ладов и замена порожка. Я могу делать шлифовку ладов, но не могу исправить искривлённый гриф. Я чуть не заплакал/а, отправляя её обратно. У неё были чудесные винтажные ощущения и тон. Я планирую купить другую. Я люблю эту гитару, а у меня много гитар. Я не могу рекомендовать её кому-либо, кроме лютье, которые ценят 70-е. Новичкам лучше взять новую гитару с идеальным строем и вдвое дешевле. Eart, например. Их так много.

source_doc: I can finally play the high notes. I am an adult casual learner of recorder. I started playing on a $12 yamaha plastic recorder and upgraded to a $30ish dollar wood recorder because I couldn't manage to play high notes. I like the tone of the wooden recorder for the most part but I have the same trouble with notes higher than "G" and couldn't really hit high "B" or "C" at all. With this recorder I am able to hit all of those notes. It's still not super easy but I'm getting better all the time, much less squeaking - the dogs are very thankful. I have read that the arched airway gives more "control" over pitch. As a beginner I can tell that this will be difficult for me as I can vary the pitch a lot unintentionally, would probably make an experienced player cringe. I downloaded a tuning app so I can work on being consistent with my pitch.I also really love the feel of this recorder. It feels more lightweight, refined and well built. I also like the snap on thumb rest. I am pleased with this purchase.

source_doc: Going back to knipex. Long story short, I tried to use these, and they weren’t for me. After cutting what turned out to be a hot wire thanks to sloppy wiring in the past, I discovered these after watching a video recommending them.  I thought the pliers would be sort of a two tools in one for my tool belt.  If I need to cut a heavy gauge wire, the button would give me additional leverage without going back to my tools or carrying one more tool around.  What happened instead was the 85% of the time I was just cutting 10, 12 or 14 ga romex that the pliers were awkward in my hand and about half the time locked shut.  It would turn  a no look grab from tool belt, cut and return to tool belt into a grab, fiddle, cut, return.  I don’t have small hands but I am certainly not palming basketballs either (typically size L glove). The wihas were bulkier than my knipex cutters. The difference was a tool that took little thought was replaced with a tool that just didn’t fit or feel right.  When I was removing some old chain link fence, I appreciated the extra leverage but how often do I do that.After trying them for a month, I finally just went back to my knipex cutters. source_doc: Took me a long time to figure this out, but happy with it now. I was eager to try this as a way to record from my guitar onto a Macbook Pro, but was totally new to this type of device.  I understood that I would need to download 'digital audio workstation' (DAW) software, so I read about a few options and decided to go with the free version of Waveform. After downloading it, and connecting my guitar to the BOMGE, and connecting the BOMGE to my laptop (all of which were simple and quick), I spent an unsuccessful hour trying to achieve a recording. Then I downloaded Audacity software and retried, but was again unsuccessful. At that point, I had no idea whether the trouble was the BOMGE or just me not being able to figure this out. Turned out it was me. I returned to Waveform, re-watched a couple of its Youtube tutorials (which I highly recommend for beginners), and eventually got the hang of this. (With the guitar plugged into port 2, make sure that the 'inst' button is set on, and in Waveform, set the input for the recording track to 'input 2.') After that, the info page that came with the BOMGE was meaningful, and I have found the device to be just what I hoped for. It is compact in size and provides a fine sound quality for my amateur level.

source_doc: Using as an Ice Bin. I am writing this review and including pictures for those, like myself, who wants to use this as an ice bin.  I don't have a refrigerator with an built in ice maker and so I needed something to store a bag of ice.  I had originally purchased the 21 cup LocknLock but when it arrived, it didn't look big enough to hold a big bag of ice; so I sent that one back and ordered this 50.7 cup LocknLock bin.  It is large and takes up almost half to the upper freezer shelf but as I have a separate stand alone freezer, this isn't a problem.  What I like about it is that this bin have a large front door that I can scoop ice out of.  The lid snaps easily in place and the base seems pretty solid so I don't expect any leakage.  No cons so far but will update if I experience any.  The pictures shown are what was left of the bag of ice I'd purchase, so about a quarter of the bag.  I think another bag of ice will fill this bin completely full.

source_doc: Don’t waste your time or money. I have a 6 year old German Shepherd that was going on a 1k mile road trip with me. I wanted her to be more comfortable while strapped into a safety harness in the backseat of my GMC Terrain. I ended up purchasing this 1 piece grey inflatable seat extender in a bind because a different product I ordered had been delayed and wouldn’t arrive in time. I read the reviews and knew I was taking a chance.Product inflated easily using a shop vac. It fit very well and I was able to adjust seat position and seat back easily.The outside temp was around 28° F so I left it inside the house after checking the fit thinking I would pop it in place before hitting the road.In a 70° F room it completely deflated in under an hour. I checked the plug, reinflated it and again it was completely deflated in under an hour. I decided to give it one more chance; fully inflating it and checked it for leaks in the bathtub. I could not find a single location where air was escaping. No air bubbles at any seams or the plug.I ended up putting empty cardboard boxes in the floorboard instead of using this product.Don’t buy it. It’s not worth the high chance that it will be defective.

source_doc: Smells really good. I didn’t have the main product for which this is a refill, but I do have the Sol de Janeiro Cheirosa ‘62 perfume, which I Love… so I went ahead and ordered this. The smell of this is really So good. I think the only thing is that I’m not used to that much smell coming from my armpits, even when it’s a really delicious smell. The armpits are really warm, so they release fragrance more intensely than other parts of the body. I found that I couldn’t really get used to that much smell wafting up to me from that area, for some reason. So I may have to find another way to use this, other than on my armpits. Because I really do love the smell. But I think I need for my armpits to not have much smell to them, good or bad.

source_doc: Good value. I bought this in January, 2023 and have been playing it for 3 months now. I am a beginner so I didn’t want to invest too much in something if I didn’t stick with it. The threads aren’t rounded off but don’t stick out too much on the sides. The strings were a bit rusty from the warehouse but I didn’t change them out in case I wanted to return. I finally changed them out the other day after 3 months averaging 8-9 hours a week of playing.  Sounds much brighter and louder now with fresh strings. The tuning pegs turn smoothly and after the strings stretched they hold tuning fairly consistently. I decided it was time to get it a case and today received this case today. A perfect fit. Crossrock Hardshell Arch Top Wood case fits OM, Martin 000 Guitars-Vinyl Tweed(CRW600OMTW)If you’re a beginner, I think this is a good one to go with. I really like the tone of it compared to others I have heard. My music interests are Dixieland and music from the 30’s so the tone fits that era well.

source_doc: Warm White Light Bulb. Exactly whT I expected. I got the warm white color. 3000 Lumen or whatever the rating is. I knew these were not dimmable. I didn't see the note on the site that clearly says do most dim these or else they may flicker or hum. My microwave does have 2 settings for lighting underneath. They do flicker a bit only when on the lower setting. As they clearly posted. However, I decided before I bought these to not use the lower setting. Not a big deal. We use it as a kitchen night light. Why didn't I buy the dimmable ones? Because the ones I saw came in a pack of 6 and I only needed 2. If it really bothers me later I will buy dimmable lol. These are good bulbs. I didn't rate the longevity because they have only been in my microwave for 5 mins.

source_doc: 1mg time release lasts WAY too long, 13+ hrs after taking pill. I've done a lot of experimenting with different timing/dosage of melatonin, so I have a pretty good sense for how any given pill is affecting me. In theory, a 1mg time-release pill should be exactly what I need (more on this below). However, for me, this pill takes too long to kick in, and then induces drowsiness WAY too long. I don't feel much affect until 1-2 hours after taking it, and then it gets most intense right when I need to be waking up (about 8 hours in), and then it continues to make me sleepy for 4+ hours after that. I can definitely feel the affects lasting more than 12 hours.Before trying this tablet, I had been taking a regular melatonin pill divided into 0.5mg pieces twice per night---0.5mg before bed, and 0.5mg between sleep cycles (about 4 hours later). I had been doing this because I need help both falling asleep and staying asleep, and I only need a little melatonin to notice the affects. Taking 0.5mg twice worked well for me. Then I discovered this time-release 1mg tablet, which sounded ideal since I wouldn't have to take a second dose halfway through the night. However, this pill takes too long to kick in, and then lasts WAY too long after that (as described above).

Я определенно чувствую, что эффект длится дольше 12 часов. До того как попробовать эту таблетку, я принимал/а обычный мелатонин, разделенный на части по 0,5 мг, дважды за ночь — 0,5 мг перед сном и 0,5 мг между циклами сна (примерно через 4 часа). Я делал/а так, потому что мне нужно помочь себе как уснуть, так и не просыпаться ночью, а чтобы заметить эффект, мне достаточно совсем немного мелатонина. Прием по 0,5 мг дважды мне отлично подходил. Затем я открыл/а для себя эту таблетку с постепенным высвобождением 1 мг, которая казалась идеальным вариантом, ведь мне не пришлось бы принимать вторую дозу посреди ночи. Однако эта таблетка слишком долго начинает действовать, а затем действует СЛИШКОМ долго (как описано выше).

source_doc: Nice kit with plenty of extensions. I used this to pull the center drive shaft bearing on my BMW. I found it really easy to setup and get everything in place. I had to use a pair of extenders to reach down the shaft a ways, but even with them combined I found that the tool worked perfectly.All of the pieces are well made and precisely cast. There is a pretty sharp edge to the bearing separator that is great for some applications. This tool is made of cast metal, but it's stronger than I expected.The case is great also at keeping things organized.This is my first tool from Orion Motor Tech, but I'm happy enough that I'll look for their brand next time.Update 02/20/23...I have now used this to remove 5 different bushing or bearing sets and I'm Really Really happy with it. The last bushing I removed was the lower control arm bushing and I used a low torque impact wrench to turn the shaft instead of my fixed ratchet. No matter what I throw at this tool it remains looking and working like brand new. If I lose this one day I would buy it again. Of course I can't imagine it breaking at this point, but I would buy it again in that case as well.

source_doc: I'm REALLY Impressed. At the beginning of pandemic, I was constantly on video calls/doing virtual presentations etc. I heard a lot of  other people in meetings where you could barely understand them, and decided that I didn't want that to be me. I decided to buy a Blue Yeti because I figured it's probably important that other people can hear you speaking.After a few months, I upgraded to the Shure SM7B. It was an incredible upgrade and I was very happy with it. If you can, start with the Shure as opposed to a USB mic.Fast forward a few years, and I'm doing meetings and hosting webinars at least once a day. I heard the Neumann U87 is what NPR uses and I wanted to up the professionalism. I couldn't stomach paying $3500 for a U87, so I decided to compromise and get the TLM 103. It's a huge step up from the Shure.Both are great, but the 103 is way less fuzzy and sounds a lot more like my actual voice. A bonus, is that now I don't have to use a $150 cloud lifter to get decent sound out of the Shure. I highly recommend this product. The price is still a kick in the teeth, but it's noticeably better than anything I'd tried previously.

source_doc: very simple and straightforward, easy to use. This device was beautifully designed and the instructions were easy to follow.The way the device heated up the wax was a game-changer for me. I've used other waxing products in the past that required heating the wax up separately and it was always a hassle. With the roll on wax device, all I had to do was plug it in, wait for it to heat up, and then I was ready to go.Using the device itself was a breeze. I simply rolled the wax onto the wax strips, placed them onto my skin, and pulled them off. The strips adhered perfectly to my hair and removed it effortlessly. I was pleasantly surprised at how painless the process was. In the past, I had always associated waxing with pain, but with this device, I barely felt a thing.One of the things I loved most about the roll on wax device was how efficient it was. I was able to remove hair quickly and easily, and the results were long-lasting. I also appreciated how easy it was to clean up after I was done. The wax came off of the strips and the device itself with minimal effort.In conclusion, I highly recommend the roll on wax device to anyone looking for an effective, painless, and efficient hair removal method.

source_doc: Best on the market. I am ridiculously happy with these under-mount rechargeable lights! I recently updated my master closet and installed two of these lights. They are perfect for what I need. The motion sensor is very sensitive. They turn on immediately as I walk in, remain on as long as I am there and shut off about 30 seconds after I leave.  The brightness is adjustable. There is a switch to turn it on, off, or automatic. The little metal discs that the light magnetizes to are simple to adhere to a myriad of surfaces. I applied them to a melamine shelf so I’m not worried about removal should I want to move them. I would be cautious of applying to painted surfaces unless you plan on it being permanent.These have been perfect in my closet for low light for nighttime or early morning when I don’t want the brightness of over head lighting. I love them so much that I am getting more under cabinet lighting in the kitchen. They would also be perfect for a dark cupboard or linen closet that doesn’t have its own light. Honestly, I need them all over my house!The battery life seems to be long lasting and charging them are quick and simple. You can’t go wrong with these lights!!
hypos: Лучшие на рынке. Я безумно рад/а этим аккумуляторным светильникам под шкаф! Недавно я обновил/а свой основной гардероб и установил/а два таких светильника. Они идеально подходят для моих нужд. Датчик движения очень чувствительный. Они включаются сразу же, как только я захожу, остаются включенными, пока я там нахожусь, и выключаются примерно через 30 секунд после моего ухода. Яркость регулируется. Есть переключатель для включения, выключения или автоматического режима. Маленькие металлические диски, к которым примагничивается светильник, легко приклеить к самым разным поверхностям. Я прикрепил/а их к полке из меламина, поэтому не беспокоюсь о демонтаже, если захочу их перенести. source_doc: Everyone said I was dumb for getting this. Literally everyone I spoke to who mentioned this type of product wrote it off and said it was unnecessary and I was dumb for wanting it. They said I’d be too busy cleaning my newborn I would just apply creams with my finger and wouldn’t care.I do care. I care a lot lol. Personally i’m the type of person who eats chicken wings with gloves and washes my hands 20 times when cooking. I hate having random textures or residues on my hands. I made it maybe 3 days with my newborn before I ordered this because I was going insane feeling butt cream residue.I am so relieved I bought this. We switched from our expensive butt cream to cheap petroleum jelly, which works for our baby so much better lol. This spatula is godsend. I just swipe a glop of jelly onto it before the change and then smear it on my baby’s bottom like icing on a cake. The flat sides are great because you can get jelly right in the crack without hassle. You can also tackle their legs and arms without worry of getting them messy with jelly. It is easy to clean with a baby wipe after as well

source_doc: Absolutely Luxurious. I have been singing the praises of Andy Pandy diapers for six years and you could not have paid me to use anything else. Until the size large were out of stock for months. I had no choice but to find something similar and I did when I came across Eco Boom. Then for a reason I cannot recall I was on the hunt again. These diapers were on sale and oh how I wish I had been able to purchase more because they are the best diaper I have ever put my hands on. The feel absolutely divine, almost too good to be something a little human poops on. I have had no issues with leaking and they hold pee just as well as the other bamboo diapers I have mentioned here. They are out of my price point but if I they ever go on sale again I will be back. If you can afford them, I highly recommend these diapers.
