source_doc: It’s okay. It’s a starter kit, so it will give you what you need for a quick start up. I purchased Quick Start and Stress Coat+ instead of using the conditioner provided with the tank and they worked very well. Within a few hours of adding those in and running the filter, my water was ready.I’m not a fan of the filter at all, it’s loud, creates a strong current, and it doesn’t do the best job of cleaning the water (the sole thing a filter is supposed to do). Based on previous reviews it’s not reliable so within a week of having it I decided to replace it with an inexpensive, but much more reliable, sponge filter that doesn’t create a current. Happy water, happy fish.The lights are decent, though I wish they were dimmable. There are cheap options for dimmable lights with a timer that can be submerged, and I will be using those instead.The instructions for this tank mention a provided heater. There isn’t one provided, which I think is better as I found a heater that reads the water temperature and it’s keeping my betta very happy.Overall, the tank is decent and a huge upgrade from the 2.5 gallon I had before. With the money I spent, I could’ve purchased a bigger tank since I replaced everything else but now I know for the future.
hypos: Всё в порядке. Это стартовый комплект, так что он даст вам всё необходимое для быстрого запуска. Я купил/а Quick Start и Stress Coat+ вместо кондиционера, который шел в комплекте с аквариумом, и они очень хорошо сработали. Через несколько часов после их добавления и запуска фильтра моя вода была готова. Я совсем не в восторге от фильтра: он шумный, создает сильное течение и не очень хорошо очищает воду (единственное, что должен делать фильтр). Судя по предыдущим отзывам, он ненадежен, поэтому в течение недели после покупки я решил/а заменить его на недорогой, но гораздо более надежный губчатый фильтр, который не создает течения. Чистая вода — счастливая рыбка. Подсветка приличная, хотя мне хотелось бы, чтобы можно было регулировать яркость. Существуют дешевые варианты погружных светильников с регулировкой яркости и таймером, и вместо этого я буду использовать их. В инструкции к этому аквариуму упоминается нагреватель в комплекте. Его там нет, что, на мой взгляд, даже лучше, так как я нашел/шла нагреватель, который показывает температуру воды, и мой петушок очень доволен. В целом, аквариум приличный и представляет собой огромное улучшение по сравнению с 2,5-галонным, который у меня был раньше. За те деньги, которые я потратил/а, я мог/ла бы купить аквариум побольше, так как в итоге заменил/а всё остальное, но теперь я буду знать на будущее.

source_doc: Holy smokes! (Or holy flame?!) Geeze very few times have I actually bought something especially on Amazon and I’m blown away with the quality and price. (I’m not getting paid for this review but I should). This little thing packs a hell of a punch!!I have a Kamado joe grill and also a solo stove so I figured a propane torch would help speed things up. I tried the welding torch I have but it has a check valve and it’s a super small flame. I bought a cheap one off Amazon for 30 bucks and it failed on arrival. I waited a while and saw grillblazer. I really wanted that long one they got but no way I was shelling out 200 bucks and still need a kickstand for it to stand on its own.So glad I saw this and watch’s several YouTube reviews on it. Figured I’d give it a try and so glad I did. Now I can use my charcoal grilled just as fast if not faster than my propane grill on weekdays/nights :)

source_doc: Amazing mouse! I bought second hand and after a reset it works great! I own 4 mice, 2 cheapos a Corsair harpoon and this dark core. Only going to compare the corsair mice. The harpoon is light and easy to use. The the scroll wheel is very easy to use. I would rate this mouse excellent if I had never used the dark core RGB. The dark core is heavier which I actually like. And it FEELS so smooth I’m guessing that’s due to the 18,000 dpi optical sensor. The RGB IMO is awesome. I have it set to match my monitor or whatever is on display. The scroll wheel on the other hand is stiff. I find my finger sliding on it constantly. I have to adjust the pressure at what I use to move the scroll wheel. On the harpoon it’s effortless.I am using both wings on the dark core and I enjoy resting my fingers on them. It’s a nice feel/grip.Overall I love this mouse and it’s working great for me. Unfortunately I made the mistake and got them on qi charging version but I like it so much I don’t want to return
hypos: Потрясающая мышь! Я купил/а её подержанной, и после сброса настроек она работает отлично! У меня 4 мыши: 2 дешёвые, Corsair Harpoon и эта Dark Core. Буду сравнивать только мыши Corsair. Harpoon — лёгкая и простая в использовании. Колёсико прокрутки крутится очень легко. Я бы оценил/а эту мышь как отличную, если бы никогда не пользовался/лась Dark Core RGB. Dark Core тяжелее, что мне на самом деле нравится. И она ощущается такой плавной в движении, думаю, это благодаря оптическому сенсору на 18 000 DPI. RGB-подсветка, на мой взгляд, потрясающая. Я настроил/а её так, чтобы она соответствовала монитору или тому, что отображается на экране. С другой стороны, колёсико прокрутки тугое. Я замечаю, что мой палец постоянно соскальзывает с него. Мне приходится контролировать силу нажатия, с которой я кручу колёсико. На Harpoon это происходит без усилий. Я использую обе боковые панели на Dark Core, и мне нравится класть на них пальцы. Это приятное ощущение/хват. В целом я обожаю эту мышь, и для меня она работает отлично. К сожалению, я совершил/а ошибку и взял/а версию без беспроводной зарядки Qi, но она мне так нравится, что я не хочу её возвращать.

source_doc: Gear for Motorcycle front sprocket. I used this sprocket JT1264.17 17-tooth to swap out the front sprocket gearing of my Lifan Xpect 200cc motorcycle.  There are videos on how to do it on youtube. It's a very well-made sprocket and heavy-duty. After removing the sprocket cover and loosening the back wheel and chain I was able to take the stock 15-tooth sprocket (JT1264.15) out and install this 17-tooth with little issue.  The sprocket cover needed a little wiggling to get back on over the larger sprocket, but it worked. The result: This was a test I conducted as my own gear ratio experiment. Please consult for advice, from a mechanic professional, the manual, and the service dealer before doing this experiment. What did I gain? I was able to extend lower gears out longer and gained a comfortable (less RPM) 5th-gear speed riding the paved highway.  What did I lose by doing this swap?  I lost lower gear torque to the rear wheel.  I don't want to lose lower-gear torque. I am going to ride the bike on dirt roads and ATV trails where I need lower-gear torque for many purposes.  I won't keep the 17-tooth front sprocket in the motorcycle.  The 17-tooth sprocket looks very well made.  No manufacturing imperfections.  If you have a purpose for this front sprocket this looks like a good one to buy.  I am a DIYer.  Please consult your dealer service department for professional advice.

source_doc: Strange angle of mouthpiece. I think I've played just about everything that has keys or strings - even a theatre pipe organ - and I was looking for something different that was fun to play.  I did play the recorder a number of years ago, but again, I wanted something unique.  And that, is when I came across the ocarina.  I didn't want to invest a lot of money, but wanted something that had a good tone.  A little research on line brought me to the Night by Noble.  And I love it -- but my right wrist Does Not.  The mouthpiece just seems to be at an odd angle.  I did a little comparison to other brands and sure enough the angle and length is a bit odd.  Again, I really like this particular instrument, but might consider another brand with a longer and,more importantly, more angled mouthpiece, in the near future.Update - I purchased an STL Aria ocarina yesterday.  What a huge difference!  The mouthpiece angle is perfect and definitely longer.  And it gives me a great finger wrap for the balance needed in high notes.  It was three times the price of the NbN, but you pretty much get what you pay for.  I got a thick velvet carrying bag with the NbN, but wanted something more protective for a ceramic instrument.  Ended up finding a camera case that was just the right size.  I'm happy, my wrist is happy, so all is well!

source_doc: Super impressed, I love this bra! I love this bra way more than I originally thought I would. The package is easy to open, easy to pour out, and zips closed.I’m pretty careful about what I give our dog and usually stick to name brand products with lots of reviews. I checked out this company online and they’re based in the US. They have a website which you can order from. I can’t find any retailers other than Amazon. From what I read, the ingredients are sourced from the US. I like that the company also donates food to dog shelters.Our dog likes it just fine. I can’t say that this product has changed his eating habits for the better because he’s usually a very good eater. But he knows when he doesn’t like a food or treat. It is a bit less per ounce than the name brand product I use.

source_doc: Honestly, I love this bag. I got this bag specifically for one day of a three day music festival I went to out of town. I flew in the morning of, attended the show, stayed in a hotel, flew home. I had to take everything I needed to the show with me because I wouldn’t be able to check in before the show. Granted I packed light, but this bag held everything I needed for a day in the sun and an overnight.Ive since taken the bag on a handful of travels where we’d venture out all day without returning to the hotel and it was perfect. Everything I need for the day AND room for some crap I’d buy along the way, one time it was three books and a T-shirt! It was stuffed, but it held it all.I’ve been looking for something a little better quality because I’ve grown to love this style and I can’t find anything that I like as much as this bag. I’m not having issues, but there are a lot little strings from unraveling fabric that’ll eventually cause problems.I carry it almost every day now. It’s gonna wear out, but I figure I’ll carry it gladly until it does.I took the patches off and put a couple of my own on, looks much better now.All in all, great bag. Probably 8L or so. Plenty big and decently constructed with lots of pockets.

source_doc: DO NOT BUY THESE. these are absolute garbage unless you just want to play by yourself. they are so buggie i have to keep going back in and play with the audio settings in my XBOX series x MULTIPLE TIMES per session. I have 2 accounts on my Xbox and i use the same headset for each (for a high level and low level character in a particular game that won't let you have multiple characters), this screws up the headset every time i switch back and forth (others can hear me but i can't hear them, so i have to go into xbox settings and start over). then there's an annoying occurrence where if i play alone the audio is really decent- not great but decent. as soon as my wife invites me to a party her voice is super loud and i can't hear the game. these headphone lock you out of the normal chat mixer and force you to use the volume dials on the headset- but the problem is the volume doesn't change. I have my wife screaming at me and i can't hear the game, the games music or my guns shooting- so i smashed these pieces of garbage on my table. total garbage. the XBOX official ones were the same price, but they were not available so i got these, that was a hundred bucks i really regret spending.
hypos: НЕ ПОКУПАЙТЕ ЭТО. Это абсолютный мусор, если только вы не хотите играть в одиночку. Они настолько глючные, что мне приходится постоянно заходить в настройки звука на моей XBOX Series X ПО НЕСКОЛЬКУ РАЗ за сессию. У меня два аккаунта на Xbox, и я использую одну и ту же гарнитуру для каждого (для персонажа высокого и низкого уровня в определенной игре, которая не позволяет иметь нескольких персонажей), и это ломает гарнитуру каждый раз, когда я переключаюсь туда-сюда (другие меня слышат, а я их нет, поэтому мне приходится заходить в настройки Xbox и начинать все сначала). Кроме того, происходит жутко раздражающая вещь: если я играю один/одна, звук вполне приличный — не отличный, но приличный. Но как только жена приглашает меня в тусовку, ее голос становится супергромким, а звуков игры я вообще не слышу. Эти наушники блокируют доступ к обычному микшеру чата и заставляют использовать колесики громкости на самой гарнитуре, но проблема в том, что громкость не меняется. Жена орет мне в уши, а я не слышу игру, игровую музыку или выстрелы своего оружия — так что я просто разбил/а этот кусок мусора об стол. Полный отстой. Официальные наушники от XBOX стоили столько же, но их не было в наличии, поэтому я купил/а эти, и я очень жалею о потраченной сотне баксов.

source_doc: My very first VR set! So worth the money! I finally decided to plunge into the world of virtual reality — and I’m so glad I chose this item as my first “attempt” at VR! I really liked that any adjustment (minus the strap) could easily be done even while wearing the device without interrupting gameplay! As for the strap, just a simple fix of placing the joycons down, fix it, and bam, you’re immediately back to gameplay. I saw other reviews say it was heavy… honestly I found it to be light!My only downsides to it (which neither have nothing to do with the product itself), are…- The games offered. I wish Nintendo would offer a VR mode for more games- Because I have thick hair, if I moved a certain way, the straps would slide up to the top of my head (due to gripping) and I would have to pause the game and reset it on my head before continuing. But I’ll try wearing a ponytail next time!All in all, I really enjoyed my time with this, and I can definitely see it as a more long-term option than what Nintendo offers!

source_doc: Well-made, sturdy, elegant case. Just received this yesterday. The first impression is, as the title says, that it is a well-made, sturdy and elegant case. I read reviews that said the handle was uncomfortable. I don’t think it is. also read reviews that the straps were uncomfortable, that if you just hold by one strap the bass Flips upside down. That’s not true. The shoulder straps are fine. I wonder if people know how to adjust them? I opened them up all the way. That works for me.To put the bass in the case, you really do have to open it up almost all the way. And the extra pads at the bottom or a little bit in the way sort of. I didn’t want to remove them because I like the extra padding there. I don’t want to take the strap off my bass when I put it in the case, but that would probably make things a lot easier.  Anyway, it fits in there the case itself as I mentioned is very good looking in an understated sort of way  - you could show up at symphony hall with this thing and fit right in. It feels very sturdy and solid and stiff. The best of both worlds between a case and a gig bag. In my opinion I bought it because I fly sometimes in like to gate check the bass. this I think is as good as it gets for that option.

Мне не хочется снимать ремень с самого баса, когда я кладу его в чехол, но, вероятно, это сильно облегчило бы задачу. Как бы то ни было, он туда помещается. Сам чехол, как я уже упоминал/а, выглядит очень красиво и при этом сдержанно — с такой вещью можно появиться в филармонии и выглядеть абсолютно уместно. Он кажется очень прочным, надежным и жестким. На мой взгляд, это лучшее сочетание жесткого кейса и мягкого чехла. Я купил/а его, потому что иногда летаю самолетом и мне нравится сдавать бас в багаж у выхода на посадку. source_doc: Find your studs before ordering. I assumed I would not have trouble laying out the footprint I hade in mind. But the studs in my garage walls appear to be irregularly spaced. Two different stud finder tools failed to help. So I had to probe around. I attempted to pop the wall plates off of a light switch and an outlet, identify the corresponding wall stud, and measure in 16 inch increments and higher, and couldn’t figure a consistent interval. So I ended up just using my smallest drill bit with some guesswork until I found enough spots that would work.Wish I had spent some time getting lines down on every possible stud before I opened boxes and stuff everywhere. I made it work by combining some 4’ and 3’ spans (from the 6’ model).Now that I got them up, I’m satisfied with how they look and getting my crap off the floor.

source_doc: Amazing Powder for the extra coverage I need! Airspun Loose Powder Translucent Extra Coverage- I’ve found a gem with this powder. At first I thought it would be too light for my skin but it’s not the case at all. Other powders I’ve used in the past have been beige. This powder amazingly blends into my skin beautifully. After my morning routine of cleansing, toning, vitamin C serum & moisturizer I then use L’Oreal Magic Erase Primer which is the only primer that controls my very oily skin. Once my face is set I apply this powder. This sets my face for an entire day! I apply it before 7am & it’s still looking great at 7pm. Liquid foundation has never worked for me due to my oily skin. I also have scarring from acne I had when I was a teenager into my 20’s. This powder falls nicely into place eliminating the look of this on my face. I love it! There is a lot of powder that comes in this container. For the price it’s amazing. A puffer comes with it but I use my makeup brush to pick the powder up to apply it. Yes, there is a scent to it. This doesn’t bother me but if you’re sensitive to fragrance this wouldn’t be for you. Otherwise I’d say with the low price it’s worth trying. From my personal experience I definitely recommend it!

source_doc: I wish I bought this years ago - worth every penny! I suck at soldering. My hands are really shaky and I don't do it often enough to get the practice. I can't believe how much of a difference this made over the cheap stuff (which have thousands of 5 star reviews!) I'd been using. It flows where I want it to go, very easy to use, low temp..For years I've been thinking about trying this, but the price compared to others is significant. I had tried a little tube of it awhile back and didn't like it at all. I didn't know I had brought the wrong type  (the naming of various solders is a bit confusing)  I finally broke down a few months ago and bought this. I was getting so frustrated soldering I started buying in stead of making.  It is absolutely worth the price.It's not a miracle tho - I still suck at soldering, I just suck less now.

source_doc: Overpriced. 1. The printed directions were horrible and the installation wasn't easy.2. I don't see how the cord you pull to open up each segment of the cover will last. For the price of this, there should have been something better and stronger that will hold up to constant use. I don't even know if and how this cord can be replaced if it has to be.3. I used it entirely open yesterday for the first time since installation and I knew it would block the entire window. What I didn't count on was the rods not staying in place. I know I tightened each opening for the rods before driving off. Plus, the part that you put the rod in when it isn't used, came off and it shouldn't have.The weather stripping doesn't stay put so I don't know how good this will be in keeping my bed dry when it rains.I was deciding between this cover and the Lomax and I wish I would have chosen the Lomax even though it was more expensive. This cover is overpriced and expensive. I don't think it's worth it and now I'm stuck with it unless I try to sell it myself.

source_doc: Absolutely worth it! I needed a replacement table and found this one. I was worried bout some of the reviews, but it came in pristine condition and was very easy to put together. My 14 year old son and I put it together.For a small table it's decent sized and serves its purpose and I think it looks adorable.Only complaint I have is to the delivery company. I live on the second floor of an apartment and they sent 1 poor delivery driver to push this thing up two flights of stairs. I didn't realize this til he was already at my door. I felt awful for him.But huge rave for him! He was kind, and sweet, and pushed 123lbs of awkward sized box up all those stairs all by himself and was so polite and acted like it was nothing. I truly wish I would have known, because I would have helped and at least tipped him, but I had no cash on me. :(

source_doc: Fantastic bag. So I wish MR made a 'toned down' tacticool version of this due to the nature of my work. I use this as my primary laptop/work bag. I appreciate how "close" everything feels in the pouches. All of the compartments are very accessible and have the appropriate attachment points so I can carabiner/zip tie the zippers if I am in a pickpocket area. I would recommend this bag to anyone who is on the go for work. It flies through TSA security stuff and has ample room for all of the stuff I need on the go. I leverage packing cubes for all of my stuff and carry a Dell 15" laptop and a USBC Dell secondary monitor, as well as an anker 737 battery and all appropriate cables. I typically keep my glasses case/sunglasses in the outside pouch and in the other, I keep gum and keys I don't put in my pocket. The inside zipper keeps pens (in ink proof cube), passport, immunization card, and some cash. This is a very nice system for the price and very durable construction compared to most of the bags in this class.

source_doc: A lifesaver. I suffer from migraines quite often and I don't know how I would survive without this. There are days where I literally can't open my eyes until I put this on and then I can actually be productive. It is a bit tight for my head, but while I have a migraine, that is actually very helpful. Sometimes I don't pull it down over my eyes and it is still quite helpful. Personally, I need to let it warm up for a minute before I put it over my eyes anyways because if I put it over my eyes immediately, it can make me feel like I have brain freeze. If I were you, I would consider buying two of them, so that when one of them warms up and is no longer helpful, you can just replace it with the one thats still in your freezer.
hypos: Настоящее спасение. Я довольно часто страдаю от мигреней и не знаю, как бы выжил/а без этого. Бывают дни, когда я буквально не могу открыть глаза, пока не надеваю это, а после этого я действительно могу быть продуктивным/ой. Для моей головы оно немного туговато, но во время мигрени это на самом деле очень помогает. Иногда я не натягиваю его на глаза, и оно все равно отлично помогает. Лично мне в любом случае нужно дать ему нагреться в течение минуты, прежде чем надевать на глаза, потому что если я надену его сразу, у меня может возникнуть ощущение, будто у меня замерз мозг. На вашем месте я бы подумал/а о покупке двух штук, чтобы, когда одна из них нагреется и перестанет помогать, можно было просто заменить ее той, которая все еще лежит в морозилке.

source_doc: I have owned 7 house bunnies in a row!!! In about thirty years I have owned 7 bunnies, all who have lived inside and been treated very special.  Sometimes I have owned two at once, but in those thirty years never gone without at least one.  Obviously I am doing something right since several of mine have lived to be about 12-13 years old.  So in say that, I highly recommend this grass mat that I use inside their huge open door cage where I also have pet fur mats on the floor along with one of these mats where I sit there bowl of TIMOTHY pellets.  I notice that the bunny I have now will ignore it for awhile and then one day just start shredding it to pieces, so I make sure to keep buying them for her since she really doesn't play with any rabbit toys I buy her.  Except for loving empty toilet paper rolls this is her fav fun project!  I always make sure anything I give my bunnies is safe and healthy (note, always use timothy pellets, give them just the tiniest bit of fruit, no other carbs and tons of green vegies daily).  Rabbits love to eat but anything sugar or sweet will mess up their stomachs real easily...but back to this product, it is a big yes and I will continue buying them when needed.

source_doc: I love this brand. So i actually bought the white one last year and i loved it but the keys where so loud but overall i loved it. I am a gamer, and the mouse did start to miss a few clicks so i decided it was time for a new keyboard and mouse. I decided to go with the pink one this time because white is hard to keep clean and i just didnt want to do the black since my mouse pad and mic are black. Anyways i actually love the pink one a lot more and the keys are a lot quitter, and the lights are more fun and easier to control and there are so many more options with this one then the one i had before. The only issue that i have is the space bar is a little harder to hit. And while that isn't a big deal for just typing it can be when you miss a jump in a game. Other than that, yeah i would buy this keyboard and mouse again. the mouse is perfect so far and I haven't missed a click.

source_doc: Won't connect to Razer Synapse. I bought this to upgrade from my old Diamondback.I have never had any issue connecting peripherals from any other company other than Razer and this mouse is no different. I went through the processes outlined on their website to have Synapse recognize this mouse but it didn't find it. Take note, I also have an old Diamondback and Firefly already installed. During the 'repair' process, it prompted me to search for the synapse.msi file but couldn't find it saying the file doesn't exist. The folder it was pointing to exists but that msi file is no where on my system so even though I updated my synapse application a week or two ago, I tried it again but no updates were available.This isn't rocket science. This shouldn't be that difficult. I have 'gaming' peripherals from numerous other companies and never, not once did I ever have an issue connecting one of their devices. They are recognized immediately upon connection but not with Razer. Razer forces me to jump through all these hoops and it still doesn't work. So, I no longer spend hours upon hours trying to get their products to work. If they don't within five or ten minutes of troubleshooting it's being sent back. I should have remembered when I tried to connect one of their headphones and had the same issue. I remember even uninstalling the application back then and reinstalling it and it still didn't connect.

source_doc: Decent quality at a good price. I am one of those old retired guys that has been building at stuff for, well, since Kennedy got elected.  Anyway, I have so many types of bits it is crazy, but counter-sinks are something I never have enough of.  These are pretty good.  They are not the best you can buy, but they are well worth the money.  The actual bit is ok, but that does not matter a lot to me as I have a substantial number of titanium bits to replace them.  The counter sinks work well in wood and aluminum.  The taper design is something that can work very well, when needed.For the price and the value quality, I feel compelled to give them a 5.Note: I have been an Amazon customer for almost 20 years. I write all of my reviews to reflect my personal observations and opinions on a product. It matters not if I have purchased the item myself or if it was provided to me for review. My goal is to provide other potential customers as much real-world knowledge as possible to make an informed decision. In most cases I will return to my review in 6 months or less to see if I should alter my original observations. In no case will the cost of a product influence my opinions at all. source_doc: Beautiful and super easy. Update: Removing these weren't bad. Most of them were ready to come off at about 1.6 weeks. Some were loose and came off and others I soaked in acetone and they dissolved.These nails are so beautiful. I used the glue in the package. Next time I plan on using a brush on glue as I think that may be a little easier but all in all, they went on easily. The length is great and not too long that they get in the way. I may try a longer one at some point just to try it but I have a feeling the "RS White Cream French Tip" will be my go to.I 100% recommend these especially because of the tabs. Its easy to pick out the size and then grab the matching nail for the other hand. The set that is a medium length doesn't have the tabs. I'm going to try them but I already know I love the tabs.These are great. I'm not sure how they will be when I want to remove them. Hopefully not too hard.I did accidentally pop my thumb nail off the first day but I'm guessing I may not have used enough glue. The good news is, I just reused the nail and I'm back in business!Give them a try!

source_doc: Lasted longer than I thought. I teach a sport that requires me to pack food for 14 hour days on the weekend. I try to pack as lightly as possible because everything has to be transported with my on a bus and then into schools, it's a whole thing. Since I'm on a special diet I bring all my food for the day but I try to fit it all in one lunch bag. That was not really possible with those hard plastic ice packs that I would typically use. However, with these, they don't take up as much space and they still lasted me at least 8-10 hours and still felt cold.Do I think these will work well for more than 8-10 hrs? I don't think so. But if you are using these for school lunches I think they would do the trick. Because of their size they don't take up a lot of room so I was able to use both of them to make sure I could be near more than one item in the bag.I'll keep trying these each weekend and see if I can narrow down exactly how long they last but if they're well frozen and in a decent lunch bag you should be good to go.Also, I love the color of these. :-)
hypos: Прослужили дольше, чем я думал/а. Я преподаю вид спорта, который требует от меня собирать еду на 14-часовые дни по выходным. Однако эти не занимают много места, и их всё равно хватило как минимум на 8–10 часов, и они всё еще оставались холодными на ощупь. Думаю ли я, что они будут хорошо работать дольше 8–10 часов? Не думаю. Но если вы берете их для школьных обедов, думаю, они отлично подойдут. Благодаря своему размеру они не занимают много места, поэтому я смог/ла использовать оба аккумулятора, чтобы положить их поближе к разным продуктам в сумке. А еще мне очень нравится их цвет. :-)

source_doc: Not accurate, irritated my wrist. I really wanted to like this watch, as my friend has 1 and we could join eachother and share our progress with one another, etc. I was amazed at how many steps I was doing each day- until I realized that it was adding steps when I wasn't even walking! I bought another less expensive watch and wore both of them on my wrist for several days. sure enough, the Fitbit showed many more steps then the other- which showed to be more accurate when I was watching.My second complaint is that though it is less bulky than some watches, it irritated my wrist. I don't know if it is the materials it is made out of or what, but it wore a rash into it.Lastly, the App. They want $80 a year for their "premium" edition, which my other watch app gives me for FREE! Plus, my other watch monitors my blood pressure, which the fitbit does not, unless I enter it manually. All in all, I can say I tried it but I am not impressed. The seller, however was great. I had the watch in less than 2 days.

source_doc: Good for the Price..But. I have some nice heavy duty solar lights that I want to hang in my yard along the back fence line which overlooks a wooded area.  When I saw these 9ft light poles, I knew it would be the perfect solution!  I was so excited when the box arrived but then quickly disappointed because apparently I did not read the description well enough - I saw the beginning of the title ‘Patio String Lights Poles” and assumed I would be getting two poles.  It does say ‘Pole’ singular further in the description.  So if you order these, you may want to order two.  I cannot hang lights from one pole lol so I will have to order a second one.  Having said that, the price doubled is about what other sets of two cost.  The pole comes in sections that you just screw together so assembly is simple.  I wish it was a little bit heavier duty because I’m not sure how well it will support my lights but it may be fine.  The pole doesn’t wobble much once in the ground with the five spikes.  Overall they are decent quality.

source_doc: Good moisturizer, fragrance free. I have been using oil vs lotion on my body for years. Usually almond or grape, but thought I would give this a try. I have heard good things about jojoba. It has no fragrance, which I prefer. It is a little thicker, but absorbs nicely on wet skin. I like oil better as I have dry skin & lotion tends to coat skin on me, instead of feeling like it’s actually getting into my skin. I can keep my dry skin in check, if I use it daily. The Jojoba oil seems to leave a bit of a layer, but only cause it  takes a little longer to absorb completely. My skin definitely feels moisturized & looks healthier. I like it. Other than the thicker texture of the oil, it isn’t much different than what I have used before. No negatives that I notice. Competitively price for the large size. Worth a try.

source_doc: Best Bassinet!! This bassinet is absolutely perfect. I am so happy with it! I bought 2 because my daughter had twins. Best baby buy EVER. I wanted a bassinet that had the side to side glide but I wanted it to be sturdy and it not be able to shift a baby into the side panels (we have 5 and 3 yr old siblings.) I wasn't crazy about the all white but it works so beautifully it could be puke green and worth every penny.If I were on the design team I would change that the glide motion have an "always on" feature for the exhausted new mom in addition to the 60 min timer.  I would improve the sound quality. Its harsh. The white noise and nature sounds are great but not so much the music. I would not have the flashing light. We havent figured out exactly what the flashing light is all about. I'm sure it's just that we haven't set up the wifi yet. Which we will get to and update if it changes our perception of the bassinet.I have 4 children and I have 6 grandchildren. I wish this product was around for the past 40 years!!!

source_doc: Great option for small spaces! I got this because I don't have enough under counter space to install those typical paper towel holders, and I didn't want a tabletop one. source_doc: AMAZING OIL - Smells much stronger when used then in the bottle. This essential oil has thoroughly impressed me. When I got it and smelled it out of the bottle I didn't think it had much of a scent at all and was disappointed but I read the insert saying it would be stronger once used and then I gave it a try. WOW!!!! I used the included nozzle and sprayed it about 6 times in my room hours ago and now my entire unit (700 sq ft) is filled with this wonderful fragrance. I cannot believe how long it has lasted and even that it traveled through each room so that when I came back from walking my dog and opened the door I immediately smelled the clean fresh scent of Gardenia Lily. I am a home fragrance fanatic and have tried many many products but this one has surpassed them all. I usually use a room spray and within half an hour the scent is completely gone so for this to last hours is amazing. Now that I know what this can do, I know I will only need a spray or two so this bottle is going to last a very very long time. I was wondering why this bottle of essential oil was at this price point but now I know. It's also 100% pure essential oil with no water. I can't wait to try it in a diffuser.

source_doc: I buy for convenience. I buy this strictly for the convenience factor. I do a lot of cooking from scratch and many recipes call for bell peppers. I have a smaller refrigerator and I’m tight on space. This can is huge, so I poured it into a 2.7 Quart Lock n Lock container. As you can see, there’s plenty of room leftover. I could probably fit it into an even smaller container. So while the can is huge, there is significantly less product than I expected. I realize it’s sold by weight, not volume.After the initial shock of a half empty can, I can say I am still happy with this purchase. I’ve always got peppers available now; no last minute shopping trips to the grocery store to finish making a meal. The smell is that of fresh peppers and the taste has been very good in every dish I’ve made with them. I’ve used in meatloaf, soup, poultry dishes, and even omelets. For omelets, I let them sit in the egg mixture for 5 minutes or so with an additional tablespoon of water before adding to a hot pan. source_doc: These made for a great relaxing evening! I like to give my wife massages. She has lots of back pain and tension. I have a set of stones I bought prior, but no heating source. I would put them in a pot of water and heat them, then bring them into to room. This was kind of a pain. This lets me keep them right on my nightstand. Takes about  20-25 minutes I guess to heat them. Wasn't timing it. For me by the time I was ready to put the stones on, they were ready to go. Not too hot! They were very soothing. I actually put some of my other stones in to heat them as well but honestly, I didn't end up using them. The stones that come with it are enough to put them on the spots that needed them. I watched many YT videos on how to do massage, and where to place the stones. Getting pretty good at it now! :-) I have used products from SereneLife in the past and have been happy with them, so I chose these. Nice case/heater combo. Well thought out. Easy controls.

source_doc: Be aware of hot glue dripping down! I've purchased several of these at the same time (1 for travel trailer, 1 for vending at craft shows and one as a gift) and I like it much better (for the most part) than my previous one from another company that I got several years ago.  I really like how easily this one closes - huge improvement over my other one, which I really struggled with.  I use a piece of parchment paper inside which helps with cleanup.  It heats up hotter and faster than my old one, so I'm still learning that aspect of it.  However what I'm not happy about is how hot glue (or so it appears) has dripped down on to the power cord inside where it attaches.  Over time it got harder and harder to remove it (a/c cord) and finally I had to have my husband remove it with a pair of vise grips and even then it was hard to remove.  We found hot glue on it.  I did put it back in and won't be removing it, which could be a problem when I want to use the 12v attachment for when I want to use it in the vehicle.  I like the carrying case.  But yeah, not too impressed with the hot glue.  I keep meaning to write to the seller about it.
hypos: Остерегайтесь стекания горячего клея! Я купил/а несколько таких штук одновременно (одну для автодома, одну для торговли на ярмарках ремесел и еще одну в подарок), и эта вещь мне нравится гораздо больше (по большей части), чем моя предыдущая от другой компании, которую я приобрел/а несколько лет назад. Мне очень нравится, как легко закрывается эта модель — огромное улучшение по сравнению с моей старой, с которой я действительно мучился/лась. Внутри я использую лист пергаментной бумаги, что облегчает очистку. Она нагревается сильнее и быстрее, чем моя старая, так что я все еще привыкаю к этому аспекту. Однако я не рад/а тому, что горячий клей (или нечто очень похожее) стек на шнур питания внутри, в месте его подключения. Со временем вытаскивать его (шнур питания) становилось все труднее и труднее, и в конце концов мне пришлось просить мужа вытащить его с помощью ручных тисков, и даже тогда это было тяжело сделать. Мы обнаружили на нем горячий клей. Я вставил/а его обратно и больше не буду вынимать, что может стать проблемой, когда я захочу использовать переходник на 12 В для работы в автомобиле. Мне нравится чехол для переноски. Но да, горячий клей меня не слишком впечатлил. Все собираюсь написать об этом продавцу.

source_doc: Not gold and not absorbant. These are really soft and fluffy microfiber towels!  I've never seen microfiber towels like these.  I got them because I have a new color theme in my bathroom that includes a bright egg yolk yellow.  I was trying to liven it up from the grey, beige, black and white in there.  I bought a new rug, new bath towels and a couple pictures to hang on the wall.  I wanted these to wipe off the faucet handle and tub spout after I take showers.  We have a new home and I want to keep it looking new as long as possible. These microfiber towels are labeled as gold and look more yellow in the description than what I recieved.  Mine are bright orange, not gold at all.  But what I don't understand is why they are considered absorbant...?  They smear around the water on the faucet.  I thought maybe I didn't get all the stuff out they use when they are manufactured so I hand washed them again in fragrance free detergent, and baking soda.  Tried again and they still don't wipe off water like my old cotton towels.  I tried them several times.  I think they might be good at dusting.  They probably pick up dust well.  They probably also work great at washing things, but I specifically ordered them for their color and their absorbancy and neither work for that purpose.  I will find another use for them, but I am disappointed.

source_doc: More feel and stability. I took the JumboMax challenge, ordering a full set of grips, re-gripping one club and going to play.  I changed out my 8 iron because I use it a lot, plenty of opportunities for bump and run where I play.Came home, had lunch and re-gripped the whole set.  I find that I was too tight, tense, whatever you call it with the old skinny grips.  With these I was able to swing without clamping down on the club and without having to think about it much.  This lead to much increased feel and more clubhead speed.Around the greens my wedge play  is much improved.  I let one of my regular partners try out a wedge and he showed up the next week with HIS set changed out to these grips too.  So he still scores better than me, not that I mind.I love these grips.  Picking up a regular grip club now feels very strange.  I now understand why I never really had the degree of control I wanted before, even though I used oversize grips.  Oversize does not come even close to the feel of the JumboMax.

source_doc: Fun. I bought this in November, tomorrow it will be January and I have yet to finish the game as I’m having so much fun exploring and dinking around as I play. The graphics are great when they’re not glitching but glitches are momentary and I’ve only become stuck in game once and the game did self correct after a minute so it does have safety features that I’m grateful for. I wasn’t sure how I’d like the tera evolution deal but it’s not bad but I don’t really use the feature although I do enjoy the battles against the tera Pokémon too. I do wish I could customize more of what my character is wearing as the school uniform kinda sucks and I love customizations so much but I am glad I can change between seasonal wear. The new Pokémon are interesting and I’m enjoying learning about them too.

source_doc: You guys…buy this ASAP! This thing is magical! Seriously. Where has this been all my life??? Why have I been sleeping on this!? Why have I been using a blower dryer AND a round brush all my hair drying life when I could’ve been using this all along? Well maybe this didn’t exist, but it does now and that’s all that matters.With a blow dryer, it would normally take me 45-60 min to blow dry my hair. I have THICK hair, that’s somewhat coarse and curly/wavy, but even more textured towards my scalp/hairline. It’s impossible to straighten with a blow dryer and I heavily rely on a flat iron. AND I can’t blow dry my hair as soon as I get out of the shower. I typically have to wait 30-45 min for it to air dry some or else I’m standing there sweating for eternity while 20 hairs dry. It’s torture.I don’t know what kinda witchery this is, but I literally blow dried my hair in 30-40 min today. Straight out the shower! What?! And flat ironing was minimal! I can’t believe it. I’m beyond happy!The dryer seemed kind of loud, but it’s powerful. The heat felt kind of too hot at times, but I had it on the highest setting. I just had to make sure I didn’t let it blow on my skin/scalp for too long or it would get uncomfortable. Aside from that, it’s perfection. Believe the hype. Seriously.

source_doc: Good for GI issues. I decided to try this food for my APT, who was having intermittent diarrhea.  I initially thought it was related to NSAIDs, as she needs them daily for arthritis.  At wits end, I tried stopping the NSAIDS as a last resort, as I also tried MANY supplements and changed her food, with still no signs of her loose stools resolving.  Chicken and rice helped the most, but I knew she couldn't stay on it forever.  My dog's only symptom was diarrhea.  Her appetite and energy were normal (both over the top) and she would have formed stools as often as diarrhea.  Her weight remained unchanged.At the time I switched to Dave's dry food, I was feeding our dog Blue Buffalo Basics Salmon dry food and white fish wet food.  I didn't realize these were grain free, as I was focused on the "basic" part of the food.  In chatting with a vet, I learned that sometimes grain free diets in dogs can lead to intermittent diarrhea.  After  much research of good quality and affordable dog food for sensitive systems, I came across Dave's Pet Food and decided to try it.  Within a month our dog was back to having consistent formed stools, even while taking her NSAIDS.  I would highly recommend this food for dogs with sensitive systems and GI issues.
hypos: Хорошо подходит для проблем с ЖКТ. Я решил/а попробовать этот корм для своего американского питбультерьера, у которой была периодическая диарея. Изначально я думал/а, что это связано с НПВП, так как они нужны ей ежедневно от артрита. Отчаявшись, в качестве последней меры я попробовал/а прекратить прием НПВП, так как я также перепробовал/а МНОЖЕСТВО добавок и сменил/а её корм, но признаков прекращения жидкого стула всё ещё не было. Курица с рисом помогали лучше всего, но я знал/а, что она не может оставаться на этом рационе постоянно. Единственным симптомом у моей собаки была диарея. Её аппетит и энергия были в норме (и то, и другое через край), и у неё оформленный стул бывал так же часто, как и понос. Её вес оставался неизменным. В то время, когда я перешел/шла на сухой корм Dave's, я кормил/а нашу собаку сухим кормом Blue Buffalo Basics с лососем и влажным кормом с белой рыбой. Я не понимал/а, что они беззерновые, так как был/а сосредоточен/а на слове «basics» (базовый) в названии корма. В беседе с ветеринаром я узнал/а, что иногда беззерновые диеты у собак могут приводить к периодической диарее. После долгих поисков качественного и доступного корма для собак с чувствительным пищеварением я наткнулся/лась на Dave's Pet Food и решил/а его попробовать. В течение месяца у нашей собаки снова стал стабильный оформленный стул, даже во время приема НПВП. Я настоятельно рекомендую этот корм для собак с чувствительным пищеварением и проблемами с ЖКТ.

source_doc: Just what I needed. With a young kid and a baby on the way I wanted something that could accommodate both kids.  I really like that there is space for the baby but also a seat for when my older one wants to ride instead of walk.  She is usually really good about walking but I worry she will get jealous of the baby in the stroller and this is a nice way to avoid that.  I really like the cup holders for my drinks as I can put a drink for me and a drink for my older kid in it and keep my hands more free.  I admit I don't leave my phone in the tray.  The under storage is big enough for the things I think I need to bring but I tend to store stuff there I don't need as often.  I like that the baby seat can recline or go more upright as my little one grows.  The canopy is small but easy to position.  I like how easy it is to fold up, this works best when the basket is empty.  I do not have the matching car seat so I can not comment on that.

Обычно она отлично ходит пешком, но я переживаю, что она начнет ревновать к ребенку в коляске, и это отличный способ избежать этого. Мне очень нравятся подстаканники: я могу поставить туда напиток для себя и для старшего ребенка, чтобы освободить руки. Признаю/сь, свой телефон я на столике-подставке не оставляю. Нижнее отделение для хранения достаточно вместительное для вещей, которые, как мне кажется, нужно взять с собой, но обычно я складываю туда то, что требуется не так часто. Мне нравится, что детское сиденье можно разложить или поднять вертикальнее по мере роста малыша. Козырек маленький, но его легко регулировать. Мне нравится, как легко складывается коляска, лучше всего это делать, когда корзина пуста. У меня нет подходящего автокресла, поэтому я не могу ничего сказать по этому поводу.

source_doc: I LOVE Being Able To Just Unplug The Cable, And It DOESN'T BUZZ! IT'S GREAT! This "LEKATO Instrument Cable with Dual Mute Plug Ends" works quite well!I REALLY LOVE being able to just unplug the cable, and NOT HAVING IT BUZZ!And, I don't know WHY I waited so long, (50 years!), to get a cable with this Auto-MUTE SWITCH Feature!It's quite a flexible cable, and, it has the all-important Gold-Plated Connectors, too, so I won't get any corrosion! It goes perfectly with the gold Pure Tone output jacks, that I like to add to all of my guitars. (THAT WAY, it's gold-to-gold, and I avoid any 'dissimilar metals effect"...)I also like having the right-angled connector on one end, too. It works nicely going into my little Fender Mustang I V.2 Modeling Amp, which I have placed on a chest-high shelf. The 90 degree-end takes all of the strain off of the cable, in that setup. And then, of course, the other, straight-end goes nicely into my Strats, my Teles, my Mustang, my Toronado, my Les Faul... or whatever...BTW, BOTH ENDS of the cable offer the auto-Mute Switch functionality.So, in short, I think it's a pretty good option for an Auto-Mute Switch Instrument Cable, especially for the price.I like it!Have fun.-C(NOTE: I did NOT receive this product through any Promotion, I bought and paid for it myself.)

Я ДЕЙСТВИТЕЛЬНО В ВОСТОРГЕ от того, что могу просто отключить кабель и ИЗБЕЖАТЬ ЭТОГО ЖУЖЖАНИЯ! И я не знаю, ПОЧЕМУ я ждал/а так долго (50 лет!), чтобы обзавестись кабелем с этой функцией автоматического отключения звука Auto-MUTE SWITCH! Это довольно гибкий кабель, и к тому же у него есть крайне важные позолоченные разъемы, так что у меня не будет никакой коррозии! Он идеально сочетается с позолоченными выходными гнездами Pure Tone, которые я люблю устанавливать на все свои гитары. (ТАКИМ ОБРАЗОМ, получается золото к золоту, и я избегаю любого «эффекта разнородных металлов»...) Мне также нравится, что на одном конце угловой разъем. Он отлично подходит для подключения к моему маленькому моделирующему усилителю Fender Mustang I V.2, который я поставил/а на полку на уровне груди. В такой конфигурации 90-градусный разъем снимает всю нагрузку с кабеля. И затем, конечно, другой, прямой конец отлично вставляется в мои Strat, Tele, Mustang, Toronado, Les Paul... или во что угодно... Кстати, ОБА КОНЦА кабеля поддерживают функцию автоматического отключения звука Auto-Mute Switch. Так что, вкратце, я думаю, что это довольно хороший вариант инструментального кабеля с автоотключением звука, особенно за такую цену. Мне он нравится! Желаю хорошо провести время. — С. (ПРИМЕЧАНИЕ: я НЕ получал/а этот товар по какой-либо акции, я купил/а и оплатил/а его самостоятельно.)

source_doc: Very useful, built in metronome is nice. As a person who has been playing bass for almost 16 years now, I tend to try to get whatever equipment I can. For years I had been looking for a metronome, but never really found one at a price point I wanted. After seeing that this tuner has a built in metronome, I decided to give it a try. I charged it with the included cable and first tested it as a tuner. I used the included (piezo?) sensor on the headstock of my acoustic and it seems to be just as accurate as any other tuner I've used in the past. Afterwards, I played with the metronome for a bit, adjusted the tempo, changed up the rhythms, and was quite surprised with the variety of beats I could get out of it. If I didn't already have a designated tuner pedal, I'd probably use this at my local church where I play bass. Display is pretty good, and easy to read, too, so there's that.Overall, I'm satisfied with it. I give it a thumbs up.

source_doc: Buy The Bundle - You Will LOVE These!! I ended up buying the elderflower one just to try them after finding out about these existing. I have pretty bad anxiety and need something to fidget around with/concentrate on and mints were too sugary for me. These are so pleasant to have in your mouth and really do make you feel calmer! I just wish they lasted a little longer since I do like them a lot haha. I wish I bought the bundle first to save money but I never thought I would like them this much!I have one container in my purse, one on my desk, and one for backup! Absolutely lovely having this bundle.Also I love playing with the lid sometimes because it has such a unique way to open! Just make sure to read the directions and not try to pry it open like I did at first haha.EDIT: Lemon actually ended up being my favorite flavor and I eat that flavor after meals since it makes me feel better! Also I am a huge lemon fan fyi, so this might not be your favorite if lemons aren't your thing.
hypos: Купите этот набор — они вам ТОЧНО ПОНРАВЯТСЯ!! В итоге я купил/а бузину просто на пробу, когда узнал/а об их существовании. Только обязательно прочитайте инструкцию и не пытайтесь поддеть ее, как это поначалу делал/а я, ха-ха. source_doc: Didn't know I needed one till I started using it. I've been stressed out quite a bit lately with work and my home so I've decided I need to take some time to relax through the day so when I saw this I figured I would give it a shot, and I was glad I did.  It came packaged well with no defects I could see.  In the box are the eye massager and a USB c cord.  It charges via USB C which I like and didn't take all that long to charge.  Putting it on I did have to adjust it a little bit but that wasn't too hard.  I kicked it on and let it run a preset on my eyes.  Let me tell you it feels wonderful.  It does have a bit of pressure but nothing uncomfortable.  I let it run its cycle and ran another one because it felt so good.  If you are looking for a way to relax and block out light this thing is amazing.

source_doc: Awesome Poor Man's Peloton. I purchased this about a year ago to use as a cheap alternative to a Peloton. Assembly was super easy. I added a bluetooth Wahoo cadence tracker, my Apple Watch for heart rate, and my iPad fit perfectly on top to stream the Peloton app. The only thing I cannot replicate is the resistance and I just go by how hard they say it should be, it works for me. I love it. I have a quiet room it is tucked away in that I can work out in and have had absolutely zero problems other than the infamous seat squeak which only happens if I fidget. I am just at the point that cages are getting annoying and I am going to put clipless pedals on but the cages worked fine. For reference, I am 5'1", 200lbs, and have never broken a pedal standing to ride or had any clunking noises. I do feel like I could use one more tiny click lower on the seat to perfect the alignment, or farther forward but not to the point it is uncomfortable.

source_doc: Its a gd enuf substitute. Glad i found this, i really hate to throw away a working Fairywell E11 just bec they do not sell replacement heads anymore. Mighty irresponsible of this company and i am not going to buy another Fairywell product bec i am forced to be so eco unfriendly. I must thank the customer who replied to the question if these heads can fit FW-E11, and he said he managed to use them for his E11. I went ahead trusting his ans. It does not click fit, but it works fine. I dare not take chance on those heads from other sellers that clearly state not meant for FW-E11, although i suspect it probably also can work.Anyway, this heads are smaller than the original FW heads, but i am ok with it bec i like small heads brushes that can reach further in anyway. They are not as lasting as the originals as well, but its not by too much, and at this reasonable pricing, i am happy to change them out to be more hygienic.

source_doc: It’s a pretty decent tray. First off the tray, does not come with any instructions, so I had to assume how to place it on the steering wheel, which is somewhat obvious sorta. It is a zip up case that you could probably use to transport papers or something like that because of the handle on the outside, and the fact that it zips up. So it is extremely portable. The outside pocket is actually the part that goes over the steering wheel. It wasn’t until later on that I realized that the straps on the inside actually go together to hold it up in place. It’s not a hard surface and it is bendable. But I do prefer it over the other one that I had simply because the other one that I have is hard and it is not fold up , so I just pretty much slid it between the seat of the door when I wasn’t using it. So I took off stars due to not having instructions and not really knowing where that extra strap goes and the fact that the bottom part is somewhat bendable. I’m not saying that it’s flimsy or won’t hold up but then again, I really don’t know because I haven’t been using it for a long time. I only used it for a few minutes to enter some information on my computer.

source_doc: Does not work... never did. Bought in 2020 didnt use it right away, just wanted to have it on hand when I needed it. When I finally needed it would not turn on... and it has never worked!Ive tried it on a 2006 pontiac G6, 2002 GMC Yukon, and a 2009 Jeep wrangler. It never turned on. I thought it was just me using it wrong. Then I lost it in some boxes. Found it three months ago and tried it in the jeep. It wouldnt turn on.03/11/23 I thought Id try it again in a 2002 GMC sierra... it didnt turn on. Tried it on a buddies s10 and it came on but wouldnt connect.Updated 03/19/23 I went back to the 2002 GMC sierra and started checking fuses. Found 2 blown fuses (cigarrete & DRL) and replaced. Reconnected scanner tool. It comes on but wont connect. Retried multiple times... same results. Next I guess is the drag test... where you use a paper clip to test each pin hole on the vehicles scanner port under the dash.After reading some other peoples reviews of this unit, I thought I should add my review to the list. No pins are broken, none are bent, and plug was pushed all the way in.If I could return it I would its really been no help so far, and a waste of money...

source_doc: I didn't think I would love it. I honestly wasn't expecting to love this game.  I was waiting for Frosthaven to arrive from the kickstarter and was jonesing for a card game fix that was easy to set up.  Then I saw the reviews for this and figured I'd give it a try since I had a gift card to burn.  Well glad I did, I put 70 hours into it before the credits rolled and I'm waiting for all the DLC to get released before playing it again on new game plus. I'll be honest I haven't had a game tickle me like that since DBZ: Kakarot a few years back.The game loop is nice; get cards, get powers, and make friends.  The combo of it all worked perfect for me, and I was telling my wife dumb stories from the game about blade and captain marvel cute romance or the book club which I found hilarious.  Also one of the first times I've liked captain America.  Or I should say I got him in a way the movies/comics never worked for me.  I still don't like Tony, but that's not a surprise he's a terrible human being.I'm excited for the DLC and what they add since I figure I'll be putting in another 40-60 hours easily to platinum the game on my NG+ run.

source_doc: Great for traveling. I have 7 kids so I've had a lot of baby gear. This is one thing I wish I bought sooner. It's very compact and easy to set up. I used it for my toddler at Thanksgiving when we visited family out of state. He's currently 20 months and I anticipate it wouldn't work well once he's two because it's a little small. His little brother will use it later. I just set it up on the floor and still need to install the straps to used on a chair so I can't say if it's easy or not. The main things I love about the booster is the look and the removable tray insert. The only thing I think is dumb is the little spot on the tray that has like a cut out for tiny utensils. It's pointless because only doll utensils are that small. Other than that I love it. It's sturdy and easy to use. Oh and the best part is the way the tray can be removed or swing open on either side. It's a good design. Also the cover is easier removable to be washed which is a must! That makes it better than other brands I looked at.

source_doc: Worth it so far! I live in the Carolinas and have a lot of humidity here. I was 24 and pregnant with my only girl when my hair went from straight and unable to hold curl at all, to being super wavey, frizzy, and stubborn. Fast forward 20 years and I have tried I swear all the curly hair products with not much luck. I wash my hair twice a week. I have used this product 3 times since my purchase. Right out of the box this smell is AMAZING! After the wash my hair felt a bit dry, I did not use any product because I wanted to give a proper review, once dry my hair was soft, and manageable even without product. The poof was minimal, and the dry feeling decreased as it dried. I have used this with product twice, and the wave definition is unreal! I am very happy and satisfied with the product, and will continue to purchase it. I have since bought everyone in my home their own bars. Make sure to get the correct one for your hair type, but don't hesitate, this is awesome stuff!
hypos: Оно того стоит! Я живу в Каролине, и здесь очень высокая влажность. Мне было 24 года, и я была беременна своей единственной дочерью, когда мои волосы из абсолютно прямых и не держащих завивку превратились в суперкудрявые, пушащиеся и непослушные. Перенесемся на 20 лет вперед: клянусь, я перепробовал/а все средства для кудрявых волос, но без особого успеха. Я мою голову два раза в неделю. С момента покупки я использовал/а это средство 3 раза. Прямо из коробки этот запах просто ПОТРЯСАЮЩИЙ! После мытья мои волосы казались немного сухими, я не использовал/а никаких дополнительных средств, так как хотел/а написать честный отзыв. Как только они высохли, волосы стали мягкими и послушными даже без укладки. Пушистость была минимальной, а ощущение сухости уменьшалось по мере высыхания. source_doc: What a surprise, exceeded my expectations. For the price I paid I had set my expectations fairly low.  For me as long as it worked reasonably well I would be happy as I don't do many zoom calls. But this little mic blew me away. I am running Windows 11, I plug the mic in and woke up my PC. It worked - immediately - I didn't have to do anything. I ran a quick test, and I was in business.  I pointed the mic away from me and it worked just as well.  My wife had a TV going in the other room, which I could clearly hear, but the mic didn't pick up any background noise.  Exceptional product.

source_doc: A little smaller than expected. I wear a size XL glove and they fit perfectly so I went with the XL size slide but it's a little tight. The first time I put it on I actually had a moment where I thought I was in trouble and really had to yank to get it off my finger. I thought maybe I just put it on too deep but after looking at the video they have that's not the case, it's just a little too snug to wear like that.Otherwise I like the idea and if I had gone a size up I think I would really like it. I like the one I got enough and am able to use it and get a sense of the "ergonomic design" which is actually pretty nice. I was ripping No More Tears earlier and it sounded much better with a slide as intended rather than faking it.

source_doc: This comes in real handy even if you think it won't. These oil 'suckers' have been around for a while but I never thought I would use one. Let me tell you I was wrong. I wanted to do something simple as a test so I changed the oil in one of my mowers. I removed the dipstick and inserted the larger tube and pumped a few times (maybe 5-6) and the oil began flowing out.  I pumped a few more times and within 3-5 minutes I had removed all the oil from the crankcase. There was no mess. The spherical accumulator showed the exact amount I removed and I replaced that amount into my mower. Very easy deal.I will note that many new zero turn mowers are sold with 'lifetime' filled transaxles and I had been putting off purchasing one because of this. Now that I have this extractor pump I know I can change the fluid and prolong the life of the transmission. Fluid changes can be very cumbersome for a unit that was never meant to have the fluid changed but this extractor will make it easy.I wish there was storage for the tubes and the extra caps that come with the unit. Also, you need to be careful to keep the rubber isolator straight (unbent) between the tube and the tank or you may lose vacuum while pumping.Overall, this is a good deal on a very useful tool.

source_doc: Perfect fit for SRX 2012 13582688...Why I remember this number? Because this was the BCM number in my SRX, and I had a hard time finding it new. That was also before I learned EEPROM...anyways. I saw this one, and it was reasonable, I tried to google to see if it will work, no clear answer. I finally contacted Cadillac and they told me yes it fits, then I purchased it. I did have hard time to get the car start even after programming the part, then I copied the EEPROM from my old BCM, wrote that in the chip, it showed "EEPROM PROGRAM INCORRECT". So what to do? I just ran SPS2 and reprogrammed the BCM again, then everything worked. Car started fine, most of the error message is gone on the dash. That was great! Then I purchased ALLDATA subscription, and under the BCM replacement, it showed this one as the only one fit for my car. So happy!

source_doc: pretty good at getting a close shave wherever you choose to shave. I use a popular subscription service, but I keep forgetting to order a new handle. I like to keep 2 handles, 1 in each bathroom. I use it to shave all over, including my face (no, tis a total myth that hair grows back more course). It helps keep my skin ultra smooth, and unless going to a professional, it is the exact same thing as other so called DIY dermaplaning gadgets. I swear, the pink tax on some stuff, some of which is our fault for buying into it all. So until I actually remember to buy another handle, I decided to just grab one of these. I like it enough that I may or may not bother with an additional handle (though I have dozens of razor heads so I may not want to have to add in another purchase). but for $15 or so bucks, I think it is reasonable. Has a good close shave, skin feels soft and smooth, if I take care of the razor head it should stay sharp for awhile. So far so good.
hypos: довольно хорошо обеспечивает чистое бритье везде, где вы решите побриться. Я пользуюсь популярным сервисом по подписке, но постоянно забываю заказать новую ручку. Мне нравится иметь 2 ручки, по 1 в каждой ванной. Я использую его для бритья всего тела, включая лицо (нет, это абсолютный миф, что волосы отрастают более жесткими). Это помогает сохранять мою кожу ультрагладкой, и, если не обращаться к профессионалу, это абсолютно то же самое, что и другие так называемые гаджеты для домашнего дермапланирования. Клянусь, «розовый налог» на некоторые вещи — это нечто, и в некоторых случаях мы сами виноваты, что ведемся на все это. Поэтому, пока я действительно не вспомнил/а о покупке еще одной ручки, я решил/а просто взять эту. Она мне нравится настолько, что я даже не знаю, буду ли заморачиваться с дополнительной ручкой (хотя у меня десятки кассет для бритвы, так что мне, возможно, не захочется совершать еще одну покупку). Но примерно за 15 долларов, я думаю, это вполне разумно. Обеспечивает хорошее чистое бритье, кожа кажется мягкой и гладкой, если я буду ухаживать за лезвием, оно должно оставаться острым какое-то время. Пока все отлично.

source_doc: Just what I needed. incremental degrees of lighting is helpful. I needed a lamp for my desk, so I was pleased to try this gooseneck lamp. It clamps onto the desk securely via a spinning C-clamp (as opposed to one you pinch to open). Since it can be tightened and loosened it is quite stable. I tried this lamp in different positions so I clamped it and reclamped it with no issues until I found exactly where I wanted it.I REALLY like that I can increase the light output incrementally (10 levels) from quite dim to nice and bright. There are also 3 different light modes: warm light (2700K), warm white light (4500K), and cool light (6500K). Each of these modes also can be increased/decreased incrementally. Really nice for helping prevent eye fatigue.The neck/arm is 24" and the light strip is 11". I really didn't notice the power supply before I got it, and assumed that it was a normal plug, but it has a USB plug at the end instead. It seems that I'm finding this to be the case more and more. Not an issue except I have to grab some more USB adapter blocks.Made in China.

The drill came without a case or any bling which is exactly what I expected. It did come with an instructional manual and a full 1 year warranty which was enough to impress me. I have used it a couple of times and I am not disappointed at all. It has plenty of power for the size of drill it is. I am a 60 year old disabled woman and I was able to fix my own wall that was bulging out due to blown insulation settling. I search high and low to find this Ryobi drill because I still have the 9v cordless I bought about 18 years ago and it is just now dying and no batteries are made for it anymore. Ryobi is a great product line. I wish I could afford 1 of everything they make. Don't be afraid to order the refurbished drill. It was a fantastic purchase choice for me.

source_doc: Is not easy to assemble! I have had a pack and play in the past, easy to set up and take down.  I wish that I had that one back but I sold because I thought we were done with grandchildren.  To our surprise we have a new grandchild so I purchased the Dream On Me, because of the reviews.  The ease to set up and take down does not happen with this unit.  It took three of us to get it into a locked position so that we could lay the baby down.  I now am afraid to take down because I may not be able to get it set up again especially on my own.  I would look for another brand.I wish I could return however I didn't have a need to use until the child was 4 months old and I purchased right after her birth.  Not happy.

source_doc: Build Quality Could be Better. I purchased the ES110 based on exhaustive research and reading reviews. I also own an upright Kawai piano. What convinced me to purchase it was the key action and sound quality. I primarily wanted a piano and didn't need a lot of other features.When I set up the ES110 I noticed a fair amount of noise from some keys clacking when released (plastic on plastic). Most keys seemed adequately sound dampened but some were not. I contacted the vendor and Kawai support. The vendor told me to contact Kawai support as well. I never heard back from them.The clacking key noise was driving me crazy so I returned the ES110 and asked a few different music stores what they would recommend. I Purchased the Roland FP30X. I didn't purchase the Roland initially because a reviewer said the keys were a little too heavy and it might not be the best for high speed fingering used in classical music. I've also been very satisfied with my Kawai upright.The Roland keys feel much more solid with no clacking noise. The build quality on the Roland seems better than the ES110. Maybe the key feel is a little heavier but you can adjust the Key Touch to make it feel lighter.I really wanted to love the ES110 and was very disappointed. Maybe I got a lemon. The Roland FP30EX has been great so far.

source_doc: Use force and don’t touch with skin when applying adhesive pads. I applied mine to wood paneling and some kind of dropped ceiling material as well as drywall. These were all freshly pained with an eggshell finish.The part that may help you- Given other reviews I was aware of adhesion problems so I made sure not to touch them with my skin AT ALL. I removed the pad from the sheet with tweezers (leaving the backing on the one side) and placed it on the fattest part of the butterfly body where the magnet is. I then pressed it on hard using my fingers, thumb on the pad and the rest on the other side of the body. And I do mean hard. After doing them all my fingers really hurt. After this I then removed the paper backing and applied them to the surface and pressed HARD repeatedly. A few of them I heard a crack because I pressed so hard but not sure where I cracked as it wasn’t visible.I have had 3 fall. One after 2 days, another after a week, and then another 3 weeks later. I put each of these back up using superglue.Other than that, haven’t had any problems. I believe that using force and avoiding getting skin oils on them was helpful.

source_doc: Great to use. I was extremely happy to purchase this at the price point that I did. I've been looking for a wireless keyboard for so long to reduce clutter. Definitely wanted to wait for a sale as I didn't want to spend original price for it.I've had mechanical keyboards now for over 10 years now. Some corsair, and some off-brand ranging from $20-$150. This has definitely been the best keyboard that I have typed on, and love the wireless function. I have not had ANY delays. I've played MMO's, FPS, and various strategic games and have no issues. I also type a fairly high amount as I am in a work from home position and typing a good portion of the day.As part of anything that may be faulty, I did notice in plenty of reviews people complaining about the quality of the keycaps. I have no issue with it as I know that these keycaps are so light to press. Wife has a keychron (also great) and I can definitely tell the keycaps are bigger, but will also require a little bit more force for similar switches.

source_doc: Blender, frother or shaker bottle works best with this. In adding 3 scoops to my 12 oz coffee, I found it didn't mix thoroughly. Next try, I added 1 scoop to my coffee and it mixed up a little better using just one scoop. I then added an another scoop to a 1/3 cup half & half (yes, I like a little coffee with my creamer lol). I used my cordless frother and it mixed up fine. I am not sure 2 scoops in the creamer would have worked as well. I'm ok with only using 2 scoops a day; it's better than nothing.  The flavor was nice, but I also add flavored syrup to my coffees as well.  Next day, I put 3 scoops in a blender bottle (with wire wisk ball) along with 12 oz of milk and half a packet of chocolate breakfast drink mix. Then, shook and shook and shook. It mixed up great and tasted awesome.  I removed a star only because I didn't feel this worked as well as I thought it should in hot coffee. It's better than some, but still not awesome.

source_doc: It will jam up, and break. So. I bought this specifically for the claimed 5 ton power. I wanted the overkill.  My 4500 lb sub got a we stuck in some wet mud. It's awd so it's horrible in that environment. After the heavy rain. The ground got really soft and I sunk while driving on my grass. I thought, ok I'll get this to save hundreds for a tow... Fast forward. I hooked it up  so I read the terrible instructions since it's a double hook. Watched some YouTube videos. Got it going.. Click click. After a couple feet. It made a weird sound and kicked back a few inches. I inspected everything... Couldn't see anything crazy, but now it's really hard to crank, and stuff in both directions.... I thought. Ok maybe it's just the tension...? But no I still had a good length to go before I had to release and start over. And as I was cranking the lever, snap!!* The cable broke and the comealong hit my leg.So. Long story short, DON'T BUY THIS POS ..

source_doc: Great Product For Automobiles Or Any Filling Need! I used this product to repair a hole in the front bumper of my wife's car after an accident! I had a hole about 3 inches by 4 inches that was in need of repair. What I liked about this product was that I did not have to put a bunch of materials together or make a big batch for such a small job.I packed the hole with some newspaper; then I left about a half inch depth from the front of the bumper to fill. I took out about a cup of putty from the can with a plastic putty knife and then  added about a half inch line of hardener from the package.I then stirred the material until the colors blended well and applied it to the bumper. I did read where other users added too much hardener and it hardened on them rapidly; but I did not experience that problem with my batch. As a matter of fact, it took around an hour to dry completely which led me to believe I was a little too lenient on the hardener. It worked well though and I sanded it down within three hours and painted it the next day.You really can't tell that the hole was there at all; with the exception of paint difference. I strongly recommend this product for any of your patching needs!

source_doc: Easy to swallow capsules. I purchased a bottle of Surebounty Magnesium Malate 90 count. When reading all the pro’s & con’s about this product, I knew I wanted to try it. The one thing I liked was the fact their capsules are so easy to swallow. That means a lot to me. As I get older I am not able to swallow big capsules anymore. The direction on the bottle says you can take 1-4 capsules a day. I have been taking 2. The reason I do that is because I take other supplements that already has some magnesium malate in it. I am happy to see they do not use any fillers or binders. The capsules are non GMO/dairy/gluten free. So far I am very pleased with this product. I would definitely recommend.

source_doc: Works great for me! As I have gotten older and I suppose less active, I seem to have more trouble going and staying asleep. I did not want to take a prescription sleep aid, so I tried the Sleep Foundation formula with melatonin. supplement, and I am glad that I did. I have tried other melatonin supplements but really did not have good results. This product not only helped me get to sleep faster, but I stayed asleep most of the night with the exception of having to get up to go to the bathroom as usual. I did not feel groggy in the morning and according to my sleep tracker, I was sleeping better. I believe that the price is a little high as similar products sell for quite a bit less, but if it keeps working for me it is worth it.
