source_doc: Thick, plush & WARM as advertised!! Sir Thomas is a stray ( in pic), roaming the neighborhood; came up missing for a few days; when he did return, he had been in a fight. I brought out the new (still in box) thermal cat mat-pad, folded a blanket throw underneath the Morapet, so he’d be elevated a bit. This fellow didn’t hesitate; it’s as if his name was on it, got right in, laid down and was out like a light. Slept several hours. Outside temp was 47°. I called our Vet, no openings for another 4 days. I’m trying to get him to trust me more, so I can get him fixed, but this injury took front-runner, I can work on trust later. Originally, I had browsed all the other brands of self-warming mat-pads for one of our senior indoor cats, as I needed another self-warming mat-pad for Geno… I settled on this one for it’s plush fabric &  thickness, but when I saw Sir Thomas’ eye injury,  the 3 deep gashes on his paw and small bit of missing fur on his hind area, I felt this warming mat-pad really needs to go to him. Before his injury, he’d just sleep wherever he could.I was so impressed with the quality of workmanship, the thickness, plush & warmth of this product. I will be buying another 1 or 2 to replace Geno’s.  YES I would recommend this product !!

source_doc: Amazing red light handheld. I got this because around the winter I tend to get cold sores and I currently have one on the side of my lips and I want it gone.  It came packaged well and I didn't notice any defects on it.  In the package, you get the light, two batteries, a charger for the batteries, glasses, a microfiber cloth, and a case for it all.  I really like that this comes with removable batteries instead of being charged in the device as when one battery dies I can have the other ready to go. The light really is really bright and you can feel your skin heating up when you have it on. There are three different lights red, blue and red, and blue though I primarily use blue and red. I used this on my cold sore and I guess it has made it speed up healing kinda hard to tell without going to the dr.  Out of all the handheld red light devices I have tried this one is definitely the best I've tried.

source_doc: Is not anti-scratch. I don't like anything about this set. There weren't any instructions and I thought it was pretty difficult to put on because of how solid it is. Once the case is on, it doesn't fit. I was worried about scratching my deck or breaking off one of the triggers while pulling the case over the top.I tried to take photos of as many gaps as possible. The solid screen cover is so tight that it rubs across the screen when closing. That is the opposite of its purpose and I'm glad I put the screen protector on first. At first, I thought I may have put it on wrong. Now I don't think so. You can tell in the photo of L1/L2 that I didn't have room to wrap the case around L1. Even if I did it didn't feel safe to try further.If it were to fit, I don't think it would matter. The edges around the triggers are uncomfortable. I wouldn't say sharp, but they could feel that way after a bit of rubbing.I took the case off right after taking the photos and will not be using it again.

source_doc: beachy aroma lingers like cologne, good coverage, even spray, pretty good overall. Pleasant aroma, sprays well, no irritation.I use sunscreen all year round. I am fair and have sun sensitivities. Add in that I take a couple of meds that exacerbate this, and I just cover up. Currently dark and snowy in NY with no real use for body sunscreen, but I gave this a cursory try. It should be good for body use when the time comes. I buy the sprays for the ability to cover my back to reach places that a lotion cannot.Since I use sunscreen copiously, and spend a lot of time outside which warrants it, I tend to prefer a higher SPF (I dont down rate for this because I can clearly see what I am ordering; no suprises), and I also prefer healthy sunscreens that are good for body and environment. I can get giant bottles of cheap stuff which is fine in a pinch, but for every day use, multiple times a day.. I choose wisely.Keep in mind that this is aromatic. This comes with an air freshener of this aroma. It is beachy and pleasant, but also a tad perfumy. If you like colognes and such then you will likely enjoy this. I dont mind it but it is something I am aware of when I have it on.
hypos: Пляжный аромат держится как одеколон, хорошее покрытие, равномерное распыление, в целом довольно неплохо. Приятный аромат, хорошо распыляется, без раздражения. Я пользуюсь солнцезащитным кремом круглый год. Я светлокожий/ая и чувствительный/ая к солнцу. Добавьте к этому то, что я принимаю пару лекарств, которые это усугубляют, и я просто закрываюсь от солнца. Сейчас в Нью-Йорке темно и снежно, и особой необходимости в солнцезащитном креме для тела нет, но я попробовал/а его на скорую руку. Он должен хорошо подойти для тела, когда придет время. Я покупаю спреи из-за возможности обработать спину и дотянуться до мест, которые невозможно намазать лосьоном. Поскольку я пользуюсь солнцезащитными средствами в больших количествах и провожу много времени на улице, что этого требует, я предпочитаю более высокий SPF (я не снижаю оценку за это, так как четко вижу, что заказываю; никаких сюрпризов), а также предпочитаю полезные солнцезащитные кремы, которые хороши для тела и окружающей среды. Я могу купить огромные флаконы дешевого средства, которое сойдет в крайнем случае, но для ежедневного использования по несколько раз в день... я выбираю с умом. Имейте в виду, что это средство ароматное. К нему прилагается освежитель воздуха с таким же ароматом. Он пляжный и приятный, но также немного парфюмерный. Если вам нравятся одеколоны и тому подобное, то, скорее всего, вам это понравится. Я не против этого, но это то, что я ощущаю, когда средство на мне.

source_doc: Beware. I was extremely disappointed in this product because when I opened it and went to use it i held it up to my lamp next to my mom's bed and I could see that the container was half full.  Brand new never used!!! I paid for an item that I only got half of . I don't know if this was purposeful or if this is how it comes. I would have liked to have left a message to the seller instead of writing a review.  I felt it's important to warn others to check theirs before using.  Buyers you might want to know this in advance if you decide to order it.  I'm pretty sure that this is one of those items that you can't return so just a warning. Other than that I really like the powder and I like the price. This is the first time I've ordered this item. I was excited to use it because the powder smells great and the ingredients in it that would help my mom who is bedridden.

source_doc: Good keyboard for Mac. I have an apple wireless extended keyboard and I like the simplicity but was never happy typing on it for long periods of time.  I bought this one because I was hoping for the feel I had with the older Apple keyboards.  I miss those.  This one is a pretty good replacement.  The key feel is good for touch typing and the angle doesn't make my hands as tired after a long time banging away at the keys.The light effects I do not find necessary but I do like the setting that illuminates the key that was just typed.  I just wish there was a way to lock that selection in as if I accidentally hit the key that switches the light setting I have to toggle all the way back to where is was.

source_doc: Not sure if it worked, but my tank was cycled quickly. I watched a bunch of youtube videos and was expecting to get some giant algae bloom or a huge spike in nitrites and then nitrates.  I never experienced any of this. I was so unsure if my tank was cycled. I tested my water consistently, for 2 weeks no change. Then i bought a small rock covered in algae from petco and put it in there. I shined a flashlight that night and saw it had some good hitchhikers in it. Tiny Stomatella snails, and alot of amphipods. I watched them for a week and they were thriving so i knew it was obviously cycled now. Then i bought one fish, a diamond goby. That guy is the best purchase ive made. He is a workhorse and keeps my entire sandbed clean of all extra food. Anyways... he was happy in there. So then i knew it was safe to add more.  My tank is 75 gallons with live sand and dry live rock carib sea. The only wet live rock i added was that tiny one from petco.  I think it works. Still not sure really if it was this stuff or the extra time i gave it.

source_doc: In The Stars. I LOVE this scent and have it in the body lotion and spray. When I saw the fragrance plug in I had to try it. I have never used a wallflower plug in before so I had no idea how it would work or how I would like it. The product came on time, packaged well with no damage. I put one in my small guest bathroom and WOW. It smells just like the body products! If you love In the Stars, you will love this. The room is small but the throw is just perfect. The smell is noticeable but not obnoxious. It makes me happy when I walk in there. I just added one to my bedroom so I’ll see how it works in a larger space. This scent is clean while being sexy, girly and like nothing else. It is not overpowering and not too feminine that my husband won’t like it. It just plain smells amazing! I will probably put at least one downstairs too. I think I’ll buy more because it is not gettable on the BBW site. Did I say I love this?

source_doc: Awesome with a Catch... I really hate breaking the wood hotrods and then buying them again, only to break them again. The Kuppmen carbon fiber rods seem to be the answer to this issue. I love the way they feel, and they sound just great on my hi hats when I need less attack but still want to play pretty hard. Rebound from the snare is awesome, and all around they're just a pleasure to play with.BUT... the center rod will eventually fly out! This usually happens mid song, and I usually realize it when I go to hit the snare and I get the crash (12 inches behind the snare) instead. Then I have to use a drumstick to smash the rod back into place and hope it doesn't come out again. I've considered pulling the center rod and putting a dab of superglue on the very bottom of it, but I kind of wish I didn't have to do that, considering how expensive these rods are. I don't mind paying the price, but I expect durability, you know?Otherwise, I love them!

source_doc: great stabilizers and super pretty!!! OMG! I LOVE these rings! I purchased a set of 6"-12" crystal bowls from Amazon. I really enjoy them, as does my kitty Olivia who regularly totally blisses out listening to them! (The root chakra bowl is her favorite, in case your interested!) The only problem was that the tiniest bowl, the crown chakra bowl, was seriously unstable. I found it super difficult and frustrating to play. The problem may well have been that I have the bowls on carpet. I don't know, although I did try setting it on a stone coaster. (Desperate, I know!)  But it got frustrating enough that I eventually replaced it with an 8" bowl. I needn't have bothered! The new ring perfectly, absolutely, 100% stablizes the bowl, perhaps because it raises it above the caarpet. I don't know! I DO know that these rings are much thicker and actually  hug the bowl. Also, unlike the rubber rings which seem to come in only 2 sizes,  these are individually sized to fit each bowl. The bowls aslo seem to sound better. The carpet issue again?? They are also color coordinated to each bowl and are readily visible, so they are super pretty, I mean, really pretty! I am thrilled with this purchase.

source_doc: These really work! I took these for the first time and had great results. I chose a night when I was pretty sure I would have trouble sleeping (Sunday night for teachers is the worst and I napped too much on Sunday afternoon). I took one gummy a hour and a half before bed because I wanted to make sure it wore off by morning. I was sleepy within 30 minutes! I made myself wait until bedtime and then slept peacefully. My cat woke me up once and I woke up another time naturally to go to the bathroom. Normally I wake up several times a night, so this was a huge improvement. I also have an issue with eating snacks at night, but I did not eat a single thing that night. I’m not sure if it keeps you too tired to be hungry or if it creates an appetite suppressant effect, but whatever it is, I am pleasantly surprised. I will be reordering when I run out. source_doc: Fizzy bath tablets. I had previously tried a Monster Bubble product by the same brand, in spicy citrus, that I really love, so I was excited to try this assortment pack. What I realized is that the Monster Bubble is the same bath tablet, but in a larger size. And I realized that I actually prefer the larger tablet, as there is more scent and bath ingredients (I’m a huge believer in using Epsom salts and other minerals in the bath, and I love going to the hot springs for the same reason, so I’m a fan of products that add minerals to my bath). However, though I didn’t find the scents to be offensive, I didn’t love them as much as I loved the spicy citrus scent that I had originally tried. Overall I still enjoy using these bath tablets. I have come to really enjoy the pop of color in my bath, as well as the fragrance. The color doesn’t stain my tub but does kind of lift my spirits. I never realized that I would enjoy color in my bath, until I started using these tablets. I definitely prefer the larger sized Monster Bubbles, but overall still really enjoy the regular sized assorted tablets in this set.

source_doc: Wish the Structural Part was Better Designed. I so want to love this bag for cloth diapers. It does very well with keeping the smell contained, looks nice, and I love the zipper bottom and how it fits with a hanger. However, the plastic pieces that provide the structure push themselves through the fabric during the washing process. I have mended it multiple times and they keep finding ways to push through...and the main one is difficult to put back in. The last time it happened, I decided I was done fixing it and got a different bag. The fabric near the ends of these plastic pieces needs to be reinforced. My other issue is that after washing once I left it in the washer a little too long and after going through the dryer on highest heat there were little spots that I guess I assumed were mold spots. I immediately washed again and made sure to move to dryer right away and they seemed to be gone. But they have come back over and over. I'm not sure how to dry hanging and keep these spots from developing, and the dryer makes the plastic pieces push through the fabric worse. If this bag was redesigned with reinforcements, I would consider purchasing again because I do like it apart from the two issues I talked about.

source_doc: What I expected for the price. I had to send the first order of these baskets back due to damage to the large & medium basket. The return procedure was very simple and I quickly received the replacement order. These baskets are exactly what I expected for the price I paid. Before I ordered I read through the reviews. I was surprised that one of the complaints was that they were not made of wicker but plastic. A set of natural wicker baskets would cost way more than the $40 I paid for these. In spite of the plastic they look very nice and seem sturdy. I have not put any items in them yet but I am sure they will be fine. They are woven around a wire frame and I am sure they will hold up once filled, Another complaint was the inside metal pieces that hold the straps in place. The baskets I purchased are safe. The pointy ends are tucked under the weave. I figured if there was any danger I would simply cover the metal with some sturdy tape, All in all I am pleased with my purchase and I would recommend these baskets.

source_doc: Great exercise wedge. I got these to do calf stretches as I was getting leg cramps. I like how sturdy they are and I will say I was surprised at how much they weigh ( approximately 10 pounds). I am very pleased with my decision to get these and I would purchase again.

source_doc: It seems to work as advertised. I do not use this as often as I had thought I would. I am not sure how much utility it has in real life due to it being a card.  I tend to reach for a pocket knife instead. I am still waiting on the day that I need it over what I have but it wasn't super expensive and it is always nice having a backup.

source_doc: Can't be placed under a cabinet without pulling the coffee maker out to fill with water. I was specifically looking for a coffee maker that I could place under a cabinet and not have to pull out each time I needed to add water.  That may be a minor thing to most people, but it was what I wanted the most besides good, hot, coffee, an auto shut off feature, etc. Things most people look for when shopping for a coffee maker.After researching for days and weeks I thought I had found it in this model, but the measurements on the product page did not match the measurements I needed to make this work on my counter.  I was disappointed because after a ton of reading I discovered how happy people were with the Hamilton Beach brand.  I had to return it and now I have to decide if I want another 4-5 cup maker again - I know that one will fit.

source_doc: Exactly what I wanted. I am not a big fan of water. I can’t explain it, I just never really like it unless I’m severely dehydrated. Since I don’t drink sodas or sugary drinks, that means I usually just drink coffee or tea all day. Not exactly the best choice as that’s a lot of caffeine. So I determined that I’m going to drink more water. I swear the water tastes funky to me if it comes out of stainless steel containers. I can only tolerate drinking water from glass or ceramic vessels. Plastic is out of the question to touch my food or drinks.  I know- I’m picky. I couldn’t find any large volume glass water bottles locally, so I turned to Amazon. I completely love this water bottle. I’ve been throwing some frozen fruit & chopped cucumber in there & filling it with filtered water to infuse. It has been a game changer. It’s also easy to use, easy to clean, no leaks, and you can use the straw or not depending on your preference. Yeah, you have to be careful not to throw it around since it’s glass, but the carry handle is very sturdy. I love everything about it!

source_doc: Wonderful. When I couldn't get an appt. with our groomer, and I knew my dogs nails were getting too long, I thought I would trim them myself.  No way. It was not a pleasant time for any of us.  So I ordered this.  It arrived the next day.  I tried it immediately.  I put a shower rod between a door frame to hang it on.  Love it.  I have two Havanese and 1 boykin spaniel.  They hang there and don't move.  I was able to trim all three dogs nails and clean the nail pieces up,  within 20 mins.  This is fantastic.  I won't need the groomer any longer to do their nails, and that alone with save $$$.  Make sure you get the correct size.  The size I got is perfect for my Havanese.  I will have to order a slightly larger one for our Boykin, because she is bigger, but I wanted to see how it would work on her also.

source_doc: WOW. I am no longer a Sacrete guy. I set a 4x4, 8 foot post using this product.  I made a hole 2 feet deep, 7 to 8 inch diameter.  One package of this stuff nearly filled the entire hole with the post centered in it.  Mixed it exactly as the instructions dictate. I was initially disappointed because the liquid I poured in only filled up a couple of inches.  I was using a 2-foot level to confirm the pole was remaining vertical and then I looked in the hole and it was more than half-way full up with foam and I could see it rising. In perhaps 5 minutes more, it was nearly completely full up on all four sides.  After 15 minutes I removed the straps I was using to hold the post in place, and light pressure on the sides of the post showed no give in the foam, it was solid enough to leave standing alone.  Incredibly easy compared to how I used to have to mix a bag of sacrete by hand and carry the 30 or 40 pounds around.  Wish I had another project needing another bag of this stuff so I could do it all again, it was well, "fun".

source_doc: Absolutely Beautiful!! As an avid, long time bass fisherman, I am quite used to paying, what my wife considers to be, big money for a good reel.  I use only bait casters for my bass fishing and relegate spin casters for light stuff like crappie and brim.I really didn't expect too much considering the price of the reel.When I took it out of the box and unwrapped it, my chin dropped to my chest.  This reel is beautiful.Once I got past my initial surprise, I started to inspect it closely for the features that I would pay big bucks for.  I found all the features of my more expensive reels and more.  I would normally change out the crank handles for the ones with soft, grippable rubber handles.  This reel already had those.  I got the owners manual and read it from cover to cover and found it to be the most comprehensive and instructive manual I have ever seen.  It explained every single thing about the reel in very understandable English.I have yet to fish this reel, but if it works as good as it looks, I won't be dissatisfied in the least.I highly recommend this reel to serious fishermen everywhere.  I am considering buying another for my flipping rod.

source_doc: Love this!! I've been wanting something to keep my exercise equipment organized but never thought to look for anything.  I don't like shopping (even online although it's a little better than going to the store) so I just don't think of it.  But finally I had enough of the mess and nothing in the same place and started looking around at reviews etc.  I saw a few videos of this being put together and everyone seemed to be pretty happy with it so I gave it a try.  I love it! It holds all my stuff plus a couple of my husbands torture rollers.  I have to do a little rearranging for my new yoga blocks but they will fit as well.  It also rolls on the carpet pretty easy.  I only had one hand available and I was able to move it.  I would buy another if I needed to.

source_doc: Best value for the price. I like the Old Mother Hubbard minis.  They're the perfect size for rewarding my dogs (I have large dogs).  I appreciate that the ingredients are better than many of the comparable treats, such as Milk Bones, and yet the price is more reasonable than brands like Blue.  My dogs are eager to be treated with them, so they must taste good.  As I stated, I have large dogs, so we do go through them somewhat quickly.  For this reason, I buy the 6lb boxes.  I get more for the cost.  I do feel like these could be better packaged.  The box isn't tightly sealed, just taped along the middle.  The biscuits are in a large plastic bag inside the box which isn't sealed either.  I do worry that these could easily be contaminated by their surrounding environment.  It would not be difficult for a mouse to crawl under the flap of the box and get inside the bag of biscuits.  Definitely something I think the manufacturer should consider.  When I get mine, I fill the treat jar and then store the remaining in the deep freezer until I need them.  (My German Shepherd is allergic to storage mites, so this helps me negate that issue.)

Я ценю то, что ингредиенты здесь лучше, чем во многих аналогичных лакомствах, таких как Milk Bones, и при этом цена более разумная, чем у брендов вроде Blue. Мои собаки с нетерпением ждут этого угощения, так что оно, должно быть, вкусное. Как я уже указал/а, у меня крупные собаки, поэтому они уходят довольно быстро. По этой причине я покупаю коробки по 6 фунтов. Так получается выгоднее по цене. При этом я считаю, что упаковка могла бы быть лучше. Коробка запечатана неплотно, просто заклеена скотчем посередине. Сами галеты находятся внутри коробки в большом пластиковом пакете, который тоже не запечатан. Я беспокоюсь, что они могут легко загрязниться из-за окружающей среды. Мыши не составит труда залезть под клапан коробки и проникнуть внутрь пакета с галетами. Определенно, производителю стоит об этом подумать. source_doc: Always Have Loved Maple Necks/Fingerboards. I dont "get" alot of these reviews.  I've been playing forty years and have had at least five dozen guitars running the gamut of pricing.  You never know with a guitar, they all are different.  Personally, i have always liked maple necks and fretboards.  It has a soft, easy to play feel.  If it doesn't feel right, NOTHING else matters.  This guitar feels good and makes it easy and fun again, the same can't be said of plenty of guitars I've owned over the years.  I've had cheaper guitars feel great and really expensive guitars feel like crap.  As long as it feels good, i can get a good sound by using pedals.  I was very pleasantly surprised.  The tuning is a slight issue but stretch them good and/or put a new set on it.  The finish I think is great, too.  I like it so much i am going to get another.  That'll be a fun comparison.  Like i said, you never know.  I think it's a crapshoot.  I don't trust so-called luthiers, either.  I've had plenty of guitars come back less-playable.  These were well-respected people.  It's either playable or not.  I like this little thing.

source_doc: SHORT style great for people 5’9” or taller DID NOT SWIVEL & WOBBLY. Preface: I am female…weigh more than I care to say…(229lbs)…and I am 5’7”. I purchased this for guitar practice as I have read many, many people have. So let’s cut to the chase……Maybe I received a dud…who knows. I do know that 1) it was wobbly with no means of adjusting it. Well…I guess I could put a matchbook under one of the legs to level it out…you know, like in the old days! 2) Maybe my definition of “swivel” is different than most…seat barely even moved when I wasn’t even sitting on it and had to strong arm it. 3) I researched like crazy to find the “perfect” stool. I read several reviews that stated it’s good for people 5’7”….. um…nope. I couldn’t put a foot on the floor without sitting so close to the front that it was quite uncomfortable on my woman parts. Again…I might have received a defective item. I have learned through all my research that roc-n-soc is extremely well made and very popular. I just purchased the r-n-s nitro drum throne so I’ll let ya’ll know how that one is. I’m super stoked!

source_doc: White Light=Bright White. I have used several different Chemical Guys detailing products. Some I like better than others and this is one of them. I have a white metallic vehicle and I wanted to see if I could find a product that really makes the white “pop.” I tried a few different things and even though they looked good, I never got the “pop” I was seeking. Also, many of these other products are magnets for dust and even though I don’t drive anywhere near dirt roads or live in a particularly dusty area, my car would would coated with dust just days after I detailed it. I did not find that issue with White Light. In fact, it hasn’t rained in a week since I detailed my vehicle and it doesn’t have much dust sitting on it at all. The white is bright and crisp and has a deep shine. I will definitely continue to use Chemical Guys White Light for my white vehicle.

source_doc: Wow just wow. I bought a Grote 335 style guitar a few years ago and am extremely happy with its quality and performance. Because of its price, I thought it might be a fluke. Last week I decided to buy the LP Grote. This guitar arrived in less than a week. I picked the purple tone. I don’t care that it’s a printed front. It’s stunningly beautiful. I am a guitar tech and luthier but I haven’t done a set up to either Grote’s I own and they sound decent right out of the box. That being said, if you are hitting the road or doing studio work I would recommend doing a pro set up on these guitars. I love the amplified sound of the 335 style Grote I own so I expected the same when I tested the new one. when I plugged in the LP I was blown away at the warmest sound I’ve heard in years. No pedals or effects, just amp. This 199.99 guitar was boasting a 1000.00 sound. I would recommend any guitarist who doesn’t have a large budget to look at Grote. If you have a large budget, still look at Grote and spend the rest of a great amp.

source_doc: Stains skin, medium brown is black. I have been using henna on my hair for over a decade and never though of dying my eyebrows with it since usually the package says not to. Anyway henna is too orangey for my brows anyway, that are naturally very light. So I tried that kit, but 2 things happened:- the color never lightened and stayed dark so now I have black eyebrows with red hair and I guess I'll soap my eyebrows everyday hoping that product doesn't last too long- it really stains the skin! When I do my hair I slather the henna and it goes on my ears and neck and has never stained even though I keep it on all day. I had to scrub around my eyebrows really hard and damaged my skin. It also has absolutely no instructions so I had to come here. I wish I could return it but the window closed yesterday.Next application I'll mix it with my regular hair henna so it doesn't get too dark, and will make sure it doesn't go on my skin at all.

В общем, я попробовал/а этот набор, но случились две вещи: во-первых, цвет так и не посветлел и остался темным, так что теперь у меня черные брови при рыжих волосах, и, видимо, мне придется каждый день мыть брови с мылом в надежде, что средство не продержится слишком долго; во-вторых, оно действительно окрашивает кожу! source_doc: What a relief! I didn’t know that such a device existed, however, I will now share my new discovery with friends! For many years I found myself constantly readjusting my seatbelt while driving. I added a pad to the belt hoping it would project my neck from the rubbing seatbelt. It only reduced my discomfort slightly.This product appeared as I was looking for something to help me install a dog booster seat in my car. It was a spontaneous purchase. While I’ve only used the device for two days, I am pleasantly surprised by the comfort it provides. The seatbelt now feels like a good, personalized fit for me and my atypical body.I marked down the “ease of use” because I am still trying to figure out how to keep the device on the seatbelt when I leave the car. The belt doesn’t fully retract when I leave the device on the belt. My hunch is that I need to develop a new habit of consciously tucking the belt beside the seat as I’m leaving the car so I don’t shut the door on the belt.My biggest regret is that I didn’t discover this device years ago when I was doing more cross-country road trips!
hypos: Какое облегчение! Я не знал/а, что такое устройство существует, однако теперь я поделюсь своим новым открытием с друзьями! На протяжении многих лет я ловил/а себя на том, что постоянно поправляю ремень безопасности во время вождения. Я добавил/а накладку на ремень в надежде, что она защитит мою шею от трения. Это лишь немного уменьшило дискомфорт. Этот товар попался мне, когда я искал/а что-то, что помогло бы мне установить детское автокресло для собаки в машине. Это была спонтанная покупка. Хотя я пользуюсь этим устройством всего два дня, я приятно удивлен/а тем комфортом, который оно обеспечивает. Теперь ремень безопасности ощущается так, будто он идеально и индивидуально подходит мне и моему нестандартному телосложению. Я снизил/а оценку за «простоту использования», потому что все еще пытаюсь понять, как оставлять устройство на ремне, когда выхожу из машины. Ремень не втягивается полностью, если я оставляю устройство на нем. source_doc: Excellent quality and lovely zippered case. I think another reviewer said these weren’t made of real memory foam, but when I compared it to my other memory foam pillows, it was definitely the same quality.I also like the fact that they were no offgassing smells when I resuscitated the pillow from being compressed in a small box.The thing with these pillows, and I have been using them for years from different  companies, is you have to try them for yourself. There are subtle differences in the dimensions of each one, and our bodies are differently designed, so you just have to experiment.I tried it with, and without the inner insert, without the insert it was just a little too floppy, even though it felt comfortable to lie on.The only other thing I want to mention is the case, while it is really beautiful quality and aesthetically designed, is a little too long for the actual pillow I received. When I see a little, I mean about an inch.This doesn’t really affect anything, so I didn’t take any stars away for it, it’s just some thing you might wanna know when events. I think it’s very good quality and looked as if it would last a long time. That said, you can find less expensive models that might do the trick for you, but I doubt they will be queen-size, they will probably be standard size.

source_doc: Bright is a Under Statement. I have been wanting to switch over to LED's for awhile now, but I have held off because the colors of LED's were more pastel and didn't look good to me. So I can honestly say these do look great and remind me of my classic C9's. I still have over 20 strands of C9 Christmas Lights from the 70's that are still going strong with GE light blubs. More than half are still original and look great, but as you can guess my light bill for Nov. - Jan. shoots up a lot when using.So when I saw these lights I decided to try one box. When they came and I first tried out I was blown away how good they looked.  They look so good. I will be definitely getting more.  Well let me redo that last statement. If these hold up this season, and make it through the cold weather, rain, snow, ice. Then I will be getting more. I will update later if they don't, but for now all is good.

source_doc: Great for any wide mouth water storage jug. Since we had my daughter and the ridiculous amount of distilled water we used for her I bought a home water distiller so I didn't have to go to the store all the time to get distilled water.  The only problem was I was only able to do a gallon every three hours and when I was just using it for the kid that was fine but since we have hard water I've started using it for my humidifiers, coffee, tea, basically anything that water quality matters on so I needed to find a way to store it.  I got a couple of empty jugs and an electric pump to get the water out with, the only problem is sometimes I need to charge the pump and I don't want to leave the water open to our air which is why I got these.  They fit on both of my 5-gallon and 3-gallon just fine and keep the air out while I do whatever I need to do.  I don't have any gripes about these and they work as expected.

source_doc: It’s all about THAT Bass. I recently purchased a Fender Aerodyne Jazz bass.  This particular bass has no fret markers on the fingerboard, which makes for a nice, clean look.  I normally don’t pay any attention to the markers on the fingerboard, so no problem.  Here’s the problem.  I’m visually impaired and I DO rely on the markers that are in the neck of the bass.  The Aerodyne came with tiny , white dots that I couldn’t see while playing.I tried 1/8” inch dots, but they were too small.  I then ordered these 1/4” dots and they are perfect.  They were easy to apply, and seem to stay adheres pretty well to the neck.  Even if I have to replace them regularly, it’s worth it.  I was about ready to return the bass, not because I didn’t like it, but because it was too difficult to play well.  These simple dots saved the day for me as I love this bass!  See picture for details.  No jokes about them not being straight cuz I already told you I can’t see lol.
hypos: Все дело в ТОМ САМОМ басу. Недавно я купил/а бас-гитару Fender Aerodyne Jazz. У этого конкретного баса нет ладовых маркеров на накладке грифа, что придает ему красивый и чистый вид. Обычно я не обращаю никакого внимания на маркеры на накладке, так что никаких проблем. Но вот в чем проблема. Я слабовидящий/ая и мне ДЕЙСТВИТЕЛЬНО нужны маркеры, которые находятся на торце грифа. Aerodyne поставлялся с крошечными белыми точками, которые я не видел/а во время игры. Я попробовал/а точки размером 1/8 дюйма, но они оказались слишком малы. Затем я заказал/а эти 1/4-дюймовые точки, и они идеальны. Их было легко наклеить, и они, похоже, довольно хорошо держатся на грифе. Даже если мне придется регулярно их менять, оно того стоит. Я уже был/а готов/а вернуть бас, не потому что он мне не понравился, а потому что на нем было слишком сложно играть хорошо. Эти простые точки просто спасли меня, так как я обожаю этот бас! Подробности смотрите на фото. Никаких шуток о том, что они наклеены неровно, потому что я уже сказал/а вам, что плохо вижу, лол.

source_doc: Excellent nest holder but no instructions; Khaki color looks like a pasta nest. First of all this Khaki colored nest looks like some sort of edible pasta that has to be cooked. It comes with absolutely no instructions either when received or online. I almost was going to throw this out. However, after manhandling it for a few minutes, I had to strongly pull it apart. Once I opened it like an accordion, I understood how to use this.I have short to medium fine curly hair and I was able to roll my hair up in a  bun and then close this over the bun while holding my hair with the other hand. This then formed a nest. I tried unsuccessfully to take photos of it in my hair, so I only got a photo of one side. However, it holds exceptionally well because it is very strong.If using this with a ponytail, I recommend holding the ponytail with an elastic first and then pulling it through and clamping this over the hair. This is both unique and a wonderful hair implement. I do not love the khaki color, but I love the design. It also appears to be well-made. I would have rated this 5 stars had it come with instructions.The current price of $4.99 appears to be competitively priced for such a unique design and strong holding hair nest.

source_doc: Exactly what I have searched for to help my dark circles! Years ago I used the green Garnier under eye for dark circles and no idea when/why I stopped. I was searching for something to help my dark circles (I’m very pale and 52 yes old) as even if I was able to cover them up initially, an hour later it looked horrible and crepey. I saw this product mentioned on reddit and several people called it their “holy grail”.I tried it in the am, before a shower as I was curious if it lived up to the hype. I was amazed! Very little goes a long way. I tapped it around my under-eye area and it looked great. Plus, it didn’t look crepey/dry an hour later.It also lasts and looked great at the end of the day. I’m thrilled to find something that works! Today I did a full face of makeup and a tiny bit of concealer over the top was my only addition. I can’t recommend it enough!

source_doc: So Easy. You just put the clips on them and they are ready to learn. I have a liftmaster + security. I looked on the garage door opener for the dangling wire, took the light cover off and saw a red button. This is my learn button. I long pressed II & III until the LED came on and then blinked a bit and went off. Since my learn button was red I clicked the I button 3 times. then pressed one of the different buttons (II or III). Then I pressed the red learn button on the garage door opener and immediately clicked the I button on the new remote. I heard 2 clicks. My light bulb is out or else it probably would have blinked 2 times as well. Afterwards I hit the I button on the remoter and the door opened. Then I hit it again and the door closed. Very easy for me. If what I said isn't clear refer to the directions that are in the box. Plus your learn button may be different. Inexpensive way to get extra remotes or replace broken ones.

source_doc: Great idea. Does not work well. I love the idea of this device. I'm always looking for ways to do nordic curls and Spanish squats. I don't like using a strap for sit ups as I think it's too much of a crutch. However, I was excited about using this strap for nordic curls and Spanish squats. This does not execute at all. First off I am a small woman with size 6 feet and I feel like for nordic curls you need to have bigger (longer) feet to even remotely make this work on the shortest length. This did not work for me at all. It worked only slightly better for my very tall husband with huge feet but not even very well for him. As for the Spanish squat this is where the device works the best. I tried it for sit ups and it was impossible again due to my small stature. Didn't work great for my large husband either. I really wanted to like this but the design is not right. I followed the directions and I am a personal trainer so I thought I might be able to figure out an alternate way to make it work but I did not. On the plus side, the device does seem fairly well built. The foam of the pads is a little soft and dented on first use. The buckle and straps appear quality and secure.

source_doc: Waste of money. Works great... until it stops working. I purchased two for a trip I took last December/January where it was going to be cold. I live in Florida, so I did not have to use them again until another trip up North about a month ago. I packed them along with the charger and when I got up there, found they were not working (the light would not turn on once it was connected to charger). Thankfully other friends packed extra disposable hand warmers. I emailed the company because I purchased this over disposable hand warmers thinking they would last a while, and I only used them for one trip that was a week long. I was two weeks past my 1 year warranty so I lost my money and nothing can be done. They suggested to charge every once in a while when they are not in use and offered to give me a coupon for my next purchase with them. I respectfully declined as I am sure that product would break as well. Would be great if they included that suggestion along with the product, so their clients would know to charge it every so often to make it last longer. Might just stick to disposables for next trip.

source_doc: Good seat for floor play. I bought this seat for my 5 month old to help her sit up even though I was hesitant. We are doing as much of the Montessori method as possible, so I do my best to minimize her time spent in ‘containers’. There are still times where I want/need her to sit by herself for independent play while I complete a task and this fits the bill.The seat is lightweight, which makes it easy to move from room to room or travel with. The tray is very easy to install. Right now I put her in it and place on or two of the toys in our current rotation for her to play with on it. She seems to focus on them more in this upright position than she does in tummy time. I only use the seat after she has had some tummy time and I don’t keep her in it for more than 15-20 minutes.For what it is, I think the price is high. I don’t really need it as a booster seat, as we have a tripp trapp high chair and a Montessori table we’ll use when she starts solids next month. I can see how it would be helpful to people who don’t have or don’t want to buy those things.

source_doc: Mixed. I'm a little mixed & unsure as to whether or not this is really helping. When I ordered this I realized that this was basically a rubberband in a sense, with some items that are & aren't needed in my opinion. I really don't think you need the first remover for this specific product it doesn't really relate, the tweezer are a definite must though, they were a big help. Anyway once I put it on I really kind of expected it to be tighter, or I guess not as easy to just swing the joystick around, in essence showing me that this is holding it together better. But that's not what happened, I feel no difference in the resistance from now & before I put it on so I'm disappointed but I also can't price that it isn't working hence the mixed feelings. I'm not really sure if maybe I'm not supposed to feel any difference & I'm just supposed to wait & hope that I see it in the longevity, I don't know but I don't think that I would actually recommend this since I can't actually feel any difference.

source_doc: Great Dry Bag! I like this bag because it has a clear window so I can kinda tell where things are at. I purchase towards the end of the season so I only have used it a few times I can not really comment on the durability. It appears to be constructed well  however there are seams throughout the bag its not 1 peace nor do I think it would be possible to make it that way. Like anything with seams its more apt to leak in wet conditions although the few time I had it out kayaking on the water and exposed it to water everything i packed in it stayed dry. I can fit a beach size towel some sweats and sweat shirt a t-shirt socks etc. my DSLR with a lens an additional lens snacks etc its pretty roomy and it all stayed dry rolling around in the bottom of the boat. I may have had a few drops of water on the top layer where it was folded twice and not 3 times but it was stuffed and I was experimenting how much i could actually carry with me. I say its a good quality for the price and would recommend to anyone looking for this size however I can not comment on durability as I've only used a few times at the end of the season.

source_doc: Headache relief!! Sometimes I need 2-3 ice packs for my head when I have a bad headache. I usually use the eye mask kind but stretch it across my forehead, but then I can't get relief across the top of my head when I have tension headaches. I just tossed this pack into the freezer. I forgot about it and expected a block of ice, but wow. This head wrap was still soft and pliable, not frozen at all. It was cold like it was frozen though! I slipped the wrap over my head and immediately realized this product is way better than everything I used before. I can get relief in all areas of my head and eyes, unlike all of my other packs. The material is soft and silky like a fancy eye mask. I will be ordering more to switch out since I usually need more than one pack. I'm really relieved to have found a great product to help me deal with my tension headaches.

source_doc: Great for Dog Training Gloves. I have learned that my dogs and I both do better when I wear gloves while training them. I have a better grip on toys and tugs, and when my pups see me don a pair of gloves they get excited because it is time to WORK. I have been using leather gloves, and they get gross very quickly.These Manusage work gloves are exactly what I need for training. Obviously, they'd work well for gardening and other things around the house too, but dog training is what I'm most excited about. Slobber doesn't soak through these gloves to make my hands cold or stinky. The gloves themselves dry out quickly so they don't get stinky (leather gloves...ewwwww). The gloves grip things very well so I am no longer dropping slippery slobbery toys and balls. They do actually work on a touchscreen - I tried them out just to see - but I highly doubt I will be using a screen with slobber covered gloves.After multiple sessions of training dogs with the same pair of gloves, I may never need to buy any again...or at least, it will be a couple of years since I have 12 pairs now. The medium size fit as I expected as I typically wear a medium in work gloves.

source_doc: Solid basic arm. Honest review! Bought this because i wanted a basic simple arm for my mic. Easy to install and works as advertised. It is a little clunky and the motion is very meh. But for what i paid for it… Come on. I don’t get any metal ringing through recordings if i hit the stand slightly like in some others i’ve had. The medium sized one was perfect for what i needed. The large would have probably been returned. If i had to pick out one thing i love and hate? I LOVE the base that goes to the desk. Very solid and makes me feel confident in it. The thing i HATE? This arm would be 10/10 if they made a simple design change on the mic holder. I want it to be able to turn full radius. Up, down, left, right, ect. It’s a little limited. Up and down only. Now I KNOW i can buy a separate piece to make that happen and it is probably designed for that. But it would be a game changer if it just DID THIS TO BEGIN WITH. 4/5 stars good

source_doc: I used these to protect my chicken runs. These are great!  I actually bought several after the first one impressed us.  Last year, my first year with chickens, I got expensive, opaque, heavy plastic and put around the runs (I have 4).  It did the trick, no issues there, but I had to staple it on.  Taking it off was tedious since I wanted to save it, given the price.  I saw these and ordered one to see how we liked it.  The rivets meant we could screw it into the wood (or use cable ties on the wire runs), making removal and reuse next year much easier.  The little "block" design allows more light inside the runs, which is great because the chickens do need light to stay healthy.  It's a toss up - light vs. keeping wind and elements down so they don't freeze.  I feel like this does a good job at both.  The tricky part came when I had to use them side by side because, while the screws were fine, the cable ties left a gap. I fixed that by using Gorilla tape, which sticks well in inclement weather.  Overall, very happy to have found these and I got them at a good price, which is awesome since my pet chickens cost more than any other animal I've ever had in my life!  They're spoiled, but I wouldn't have it any other way.

source_doc: Best travel teacher bag ever. I spent years looking for this bag, I only wish it came in more colors.As a teacher I carry laptop, pens, planner, notebooks, snacks, and water bottles.  This is the only bag I have found that stays upright with my Stanley water and coffee cups.When I travel I want laptop, I pad, books, phone, purse, snacks, makeup, medicine, charging cords and cubes plus water bottles. Oh and the strap to put over suitcase handle that velcros when you don’t use it. I’m pretty sure I could use as a weekender or gym bag too.I Haven’t come close to using all the pockets.  I love the key lease in one of the big upside pockets.  Smaller two zip pockets perfect for phone. My large iPad Pro fits in outside pocket.It comes with a baby pad my cat sits on and a cute cloth wipe I clean my screen with.  I imagine those are awesome for diaper bag use.

source_doc: disappointed! I just gotten an 8-month-old English Cream Golden retriever and she was not responding to the training that my trainer is help me with, so we talked about a shock collar. I read reviews and decided on this one and was thinking this will help me with my ECGR behavior problems. Well came and I followed the instructions, and it just wouldn't pare up the remote would not charge. So, I did a return and not a replacement. I mailed it out the very next day and went to a shop in my town and purchase a more costly shock collar something I didn't want to do because I would only be using the collar for a short time, but I needed one to start our training and couldn't wait on a replacement and then it not work. Then I checked my emails and seen I received an email from Amazon on a replacement for the shock collar. I recommend if you are thinking about purchasing a shock collar don't pick a cheap one, because they will only last 6 months dispending on brand.

source_doc: Finally, the perfect heating blanket! I've been looking for a heating blanket for my bed, when I found one, I really liked it. However, the middle of the blanket would not warm up. I sent the blanket back and asked for a replacement since I reasoned that there might just be a problem with it. The identical action was taken by the second blanket. I subsequently bought another blanket, but I didn't like it because the coils only allowed it to heat up in the middle, not on either side. Even when I bought a fourth heating blanket, it still would not become hot enough. I was about to give up when I decided to give this one a last go.I am very happy I did. Only setting number medium  on this heated blanket keeps me toasty. It becomes unbearably hot if it’s on high. . Not only is the temperature control excellent. It's incredibly soft. I sincerely hope you enjoy the blanket as much as I do and my four-legged luvies.

source_doc: Very disappointed, and had to return. As someone with MCS - multiple chemical sensitivity- any fragrance can make me extremely ill. Someone can walk past me wearing perfume or fabric softener or lotion, and I can become so ill. I will have to be in bed for two or three days. People don’t realize how toxic things are, or are to others around them. Therefore I use products that are natural and clean and pure as far as fragrance goes and have always had good luck with Mrs. Myers products. So I purchased these bottles of hand soap. However, I had a reaction to this fragrance. This does not smell natural. It smells more chemical I used it for about three days in a row to be sure that it truly was this product. I was reacting to, and without a doubt, even after using it, and with the fragrance lingering in the air, I could not enter the room.  Therefore I will no longer use Mrs. Myers products as I cannot trust the source of their fragrance. I do not react to natural essential oils so if the source is truly a natural fragrance, I’m usually good, but not with anything that is chemical. This fragrance does not smell at all natural and smells more chemically derived. I absolutely cannot recommend this product .
hypos: Очень разочарован/а, и мне пришлось оформить возврат. Как человек с МХЧ — множественной химической чувствительностью — я могу серьезно заболеть от любого аромата. Кто-то может пройти мимо меня, надушенный парфюмом, кондиционером для белья или лосьоном, и мне может стать очень плохо. Мне приходится проводить в постели два или три дня. Люди не понимают, насколько токсичны некоторые вещи сами по себе или для окружающих. Поэтому я использую продукты, которые являются натуральными, чистыми и экологичными, когда речь идет об ароматах, и мне всегда везло с продукцией Mrs. Meyer's. Поэтому я купил/а эти флаконы жидкого мыла для рук. Однако на этот аромат у меня возникла реакция. Он не пахнет натурально. Он пахнет скорее химией. Я использовал/а его около трех дней подряд, чтобы убедиться, что реакция была именно на этот продукт, и, без сомнения, даже после использования, когда аромат оставался в воздухе, я не мог/ла войти в комнату. source_doc: Quality seemed fine, but a major, unique screw was missing . . . . . . as it was "two-ended" with a smoothe surface in between that was required to hold the basket between two of the poles. Because China was the likely place I would've had to wait to receive it from, a return was suggested. I bought a larger one from a different company and all the hardware was there. I will say about the one I returned that you have to place four of the poles inside the cubby-hole portion, and it was impossible to see and get the screws lined up to screw into the poles inside, especially at the back area, as I kept thinking I'd gotten it, only to discover that I had not. I became frustrated after trying too many times in two different intervals, but I finally succeeded, only to realize that my efforts were futile due to that unique screw missing. The one I returned it for had the same requirement, but I had no problems with it, either due to a better design or due to the cubby-hole being differently shaped. Anyway, I suggest you read more reviews besides mine before deciding whether YOU want to give it a go.

source_doc: It has built in gloves and I feel so cute. After three years of pandemic and quarantine and wfh, which also included a pregnancy, I had very few pieces of clothing left that fit and suddenly I was being forced back into the office. It's January and cold, so I decided to treat myself to a cute new winter coat to help with the transition back.This coat is everything.It is cozy and warm without making me overheat and it doesn't feel heavy. The sleeves have built in fingerless gloves which I love because I always forget my gloves. The pockets are deep but they don't bulge when full. I can easily fit a 20oz waterbottle in the pocket and hardly notice it is there.Literally the only downside I've experienced is that I can't get to my smart watch because of the gloves, but I'm sure if I really wanted to I'd be able to.This coat made me feel cute for the first time in three years and I am so glad I got it.

Сейчас январь и холодно, поэтому я решил/а побаловать себя новым милым зимним пальто, чтобы облегчить этот переход. Это пальто просто супер. Оно уютное и теплое, но в нем не перегреваешься, и оно не кажется тяжелым. В рукава встроены митенки, что мне очень нравится, так как я всегда забываю свои перчатки. source_doc: Cable works great, Operator is clueless. A few decades ago I was a techie and computer programmer.  However management and 20 years in retirement have taken a toll on my knowledge as this stuff keeps getting more complicated.  Before the Quest 2 I had an Oculus Go since it came out.  I finally decided it was time to upgrade with the 2.  I'm struggling comprehending this new adventure.  I probably should have just stayed with the Go.Anyway, I thought tying the 2 to my laptop would do something for me so I ordered this cable as the cableless method reportedly has disconnects.  I found information on line on how to connect and started the process.  I found the required software, App in today's vocabulary, and loaded  it on my laptop.  I had one hiccup attaching the cable since my laptop only has USB C connections and I needed an A.  I tried one adapter and it wouldn't connect.  However, on a second one, it hooked right up.The cable works great as far as linking your PC to the Quest 2.  What you do afterward, I don't have a clue.  I think I need to find a seven year old to teach me or find the Youtube that I haven't found yet.

source_doc: An honest review. I initially really like these lights. Three come in a set, so I put two in the kitchen and one in the living room closet. I purchased these on January 5th and as of today March the 18th, one light is not working. The particular light I am referencing, seem to need to be charged faster than the other two lights. I thought maybe I had the brightness set too high and I charged it and placed it in the living room closet where it only needed to turn on when the doors open which isn't often. I also made sure for the directions, that I had the right setting. Went to charge it the light was red and when the light was green I tried to turn it on and it did not turn on. Overall, I would purchase these again.

source_doc: Really happy with these pump dispensers. I wanted some nice soap dispensers for my sinks because I got tired of the expense of buying the much more expensive individual soaps I have gotten for several years. I saw these and I really liked the simple look of them. I like that they are actually glass and not plastic. They came with a silicone funnel which I really didn't need since they have a large enough opening to easily fill with the large soap refill I got. The pump works really well and I am completely happy with this set of two. The labels that come with them are really pretty but I chose not to use them so I appreciate that you can use them or not. I wouldn't want ones that came with labels already attached. I can easily recommend these.

source_doc: Love it! I honestly don’t know why I haven’t tried a silicone insert for my air fryer sooner! Washing the air fryer basket is a nightmare and I can never seem to get it a clean as I would like. If I had been using one of these wonderful inventions a long time ago, I would not have had this problem. I absolutely love this set! They fit my Ninja air fryer basket perfectly and clean so easily. Removing the silicone insert from my air fryer is easy as I just take a pair of tongs and pull it right out. Since these are collapsible, storing them is a breeze when not in use. I can hand wash these or run them through the dishwasher. I haven't used them other than in the air fryer, but I can certainly see many other uses as they can withstand heat up to 450°. The only time I probably would not use these is the air fryer is if I am cooking bacon since I want the bacon to drain and not sit in its grease unless it's just one or two slices. These will certainly last a very long time and I don’t see that I will ever need to replace them. Since they come as a set of two, I will always have one handy!  Great quality!

source_doc: Almost perfect. Better as a light feature. I tried a few sound machines but this one was the best I found for my needs. I tried the portable frida, VTech soother with the app (similar to hatch), Google mini speaker, or just a fan running. I wanted a sound machine that worked with Google Home, had a reliable app, good sound quality and sound options, and dynamic lighting that I could change colors or dim. The govee sound machine fit most of these. My only issue was the sound options and the speaker sound could be improved. The app had mostly 'natural' sounds like wind, rain, river, fire, and some lullaby options. I just wanted a basic flat white, pink, or brown noise. The closest I found to the white noise is the wind and for some reason the speaker quality didn't block a lot of background noise. I noticed some of the other ones I tried did really well blocking noise because it had better sound frequency range. Other than that this would be perfect. My baby woke up more often using this for sound. The lighting options are really unique so I'll give it that. I like the gaming mode and different lighting combos. I now just use this as a light so I'll keep it.

source_doc: Better than the Toyota factory links. My elderly Toyota had a rattle that I had a lot of trouble pinning down.  It would happen as I went over some bumps but not others.  It would act up so intermittently that I couldn't figure it out.  After a lot of driving around and head-scratching I finally narrowed it down to a worn out front sway bar link on the passenger side.The factory Toyota links are non-greasable.  Mine lasted almost 200k miles which is certainly a good track record, but when it came time to replace them one of the reasons I chose the Moog parts is because I can grease them.Yeah, I know suspension grease nipples have gone the way of vent windows and manual door locks.  Modern suspension components are Lubed For Life (yeah right) and last a long time.  Except when they don't.  Besides, I don't mind hitting a dozen fittings with the grease gun once every few months.So I bought the Moog links, installed them, and pumped them full of grease.  It's been a few years and almost 100k miles and the Moogs are still going strong.  I think I've lubed them twice in all that time (so much for those grease fittings) but they're as quiet and slop-free as they ever were.If I ever manage to wear out the links again, I'll buy another set of Moogs.

source_doc: It IS lower tracking and lower dust than the other bags, but I'm not sure I'll continue buying it. The litter is made into much larger granules; this is why it tracks less and has less dust. At first, I was not impressed. I was not expecting this kind of dramatic change, so it threw me off guard. However, I gave it a chance, and I like it okay. My cats are fine with it, and it does do what it says it will do. I like that it tracks less; however, I still need to sweep every day because I like my floors litter-free. And I like that it has less dust, but it still has some dust.The only problems with this litter are:- I can imagine it might hurt my cats feet a little more, kind of like walking on gravel instead of sand, but maybe that's not the case (I haven't asked my cats how it feels).- The litter scoops I have don't sift it very well because the slots are a little too small for these large particles.- The clumping ability is still pretty great, but I think it clumps just a little bit less well than the other bags.This is still a 5-star cat litter, but, for me, I think I'm going to switch back to the other bags. It's worth trying, for sure, and it may be better for you depending on your situation.

Это все еще пятизвездочный наполнитель для кошачьего туалета, но лично я, думаю, вернусь к другим упаковкам. source_doc: Hard to deflate. I have tile floors and babysit my grandson frequently. I bought a hiccapop 69” play yard because he’s starting to crawl. This fits it perfectly. It has to inflate and can take awhile. I personally crawled on it and it did offer some cushioning. I am overweight and have bad knees and I could crawl on this. I can’t crawl on my tile floor so I know it will help. I do wish it was a little more firm so I might buy another.  I saw some tips about how to make it more firm but haven’t tried them. It is difficult and time consuming to let the air out so if you want to put it away like I do keep that in mind.

source_doc: You need your own adhesive to use these. I knew these did not come with adhesive when ordering.  They are priced as such coming in roughly half the cost of self sticking versions.  Very fairly priced.  I figured the next time I go to Home Depot I’d pick up some adhesive.  I ordered these Jan 1.  It’s now Mar 1 and they are still on the floor in the corner of my drum room.  I’ve been to Home Depot five times (house project) since then and have forgotten every single time.  The two times remembered and planned on buying, by the time i was done shopping, i had been there so long I’d forgotten again.  I know i can order adhesive but i kind of wanted to see what my options were as first time buying such a product.Although I’d normally wait to write a review until I actually used the product, i thought I’d share my status with these for the guys out there that are forgetful like me, or procrastinators or whoever;  it might better to spend the money and get the self sticking kind just so you can get them hung and be done.  I’m hoping to get there, Hung and Done, soon.  Good luck

source_doc: Not a clear wipe. I guess I am old, but I remember replacing wiper blades quickly and easily. I have a 2014 Pathfinder and somehow the driver wiper (26") cracked. Still worked fine, but I noticed a slight scratch in the glass. I had a 17" replacement for the passenger side a few weeks ago. I thought I bought the same. Duh. That one is great(Rain-X 5079283-2 Latitude 2-IN-1 Water Repellency Wiper Blade, 17") put on by mech at last oil change. This one hat two other adapters, and I finally removed the one on it as I had the old hook style. Slid on easily, but the cover at the end would not snap shut. I redid it three times. Anywho. at the center of the blade under the connection there is water that is not cleared, and when it hits the water on the right ( next to the rear view mirror) pushed by the passenger blade it hardly wipes it. I am about ready to reorder another like the 17" and keep this for emergencies.

source_doc: DIY, Save the mony. The detailer's wanted $1300. I watched 15 different YouTube Videos then decided on Adams. I do have a Quick Jack which made it a bit easier with the car lifted. It was easier than I thought ( I did do my homework). I took my time, started in a less noticeable spot and off to the races. I did have another advantage the car was freshly painted, I waited 3 weeks for the paint to gas off and I was done in 4 hours. It is a Miata MX5 a bit smaller than most cars. I left it in the garage for 24 hours before driving it. The first wash left beads of water and I dried the car with a 550 CFM leaf blower. Didn't even need a towel. I save me some big bucks and felt really good doing it myself.

source_doc: Best pillow I have purchased! Oh my-I really do not where to begin. I purchased a Rainmr queen size bed pillow for myself. We have a king size bed so naturally you buy king size pillows. No matter how hard I tried I could not sleep on this huge pillow. I  knew I had to find something else. Upon receiving the Rainmr queen size pillow I was so pleased how cool, soft & comfortable it is. It comes with it’s own cooling pillowcase. The memory foam they use doesn’t have a strong odor which is something I liked. I am a side sleeper. I was amazed how the pillow keeps it’s shape. To sum it up the cost of the pillow is worth every penny I spent. If you are looking for a pillow that keeps it’s shape, and stays cool while you sleep-this pillow is just what you need. I would highly recommend this pillow.

source_doc: Great for a toddler. I needed a 2 pack so she can have 1 by toilet and 1 by the sink (she being my 3 year old toddler). For reference, I already own a similar stool by IKEA and it's basically the same stool. I do not have an IKEA locally so would have to pay to ship it, since I didn't have anything else I needed from them I chose to just buy this set on Amazon instead this time. It's exactly what I wanted and I liked that I could get white with gray instead of having to get the white with green, which is IKEA's only color option. If you did purhcase this set in the white with green it'd probably be just like the IKEA stools. I would never use this for an adult but I see in the reviews some people are. This is pretty flimsy and really is meant more for like a 20-40 pound toddler not for an adult or anyone over 90 lbs. That's pretty risky, imo.

source_doc: Great pillow for neck pain. I wasn't sure about buying this pillow mostly because I am not a back sleeper. And while I don't think it has made any difference with my snoring, I do love this pillow. I always thought I loved feather pillows, but after getting this I realized it was because I could bunch them up to be high or low where I wanted. But they don't stay that way... I like this pillow because it is firm but not overly firm and there are various heights. So while I'm on my side, I sleep on one section but if I roll more to my stomach, I can move my head to a different section. And, surprisingly, I do actually enjoy relaxing on my back with my head cradled before I go to sleep. I still don't sleep that way but it's very comfortable to initially wind down

source_doc: Great Faucet - everything else?  Meh. I wanted a Heavy Duty utility sink for the basement.  I liked the look of this. The only positive I can come up with is - the faucet is great - I hope it lasts.  The tub comes with clear and urgent directions on how to assemble it without breaking the tub.  I followed those instructions to the T and the tub broke in three of the four leg attachment locations.  Clearly a bad design.  It's ok though - the faucet seems great so I went ahead and continued the install with the broken - yet still functional - tub.  The p-trap and drain plumbing supplied is hard and brittle.  I needed to cut the drain pipe down about two inches to fit the existing drain - drain pipe shattered not once but twice while cutting it.  Thankfully I was replacing a utility sink so I could use the old plumbing pieces.  There is almost no backsplash on this unit  - so I'm still trying to figure out how I will secure it to the wall - as securing the legs won't help because of the broken tub.  I'm wishing I kept my old tub and just replaced the faucet.  Still looking for a better solution.

source_doc: Perfect exercycle for me! I love this little stationary bike! And the price point is incredibly reasonable!! It's sleek, compact, cute, sturdy and tucks into a corner of my living room. It's SO quiet!! I can't believe it! I can listen to music, TV, read or watch Youtube while riding. My last recumbent bike made lots of noise, so I couldn't cycle if anyone else was around. I love the simple display that gives me all the parameters I need, including pulse - which at my age, is a good idea to watch when exercising. I target my heart rate. I had to have my husband put it together for me because of the few electronic parts. I didn't want to mess it up. I suppose if I HAD to have done it myself, I'd have eventually gotten through it. It really wasn't that hard to do, my husband said. All the parts were clearly labeled, well packed (in spite of the box arriving opened and smashed). Nothing was broken or smashed. Instructions were clear. Seat is comfy. I LOVE IT!! I'd buy it again in a heart beat! :)

source_doc: After a year of trying, I'm over it. I was gifted the Gaming Mouse during the December 2021/ January 2022 holiday season. This item was purchased via Amazon.The mouse started randomly dying and coming back. By that I mean my PC would say it had disconnected, the mouse LEDs would turn off and it the mouse would not respond. Upon research and inspection, it appears that the power cord connection is faulty.There is no stress to the cord, there are no pets or children around to have damaged it. I emailed the seller on Friday, Apr 8, 2022 to inform them of the issue. At that time, I had not had the mouse long enough to consider this routine wear and tear. I love the size and shape of the mouse so I would much rather get a replacement than simply returning it. I received not response. I rigged the mouse together and just focused on controller gaming. It is now January 2023. I loved how big the mouse was so I really tried to like it but its stupid to try and make this work. Please do not buy it. "Lizsword" has a way better mouse. Equally affordable and lasts way longer. My husband has had that brand for years so I should have started with that one.

source_doc: I use the conceal and perfect foundation and.. So I wanted to love this. I was like "ooh yay, a peach colored product for my eye bags". I had Hope's it would work as well as the LA Color one I use currently. I'm kinda disappointed because this was too sheer and not peachy enough.For reference I wear 2 Natural in Milani's conceal and perfect foundation. I LOVE that stuff. It's amazing. I wear NC25 in MAC.This was far too sheer. The applicator is ok but you're going to want to use a brush to pinpoint areas if that's what you're looking to do. Look.. I know hollows can't be fixed unless I get a bleph or filler. I don't have the money or sucrose father for that yet. So color corrector and concealers are the best I have. But this might be best for someone with very mild darkness and doesn't need a lot of makeup.

source_doc: Magical! I would give this a million stars if I could! About 10 years ago I switched from normal lip balm to 100% lanolin and swore I'd never go back. Unfortunately, I can't find my brand for sale on Amazon anymore so I decided to use all the lip balms I had laying around before I purchased anything new. What a mistake! A week into it, my lips were dry and just seemed to be covered in wax from the lip balms (for the record, I had all kinds - fancy, organic, "regular" .... You name it!) Although Lanolips was a little pricey, I decided to give it a try and I'm so glad I did! My lips were back to normal within 24 hours. I will always be a believer in lanolin vs traditional lip balm.

source_doc: Fender Mexico Surprised Me. I have another Mexican Starr I bought many years ago but this is a huge step up in quality. It seems many higher end manufacturers are moving some of their production to Mexico which I think is driving competition. I bought this as used but in very good condition. Very pleased. I had bought the same guitar from Musicians Friend which they sold as a New instrument which was returned. That one was abused so I returned it and was happily surprised when Amazon had one left. The finish is great and I find no faults in quality so far. I also have several American made Strats which surprised me that Fender had an anniversary model made in Mexico but don’t let that fool you. The only big difference I find is this doesn’t have the nitrocellulose finish. I wish they had shipped it in a hard case but I’ll get one for it anyway. source_doc: Works well for me. I am liking these MicroVision Optical Futura Blue Light Shiny Tortoise glasses. There are 3 in a pack but so far, I've only been using one pair. I selected the 2.0 strength, and I was a bit worried that it would be right for me, but it has been great. I love the size of the lens. I feel like I don't have keep adjusting as it covers my habitual sight range. It doesn't quite work when I need to read a book, but it is perfect for use on my computer and phone as well as tv watching. I can also wear it when I am out and about, and it is comfortable to keep. My only concern is that the frame is a bit light which I think is fine for the price point, but I do wonder how long it will last.

source_doc: Once Upon A Time. Once upon a time I used to stand on a metal box that I place on a chair just so I could reach the light bulb socket.  This light bulb socket is located in the hallway leading upstairs.  So I had to place a chair on steps that was dangerous.  Now that I am older (60 years), weigh more and not comfortable with relying on my stability, I searched for something that I could use to reach the light bulb socket safely.  I am so happy that I found this product.  I did not buy the pole but used a old sponge mop pole which worked just as well.A lot of people said that they had problems with the spiral light bulbs, I did notice that as I was screwing counter clockwise, the standard light bulb gripper also was unscrewing. source_doc: Works great for wigs, too! I ordered this Pantene Pro-V Salt Texturizing Hairspray to give my wigs a bit of oomph and hold. Because I don't have a lot of bio hair, I wear wigs whenever I leave home. Some wigs are quite flat, and I like a little more volume. This spray works well to scrunch it in, give it volume and hold in the areas I want, and it smells nice. The sprayer on the first bottle I opened does not seem to spray out in a mist, so I have to spray it into my hands and scrunch it into place. It only takes a little for what I need, and I can reactivate it with water, when needed. It works great on my wigs, and I'm certain that it would work wonderful on natural hair, as well, and I would definitely recommend it!

source_doc: Had to return controller but ordered another because I love the controller layout. So I love the controller and the buttons on the back are in the best spot on any controller I’ve used. Unfortunately, I had to return the first one I ordered. When I plugged my headset into the controller and talked to teammates in any game I played, my teammates would say that my voice was coming through awful and I sounded muffled. I tried to find any solution by playing around with game settings, system settings, and troubleshooting the controller but to no avail the issues with voice communication remained. When I plugged my headset into other controllers, my headset and voice were perfectly normal so I knew it had something to do with the powerA controller. I returned the first one I ordered and have ordered a new one hoping it was just a lemon. I love what the controller has to offer just need the mic problems not to happen! Fingers crossed with the next one I’m waiting to be delivered.
