source_doc: For me not that great. I have 2 kitties. I was using littermaids corncob. I loved it. I switched to littermaid after using tidycat. For me tidycat was too dusty for my cats and my asthma. Plus tidycat was no longer clumping for me. Id pick up the supposedly urine balls. It just fall apart. Littermaid corncob clumped really well. It is lightweight. I had no issues with odors. But it was becoming harder and harder to find. So when i needed litter i chose to try this. So i got a bag from here. Urine balls didnt clump at all. I picked it up it fell apart. It mixed in with the clean. Odor control is non existant. I can smell the urine and stools from my apt door. I may have smelly cats in the stool dept. But i shouldnt be smelling urine too. Very disappointed. I dont ķnow whats going on with littermaid. But i sure do miss it.

source_doc: Dressing up the stairway. I had been looking for ideas to dress up the risers on the stairs going to my second floor and was thinking stencils, or different paint, when I came across YouTube videos where diy shows were using this type of dress up for that project.  I had been looking around for awhile for some pattern I liked and came across this one.  It's neutral colors of beige/taupe and blue/grey that should blend in well.  It has a variety of patterns so each stair riser would be different and I like that idea and the look.  Haven't started that project yet as I have to prep the area.  It takes me awhile but I will get to it and I am excited to see how it turns out.  I will post an update when I get to that point.  The strips are a little over 7 inches wide and about 40 inches long.  There are 15 pieces, each a different pattern, all in the same muted shades.  Each piece has backing to protect the sticky side.  Feels pretty sticky so should adhere well.  I believe well worth the $$ if I can get this project done with my time and $40!  We shall see.

source_doc: I thought it had an on off button. I have a few Snarks  and the pivoting features  have broken..  I had tried to duct tape them, but  ultimately they were finished... Since I have several guitars, my theory is to have a tuner with each guitar... everything in it's place. to replace the Snarks, I ordered 2 FENDER  tuners, wanting to try something different.I  was pleasantly pleased! Fender's oval hinge feature makes me believe that I will not have any breakage issues. The tuner's panel is very easy to read and shuts off in 5 minutes. I've had these tuners  for 2 days now, and so far they are pretty nice. Of course i will come back and update later on in the year, but for now i give it 4 stars until I witness the Fender's durability.One thing I didn't count on, was the lack of an on/off switch. I almost sent the tuners back, but tried it out for the hell of it. The on/off is automatic and shuts itself off in 5 minutes, which is more than enough time to tune up.  If you are jamming and want to tune later in your session, all you have to do is unclip from guitar re-clip to the head stock. I'm guessing the on/off switch is paired up with the tuner's clip on screw. It's not that bad of a feature.Good Job, Fender!

I went for liquid coverup & came across this. I was weary by the price,at first. But,after reading the reviews, I gave it a try & holy s#it am I happy I did!!! I bought the one for fair skin,that came with a brush. It's so lightweight & yet, still covered my blotchy spots! While STILL giving my face a gorgeous Sun Kissed Glow! Like I said, I'm not a "makeup kind of girl", anymore. But,after putting this on, I'm building my makeup collection all over again! I'm feeling inspired,all because of this wonderful powder,that has the coverage of a high quality liquid concealer!!! My blotchy spots are gone & I couldn't be happier!!! I would very highly recommend buying this!!! Whenever this is gone, I WILL be buying more!!!😁

source_doc: Worst piece of fitness equipment I own. Not going to lie, I wanted something for the wife that was just easier than grabbing a bar and bench in limited basement space.  I have all types of equipment down there, and this was just going to supplement workout routines.  I had high hopes when I got this thing.  Then I started to try and out it together.  Let me tell you, the hardware us not marked, the instructions leave a lot to be desired, and holes do not line up (had to ream out two holes).  Sturdiness after being assembled is questionable, and the design is severely flawed.  There are two hooks that insert downward and attach with nuts on the back (floor side) of the platform.  We'll, these hooks protrude further than the feet of the platform and hit the ground more than the supposed platform feet.  Let me tell you, I was pretty upset when I discovered these hooks had dug themselves into my floor and sratched it all up!  I had to grind these protrusions down and tape them to ensure they wouldn't scratch anything.  I tried the system after I assembled and do not feel confident that it will last more than a month.  Everything is cheap!  I am super upset that this thing is like this, and feel cheated.  Honestly, this is the worst piece of equipment I now own!!!

Скажу вам сразу: крепеж не промаркирован, инструкция оставляет желать лучшего, а отверстия не совпадают (пришлось растачивать два отверстия). Прочность после сборки вызывает сомнения, а конструкция имеет серьезные недостатки. Там есть два крюка, которые вставляются сверху вниз и закрепляются гайками с обратной (обращенной к полу) стороны платформы. Так вот, эти крюки выступают дальше, чем ножки платформы, и упираются в пол сильнее, чем сами опорные ножки. Скажу вам, я был/а очень расстроен/а, когда обнаружил/а, что эти крюки вонзились в мой пол и весь его исцарапали! Мне пришлось стачивать эти выступы и обматывать их лентой, чтобы они больше ничего не поцарапали. Я опробовал/а систему после сборки и не уверен/а, что она прослужит больше месяца. Всё сделано очень дешево! Я ужасно расстроен/а тем, как устроена эта вещь, и чувствую себя обманутым/ой. Честно говоря, теперь это самый худший тренажер из всех, которыми я владею!!!

source_doc: Do not waste your money. I had high hopes for these pads & was impressed by looking at them when they arrived. They are a great size & cover a lot of area. They are nice & thick & seem to be of a much better quality over thin pads I’ve gotten previously. Unfortunately that’s where the good part ends. They work horribly. I have a senior dog who is incontinent so I use these where she lays. She wears diapers but has leaks. I was hoping to have an added layer of protection by using these pads. I tested them by pouring a small glass of water on them & waiting a few minutes. The floor under the pad was wet. Not damp, but wet. I felt the top where the pad would have contact with the person or pet’s skin & it was also sopping wet. I double checked to make sure I had the correct side up and it was laid down properly. These pads are no different than laying down a towel. Very disappointing. I’m wondering if all these great reviews were done prior to actually using them. If I had rated on initial looks alone without testing; I would have given this an excellent review. Because of their thickness if you have to double them up for them to work, it is going to be uncomfortable to lay on. I wanted to love these but they were a complete disappointment.

source_doc: Good support for every day activities. I received this item quickly. I bought these due to laxity and history of sprains in both of my ankles.  I wanted something that I could wear if on my feet for extended periods of time that wasn’t as restrictive as a brace.  I wouldn’t recommend these if playing sports or doing an activity where a lot of support is needed.I find the material comfortable and great quality, while being reasonably priced.  I ordered a small, which is the size I usually wear.  I found them true to size.  They are not easy to get off, but I wouldn’t expect them to be, given they are made for compression.  I have washed them on the delicate cycle in my washer machine and line dry them and they have held up very well.  I would recommend these for anyone looking for ankle support for every day activities.

source_doc: Love this play mat. I got this play mat for the kids playroom and was pleasantly surprised. This was a perfect addition to our playroom since we have hard wood floors. Sitting on the ground was not comfy for me when I was playing with the kids but it was also a safety concern for me not having padding on the ground for my daughter who was doing tummy time, rolling and crawling. The mat is very sturdy / durable which is 100% necessary when you’re working with toddlers. I wasn’t sure if would last long but for the price I was willing to give it a shot. I was not disappointed. I wish I had it when I had my first child. I love the material because I would let the baby just lay freely so if she went potty it was an easy clean up. Even in general I was able to clean / sanitize the mat when necessary! Great buy.

source_doc: I wish I had known about Keychron before I bought my Ducky One 3 Daybreak. I bought my Ducky one 3 daybreak back in January of 2022 when I started to get really interested in keyboards. I wanted something with hot swappable switches and a variety of keycap options. After using that for about year the keys started to double type. I did everything from updating the firmware on the KB to replacing every individual switch after cleaning it out with compressed air. Unfortunately I concluded that it was a PCB (printed circuit board) issue, and none of it ever worked and so it's been sitting on my shelf since October.The Keychron Q6 is a breath of fresh air. I was hesitant to spend over $150 for a KB again after my previous experience but wow am I glad I did. Almost immediately you can feel the quality in this absolute unit of a KB. It is heavy, I cannot emphasis enough with how heavy this KB is. The sound is rich and comforting using their lubed reds. I thought I'd miss an illuminating RGB experience but I've gotten to the point to where this subtle south-facing RGB is perfect for my needs. The customization is endless using the VIA software that it recommends.I will absolutely 100% recommend this if you want something built on a proper platform with room to grow in whatever direction you so desire.

source_doc: Compact, easy to use and nice carrying case. The BOOKOO jump starter is great to have in case of you need to give yourself a boost or help someone else out with dead battery. It’s easy to use. I have not had to use this particular one yet I do keep it in my boat in case my cranking battery dies or one goes bad. I feel confident this will boost when I need it to!I have multiple BOOKOO boosters and used one with less mah to completely jump my truck. I wanted to test it out so I unhooked my battery completely from my truck so it would be as if my battery were COMPLETELY dead and I hooked up the BOOKOO booster and it successfully started my 5.4 l pickup multiple times! I didn’t test how many times it could jump without having original battery even hooked up but I did at least three times and I know it had mor juice left. I was just happy with those results so I unhooked it and recharged it and put in in vehicle for use when needed. I now keep one in every vehicle we own.I’ve also jumped a 4 wheeler with the BOOKOO booster no problem.

source_doc: Best price to features for this type of product. I looked at others similar to this, Hart, Dewalt, Milwaukee, Bauer, etc.  I liked the Hart and this one because I have batteries for both of these.  The Hart was near 2x the cost, so I took a chance on the Meliff.  Two days after I ordered this, I found a Hart tool marked down due to a damage box - funny but it was actually cheaper.  I got this one in first, it worked well.  Quick to inflate, I liked the auto shut off feature.  Then I got the Hart in.  I tried the Hart out and it works well but has no cut off feature.  You have to hold the trigger the entire time.  Both are equal in speed and battery life.  Both weigh about the same and seem equal in construction.  The Hart is a little prettier in cosmetics.  End of the day, I prefer the Mellif and will be ordering another (they've jacked the price up 12% in past two weeks).

source_doc: I LOVEEEEE IT - but not for work. I eyeballed this keyboard for the LONGEST time before deciding to buy it.  I wanted something pink.  I wanted something backlit.  I wanted something CLICKY.  And this keyboard gave me all of that.  I don't like rechargeable keyboards because I never remember to charge them.  So this being wired made me happy.  I use it all the time for gaming and personal work.  However, when I am working I switch back over to my Apple keyboard.  Only because the clicks of the keys are loud and I don't feel like it is professional.  I prefer a muted keyboard when I am on the phone with clients and I'm typing away.  That's just a personal preference for myself.  I'm sure not everyone is bothered by it, it's just who I am.  So I can easily flip between my personal keyboard and my work keyboard.  That made this thing even better!

source_doc: Bummed. While initially I loved it, there were some things I didn’t like.The cord linked up often.The temperature when changing it sometimes would glitch back and forth and I would never know truly what temperature it was on.I purchased this June 25, 2021. This morning, January 12, 2023, this straightener officially died on me. I was straightening my hair before work when I noticed it was no longer very hot. I checked it and the light was off. I unplugged and tried turning it on and nothing. I moved to a different outlet, unplugged and tried again but nothing.I left it plugged in and set it on the counter and the light turned on. I picked it up and the movement caused it to shut back off again. I threw it away.$70 and I couldn’t even get a full year and a half out of it.

source_doc: Only oil I use. I am glad that I have been able to buy this oil from this same vendor for years. You just can't find it in stores and if you do it is almost twice as much per quart or higher in some places if you can even find it. This is the only oil I will use in my zero turn Skag. I have been using this oil in my mowers for 30 years. I always change oil, OEM Kawasaki oil filter and air filter before start of every mowing season. Have always been able to get many hours of mowing out of my mowers without a problem. Might have to add very little at the end of mowing season. As far as I am concerned this is the best oil to use in warm and hot climates being how I live in Texas and it gets very hot in the summer. I might add that this is a residential property and I mow 2 acres once a week and I mow an additional 5 acres three times a summer. If you mow commercially you will have to change oil and filter more often.

source_doc: Absolutely Awesome! I needed to fine away that I can have my dehumidifier in my basement run consistently without me having to remember to empty the bucket. In the summertime, my dehumidifier will fill up a 70 pint bucket every day! Since I don't go down to the basement every day to empty the bucket, I wanted something that can empty the water itself. I noticed one of these pumps on my fathers central air unit in his basement. He told me that this pumps collects the condensation until it gets full. Once it's full, it just pumps it out a hose into the back yard. Unfortunately I don't have the ability to run a hose out to the back yard but I do have access to main sewar line in my basement. I mounted this to the side of the table that holds my dehumidifier and ran a hose from the water outlet tube to the inlet of the pump. I connected the hose from the pump to a threaded barb fitting I mounted on a 2" PVC cap that screws onto my main sewar line. This setup has been running for months and I has worked flawlessly!

source_doc: Not at all happy with this drum set After a Year! I got this to practice at home so I would not bother anyone in the house a year ago. At first it was great, but as the year went on, it was not so much a great experience. After the first month, the Hi Hat doesn't sense every strike. After about a month of waiting on the warranty, I get the new cymbal. Works alright again for about 3 months. Then the pad of the bass drum tears. So I go through warranty again, still about a month of waiting. I get the new skin for the bass pad, but I realize now I have a sensitivity problem that I had with the hi hat, is the same with the bass drum. So I have to contact again. After waiting again for the Kid Pad. I'm happy to play for about 1 month before the snare issues arrive. Now the warranty coverage is over and the snare is sounding like I'm hitting the rim the whole time. I am not happy with how many issues I've had with this electric drum set. It's too bad because Alesis is a strong brand, sadly, this drum set just had too many issues to praise. I could be mean and just give it 1 star, but I want to give my honest opinion on what I experienced and how I feel it should be rated.

source_doc: Security light. I ordered this since I just moved into a new home and the backyard light it came with provided zero lighting.That said this arrived as described on time and without issue. Conversely, I finally got it installed and it genuinely impressed me.Install was an absolute breeze. I especially like the connector type. Once I plugged everything on, screwed it in place and hit the light switch it exceeded expectations.The difference in lighting is 10x better than the crappy light I had. The options it has for sensitivity and for motion are second to none.I installed it in the evening, sunset had set by 7pm, I finished installed it a bit agter 8pm so it was dark outside.As you can tell by the last picture, I had to adjust the lights to point down more since it really lights up my backyard.What makes it even better is the fact there's an app for it, makes this one of the best lights I've installed, especially at this price point.If I could give this 6 stars I would...Moreover I wouldn't hesitate to recommend it. Excellent product, easy to install, and performs better than expected.In my opinion it's worth it!

I wanted the duvet to come down the sides and foot of the bed some. It does have ties in all 4 corners of the duvet to tie down the insert. I was happy about that. This duvet is very soft and beautiful. The only problem is I was given 2 king shams because I ordered the king, but I have a queen bed, so I need queen shams. I have asked the seller if I could buy the queen shams separately. So far I've gotten no response. Eventually I'll have to get the shams taken in by a seamstress. Other than that everything is perfect!

source_doc: More than just a vase, this is a piece of art! I was expecting to like this vase but I was blown away with seeing it in person. I was thinking it would be much smaller than it actually is. It's large and so beautifully shaped. I love the primitive look of it. To me it looks kind of like an ancient cave wall drawing brought to life. I love that it's got a really nice, somewhat rough, texture to it. I wasn't sure I would like the black and was thinking I may spray paint it but the black really does work. I'm still deciding how I want to use this piece. It's not really a vase for fresh flowers at all. I have several different types of dried floral and pampas grasses I am going to try out to see which look I like best. I am really happy with this art piece and it's quality and I can happily recommend it!

source_doc: So much more than I expected. Ok, so I open my package and my heart sinks. I see this tiny little thing about 1/3 the size I imagined. So charging took about 2 hours and I was on pins and needles waiting for it. So fully charged connect it up and BOOM! Wow! So much more sound quality than I expected. The distortion and clean are exactly what I would expect. The bluetooth let me jam along with a backing track AND since BT and INPUT both have separate volumes you can mix it in perfectly. The delay AND delay time is precious and then you still have gain and a 3 band EQ! I can’t wait to run this into my Valve JR head and out my 2 12” cabs. Oh oh I wonder how harmonica sounds through it? Damn, gotta wait till tomorrow to “GET LOUD” I can’t turn this up more than 1/4 if I want to be able to turn my guitar up. So much louder than I expected… I might just have to call this thing a great affordable Christmas present for all my music jamming friends!

source_doc: Surprising results. I finally got a chance to try these dual lavalier microphones. I will admit that I was a bit skeptical but after I used them as advertised, I am happy to report that they work rather well. First, they are well-built. I did not notice any defects and even the pop-up foam blockers fit well. They are a bit bigger than expected, but nothing too excessive or distracting. They clip nicely on any piece of clothing and do not easily fall off. I appreciate the nice graphite-looking case, which houses both mics and accessories.I tested the microphones and recorded some content, and the audio came out surprisingly full and clear. There was a little bit of bass and very few pop-ups. I still would use my microphone while sitting in front of a screen, but if I need to move around, these mics will work nicely. The best opportunity to test them was during an online family meeting. I put the mic on myself and my wife. I then hooked up the laptop to the TV. The microphones came in loud and clear. We were about 10 feet away from the TV (it is 75”) and experienced no issues whatsoever.In the end, I found the BerrysParadise mics to be a very good value and I feel very comfortable recommending them.

source_doc: Mixed feelings. The 2 star is for THIS mat I bought. I must admit, it's taken me 5 years to write this review.  But I just used my OLD Jade mat and thought I should write this review.  I have mixed feeling because I bought a Jade mat at my yoga studio and have used it for many years. Great mat! I love it.  It was getting kind of dingy, so I thought I would use that one at home and buy another one for the studio.  So I bought this orange one. After about 2-3 months of uses, and past the return, it started to deteriorate.  I'd find orange specks all over my pants, as it was visibly breaking down. Life was busy so I just shoved the new crappy one in a closet and went back to using my old mat, which is over 10 years old and holding up.  I can't get it sparkling clean looking, but at least it's not falling apart.  I'm still disappointed that I wasted $80. Why was one mat great and durable and the other one crappy?

source_doc: Used for cabinets, WATER DOWN YOUR PAINT. I have never sprayed paint before and I bought this for a laundry room project to paint unfinished Home Depot cabinets.At first I hated this thing, it only has 1 PSI setting and it blows HARD. First pass with sanding sealer was a nightmare and resulted in large bubbles and all of my (quickly applied) masking tape and plastic getting blown off.Then I switched to paint and I kept getting speckles and not enough paint. I was about to give up and just roll the cabinets with paint, but after a huge mess and lot of trial an error I found that watering my paint down MUCH more than recommended worked great. You'll still see speckles or even globs of paint, but they dry fine and are not noticeable at all.I was using .5cup of water with the paint inside of the container (Sherwin Williams cabinet paint) of the gun and what I found to work perfectly was about 60% paint, 40% distilled water in the container. I had much better results and after 3 coats with sanding in between they looked awesome.I finished the cabinets with 2 coats of Minwax Polycrylic and they came out great. There are some remaining drips from my first coat of sanding sealer that I missed when sanding so I would just be careful to not apply too much and test a lot on cardboard.

source_doc: Meh. I was really excited to get this car charger adapter for my spectra. Well, my excitement was short lived once I started using it. Once I plugged it in and turner my pump on, I could clearly hear the motor of the pump struggling. This adapter doesn't provide enough power to give my pump what it needs to function properly. As a result I need to pump longer, on higher settings/vaccum and my output is less than half of what I usually can get. I use this once I day while at work on my lunch break and as soon as I get home I have to pump again because I still have milk left that needs to be extracted. Is this adapter great for relieving pressure- yes. Would I recommend it for a reliable addition to your pump for every day use- that would be a no. Other than that, it's a sturdy item that came shortly after it was ordered and packaging was nice and cute.

source_doc: Cute Starburst Lights. I have wanted some of these starburst lights to add to my holiday decor.  I ordered these because they can be used outdoors and could be used for different holidays like Christmas and the 4th of July etc.  I haven’t quite managed to get them shaped like the picture but will do a better job when I am ready to hang them.  I like that they are battery operated because that will mean I can hang them just about anywhere.  My plan was to hang them in the large tree in my front yard.  The quality seems to be good but I don’t know how long they will last.  The only thing that disappointed me was the size.  They are very small.  I put a pen next to it in the photo for reference.  Based on the size, I don’t think they will work for the look I wanted, especially since the tree is so large.  I also think the price is a bit high based on the size.

source_doc: Cute but slows gameplay. These are so cute but unfortunately they do affect how I interact with the Joycon buttons. This might not be the case for everyone (hence the good reviews), But I found after nearly a week of using these buttons, they did noticeably impact my gameplay. The buttons themselves do not feel bad, they are smooth enough that they are not uncomfortable on your fingers, but because they are hard plastic, they change how quickly you can press down on the Joycon buttons. I did not realize they were hard plastic until after they arrived, I ordered them thinking they were silicone button covers. I put them on anyway because they were really cute but after several days, I noticed that when I would press the buttons on the right joycon, the reactions with my switch were slower. Even worse, when I pressed down on one of the arrow buttons on the left Joycon, the hard plastic button cover would push down on multiple buttons at once. So if I used the down arrow on the left joycon, my switch thought I hit the right arrow instead. It actually changed how I played games on my switch.

source_doc: Really attractive candle holders. I got these because I really like the look of them. I was trying to decide where to put them in my house when my husband told me he wanted to put them outside on our house on our back patio. He put them up and they look so nice back there. There is only one issue I have with this set. I love that it comes with the flameless candles. I love flameless candles and I have many of them. The problem with these is I wish they had come with a remote to turn them off and on much easier. When they are hung up outside and you have to reach inside and get each one to turn it off or on that gets kind of old. That was one of the first things I thought of when I was wondering where to put them inside as well. I had a place I wanted to put them but it would have been annoying to have had to reach up to take them out to turn on and put them back in. Every set of flameless candles I've gotten have come with remotes. I couldn't believe that this set didn't. I took a star away for that reason.

source_doc: This gives me great breath, and I think whiter teeth. My girlfriend had this electric toothbrush and liked it, so I decided to buy it. I love it! I truly believe it has made my teeth whiter. I didn’t realize that I was not brushing my teeth long enough until I got this toothbrush. My breath feels like it. It’s fresher after I brush with this toothbrush The only thing it seems to drip a little messy toothpaste on the charger that I have to keep wiping up. When I brush as long as recommended, I have watery toothpaste, dripping down my chin, and down the toothbrush. Other than that, I love this, in fact, I’m going to buy the same toothbrush to give as a gift to my sister.

source_doc: Surprised. I've often worried about my Shady being warm enough, especially this winter where it's been so cold. He mainly sleeps with me but he still feels cool to me. So when I came across this product, I put it in my wanted list. I felt it was a little expensive. And I have bought blankets and beds and he ignors them all. So am I going to spend this much money for him not to use it?As the cold days keep coming and not letting up, the more I was concerned about him not being warm. The last thing I wanted was for him to get sick. So I purchased the mat. I no more unboxed it and tossed it to the area on the bed he likes to sleep when not on me. He jumped on the bed and walked over sniffed it and laid down! I was shocked, I didn't have to put catnip on it to get him on it! As I write this he is laying there on the mat sleeping!I couldn't be more impressed.Thank you for easing my mind. I know he will be warm now.

I also am an avid camper and hiker, and I use this off the job for that. It's one less thing I have to worry about. If you use this thing correctly, it works every time. I have zero complaints.

source_doc: These may be overkill for what I ordered them for. I'm a little paranoid.  I recently started making my own soap and the first time I did I got a small granule of lye on my foot and got a teeny, tiny chemical burn.  But now I'm paranoid and every time I make another batch I feel like I just bathed in lye and it is all over me.  So I thought getting some good gloves might put my overactive mind at ease.These definitely do the trick as far as protection.  They o all the way up my arms and make me feel ready to take on nuclear waste. I appreciate the elastic on the top to help keep them in place.  Relatively soft and flexible.  I don't have any issues measuring and dumping lye out of the bottle when wearing them, but they do still interfere with my dexterity so I wouldn't want to try and do anything that requires precision and delicacy in them.But as far as providing the protection they are meant to do, two big (blue) thumbs up!

source_doc: Don't fall for the same bait and switch I did. I had decided that I was going to purchase the carpet One, non-Pro version. When I pulled up the page, I was looking at prices and the carpet One pro had a $100 off coupon available. This made the price $499 which was the same price as the non-Pro version at the time, so it seemed like a no-brainer to me. A couple of days after receiving it, I went back on Amazon to see what current prices were and I was  let down. The non-Pro version is now selling for $349. They had obviously raised the price to get people to switch just like I did, probably because they needed to unload some. I contacted them about being upset about being duped, and their solution was to offer me a free bottle of cleaning solution. I felt that was rather insulting. The carpet One pro is definitely not worth the extra money spent. The Wi-Fi function is pointless. While the LED screen is fancy, it doesn't do much more than what the non-Pro version does. I do feel like the sensor showing how dirty the area is, or the sensor showing how damp the area is, are both gimmicks. I have not noticed any consistency with either of those functions. I do feel like it is a good carpet cleaner, but definitely not for more than $349.

source_doc: Great pants but order the right size. I really like these leather pants.  It’s hard to find leather pants in a store unless you go to a motorcycle store, but those pants are more about protection in case of a fall or crash.  The other place to find leather pants is at a kink store but those pants are very expensive.  I decided to order online, but when I read the reviews they all said to size down.  I followed their advice, and it was wrong!  I normally wear a size 36 in Levi’s, so I ordered down like everyone said and ordered a 34.  That pants was too small and too tight.  I then thought maybe I should order a size bigger so I ordered a 38, and that pants was too big.  Finally I ordered a 36, and it was perfect.  My advice is order your normal Levi size, and you should be good to go.  Just so you know I weigh 220 and I’m 6-1 who wears size 36 in pants.  Hope this helps someone out there.

source_doc: Love this... and so does my soon-to-be 19-year-old Kitty! I purchased this on December 17th, 2022....  Came on the 19th.  I plugged it in and placed it in my elderly kitty's soft basket on top of his blanket.  At first he was hesitant, but I plopped him in there.  He had been slowing down and cold, and I had moved his basket next to the heater in the kitchen and he was happy.  Well, he has not left his basket since.  He loves this heating pad.  I have set it to No. 4 bar.  I have never turned it off and it's still working.  I am surprised.  I figured it would have burnt out, but so far so good! (Fingers crossed!!!)  He is walking better and so happy!  He loves it.  I haven't washed it yet.  I just turned it over.  I can't get him out of it to wash it.  I feel bad.  I did vacuum it.  LOL!  Now, it doesn't look all plush like in the picture, mind you, but it is soft.  As long as he is still alive, I will replace it if it burns out.  I think it helps him feel better.... Heat is good for old joints for all of us :)

source_doc: A solid and well-made gate. I have pretty much the same gate (different company) but without the cat door. I didn't know they even made gates with cat doors! I was thinking of all sorts of different things I could do to create a safety barrier but not lock the cats out. I didn't want to actually have to install a door and then cut a whole and install a cat door. I was excited when I ran across this product, and was hoping it was something of good quality (like my other gate). I was pleased when this arrived as it was quite heavy (a good thing) and is made with some sort of solid metal (can't be bent). I like that the cat door can be left open, or it can be locked. I admit when I installed my first gate it was a bit confusing as I wanted to get it right, but the manual that this came with is really helpful in it's detail and pictures. It helps I've already made an installation like this before, but even if I hadn't I appreciate the instructions. I will still use them. I don't remember how much I paid for the non-cat gate, but it was definitely more expensive than this. I'm glad they make a product like this!

source_doc: I use this for my dog's toys. My dog, Hank, is overly spoiled and has a ridiculous amount of toys. The bin I used to have for the toys is no longer big enough, so I needed something bigger. This basket is quite large, and is the perfect size for his toys. It's pretty deep, so I don't think it would be great for a small dog. Hank is really tall (I'm 5'7" and he is almost as tall as me when he is on his hind legs), so it's easy for him to reach into the deep basket and get his toys. The material seems sturdy, so I think it will last a while. But, even using a hair dryer like they suggest, it's not really keeping its shape. Since I ordered this for my dog's toys, that's not a deal breaker for me. For what I wanted to use it for, it's perfect. It's also more of a dark grayish/black, but again, that doesn't bother me for what I wanted it for. It may be important for someone who is using it more as a nice, decorative way to store blankets, etc. though. I also may have done something wrong when I tried to form it. Despite those tiny quirks I love the basket and am really happy I ordered it.

source_doc: So far, so good. I hesitated quite a while before I bought this.  I don't have spam that often, but when I do I could never get the slices evenly cut.  Shouldn't be that big of a deal, but the thinner sides would always get overcooked while I finished the thicker sides.  This little gem has solved that problem.  Plus, all the picture I had seen had sliced the spam across the long side, giving smaller cut pieces.  I prefer slicing it the other way to get a piece that fits in a sandwich better.  I wasn't sure if I could do that with this slicer, but I can.  It's a tight fit, but it can be done.

source_doc: Amazing at first and then all the issues came. Great customer service and replacement BUT. I really wanted to love this automated cat litter box.  A friend highly recommended it so I took a chance and spent over $500.  It was amazing for the first 6 months and then the issues started.  First, the waste bin kept saying it was full even after I emptied it.  I did everything to try to fix it but couldn't so I asked the company how to fix it.  They sent me a new litter box.  The 2nd litter box was great for 4 months then unused litter kept filling the waste bin.  I couldn't fix it and don't understand why this started happening.  I messaged the company again but this time I had a really hard time sending the information and the video clip.  Now the odor removal sensor keeps telling me there is no liquid even after I fill it. Well, I guess having this automated litter box for a year now has spoiled me so I need to buy a new one that works!  Any suggestions?

source_doc: Not safe. I wanted to love these, and I saved them for when I got a new car. When I put them in they were fine, until I did the test with the carseat and no matter what I did to tighten down the carseat, they still moved substantially with these protectors underneath them. I could move the carseat more than 2 inches side to side, and I grabbed my kids dad to see if he could tighten them more and it didn't change much. With that movement and my kids car seats, I won't be using these. There are also standards I didn't know about when I first ordered these... any accessory meant to go with or under a carseat (even harness strap covers) must be crash tested and approved. I could find no evidence that these had been crash tested and approved.

source_doc: Awful smart switch. We got 3 of these. source_doc: Great keyboard, but not for beginners. TL;DR: I REALLY like this keyboard, especially once you add different switches and keycaps, but it didn't work out because my accuracy sucks. Definitely not for beginners.Long review: I got the optical reds with this keyboard and it's definitely not for me since I'm a heavy typist. It's just too sensitive so I got the orange and bananas (yellow) optical switches to try them out. I do like the oranges but the ping on some of the switches is too dang loud and annoying so I settled with the bananas (yellow).Once I got them to my liking, it's time to test drive the keyboard. I'm not a typist per day but I can type. Not 100% accurate though, and that's where my problems arose. When I do make a mistake, I will almost 50% of the time would hit the "page up" instead of the backspace.. I do use "del" a lot as well and would hit the light switch instead.. If you're competent and have 99% accuracy when you type, it may work for you. Otherwise, get the K1 DE (what I did instead).

source_doc: Brilliant self tightening design. I bought these chains to "keep in the truck" so I would be legal. Didn't think I would need them with 4x4 and snow tires. Sure enough, ended up in a blizzard leaving Yosemite national park while towing a trailer. Roads got really bad, really quick.  I pulled these out and was pleased with how easily they went on. Basically there's a notch for where your tire meets the ground, so you just slip it around. No pulling forward or backwards.  The chains weren't perfectly centered when I put them on, so I just drove 100 yards down the road and rechecked them. Sure enough, they have self centered and the tightening mechanism had taken up the slack on its own.  They stayed nice and tight and didn't slap around as we drove. Removal was ALMOST as easy as installing.  I was genuinely impressed.  I will be more likely to slap these on early when conditions deteriorate now that I know how easy they are. I will be buying a set for any car I own in the future.
hypos: Гениальная самонатягивающаяся конструкция. Я купил/а эти цепи, чтобы «держать в грузовике» для соблюдения закона. Не думал/а, что они понадобятся мне с полным приводом и зимней резиной. И надо же, в итоге попал/а в метель на выезде из национального парка Йосемити во время буксировки прицепа. Дороги испортились очень сильно и очень быстро. Я достал/а их и был/а приятно удивлен/а тем, как легко они наделись. По сути, там есть вырез для места, где шина соприкасается с землей, так что вы просто накидываете их. source_doc: Refreshing. Here I thought we have a really nice shower head until I came across this. How silly of me that I did not know a dual shower head/spray exists. It's not complicated to install, I actually thought I had to wait for the hubby to do it but I managed to do it myself. I love, love that it has 2 places where water comes out of so that I can shower more fully and quickly. Our current shower head has only 3 settings and with the highest pressure turned on, you don't get to cover lots of areas because the spray coverage is narrow. I love that I don't have to sacrifice the water pressure to get the most body parts washed. I also love that there are 9 different settings so even the pickiest person should be able to find the most suitable setting for their liking. Usually I'd have to take off the handheld to rinse properly but with the dual feature on this shower, I don't need to do any unnecessary work. I actually feel like I'm staying in some fancy hotel, it's really nice and refreshing.

source_doc: NOT ACCURATE! As usual, you get what you pay for. After wearing the watch for a few weeks, I can say that I am totally disappointed. It DOES keep good record of temperature, time,  blood pressure and oxygen levels, but TOTALLY FAILS in calorie count and steps. I am extremely active and I am AMAZED at the calories burned and steps taken. I jog at least 2 miles a day and I am up and down stairs all day long I have always had at least 10,000 to 12,000 steps a day. This watch has measured 4,000 on the best day and shows my calorie count as no more than 395 in a day. If that was all I actually burned every day, I would weigh about 1,000 pounds by now.  The calorie count and steps are really the most important things to me, so the watch is really useless. I am wearing the watch right now and have been running around the house since 5 AM. It shows only 105 steps and 3 calories burned. Uggg 3/10/2023 I am updating my review. I stand by my original statements, but I have to report that the seller has been harassing me every day asking to compensate me in exchange for removing my review.  Apparently Amazon has not been able to make them stop, as it is still happening. It is getting creepy

source_doc: stopped working after less than 1 month. i like the design, feel and style of this keyboard. it's one of the few that's not the annoying RGB-colored nonsense that i personally find tacky. everything's great... until less than 1 month goes by and i noticed my text would delete itself while typing, or it'd bring up a random window, or command prompt... then it got worse.i take every key off and clean it with air - still broke. so i look up a keyboard input tester. if i press any bottom row key (like space bar for example), it thinks i'm pressing every single bottom row key (ctrls, alts, windows, fn, and even the left, down and right arrow keys)it progressed so far that i can't use it for gaming, web browsing, writing emails - ANYTHING. it's useless junk. instead of jumping to a negative review, like i am now, i contacted the seller directly and they want to put me through the rigamarole instead of giving me a refund. they do this to demotivate people from getting a refund, and they will waste your time - i've been through this before.maybe i just got a defected one, but even if yours isn't, they're not keen on giving refunds, so i think that says a lot, personally. i 100% regret purchasing this.
hypos: Перестал работать менее чем через 1 месяц. Мне нравится дизайн, тактильные ощущения и стиль этой клавиатуры. Это одна из немногих клавиатур без этой раздражающей RGB-подсветки, которую лично я считаю безвкусицей. Всё было отлично... пока не прошло меньше месяца, и я не заметил/а, что текст стирается сам по себе во время ввода, или открывается случайное окно, или командная строка... потом стало еще хуже. Я снял/а каждую клавишу и продул/а воздухом — всё равно сломана. Тогда я нашёл/шла в интернете тестер ввода клавиатуры. Если я нажимаю любую клавишу в нижнем ряду (например, пробел), система думает, что я нажимаю вообще все клавиши нижнего ряда (ctrl, alt, windows, fn и даже стрелки влево, вниз и вправо). Всё зашло так далеко, что я не могу использовать её для игр, просмотра веб-страниц, написания писем — для ЧЕГО УГОДНО. Это бесполезный хлам. Вместо того чтобы сразу писать негативный отзыв, как я делаю сейчас, я связался/ась напрямую с продавцом, но они хотят устроить мне волокиту вместо того, чтобы вернуть деньги. Они делают это, чтобы лишить людей мотивации требовать возврат, и они будут тратить ваше время — я уже проходил/а через это раньше. Может быть, мне просто попался бракованный экземпляр, но даже если ваш будет нормальным, они не горят желанием возвращать деньги, что, по моему личному мнению, говорит о многом. Я на 100% жалею, что купил/а это.

source_doc: HEAVILY scented, instantly triggered a migraine and made my face puff up! Never had this happen! I got the deep hydration one (not from Amazon) -I got the scented 1 oz version and it's terrible! It instantly started irritating my sinuses and eyes even though I didn't even put it around my eyes. My face started becoming puffy and within a minute I had a migraine forming. I washed my face twice with soap to get this junk off. And ridiculously enough I put it in the cabinet by my bed thinking I could just use it on my feet or something. It's $18 a bottle so I didn't wanna waste it... But after my shower today I realized I was in bed with no face lotion on and found that in the cabinet by my bed and used it and instantly remembered what it did to me before and I went thru it all over again. I'd had it in there for months so I spaced on which lotion did it. Yeah it's in the trash now, I'm not having that happen again!I've NEVER experienced this with any beauty product at all, even cheap hand lotions haven't irritated me this much. I'm disappointed in this company for making such an offensive product that did all of this to me. Why would you need your face to smell like a field of wildflowers? Ridiculous.

source_doc: I absolutely LOVE it. I love this thing.  Got it on a lightening deal and so glad I took the plunge. I love the little open shelf.  I put an extra hand towel and I will also add something decorative as soon as I find something that fits with my decor.  The only thing wrong was on my part.  I thought this was mission style doors, but they aren't.  My fault for not paying better attention.  I really don't care because I love it so much.  Oh, and I changed the knobs only because I wanted it to match the rest of the cabinets in the laundery room.  If not for that, I would have left the included knobs because they look really nice.  I would most definitely buy this again.

source_doc: Secure and comfortable. I like these better than my name-brand ones I use for my cable machine at home and the ones available at the box gym I used to go to. The reason I like them better is because they are way more secure. The ones I have are all velcro and if you are hooked onto a heavy cable then the velcro has come off before. These ones do not entirely depend on the velcro because they are made with the two metal rings that close and then you clip to the machine with those. Much better and safer. They are padded so they are comfortable. The only thing I don't like is that I can't get the circumference small enough to tightly wrap my ankle so they are loose (I have small ankles). However, that's not too big a deal I still prefer these over the other ones. Additionally, they did come with a chemical smell which I do not like but I will leave them out in the open to air out. If it doesn't dissipate I will report back, but I anticipate that the smell will dissipate.
hypos: Надежные и удобные. Они нравятся мне больше, чем мои брендовые, которые я использую дома для тросового тренажера, и те, что были в сетевом спортзале, в который я раньше ходил/а. Причина, по которой они нравятся мне больше, заключается в том, что они гораздо надежнее. Те, что у меня есть, полностью на липучках, и если ты прицеплен/а к тяжелому тросу, то липучка уже не раз отстегивалась. Эти же не зависят полностью от липучки, потому что они сделаны с двумя металлическими кольцами, которые смыкаются, и именно за них вы пристегиваетесь к тренажеру. Гораздо лучше и безопаснее. Они снабжены мягкой подкладкой, поэтому удобны. Единственное, что мне не нравится, это то, что я не могу сделать обхват достаточно маленьким, чтобы плотно обернуть лодыжку, поэтому они сидят свободно (у меня тонкие лодыжки). Впрочем, это не такая уж большая проблема, я все равно предпочитаю их другим. Кроме того, они пришли с химическим запахом, который мне не нравится, но я оставлю их на открытом воздухе, чтобы они проветрились. Если он не выветрится, я напишу об этом позже, но я ожидаю, что запах исчезнет.

source_doc: Really Good Quality. I ordered this sink mat because I am having a new farmhouse sink installed and want to make sure it is protected from day one.  I have seen the metal ones but it seemed to me that those could scratch the sink so silicone makes more sense.  It is also easier to remove to clean it and the sink.  This silicone mat is good quality and feels like it will hold up well.  I like the cutout for the drain so I will be able to use the stopped if I want to without having to remove the mat.  I like the ‘teeth’ on the bottom too that allow the water to drain.  They are a sufficient height.  After I got it, I decided to order another because I realized I could put a drying mat under it to use as a dish drain when I hand wash larger pots etc.  It will also be good as a heat mat for larger casserole dishes.  Good quality and the price is good..

source_doc: Tire marks..avoid this sealer! I purchased with high hopes based on excellent reviews...sadly I've had nothing but issues since I sprayed it on my paver driveway. I applied the product as per the instructional video and after waiting 48 hours, I parked on the driveway. Over the past several weeks I've accumulated over 20 tire marks on my once clean driveway. I tried to scrub off with soap and water, but it made little difference. I contacted the manufacturer and they told me that the tire marks must have been on the driveway before sealing (definitely not the case) and after submitting several photos they sent me a .pdf explaining how black tire marks will happen with this time of "film forming sealer." Their recommendation was to soap/scrub and then pressure wash the marks off. I sealed my driveway so I wouldn't have to scrub it and pressure wash it frequently...but this low rate sealer all but guarantees I will have to repeatedly power wash on a regular basis to get rid of the tire marks that keep appearing. If I had a time machine I would go back and warn myself not to put this sealer on my driveway no matter how good the reviews were. Avoid this product for your driveway unless you enjoy frequent cleaning and the depressing feeling that you just paid nearly $300 for a product that will make your driveway more of a headache to keep clean. Zero stars if I could!
hypos: Следы от шин.. избегайте этого герметика! Я купил/а его с большими надеждами, основанными на отличных отзывах... к сожалению, с тех пор как я распылил/а его на свою подъездную дорожку из брусчатки, у меня не было ничего, кроме проблем. Я нанес/ла средство согласно инструкции на видео и, подождав 48 часов, припарковался/лась на дорожке. За последние несколько недель на моей некогда чистой дорожке появилось более 20 следов от шин. Я попробовал/а оттереть их водой с мылом, но это мало что дало. Я связался/лась с производителем, и мне сказали, что следы от шин, должно быть, были на дорожке еще до герметизации (что абсолютно не так), а после того как я отправил/а несколько фотографий, они прислали мне файл .pdf, объясняющий, что черные следы от шин неизбежно будут появляться на таком типе «пленкообразующего герметика». Их рекомендация заключалась в том, чтобы намылить/потереть, а затем смыть следы мойкой высокого давления. Я покрыл/а дорожку герметиком, чтобы мне не приходилось часто тереть и мыть ее под давлением... но этот второсортный герметик практически гарантирует, что мне придется регулярно и неоднократно использовать мойку высокого давления, чтобы избавиться от постоянно появляющихся следов от шин. Если бы у меня была машина времени, я бы вернулся/лась в прошлое и предупредил/а себя не наносить этот герметик на дорожку, какими бы хорошими ни были отзывы. Избегайте этого продукта для вашей дорожки, если только вам не нравится частая уборка и гнетущее чувство того, что вы только что заплатили почти 300 долларов за продукт, который сделает уход за вашей дорожкой сплошной головной болью. Поставил/а бы ноль звезд, если бы мог/ла!

source_doc: STURDY. I have been a professional chef since 1975. One of my hobbies is to buy gadgets to see if they actually work or not, and if they are made well. I have since bought 2 more to give to chef friends.MANDOLINS OF ANY KIND ARE NOTORIOUSLY DANGEROUS TOOLS, and that is why i gave the ratings as i did. IMO, I don't think any mandolin is 100% safe. That said, this one is as good as it gets. The fact that it truely is GOOD GRIPS and sturdy, and it does not bend or warp when you are using it, are what makes it safer than others i have tried.As I age, my hands suffer more each day from the years of cutting and chopping, i can't slice as acurately as i used too, so this short cut helps me in that way, too.I have put it in the dishwasher 100's of times, and i see no wear and tear form that. No color fading, no cracking from the drier element, and the plastic seems as strong as ever.I am going on a trip next week and i just bought one more to take with me as a gift for someone.JUST BE CAREFUL, USE THE GUARD/HOLDER

source_doc: Exactly what I needed. These are great! I started woodworking and whittling as a hobby and the gloves are the best. I recently burnt my thumb while cooking and was still worried I'd stab my thumb while working. Sure if I intentionally tried to make the knife go into the glove it will happen, it's cut resistant not stab resistant. I have accidentally stabbed a few fingers but there was enough padding for it to cushion it so I didn't bleed or get seriously hurt. I mainly use whittling knives, though.The bumpy grip stuff is great. I have arthritis in my hands and sometimes things slip my grasp, but not with these.Make sure to order a size down because like the other reviewers say: they run big. I would fit a medium by the charts standards but I fit into a small. I have no problem with the finger length since I have "piano player length" fingers. Your hands will get sweaty if worn too long but isn't super horrible, I wear them for 3-5 hrs at a time.They don't wear down too fast. With what I do and judging by the one month I've had them, I could see them lasting 3-4 months before needing to replace them.I give all 5 stars cause it's exactly what I was looking for.

source_doc: My feet don't hurt this morning. I expected these inserts to have an effect while I was wearing them - and they did. I was surprised about the impact the next day. My first steps after getting up were pain free, and I can't remember the last time that happened. I'm definitely sold on these insoles. Though the packaging says it can take two to three days to get used to them, my right foot was completely comfortable immediately. The left not so much. I won't call it UNcomfortable, but definitely more noticeable. That's a "me" issue, though.My feet were slightly more sweaty when I took off my shoes after about four hours, but not annoyingly so. Of maybe I just didn't notice because I live with a teen athlete and anything other than cleat feet doesn't register.I found the template a little annoying. Not enough to knock off a full star, but maybe an eighth of a star. Neither of the shoes I use these in has removable linings. I tried the template on the outside of the shoe, as it suggests, and, to no surprise, it said I needed the full-length insert, which didn't fit in my shoe. I got it right after three rounds of trial and error, but perhaps marking with template with shoes sizes (men's on one, women's on the other) would eliminate a few steps.

source_doc: Ordered 2 new monitors. One was already opened. When I opened the first shipping box, I saw that the product box inside was not sealed. The tape appeared to have been cut or torn. I thought maybe i had cut it when opening the outer box, or maybe the tape had split. It wasn't until I started opening the second monitor's box that I realized the first one was used. The second one had a padded bag around the speaker. The first did not. The second one had the volume knob turned all the way down. The first one had it turned all the way up.I would have rated these 5 stars, easily. They sound great. But sending used products to people paying new prices is unacceptable. I don't know how much it has been used. I don't know if it was abused. I don't know if someone else registered the serial number, which could cause me issues if I have a warranty issue down the line. I would not have ordered these if I knew I would be getting a used one. So I'm knocking it down to 3 stars.

source_doc: Awesome!!! This pole is awesome I've never fly fished before because it seemed to be expensive and took some practice/skill to do butt this pole is super simple. I watched a bunch of videos then took a practice fly out in the yard setup a coffee can and started to practice before I new it i was able to pop that fly into the can with easy its all on the wrist. I like that the pole is all self contained i did get a line holder that attaches to the rod just above your hand so when collapsed you can just wind the line around it slip it in the tube and be on your way. I dont know that Ill every want to buy a fly rod I have several lengths and weights of tippet lines and most of the small streams and brooks I fish are tight quarters so your not able to cast a country mile anyway. I suppose on the bigger lakes you would want a fly rod too but the portability of this rod is awesome I would recommend trying one out especial if you already have the fly gear its quick to setup and be on the edge of in the water with 13 ft and a 12-16 ft  tippet you can get a decent amount of distance and accuracy. I think its a great setup for beginners or pro's its just another style of fishing.

source_doc: Simple versus Stanley. Simple modern every day hands-down! I bought this one because it had my football team logo on it even though I received a Stanley for Christmas. I have since bought two more simple modern tumblers.My simple modern is light weight and holds ice until the next day. It is perfect for my iced coffee. My ice does not melt down and water down my product. Of course no tumbler is spill proof when there is a straw involved however, it does not leak when it spills over unless it comes out of the straw when it’s been completely flipped. I found that out when I hit the brakes and my lunch bag went flying from the car seat to the floorboard upside down. With a Stanley, it does not seem to keep ice as long and I do get the water down effect and it is heavier. also when it tips it doesn’t leak not only from the straw but the straw hole in the sides of the lid. I do have the new Stanley H2O.Another great thing about the Simple Modern is the price.  It’s affordable and I definitely use it. There is a $10 price difference between this and the Stanley.I absolutely love this and and I am definitely more hydrated and I noticed that my skin does not look as dry. I would recommend this cup.
hypos: Simple Modern против Stanley. Simple Modern на каждый день, без сомнения! Я купил/а этот стакан, потому что на нем был логотип моей футбольной команды, хотя на Рождество мне подарили Stanley. С тех пор я купил/а еще два стакана Simple Modern. Мой Simple Modern легкий и сохраняет лед до следующего дня. Он идеально подходит для моего кофе со льдом. Лед не тает и не разбавляет мой напиток. Конечно, ни один стакан с трубочкой не защищен от проливания на сто процентов, однако он не протекает при опрокидывании, если только жидкость не вытекает из самой трубочки, когда он полностью перевернут. source_doc: Buckwheat pillow for life! I have no other buckwheat pillow to compare this to, but I can say that using this pillow has eliminated neck and shoulder pain. I have not woke up with strain in my neck since I started sleeping on this pillow. Feels odd at first, as the granules collect in places and lump up, but I got used to having to shift them around to create the areas of support I need when I first lay down. Once you shift and mold the pillow to suit your neck and head, it feels like a supportive hug whilst you sleep. I use this pillow on the couch as well, as throw-pillows do not seem right after using this. There was extra buckwheat that i had to remove and I am going to make an airplane pillow out of it so I do not wreck my neck whilst flying.. BONUS!!

Я ни разу не проснулся/лась с напряжением в шее с тех пор, как начал/а спать на этой подушке. Как только вы переместите гречиху и подстроите подушку под свою шею и голову, она станет похожа на поддерживающее объятие во время сна. Я использую эту подушку и на диване тоже, так как обычные декоративные подушки после нее кажутся неудобными. В ней было лишнее количество гречихи, которое мне пришлось убрать, и я собираюсь сделать из него подушку для самолета, чтобы не испортить себе шею во время полета... БОНУС!!

source_doc: Finally found a little I like! I have an old ugly ladle that I keep because it’s designed perfectly for my hand and the motion. But during Thanksgiving, I was hosting a secret soup, supper event, and everyone was to bring a soup and not tell the other what it was. It occurred to me that I needed to get more bowls, and more spoons and then I panicked! Oh my gosh there is no way I’m going to have my nasty ugly Ladle out for everyone to see and use so I was on the hunt for a new one. But the reason I had not ever bought a new one before is because I could never find one that had the exact right angle, length, shape of the ladle scoop itself  And fit well in my hand, and in the motion of labeling. Any of them that I it was about to purchase before I either returned, or did not purchase because they were not sufficient. But I was desperate and needed to find some thing at all before my guests arrived and this one is the closest I could find to what I have been looking for! It’s well-made , it’s a good quality and fits about 97% of what I’m looking for therefore I do recommend.

source_doc: Programmed fine but a bit concerned with other comments. This is a nice smoke alarm that I was able to program with no issues.  However, after reading some of the comments, I'm a bit concerned with where I planned to install it.There were a number of posts about false alarm posts.  There are so many positives that I still plan to use it, but it's not going where I wanted it, my living room ceiling.  I need a taller ladder to reach the ceiling and hearing about false alarms in the middle of the night is very discouraging for me to install where I intended.My thought at this time is to place it high enough in the room so that it's reachable with a step stool and, if I have no issues with false alarms, put it where I originally planned.  I burn a lot of firewood and the LR is right next to the garage so I wanted an alarm that would add some protection in those areas.I love the idea of getting an alarm wherever I may be but I certainly want a true signal.

source_doc: everything is just wrong. I went to install it and took all the parts I needed off and out of the way then  I put one of the brackets on with ease thanks to a friend. but shortly afterward noticed an issue with the second bracket. the one that attaches to the transfer case bolts wasn't fitting right. I went and read that some needed to cut their brackets to get it to fit, instead of cutting the bracket I cut the bit off that was in the way with a Dremel and it fits perfectly afterward. then I went on to try to put the shifter in and attach it to the 4WD lever and I tried for nearly an hour and it wouldn't work. I went to look up if I was doing something wrong but I found out I was given the wrong bracket altogether. so I spent half my afternoon taking my car apart and now I need to go to B&M for customer support and hope they can help fix the mistake.

source_doc: Probiotic toothpaste. I am a huge fan of using probiotics for all types of products, so I was happy to try this product. It has a more delicate flavor than the toothpastes I’m accustomed to using, from America. There’s a subtle mint and sweet flavor, I found it refreshing. I don’t expect it to whiten my teeth… I use whitening strips for that, and even with those, it requires regular use for my teeth to get whiter. I like using whitening toothpastes though, sort of as daily maintenance. But I’ve never tried a whitening toothpaste on its own that actually made my teeth whiter.One thing I did notice is that I have a sensitive spot on my teeth that I started feeling after using this for a few days. I normally use Sensodyne because of tooth sensitivity. And the sensodyne definitely keeps that at bay. So I probably wouldn’t repurchase this for that reason, and also because it’s pretty expensive (currently $49 for a 3.52oz tube). But I did enjoy the other aspects of this toothpaste.

source_doc: Better than I thought. I got this microphone for my phone to cut down background noise mainly for zoom meetings but also for a bird identification app called Merlin as traffic is very loud. I am usually a stickler about apps but this said it didn't require one. Much to my surprise it actually does not require an app or anything. I have a galaxy S22 ultra and I plugged it in and it just worked. I didn't have to change any settings or anything. It worked for every app even ok google. While playing with it i did open a decibel meter and took notice of how much of the background noise was being cut out. I live full time in a Class A RV so the noise level can be pretty high inside. I put 2 screenshots in to show it does decrease the background noise a bit. I think the actual bonus comes from the microphone being much closer to you though. I only used it on my phone so not sure about the other things.

source_doc: Works great, no problem pairing but your camera App might not allow external microphones. If your video App allows you to select an external microphone, this will work very well. Any problems I had with this were the result of my smartphone, and the included Camera App and, not the fault of the product. When I first plugged this in and powered up the microphone, the two immediately paired. However, try as I might, I could not get my phone to use the microphone. Yes, my Motorola G7 has OTG and has worked with other products like endoscopes, Wallabot and other products. However, when recording video, the phone always used my internal microphone.Today I found out that the problem lays with my Camera APP that came with the phone. So, I downloaded an App called "Open Camera" from the play Store and, there is a selection to use internal or external (if plugged in). Once I selected "external" this wireless microphone has worked flawlessly.  I walked to the edge of my property (about 110 ft) and it clearly picks up me whispering and, the sound quality is as good, or better than my internal microphone. The nice thing about this particular app is that there are no adds at all so far.It took a bit to figure out but, I am now totally pleased. I just wish I did not have to use a different App to video something.

Все проблемы, с которыми я столкнулся/лась, были связаны с моим смартфоном и установленным приложением камеры, а не с самим продуктом. Когда я впервые подключил/а устройство и включил/а микрофон, они тут же сопряглись. Однако, как я ни старался/лась, мне не удавалось заставить телефон использовать этот микрофон. Да, у моего Motorola G7 есть функция OTG, и он работал с другими устройствами, такими как эндоскопы, Wallabot и прочее. Тем не менее, при записи видео телефон всегда использовал встроенный микрофон. Сегодня я выяснил/а, что проблема заключается в стандартном приложении камеры, которое шло вместе с телефоном. Поэтому я скачал/а из Play Store приложение под названием "Open Camera", и там есть возможность выбора внутреннего или внешнего (если он подключен) микрофона. Как только я выбрал/а "внешний", этот беспроводной микрофон заработал безупречно. source_doc: Well made pullover for someone with an athletic build. I ordered this pullover because I was intrigued by Tom Brady's name attached to the item. I didn't know he was endorsing a line of athletic wear. I figured if Brady was willing to add his name to the product, it must be high quality. The pullover is indeed well made with quality materials. It is extremely lightweight, and great for moderate temperatures around 50 degrees. I am in my mid-50s, 5'9" and about 170. I run outside about 4 times a week and do strength training 2 times a week. I am certainly not an elite athlete, and I find myself walking up steep hills these days when out on a run. Usually a large is about the right size or just a little big on me. The large Brady pullover I ordered was definitely meant for someone with Brady's athletic build rather than my middle-aged build. There isn't any give when getting the item pulled over my head, so it isn't the easiest pullover to put on. However, while the fit is snug, once on it worked great for a warmer than usual January run. It kept the wind away and was surprisingly flexible for as difficult as it was to pull on. I would order again, but I would order a larger size.
hypos: Качественно сшитый пуловер для человека с атлетическим телосложением. Я заказал/а этот пуловер, потому что меня заинтриговало имя Тома Брэди, связанное с этим товаром. Я не знал/а, что он рекламирует линию спортивной одежды. Я подумал/а, что если Брэди готов поставить свое имя на изделии, оно должно быть высокого качества. Пуловер действительно хорошо сшит из качественных материалов. Он чрезвычайно легкий и отлично подходит для умеренной температуры около 10 градусов тепла (50 градусов по Фаренгейту). Мне за 50, мой рост 175 см, вес около 77 кг. Я бегаю на улице около 4 раз в неделю и занимаюсь силовыми тренировками 2 раза в неделю. Я, конечно, не элитный спортсмен, и в наши дни во время пробежек мне приходится подниматься пешком по крутым холмам. Обычно размер L мне в самый раз или совсем немного велик. Заказанный мной пуловер Brady размера L определенно был рассчитан на кого-то с атлетическим телосложением Брэди, а не на мою фигуру среднего возраста. Ткань совсем не тянется, когда натягиваешь вещь через голову, поэтому надеть этот пуловер не так-то просто. Однако, несмотря на то, что он сидит вплотную, будучи надетым, он отлично подошел для более теплой, чем обычно, январской пробежки. Он защищал от ветра и оказался на удивление эластичным, учитывая то, с каким трудом его пришлось натягивать. Я бы заказал/а его снова, но выбрал/а бы размер побольше.

source_doc: A pleasant surprise! I have to admit to being skeptical about this head wrap. I fully expected it to feel too tight or too heavy, but I was pleasantly surprised by how comfortable it is to wear.While it does feel heavy when you hold it, I didn’t find it too heavy when it was on my head. And though it’s tight, it wasn't too tight. It stays in place well, so if you choose to be up and about while wearing it, it shouldn’t slip down. It’s possible to pull it down over your eyes or leave it above your eyes, whatever best suits you. Personally, when I have a headache, I want the cooling relief over my eyes.Since it’s winter here and was below zero when my package was delivered, even though I took it from the drivers hand, the head wrap arrived cold. I’ve realized it always feels sort of cool to the touch, but I keep in the freezer as I like it colder. I haven’t tested it in the microwave since I don’t intend on using it that way.

source_doc: I LOVE This Little Light Of Mine. All kidding aside, I really love this little tactical flashlight.  The light is extremely bright and and versatile.  LED really does make a difference and it seems like the battery life is extremely long after a full charge.  The price is absolutely reasonable and I have been using this little flashlight for over 6 months and oddly, I find myself having to use it more than I thought I would.  I usually always buy those cheapy ones at the hardware store, they don't last very long and aren't anywhere close to as bright as this one is.  The fact that you can recharge is definitely a money saving bonus.  This would make a great gift for anyone as well.  I have since purchased 3 more so that I can keep them handy in different locations like the vehicle, that tool box, my desk and the tackle box.  I highly recommend this one and I hope you find this review helpful!

source_doc: Decent size for all the info. I found that the personal touch from the CEO with this letter and description of the company was beyond what I expected. I just got this and put it on my cat, I know it says SiliDog, but I loved that I was able to get the amount of information on this ID tag that I was able to. Its amazing so far. I was able to put information on both sides, which I wasnt able to with her previous one. Also its rubber and so easy to put on her collar that unlike a metal one it wont tarnish, like her previous one did because of her water bowl. So even though I just got it and Oreo seems to approve, because its not bothering her yet, I would say that I would recommend it.Oreo approved!!! Lol.Side note: I think whoever had it as an example that said "Only indoor cat. If I'm out I'm lost" is genius because I put it on hers!!!! Love that about it.

source_doc: Decent, feels like you need a lot though. Thus works a lot like your average face masks. You definitely see a brightness to your skin immediately after use. I want to add, that it seems like I need a large amount the couple times I have used this, and I'm not sure if this is just me and battling the different texture it is, or that I really do need more than I do with other masks. Still, it does work as good as your average ones. My face feels and looks radiant after use, so for me, this is a value for price review. The amount I get and use vs the price compared to other masks, is a bit steep for my liking. I have found 8 dollar ones of different brands that have 3 times more, and work the same as this, so the value just hits in the middle for me. This is something I would definitely order again, if it came in higher quantity, but until it does, I can save money by shopping in store for other brands that give the near same effect. This will be something I definitely will check in on to see if I can get a deal ever though, so it's better than some out there.

source_doc: This continues to be very popular!  Three dogs, and they love it. I was dubious about how this would hold up, or that it would keep my dog's interest, but after three months it is still a hit!  I mean, I know it's the FOOD that makes them interested, but they all will keep moving around, finding every last piece of dog food out of it.  It takes some time to load, but I've found that I can just sprinkle regular dog food (small bite sized) while I'm spreading apart the folds and it goes pretty quickly.  I expected that with two puppies and an adult dog that they'd start chewing up the polar-fleece type fabric, but they haven't done that at all.  It's big enough that it doesn't slide around, since they're typically standing on at least part of it, and I like that I can just fold it and then roll it up, with the built-in strap holding it together like a small sleeping bag.  When I want to use it, I just unroll, load the kibble in, and then I let the dogs in from outside and watch them just go at it!  They're busy, busy, busy, with their tails wagging the whole time.  I love it!
hypos: Эта вещь по-прежнему очень популярна! У меня три собаки, и они просто в восторге. Я сомневался/ась, насколько прочной она окажется и сможет ли удерживать интерес моей собаки, но спустя три месяца это всё еще хит! Конечно, я понимаю, что их привлекает именно ЕДА, но они все продолжают возиться с ней, выискивая каждую последнюю крошку корма. Заполнение игрушки занимает некоторое время, но я обнаружил/а, что можно просто насыпать обычный сухой корм (мелкие гранулы), раздвигая складки руками, и тогда это получается довольно быстро. Я ожидал/а, что с двумя щенками и взрослой собакой они начнут грызть этот флисовый материал, но они вообще этого не делали. source_doc: Can I give this 3.5 stars? I wish I could. I really wanted my cat to like these. They came well packaged, in individual pouches. The ingredients list is impressive. My cat is getting on in years and the bone/joint support sounded promising. My cat is finicky about her food - she loves her greens, her Fancy Feast Medleys and her Temptations treats. But she also LOVES her Churus, especially the Chicken and cheese flavor. I thought this would be a great substitute for Churus and so I tried to entice my cat 2 ways: I placed a pouch of this (like I would her Churus) in a bowl and placed it where I put her treats. She tried it… and quickly dismissed it. I thought maybe I should have mixed it? But I tried again and was still unable to grab her attention. I then tried this as what the brand indicates- as a topper for her food…and my baby didn’t even touch her plate… and it was her FAVORITE canned wet food flavor. So although I wanted to like this, kitty didn’t like it and so I’m stuck with several pouches of a topper my cat will not eat… Serving size is 1 pouch for up to 8lbs cat weight. Price at the time of this review is 47 USD, which is inline with the quality of the ingredients but for my cat not in line on flavor.
