source_doc: Works perfectly for what I need. I just moved my toddlers into their own bedroom. While I do have a Ring Camera in there which sends motion alerts, I was needing something that would alert me of sound in real time. This monitor does just that.Set up was super easy. I literally just plugged them in and they paired instantly. It picks up every sound so I can even hear when they move. I like that the volume can be adjusted so I can lower it down while they’re settling to go to bed and turn it up when I myself am ready for sleep.I do not use the cordless feature as the parent monitor is plugged in to sit on my nightstand and the one in my kid’s room is also plugged in so I can’t comment on the battery life.The night light on the kid monitor is a really nice touch and I like that whenever there’s higher sound the parent monitor lights up orange to alert.When we have our next baby I will definitely be purchasing another one of these. They are really simple but work perfectly for what I need. I wish I bought them when my little ones were in the baby phase to help when we put them in another room for naps.

source_doc: Works well on my very fine, thin, and fragile hair. Not a mist... I love TRESemmé products, and this TRESemmé One Step 5-in-1 Volumizing Hair Styling Mist it's no different, other than one thing. It is definitely not a mist, and cannot be sprayed directly on the hair evenly. I spray it into one hand, rub my hands together, and then apply it to my hair, starting at the root area. I don't have a lot of hair, so it works well for my fine, thin, fragile, and rather curly hair.Whenever I go out, I wear wigs, but I still want my natural hair to look halfway decent at home. Not only does it work well on my natural hair it also helps to keep my wigs in place. For what little natural hair I have, it doesn't take much to do the job. If I blow dry it, it gives it quite a bit of volume, but most of the time I let it air dry. It starts out a little crunchy, but once I finger comb it out, it has more volume and looks much thicker.I wish the product sprayed out in a mist as its name suggests, but I still like it for my natural hair, and for my wigs, as well. For those reasons, I would definitely recommend it!
hypos: Отлично работает на моих очень тонких, редких и ломких волосах. Не дымка... Я обожаю средства TRESemmé, и эта дымка для объема волос TRESemmé One Step 5-in-1 Volumizing Hair Styling Mist не стала исключением, за одним лишь вычетом. Это определенно не дымка, и ее невозможно равномерно распылить прямо на волосы. Я распыляю ее на одну ладонь, растираю между руками, а затем наношу на волосы, начиная с корней. У меня не так много волос, поэтому средство хорошо подходит для моих тонких, редких, ломких и довольно кудрявых волос. Когда я выхожу на улицу, я ношу парики, но мне все равно хочется, чтобы мои собственные волосы выглядели дома более-менее прилично. Средство не только отлично справляется с моими натуральными волосами, но и помогает удерживать парики на месте. source_doc: Like that I can feel the water. I have a set of speedo hand paddles and I wasn't sure if I had made the right choice as I just started swimming again so I wanted to try these out as well.I wasn't sure what size to get because I have bigger hands and the information didn't really explain what size to get so from what I read I decided to try the medium. These were a little tight on my hands but comfortable. I did like the bigger hole in the middle so I could feel the water, the speedo ones have a really small hole in comparison.The big difference for me between these and the speedo ones is that these are flat and the speedo ones are slightly curved. It turns out that I prefer the slightly curved ones as a beginner but I have a feeling these flatter ones are going to prove useful the more I use them.

source_doc: Love this kit, would love to buy another, but don't try to take throught TSA checkpoint. I bought this to tune my piano and my parents' piano; theirs was way out of tune, and I had not tuned a piano before.  I watched a youtube tutorial or two, got the panotuner app, and ordered this kit.  I was able to get my parents' piano sounding much better in just a few minutes.  Unfortunately, I tried to carry the kit through the TSA checkpoint, and it would not go (the tuner device is a tool more than 7 inches) so I had to ship it to my parents' house, and I left it there.  My piano is also slightly out of tune, but I am hoping they will restock and I can get another kit like the one I got my parents.  Otherwise, I will be shipping that tuning kit back to me in a few months.  Much cheaper than hiring a piano tuner, and just as effective.

source_doc: Didn’t Work. I bought one of these quite a while ago and never installed it. I finally got around to installing it. The concept is great, mine just didn’t work. I tried it on two different Leviton switches thinking that perhaps the contacts just didn’t quite line up on the first switch I tried to install it on. I made sure the switch (on the SnapPower faceplate) was in, power was in to the switch, and I covered the sensor/switch to test it. Nothing. I removed the SnapPower faceplate, inspected it, and tried again. Same result. I tried another switch, and same result. I had an extra Leviton switch, so I checked to see whether the SnapPower contacts line up with the screws. They do, not perfectly, but certainly enough to make adequate electrical contact that they should work. So either my SnapPower face plate is defective, or it doesn’t work if the hot and return wires are connected to the switch using the push-in connectors rather than the connector screws? It has been too long for me to return this one, so I’m stuck with an overly expensive spare faceplate. I’m pretty handy and technically savvy, and these are ultra simple, so it’s definitely an issue with the one I bought.

source_doc: Best keyboard I have ever had! I have a laptop but I never use the laptop keyboard as it is not comfortable to me. I love this keyboard and I have had many in the past. The palm rest is perfect (as I usually have my keyboard on my lap) and I was thrilled with the weight of the keyboard. It is very sturdy. The fact that there is no cord (to charge) and has a battery along with bluetooth makes it just that much better. The touch on the keyboard is light and works perfectly for me. I used to have the Logitech 800 with backlit keys but I have to say I don't miss it at all! I cannot say enough about how great this keyboard is. I have a second laptop coming and believe that I will be able to link this keyboard to both laptops which will be so much easier! Everyday that I use my new keyboard I fall more in love with it!

source_doc: Unbeatable great value cable. I got this as a temporary cable while I wait for an actual high quality one to come in. For those, you must either pay big or you wait a month to get it. Enter this cable:Less than 15 bucks, arrives the next day (for me,) and works great. The price and availability are unbeatable. How does the cable perform? I haven't been able to to detect any noise on the video or the audio. If there's audio hum, I geneuinly haven't noticed it. These are cheap so I'm sure they're hit or miss and I doubt the wires are individually shielded. But the one I received murders the composite cable I was using. I would even say it surpasses perfect s-video quality. It's sharp colorful rgb video.The cable feels and looks cheap, but it IS cheap. And you're definitely rolling the dice on the build quality here, but I can at least vouch that you'll potentially receive a solid cable that looks a million times better than composite.I might come back later and compare it to a high quality scart cable to note the differences, but I would say go ahead and give this one a try if you want to save some time and money. Bottom line: the cable I got looks great.

source_doc: Comparable to other standard wipers but is definitely not premium. I was fortunate in the fact that I got to utilize the wipers in the rain and slush right away on a 10 hour drive across state (California 2/24/2023) and it happened to rain 9 out of those 10 hours too. The wipers I would say were very quiet and I did not hear any noise from them what so ever, however they do bend a bit at the top tip when moving across the windshield which makes me question its longevity in terms of quality. The wipers were also labeled as premium and they are definitely not. I did get steaks on one of the wipers as it moved back into the down position and it did it every time throughout my drive but while going back up, it cleared it. For the price, I would say its worth buying and should last through the season I hope. Would I buy them again?... I most likely would not. On a side note, I did buy three sets for all my cars and none of them came labeled with the sizing so I had to measure the lengths to determine which was for which vehicle.

source_doc: Good keyboard for the money. This keyboard feels really good for the price point. I like the somewhat stiff action and the quiet clicking sounds. I enjoy using this keyboard and I use it all day. I have not tried it for gaming yet but for the everyday tasks that I do while working. My son tried it out with some games and he said it was pretty good. The RGB lights are fun, but they do not add a lot for me personally. I may just be too old to enjoy that stuff. ;)  I have two things that I wish were different. First, the indicator lights that show Caps Lock, Num Lock, and Scroll Lock are not very bright. They are white labels with white lights, and I can barely tell if they are on or not due to the reflection of my overhead lights. With all the RGB on the keyboard, I wish these indicator lights were bolder. Also, I was excited about having a keyboard for my PC that had mute and audio controls on it. Unfortunately, I have not found any way to invert the function keys so that I can use the audio controls without also holding down the FN key. The FN Lock just locks the whole keyboard which isn’t all that helpful on a desktop compared to its usefulness on a laptop, if those two items were fixed, I would give this keyboard a five-star rating.
hypos: Хорошая клавиатура за свои деньги. Эта клавиатура кажется очень качественной для своей ценовой категории. Мне нравится довольно упругий ход клавиш и тихий щелкающий звук. Мне нравится пользоваться этой клавиатурой, и я пользуюсь ей весь день. Я еще не пробовал/а её в играх, а только в повседневных задачах во время работы. Мой сын опробовал её в некоторых играх и сказал, что она довольно хороша. RGB-подсветка — это забавно, но лично мне она мало что дает. Возможно, я просто слишком стар/а для таких вещей. ;) У меня есть два замечания, которые хотелось бы изменить. Во-первых, индикаторы, показывающие Caps Lock, Num Lock и Scroll Lock, не очень яркие. Это белые надписи с белой подсветкой, и я едва могу разобрать, включены они или нет, из-за бликов от верхнего света. При всем обилии RGB на клавиатуре хотелось бы, чтобы эти индикаторы были более заметными. Также я был/а рад/а, что у меня будет клавиатура для ПК с регуляторами громкости и отключения звука. К сожалению, я не нашел/ла способа инвертировать функциональные клавиши так, чтобы использовать управление звуком без одновременного удержания клавиши FN. FN Lock просто блокирует всю клавиатуру, что не так уж полезно на настольном компьютере по сравнению с ноутбуком. Если бы эти два момента были исправлены, я бы поставил/а этой клавиатуре пятизвездочную оценку.

source_doc: Amazing bags really. So I actually already owned a set very similar to these That I paid much much for and of course it was at the local Harley store and I mean I guess I never had any complaints about them or anything they did the job but my brother ended up accidentally taking my side on a very long trip which kind of put me in a pinch so I decided I would just order the cheaper ones thinking I’m sure they’re good enough for at least one ride boy was I wrong I had a completely backwards as my first, but I was a rip off and this was the holy Grail. These bags were formed so much better material was better. The straps are even heavier duty I mean literally everything about them were better and I could literally buy five Saturdays versus the ones that I bought there . I can’t recommend is enough.

source_doc: Exactly what I wanted! I recently started playing Just Dance more and wondered if there was a way I could stick the controller to my hand without having to hold it. I tried using the leg strap from Ring Fit Adventure and it worked alright but the controller would slip and I was afraid of it flying out. I searched for "Just Dance hand strap" and liked the look of this one the most. I tried it the day it arrived and it works exactly the way I hoped it would! I was a little confused that the box said it was the small size strap because I didn't have a choice of sizes when I purchased, but they still fit very well and don't slip around.

source_doc: Undecided on these stirrups. I bought these for an overseas riding trip in Ireland. I will be riding cross country and jumping. The place where I ride will outfit you with the horse and saddle, etc. however, I've brought my own stirrups and leathers before and just swap them out. The climate is pretty wet. I specifically bought these because when I ride there, my boots are always slipping off the stirrups due to the wetness of the land we're riding through. I have mixed thoughts on these. I like the light weight nature of the stirrups. I normally ride in MDC sport stirrups and they are quite heavy. I like that my feet don't slip out of my stirrups when my boots are wet. I don't like that they're hard to get your feet back in if you lose a stirrup because they lie flat against the flank of the horse. I'm not sure if they're more comfortable. I have been trying them out during my normal riding and lessons. I will keep the stirrups and take them on the trip but I think I'll switch back to my MDCs for normal riding.

source_doc: Unplayable. I really wanted to like this game.  Visually its a very appealing game and the background music is good.  However the controls are way too sensitive and combat is clunky.  These are things I think I could have gotten used to over time.  However what I can't get used to is the horrendously long respawn times after you die.  It consistently takes over a minute for the game to load back up after you die.  I even timed it and the load time was 1m 05s 95 seconds.  This is completely unacceptable.This game was free with Playstation Plus, but I will be deleting it because I can't even enjoy it when most of the time is the stupid loading screen.  Months ago, this game was on sale but for some reason I decided not to get it. Knowing what I know now, I'm glad I didn't waste my money for an unplayable game.Thanks EA for reinforcing a decision I made nearly 15 years ago to never buy games at price, if at all.

source_doc: Helps for arthritis-type pain. Many reviewers say the capsules are big. I agree. I take with a cupful of water and thoroughly wet it before swallowing but it still sticks in my throat for a few minutes. I don’t know why.That said, this supplement is amazing. Another reviewer mentioned it helped with her arthritis. I don’t know if what I have is arthritis, but for nearly a year I have had pain in my left hand and have not been able to close my fingers completely into a fist. Not even halfway. I tried creams, ibuprofen, Tylenol, and even dmso, and nothing helped the pain or changed how my fingers closed. It got to the point I became used to the pain and basically accepted it as my new normal until I got around to seeing a doctor—not easy to do in the rural area I live in. So when I read the review that mentioned how it helped with the person’s arthritis, I looked at my hand. I had only been taking it for 2 or 3 days, but the pain was gone, and I could close my hand almost completely. I hadn’t even noticed! I take only one capsule a day now (half the daily dosage), and take it with liposomal vitamin c for better absorption, and my hand is doing great. I’m sure it must be helping me in other ways I don’t recognize. Great product!

source_doc: Problem Solver! I cannot tell you how many times I have battled with trying to remove stripped screws!  The most recent was when I was trying to remove my bathroom cabinet doors to repaint them.  I spent well over an hour trying to get a damaged screw out and ended up having to repair damage to the actual cabinet as a result.  I have tried most of the methods I looked up on the internet but nothing worked easily.  When I saw this set of screw extractors, I seriously did a happy dance.  I don’t know why I never saw this when looking up ways to remove damaged screws but this is genius!  It will make it so much easier when faced with this irritating problem and I won’t have to come up with new and creative curse words anymore lol.  The set includes six different types/sizes and comes in a plastic latching case.  The tools are good quality, especially at the price!  Must have for the diy-er!

source_doc: Sounds Nice But Doesn't Work as Expected (Until I Drank a Energy Drink) **UPDATE** Today, I took 3 of these as suggested again and did not feel the effects as expected, but after I forgot I took these, I had an energy drink, and DANG. If this had the same amount of ingredients but in only one drug, then this would have gotten a better rating; it seems like too much money to drop on "Energy-Pills/Supplements" for only a 30-day supply when they don't work that well.

source_doc: Reminds me of my other more expensive name brand sound machine. Worth it! I love the sound options. I always wish I could get it a little louder for covering noises in the house. But all in all I love the sound machine aspect. I like the ready to wake clock. My kids respond well to it. I like that there is a clock display for my. If kids who can tell time. The nightlight options are great. I LOVE that you can adjust the brightness!  love that it had battery back up so I don’t have to reset it every time I unplug it to move it. That’s such a pain. I wish it had a battery power option for when a storm knock out the power but it’s not a deal breaker. Overall it reminds me of my expensive Hatch sound machine that I like as well.Edited to add: I LOVE that it is a Bluetooth speaker! I can play audiobooks for my kids through it and they love those!!
hypos: Напоминает мне мою другую, более дорогую брендовую звуковую машину. Она того стоит! Мне нравятся варианты звуков. Мне всегда хотелось, чтобы она работала немного громче, чтобы заглушать шумы в доме. Но в целом мне очень нравится сама функция звуковой машины. Мне нравятся часы с будильником «пора вставать». Мои дети хорошо на них реагируют. Мне нравится, что есть дисплей с часами для моих детей, которые умеют определять время. Варианты ночника отличные. Мне ОЧЕНЬ нравится, что можно регулировать яркость! Рад/а, что у нее есть резервный аккумулятор, поэтому мне не приходится настраивать ее заново каждый раз, когда я отключаю ее от сети, чтобы перенести. Это такая головная боль. Мне бы хотелось, чтобы у нее была возможность работы от батареек на случай, если шторм отключит электричество, но это не критично. В целом, она напоминает мне мою дорогую звуковую машину Hatch, которая мне тоже нравится. Дополнение к отзыву: мне ОЧЕНЬ нравится, что это Bluetooth-колонка! Я могу включать через нее аудиокниги для своих детей, и они в полном восторге!!

Мне очень нравится, что у неё есть резервное питание от батарейки, и мне не приходится настраивать её заново каждый раз, когда я выключаю её из розетки, чтобы перенести. Это такая морока. Жаль, что нет возможности работы от батареек на случай, если из-за грозы отключится электричество, но это не критично. В целом, она напоминает мне мою дорогую звуковую машину Hatch, которая мне тоже очень нравится. Дополнение к отзыву: я просто в восторге от того, что это Bluetooth-колонка! Я могу включать через неё аудиокниги для детей, и они от них в восторге!!

source_doc: (Almost) Perfect! I just got a new sports car, and I hate to have things flying around. Plus I just really like organization. I like to keep a few things like a small box of Kleenexes, hand wipes and an umbrella in the cabin of my car, but I don't want to have it look messy. Plus I like that this keeps them close at hand and that I can easily take everything out and move it to the trunk when I have passengers. This fits exactly in the space behind the passenger seat and meets all my criteria. I also like that it has a divide in the middle and several elastic netted holders to keep the things more organized. If I have something small but I don't want to have tip over I can put it in the second compartment. It's not the most durable thing given that it's only made of cardboard. But I've had it for several months and it still looks like the day I bought it, and I love it! I definitely recommend it.

source_doc: Strong, lasting fragrance...& rash. Update:Although I washed this off soon after because I couldn't stand the smell, I broke out in a rash on my arm where I tested this.I love the convenience of a spray sunscreen, but I couldn't tolerate the fragrance added to this one. While I detect the coconut and maybe it's the shea, it's overwhelmingly a chemical, plastic, perfume smell that reminds me of something you would spray your car with or buy in the dollar store. I only sprayed it on my arm, and it's giving me a headache. I can't imagine how awful I would feel if I sprayed it all over, not to mention on others around me. The spray is very strong and generous and dries quickly. I do like how lightweight it is. I also like the twist lock cap. Each of the bottles was sealed, and they were in a resealable bag. The trio is $45.60.

source_doc: Nice bag. I love my yoga sandbag weights. I’ve been doing yin flow yoga a few times a week and using the weights has really helped me stretch and I find them very relaxing. source_doc: Needed it to sleep outside. I’m not one to rough it in the outdoors.  And I don’t function well without sleep.  So, when I decided I’d like to try testing in preparation for camping again.  I knew I’d need something like this, and I was right.I picked about the coldest night to test this out.  I first laid out my bag and crawled my over six foot self in without this mattress.  I could feel every lump under my nearly 200 pound body.  I know that if I raked up the earth under me it would’ve been better but that’s not something I was prepared to do.So, I then unscrewed the valve cap to the mattress and it inflated very quickly.  I set my bag on top and got in it again.  It was quite a difference.  But, after 10 minutes or so, the mattress had settled some.  So got out and opened the  valve again.  It sucked in more air.  That held for the rest of the night.  And I needed this comfort to feel relaxed enough to sleep.It was easy enough to deflate, just open the valve and roll it up.  The strap works great to store it.For anybody who is thinking about camping in the woods after having not done it, I think you’ll want this.

source_doc: Comfortable but not slippery, cute steering wheel cover. This is my first time having a steering wheel cover. I have a 1st Generation Toyota Sienna. I measured my steering wheel and it was close to 15", so I figured this would work. It was a bit of a struggle getting it on but not too bad, I didn't need any help or tools. I do wish I would have given more thought to where the seam on the cover would be, because I didn't and it ended up being on the right toward the bottom which isn't as bad as if it were closer to the top, but I think I would prefer if it were in the middle at the bottom as a clear point of reference. It's a pretty thick seam. I don't want to have to remove the cover and put it back on though, it was a tight fit. I chose this Bohemian design because I think it goes pretty well with my old and ugly brown interior. The cover does make the steering wheel quite thick, which, I guess, is easier to hold onto. The fabric has a tooth to keep my hands from slipping, but it still feels pleasant to the touch. I'm picky about how fabrics feel on my skin, and this feels pretty good.

source_doc: Only includes 1 round banister piece. I bought this for the top of my stairs where there are 2 round banisters. When I started installing I noticed there was only 1 round spindle piece. It came with a note saying if we want a second round spindle piece we need to contact them. So I tried emailing them using the email from their customer service website but that email address doesn't work. So now I have to find time during business hours to call them cause their customer service line has limited hours. Very annoying. On top of that, I went ahead to put it together as much as I could (to make sure it is worth contacting them) and found that the one spindle piece included is WAY to big. In order to get it to stay at the right spot I had to wrap my banister spindle in a ton of cloth. Oh and one of the mounting straps broke when I was tightening it (it wasn't super tight either). So overall, not a good experience. I think I will return it, but will call them just to see if they can fix these issues.

source_doc: Native DualSense touchpad on PS4 with new firmware. I love my DualSense controller, it's amazing, and I don't own a PS5 primarily being a PC gamer.  Recently dusted off my old PS4 to discover that I was running firmware 8.5, and thus could jailbreak it on 9.00, breathing life back into the old device.  The DS4 controller is good, but it's no DualSense, so I set out looking for a way to usef the DualSense on PS4.  I had previously purchased a Magic-NS a couple years ago to use it with a Switch, so I looked into Mayflash devices again.Enter the Magic-S.  All around it was exactly what I was searching for.  I could pair the controller to the device and then move it between the various platforms I game on without having to repair it.  Only setback was touchpad wasn't fully functional.  However I contacted the developers, discovered there is a way to do gestures on it, but it was clunky.  Well new firmware came out a day or two ago and now there is native touchpad with DualSense on PS4!  Freaking amazing!Highly reccomened if you are looking to use your PS5 controller on a PS4 or other devices.  And superb communications when I bumped into pebkac issues.  Thanks!

source_doc: I was really hoping for more than it delivered. UPDATE...After a lot of trial and error I have found the Mustang Micro to be much better than my original review. I have used it for recording and the results were very good.I have had a Fender Mustang V for a few years now and I record with it often. When I saw this device I thought it might be another recording option. Technically I can record with it. However, in the very short time that I actually tried it plugged into my 1970's era reissue Strat it sounded very overdriven. In every mode I tried. Don't get me wrong, I do like some nice overdrive. But this is too much. To the point of having a crunchy sound. I tried my 2010 Teloecaster. Same thing. Then my Epiphone Dot. Same. I tried other amp models, effects, EQ, different volume settings. All of them super crunchy. Which knocks this down from a possible recording amp to only a practice device. And even then the tone is highly unsatisfying. So if you are curious and you have an extra $120 lying around then give it a try. Maybe it's just what you are looking for. But if you like good tones coming from your guitar then move along. This is not for you.

source_doc: Good but misses keys. I have had this keyboard for a while. About 2-3 months after I got it, I started having issues with the buttons on the far right not working (the enter button, the 9, 6, 3 keys. I have to try to hit them multiple times for them to register. Sometimes my 2 key sticks and does the number twice when only hit it once. And the D key doesn’t always register. It started off mild at first and kept getting worse. It’s now at the point that I can’t deal with the issues anymore. I deal with a lot of numbers on a daily basis and this keeps slowing me down. I need to get a new keyboard. I want to try this one again, but am worried about the same issue happening again. I love the colors and the quickness of the buttons (as long as they work) I would give it 5 stars if I wasn’t having issues with the keys reacting. This keyboard was exactly what I was looking for with speed, sound, touch and responsiveness. Hopefully won’t have issues on next keyboard
hypos: Хорошая, но пропускает нажатия клавиш. У меня эта клавиатура уже какое-то время. Примерно через 2–3 месяца после того, как я её получил/а, у меня начались проблемы с кнопками в крайней правой части, которые перестали работать (кнопка Enter, клавиши 9, 6, 3). Мне приходится нажимать на них по нескольку раз, чтобы они сработали. Иногда моя клавиша 2 залипает и вводит цифру дважды, хотя я нажал/а на неё всего один раз. И клавиша D не всегда срабатывает. Сначала всё начиналось с мелочей, но потом становилось только хуже. Сейчас всё дошло до того, что я больше не могу мириться с этими проблемами. source_doc: Works great for me! I have read many articles regarding turmeric extract and decided it was time to give it a try. I have had many surgeries and now suffer from arthritis because of it.  I don’t want to take pain pills, so I am always looking for a natural remedy and I believe turmeric is the solution. Within a week of starting this supplement I was noticing less pain in my back and less pain in my knees.  I am encouraged by these results, and I will continue to take this turmeric supplement. I received two jars each containing 120 capsules. The manufacturer recommends taking 3 capsules a day preferably spread out through the day. I can’t seem to remember to do that, so I take two in the morning mixed in my juice. I have not had any adverse side effects and I highly recommend this product.

source_doc: Very impressed with the quality of this microphone. I have to say I was pretty blown away by the sound and quality of this microphone. Out of the box, I saw that it was modeled after the Sennheiser series which I own. This allowed me to do a side by side comparison. Now it does come with it's own cord, but I tossed it aside as for using this mic you will in fact to get the best results want to use a full XLR cable. To be honest, I could not tell the difference. The WEYMIC has just as much warmth and presence as my mic. Weight, construction, looks exactly like my own mic, so needless to say, I was very impressed. Since I was at band practice, I let the other guys listen while I tried both and they also could not tell the difference. source_doc: Might work for others, but not for me. I am an older lady.  I have a small, older car.  It will probably be the last car I own, too.  So I wanted to try to protect the seats.  The problem is, I didn't think about how I get into my car.  Because it is a small car and I am older, I open the driver's door, turn away from the driver's seat and then lower myself onto the seat.  THEN I both turn and pull my legs into the car.  Because of how I pivot by turning and pulling my legs in, these lay-on-top covers just get all twisted beneath me!  You really think I want to try to lean up in the seat and fiddle with this tangled/twisted seat cover beneath me???  SMH...for this price these should be way better than they are.

source_doc: i think it is great and fits my needs really well. for this price i was surprised that this sounds as good as it does. here is my use case: i live in a townhome so i had the idea for my band to plug into a mixer (e-drums used) and everyone wears headphones. that way we can crank it up and not anger the neighbors. lots of headsets, wires, headphone amp... i put some time into planning it out. what i did not account for was the guitars sounding like hell - i am running a line out from the headphone out of the amps directly into the mixer. so i started researching cab simulators, IR loaders, etc. to try and replicate the sound of a mic'd amp. the sonicake does this really well - it sounds authentic. i wasn't expecting a lot for the price, but i was happily surprised. if you have similar needs to me, i would highly recommend that you use the XLR out on the sonicake. i noticed a large difference in sound quality between that and the 1/4 inch out.

source_doc: Very easy to use. I bought this for my front door because I noticed light and cold air leaking through where the door meets the frame.  I must admit that I am not very handy and a bit of a diy dunce.  I really thought this would be a good temporary fix until I could call a handyman.  Much to my surprise,  it actually works great and I didn't need any help at all with it.  The whole process is fairly simple,  but don't skip the preparation steps.  Simply measure out how much you need and cut it to size.  Clean off the area first.  I used rubbing alcohol because it dries so quickly.  This helps the adhesive stick to the surface without getting messed up by dirt or dust.  Peel off the backing and stick it in place with a fair amount of pressure.  I let it cure for 24 hours before I used the door again.  That might be excessive,  but I wanted to be extra cautious.  The D shape is really neat because it expands into the little gaps.  Nothing is getting through now.

source_doc: Awesome AirPods Max stand. I LOVE my Airpod Max headphones! I already had what I had hoped was the perfect AirPods Max stand, purchase as a kickstarter and I waited for 9 month to get it... it was minimal and came with a mag charger set-up that automatically start charging when you set the AirPods into it... I LOVE it, and it has one fatal flaw: It does not sleep the AirPods. I am always having the AirPods pick up calls when I answer the phone. I spent twice what this cost for that and I had to stop using it for that reason.That said, I received this stand totally broken. Amazon seems to have sent me a returned item and once I contacted the seller they politely, quickly and efficiently sent a new one. The second stand is flawless and works perfectly. it is attractive and sleeps the AirPods immediately when set into it. The padding is perfect to not mar the beautiful finish on my AirPods. I do wish there was a more perfect charging solution, but I am very happy with this and recommend it wholeheartedly. It feels premium for premium headphones.

source_doc: So glad I found this!!! I have experienced shoulder and neck pain for over 20 years now. I blame it primarily on a lot of customer service work and years talking with customers on the phone prior to the advent of headsets (and I had to crook the phone between my neck and shoulder). I am always on the look out for a good heating pad and massager. I had been using a standard heating pad (rectangular) but I was super excited to try this. I love that it is custom made for shoulder pain. Once on, it hugs my back neck and shoulders and supplies wonderful heat. The heat is evenly distributed and has multiple settings to give me just what I need. I love that this heating pad covers the whole area that I need help with. Highly recommend for anyone looking for a great heating pad for your upper back, neck and shoulders!

source_doc: First Canister Vac - So Pleased. I have gone through three stick vacuums in the past 5 or 6 years. I have had Dyson, Bissel, and Shark. I have three pets - 2 dogs and a long hair cat. My entire house is ceramic tile. The stick vacuums would clog horribly with pet hair. I had to take them apart about every week to deep clean just to get a lackluster clean on the floors. This vacuum, whoa! I have vacuumed my entire house, furniture, door and window frames. The attachments are fantastic, and the vacuum is just stellar so far. One caveat for which I didn't deduct a star, if you have never used a cannister vac like myself just understand that it takes a minute to adjust how you vacuum. I felt like everything was awkward and too big the first two or three times I used it. Like I said, first canister vac. After that, I have had zero problems. And I really do love it.

source_doc: Excellent storage and organizer. I bought two of these storage boxes, and quickly bought two more. In fact, I may order more before long.I had a large collection of knitting needles stored in a diorganized mess, in a large storage box. I wanted to sort the needles into straight, double points and circular needles. I also wanted to store the needles under my couch, so the storage containers could be no more than 6 inches high. I spent over an hour on Amazon, looking for the right boxes. I found these and ordered them.They perfectly meet my needs. The containers are strong and sturdy and the locking clips are easy to open and close. I sorted out my knitting needles, and now quickly find the ones I need.I started to sort out my office supplies and plan to buy more of these boxes. I can stack the boxes on top of each other to make more efficient use of my storage space.In conclusion, these boxes are wonderful. They are a great way to store various items. I wish I could give them a 5+ star rating.

source_doc: I am impressed. I have never purchased anything that has impressed me more than this.  I have a 130 lb yellow lab that sheds a pound of hair a day.  I am constantly chasing hair bunnies and sweep my floor daily.  He has very thick hair but this works great, I filled the bin the first use.  I have brushed him everyday and no longer have hair everywhere.  The best part is that he loves it.  I pick up the hose and he comes running.  The only down side is that my arms get tired before he does.  The best purchase I have made in a really long time.  I even used it on our cat, she was not as happy as he was but did let me brush her for about 10 minutes before she flipped her tail and left.  I could never brush them in the house because hair would fly everywhere I spent more time cleaning up after brushing than I did brushing. This brushes and vacuums at the same time which is wonderful, no mess to clean up.  It is amazing how much hair is in the bin.  My only regret is that I didn’t buy it sooner.  I am happy and the dog is thrilled that he gets brushed everyday.  The noise is low so it doesn’t bother him.  I highly recommend this product

source_doc: Game changer for keeping the kitties hydrated! I was a bit leery about purchasing this, but boy-oh-boy am I glad that I went for it! It is better than I even imagined. We have a bit tight living space and I needed something that could fit in a small space. I was tired of carrying a full water bowl over to the cat’s “dining area” to then have one of them nudge my hand and then spilling the entire bowl of water on the floor! Plus I could never seem to be able to tell when their water bowl was empty. This unit has been a blessing. It didn’t take them any time at all to use it—they weren’t intimidated by the new look at all. I also discovered that the lid will screw onto a soda bottle also, so if there is a time when we need to leave more water out for them, I feel confident that I could use a larger size bottle if we will be gone for an extended amount of time. It will also be useful if for some reason the original bottle cracks (which I’m hoping it won’t). I would love to find another stainless food bowl for this unit so that I can have a clean one on standby when I want to wash the included bowl in the dishwasher. The extra ones I have are either too large or too small. This was a great buy!!

Это даже лучше, чем я представлял/а. У нас довольно тесно, и мне нужно было что-то, что поместится в небольшом пространстве. Я устал/а носить полную миску с водой к кошачьей «обеденной зоне» только для того, чтобы кто-то из них толкнул меня под руку и я пролил/а всю воду на пол! К тому же я вечно не замечал/а, когда у них заканчивалась вода. Этот прибор стал просто спасением. Им вообще не потребовалось времени, чтобы привыкнуть к нему — новый вид их ничуть не испугал. Я также обнаружил/а, что крышка навинчивается и на бутылку из-под газировки, так что если нам понадобится оставить им больше воды, я уверен/а, что смогу использовать бутылку большего объема, если мы уедем надолго. source_doc: Nice full featured mouse. This is a nice mouse. It's comfortable. I've had mice with a DPI button before but I couldn't always figure out what setting It was on. I like that this one has a display so I don't have to guess. It also works either USB, 24G, or with one of two Bluetooth devices. I like using the Bluetooth mode so I don't need to take up a USB port with a receiver.  I also like that I can plug in the cable and use it while It charges and I don't have to replace batteries. I like that it has software that allows me to re-program what buttons do what. I've been annoyed in the past by mice that kept messing things up when I accidentally bumped it's extra buttons and I couldn't change how it worked.

source_doc: Defective Tool From The Start. The first time I used this wrench to torque some wheels, it locked up and displayed gibberish on the final wheel. I rebooted the wrench and it seemed to work. I used it again and it seemed to work so I just took a mental note. I recently used it and the display locked up again and rebooted itself in the middle of trying taking a measurement. I finally accepted that this torque wrench was defective. I called the manufacturer who referred me to a company in WV. They said to send it and they would fix or repair. At this point, I wanted to switch brands. I didn't feel like shipping on my dime so I contacted Amazon. They said they would do a one time refund since it had been 4 months. I was ecstatic. I printed the UPS label and shipped it. I was then notified of the refund amount which was $30 less than the purchase price. I researched and found that you only get 80% back if the return is over 1 month. My future large purchases will be from local stores and I won't buy another Gearwrench torque wrench.

source_doc: So far this bed is awesome! At 5'9" with a model like frame, I had to get help with the box b/c it's weighs more than I do.After that, opening it and placing it on the platform was easy.  As soon as I removed the plastic, the bed started to inflation. It took 24hrs to get to its full size. However, I opted to follow directions and let it sit for more than 48 hours without touching it at all.The corners of the bed are sturdy and did not collapses as shown in some pictures.There was a smell but it was not strong. The smell dissipated once the bed fully inflated.It took my body about three weeks to adjust to it.  I thought it was too firm at first but it turned out to be just right.I have a metal platform frame and it sits well without sliding even though I have additional space on the frame.  Pics will come soon.  I had the bed for about 6-8 weeks and I love it.  I also noticed that I don't have back pain or feel stiff when I wake up.The price was exceptional.This is a great buy if you follow directions to the T.  Check back for an update in April 2023.

source_doc: Cheap upgrade. I am fairly new to the sax and I bought one of the cheap Eastar $200 altos. I won't knock my Eastar, I LOVE that in 2023 there's such a thing as a $200 saxophone (didn't exist when I was a kid), but I COULD NOT hit those altissimo notes! Obviously I assumed it was because I was a beginner and I needed to practice my embouchure, and I could hit a very squeaky high F# maybe 30% of the time (the lowest altissimo note). It's been a couple months now and I was starting to get the feeling that the problem wasn't me, it was the hardware. I just got this Yamaha 4C in the mail today, plugged it onto my cheap sax, and hit a perfect high F# first try! I swapped back and forth between the mouthpieces and the Yamaha notes sound noticeably smoother and clearer.TLDR: If you've got a cheap sax then this is a cheap way to instantly improve your playing.

source_doc: Almost impossible to play as it came. The guitar looks beautiful and I was very happy until I realized the strings had never even been tensioned....meaning the neck could easily warp.  So I got to work on it, I'm very familiar and used to setting up acoustic guitars.  First the sound hole hex key adjustment is one I've never seen...bizarre...they provide a very long and difficult to use adjustment hex....and it barely works.  This guitar came with action so high it could not be played really.  I play out fairly regularly and have some very high end guitars, even affordable Alvarez guitars I have came setup and easy to adjust.  I have no idea right now what I was do.  I know a good luthier and will get his opinion.  I'm extremely disappointed.  This instrument is not well thought out in terms of design of the neck tension system at all and the copy I received had very little care before it was taken out of a very beaten up box...perhaps it was one sent back.  But this is unplayable.  I may send it back, I wanted a jumbo that I could take out to play and not worry about a super expensive guitar...I've seen half the price guitars that are better than this one...but the finish etc is nice...what a shame the rest isn't.

source_doc: I do love this water bottle. I found this water bottle at a great deal when I was looking to add a new one to my collection. I love the colors - and there were a ton to choose from. The motivational writing on the sides is cute and I know works for some people. I don't necessarily follow them strictly during the day, but they do help to keep you a bit on track for water consumption. The outside has a good grip, even if you have melting ice trying to form some condensation. The handle is also great for carrying it around. It fits into most cupholders in the car or even in a backpack side pocket. The lid has been great for keeping the water inside the bottle and not leaking. I love the ease of pressing the button and having the spout pop up. The only thing I'm not a huge fan of is it is a little difficult to clean the straw. I haven't tried to force it from the lid because I don't want to break it. But I don't think you can detach it from the lid. I'm just extra vigilant about regular rinsing and soaking in hot soapy water and hoping no mildew or mold ends up growing in there. Overall a great water bottle and probably one of my favorites from the many I have tried.

source_doc: My teeth squeak all the time now. My teeth squeak all the time now. Not in a cheesey mouse way or a "squeaky clean", but whenever I eat anything they start squeaking. It is the most uncomfortable thing ever and I only used two of the packets (one of the rapid ones and one of the normal) two weeks apart. Basically feels like the equivalent of nails going down a chalkboard but with your teeth.My teeth were never very sensitive and I would die for them to be super white so when I saw the deal on Black Friday, I HAD to cop. I was super excited to potentially see results, but after the two I used that obviously had no results, I was hoping that I could at least keep using them to try to get them to lift. However, for some reason a few days after my last strips I craved almonds. And that is when I first found out how teeth squeaking feel like. I thought I was going insane and looked it up and sure enough, almonds do make some people's teeth squeak. But it wouldn't stop after that. Just eating certain foods will make my teeth squeak and it made life a little more unenjoyable. Literally would have felt a little better if my teeth lifted a little bit. Thanks, Crest.

source_doc: It works great for holding towels. I don't have a large linen closet so I've been keeping hand towels and other extras on a shelf here or a drawer there... When I saw these storage baskets I thought they may be a solution and, as it turns out, they are! I was able to hang the baskets on a over-the-door hook on my bathroom door - it can easily hold the weight of the baskets and towels.I have to say that I expected the baskets to look a bit more "straw-like" - more like real woven basket texture... I know they are described as cotton rope, but the word "jute" was also in the description so I guess that's why I expected it to look more like straw. They are still attractive - just not exactly what I expected. Also, the 3rd/bottom basket hangs at a weird angle - it tilts forward (see photo). I tried to adjust it but nothing I did made it straighten up. It's not a dramatic tilt or dip, so I don't think anything would fall out of it, but just something I observed. I removed a star for those two small things (jute in the description is misleading and the bottom basket tilts forward). But those are tiny things I can certainly overlook and I like the baskets a lot - they are a nice looking solution for my lack of linen closet storage.

When I bought this I got it for 64 bucks and change, and it was worth every dime. I had considered getting an air fryer from the competition, but I didn't need an air fryer with 2 compartments. source_doc: Perfect. I will absolutely buy more of these hinges when the time comes for me to replace the other hinges I need to replace.  For now though, I bought this set in order to replace a cabinet door that was previously there but had since been removed for I don't know reason, but I had to put a cabinet door back on this small opening because our cats decided that being able to go in there to hide was going to be their favorite hiding place and normally I would not have had an issue with this had it not been for the fact that I have a lot of things I put down there and use on a regular basis and having to remove cat hair from my trays and stuff constantly is not my idea of a good time.  These nickel hinges are super easy to install and it might be a personal preference thing, but I really love how smooth these things open and close.  The material is solid and I really like the looks of the brushed nickel.  If you are looking for a solid constructed, smooth hinge, these are a great start.  I hope you find this review helpful!

source_doc: Stays in place all night! I ordered this sleep cap to try to keep my long hair from frizzing since I toss and turn all night. I adjusted the cap to be tighter with the adjustable strap inside. I honestly thought the cap would fall off during the night, but every time I woke up, it was still on my head. I sleep with a pillow over my eyes, so I’m used to something being on my head while I sleep, but having this cap on was still a little different for me. I think I will get used to it quickly. When I woke up in the morning and took off the cap, my hair was still smooth from the night before, so I believe this product works as intended. The cap material itself is really soft and smooth, so I can see why this is gentler on hair than a pillow case. Bonus, if you don’t wash your hair every day, this cap will keep your hair products from rubbing on your face and causing a breakout. I am excited to see if putting this cap on will preserve my curls to where I don’t have to completely recurl my hair the next morning.

source_doc: You get what you pay 4 I'm just getting back into playing the cello after many years, so when I committed to lessons at the beginning of the year I had to move quickly to find an instrument. I found what appeared to be a good beginner cello for a great price. The instrument arrived the next day and was packaged immaculately. However the good stoped there. On first inspection everything seemed normal as I set up the bridge. However, as I started to tune the cello I noticed the tuning pegs would very easily slip out of place. Then I noticed the fine tuners for the D string on the tail piece was bent. I disassemble the bridge and strings to correct it and it just popped backed into the wrong place again. When I took my cello to my first lesson my instructor immediately noticed several things off about the instrument. The nut and bridge were too high, making the strings sit up too far away from the finger board. These physical issues made it very difficult and next to impossible to play. Save your money and go to a licensed string instrument seller. It might me a little more pricey but at least you'll get a quality instrument. I know I did.

source_doc: Stopped working after a the first time using.  I paid for shipping on the replacement. I got this as a present so that I can have radio with my partner whilst biking.  I received it for Christmas and live in a winter wonderland so I only tried this once and it worked fine.  Then the weather finally got bearable to bike and low and behold it did not work.  It was passed the time to return it to Amazon so I had to try to get a replacement from Senna.  After a few weeks of back and forth I finally received an RMA but I had to pay shipping.  Maybe this is standard but it is really disappointing that I have to pay out of pocket for a product that is defective.Sound quality is not good but I guess I should have expected it.  No base and only really good for the spoken word.  It tells you to download the app but the only thing the app is good for is the instructions.The helmet itself looks nice and fits comfortably.If I could do it all again I would choose a different company.

I am very disappointed in my purchase and the fact that I spent $30.00 on this. My window to return has now closed and that's my own fault, but I buy a lot on Amazon and can say this has been one of worst purchases.

source_doc: This is the leash I never knew I needed. I bought this to use with my dog's therapy dog vest - I need a 4' leash when working.  I also wanted the short loop so I could have the dog fully in control.This is very nice.  It's quite light, but strong.  Excellent quality clasp. My dog is on the small size (18"), and this is just perfect for when I am working him in places where I need really close control.  I usually use a 6' leash, held in my right hand, with the left controlling the shorter length.  However, the second handle just makes it much simpler - one less thing to juggle and more solid control.My dog's vest is red with black, so the black leash with the red flashes looks sharp.  I use it with the vest (like harness), with his standard collar, but also with a Gentle Leader when we are doing therapy work.  The light weight is important with a small dog with the Gentle Leader - I did not want to put weight on pressure on his delicate nose. I may change out the clasp for a slightly lighter one just to relieve some of the weight.Good product for a working dog - light but well made, well designed, and it seems durable.

source_doc: A very nice inexpensive Irish whistle! I have some experience with Native American flute but am new to the pennywhistle. The first thing I looked at was craftsmanship; this whistle was flawless from what I could see; solid paint job on the brass tube, no little scratches, etc; holes were drilled cleanly; mouthpiece well-formed.  The first time I played it there was a lot of screeching; I was trying to overlay how I play NA flute onto this new little whistle. The second time I played it I tried to let go of my NA flute experience (except the basics like making sure all the holes are well-covered) and let nature find it's own way re breathing, ... ; here came the solid and clear notes! Since I do have a few other Irish whistles to compare to, I can say that this Feadog Pro D definitely has it's own voice, and it's a very pleasant one. I'm glad I added it to my instruments; it's fun to play.
hypos: Очень приятный недорогой ирландский вистл! У меня есть некоторый опыт игры на флейте коренных американцев, но с пенни-вистлом я знаком/а недавно. Первое, на что я обратил/а внимание, — это качество изготовления; насколько я мог/ла судить, этот вистл был безупречен; прочная покраска латунной трубки, никаких мелких царапин и т. д.; отверстия просверлены аккуратно; мундштук правильной формы. В первый раз, когда я на нем играл/а, было много визга; я пытался/лась перенести то, как я играю на индейской флейте, на этот новый маленький вистл. Во второй раз, когда я играл/а на нем, я постарался/лась отпустить свой опыт игры на индейской флейте (за исключением базовых вещей, таких как уверенность в том, что все отверстия хорошо закрыты) и позволить природе найти свой собственный путь в плане дыхания...; и вот пошли плотные и чистые ноты! Поскольку у меня есть еще несколько ирландских вистлов для сравнения, я могу сказать, что у этого Feadog Pro D определенно есть свой собственный голос, и очень приятный. Я рад/а, что добавил/а его к своим инструментам; играть на нем — одно удовольствие.

Очень приятный недорогой ирландский вистл! У меня есть некоторый опыт игры на флейте коренных американцев (пимак), но с пенни-вистлом я знаком/а недавно. Первое, на что я обратил/а внимание, — это качество изготовления; насколько я мог/ла судить, этот вистл безупречен: прочная окраска латунной трубки, никаких мелких царапин и т. д.; отверстия просверлены аккуратно; мундштук правильной формы. source_doc: at 73yrs old, I need to be picky! Just read other reviews and am surprised that some do not like this.  I try many brands of drugstore foundations but hardly ever Almays' which is ironic since I have sensitive, allergic skin!  By chance I tried this one (first I love that it comes in a tube rather than a bottle) (seems more hygenic), and then liked that it has the word "prebiotic" in the name.  I am somewhat on the light side, with cool undertones, pretty descent skin for my age with some wrinkles, no age spots, average pours.  Skin is normal but can tend to be dry if I don't work at it.  I bought the 130 beige because in the pictures it looked like a cooler tone than the 120 color and I am more than happy with this.  It looks natural and very healthy looking and I am picky.  I put it on with my fingers all over my face including my eyelids.  I just love how this looks even out in the bright sunlight.  I would be one to highly suggest mature women like me try this out if you are on the fence, looking for a natural foundation that is hypoallergenic with descent products in it.  I would totally rebuy this a second time.

source_doc: This gadget is freaking amazing! As it would happen, if things can go wrong, they will.  The day before I received a positive COVID test that not only knocked me on my ass, but the very next day the master bath toilet backed up.  I plunged and plunged, and plunged, and plunged to no avail.  So, I turned to Amazon and found this gadget. I thought it would be a rinkydink, use a couple of times before tossing into the garbage but to my surprise I was wrong.  I’m rarely wrong :).  In my now full on COVID ravaged body I easily assembled, pumped it up (29 pumps to be exact) shoved the gadget into the tank.  I kinda felt like Rambo as I pulled the trigger!  Yes, there is actual trigger.  To my surprise, the recoil felt like a shot a baby shotgun!  What I didn’t know is that I should have tried to cover the bowl because along with the recoil, a bunch of toilet water splashed back on me and the floor.  After I got over that shocker, I flushed and Wallace.  Whatever was stuck was gone.  It probably got blown to smithereens!  Run, and don’t hesitate to make this purchase!

source_doc: Large capacity storage bags. These hold more liquid than most breast milk bags. I like that they are reusable, I keep them in my pump bag for work just incase I forget to grab enough breast milk bags for the week. The daily use of them is hard because it's only a 2 pack. I pump around 4 regular bags a day, so I feel like I would need to purchase maybe 6 because of the larger storage space. I did have to push really hard to pop the lid when testing it, before filling it. I think that the best advice I can give is do not completely fill it because you do have to mess with it a bit before completely sealing the lid. I think the only down side is the cap and the fact that it's only a 2 pack and the 4 pack is 32 bucks. Also I noticed in the listing it says BAP free. I sure hope that they mean BPA free.
hypos: Пакеты для хранения большой емкости. Они вмещают больше жидкости, чем большинство пакетов для грудного молока. Мне нравится, что они многоразовые, я храню их в своей сумке для молокоотсоса для работы на случай, если забуду взять достаточное количество пакетов для грудного молока на неделю. Использовать их каждый день неудобно, так как в комплекте всего 2 штуки. Я сцеживаю около 4 обычных пакетов в день, поэтому мне кажется, что мне нужно купить, возможно, еще 6 штук из-за большего объема хранения. Мне действительно пришлось очень сильно нажать, чтобы открыть крышку при тестировании перед заполнением. Думаю, лучший совет, который я могу дать — не заполняйте пакет полностью, так как с крышкой придется немного повозиться, прежде чем плотно ее закрыть. Думаю, единственный минус — это крышка и тот факт, что в комплекте всего 2 штуки, а набор из 4 штук стоит 32 доллара. Также я заметил/а, что в описании товара указано «без BAP». Очень надеюсь, что они имели в виду «без BPA».

source_doc: Pretty good lemon flavor, better when mixed with water. I've been trying to live a bit healthier lifestyle and have been trying drops like this as I see them so when I saw this I thought ok ill give it a shot.  The package came just fine without any leaks or cracks in the bottle.  Opening the bottle it doesn't really smell like anything and I was a bit worried but I shouldn't have been.  I took the dropper and put a couple of drips on my tongue and it was a sweet lemon flavor, kinda reminds me of lemon drops but didn't linger.  I tried this mixed with water also and with 2 drops per 8 oz I couldn't even notice the flavor at all so keep that in mind if you aren't 100% sold on the flavor.  As I have just started trying it I have not seen any results but I have not seen any negatives and that works for me.  All in all, if you like sweet lemon and want to try it in liquid form this is pretty good.

source_doc: I use this for my dog and cats. This camera is decent for what I wanted it for. I actually got it so I can monitor my cats and dog, while they hangout, or play, on my fenced in porch. The camera isn't rated to be outdoors, but I have an overhang that keeps the camera dry, and then I just move it inside at night. Since setup is super easy, it's easy for me to move it back and forth as needed.If my animals had it their way, I would be hanging out on the porch with them the entire time, which I don't mind doing, but unfortunately, I have chores to get done. So, this camera gives me the ability to go back into my house and do a little work while they hangout. I can monitor what they are doing, and if they are misbehaving, I can call their names through the two way talk, and it's clear enough that it actually will stop them in their tracks. The picture quality isn't fantastic, but like I said, it's a decent monitoring camera for what I intended it for.

source_doc: Nice half cup size for baby and toddler food. I got these to have a set of same-sized containers for when I make baby food, and I really like the 1/2 cup size.  Currently I’m putting the food in various containers I have, and I am wanting to be more orderly.  I like that the lids are sunken in the middle so one container can sit on top of another without sliding off.  Because these are plastic, they are lightweight if I need to take them on a day trip.  I like the various colored lids for sorting fruits, veggies, and meats. I have also found that the screw lids are leakproof, which is necessary for traveling.  I will say that they are indeed plastic, not brittle thin but not super thick either, so I do not expect them to last forever.  If they get too close to the dishwasher heat element I suspect they would melt. These state that they are microwave safe but I would not do it.  I would purchase glass ones if you need to microwave.

source_doc: Do not overtighten the bolts. I bought this about a year and a half ago based on the features and reviews.  I don't run a windshield on my cruiser, so my phone gets hit with direct wind when I ride.  I have gone 75+ mph with no trouble at all and no concern that my phone would come loose.  I do occasionally have to re-tighten the knob, which shouldn't happen but isn't a big deal.I only rated it 4 stars (debated about 3) because I had to remove it today and the aluminum mount snapped in half next to one of the bolts when I was attempting to reinstall it.  I didn't think I had cranked on it too hard, but maybe I have some of the blame.  I'm just glad it didn't break while I was riding.  I just bought another one, so that should say something about the quality.  I will be more careful not to overtighten the bolts when I install the new one and see what happens.

source_doc: Finally I can see the road. After driving around at night with old foggy zero visibility headlamps for the last ten years, I came across these. Wasn't really interested in high-tech LED lights as they are not in character with my truck. I found the only hard part about installing these was the lower screw positioning which is right behind the bumper, a real pain to get to...  So I improvised I drilled a one-inch hole into the bumper as you can see in the picture, a service hatch, to get to the screw which I will stick a plug into later.  Maybe I got lucky they seem to be in the exact spot, light-wise, so I have not needed to adjust them.  The only issue with them is because they are not two-part lenses like the stock type if you have to remove the indicator bulb you will have to basically remove the headlamp screws and pull the headlamp forward, which I discovered when I noticed the indicator bulb was out. It is also a bit of a tight squeeze to get the headlamps in. Overall for the money, you cannot beat them. And I would buy it again if needed.

source_doc: Easy to use, feels professional. I must admit I was skeptical about buying this because of it's price! I wanted this model because cortado is one of the presets, and I had red good reviews about the milk recipes.My previous machine is a Nespresso latissima plus, which I still think it makes decent coffee, and maybe more coffee crema that I have been able to get with this Gaggia.Can I go back to nesspreso... source_doc: Water tastes great! I love this filter! I’m new to RVing and I noticed all the neighbors have this on their water supply so I researched it and I knew I needed one! I immediately noticed the chlorine smell was gone. I use bottled water but I occasionally run out and I hated using tap water because of the toxins it contains. I also worried about giving it to my dogs to drink. The installation was a breeze but there were no instructions that mentioned the black water that comes out at first. I was alarmed but I found their website and read that it’s carbon from the filter and it isn’t harmful. I made my first pot of coffee this morning (without my regular dread) and it was far better than regular tap water! The only thing that I don’t like is that it leaked from the water source. It comes with a rubber ring but it didn’t work for me. Luckily I had others on hand and now it doesn’t leak. Best purchase I’ve made in a very long time!

source_doc: Great product and great company. I got this high chair for my 2nd baby. It converts to a little chair when it’s not needed to be a high chair anymore. source_doc: Very nice! I am replacing my G910 spectrum. the G910 started double typing letters I could have replaced the bad switches but after reading about this I decided to sell the 910 and buy the G513, I do lose the multi media keys and the "G" keys along the left side but I honestly never used them.this is very comfortable to type on and the blue clicky keys feel real nice. source_doc: Works great for pets. I am using this item to secure my dog's car seat/booster seat. The lap belt of my rear seat hooks into her car seat. I liked that I could actually lock the belt nice and tight so in case of an accident, her seat would be as immobile as possible. This way, in an accident, I know the lap belt is locked, and I don't have to depend on seat belt locking itself.l Also, the lock mechanism for the belt release button is also handy in case I am in the back seat, wrangling groceries and packages, and accidentally hit the belt release buttons. This is a great invention, and I wish I would have found it when caring for my grandfather who had dementia. I can't tell you how many times I would slow down the car to park, and he would be releasing his seat belt and trying to get out of a still moving car. I did have a little trouble getting the belt locking clip on my seatbelt. (I have a 2018 or 2019 Buick Encore). I took a little trial and error, but after about 5 minutes, I locked it where I wanted it.

Мне понравилось, что я действительно мог/ла зафиксировать ремень очень плотно, чтобы в случае аварии её сиденье было максимально неподвижным. Кроме того, механизм блокировки кнопки фиксатора ремня также удобен на случай, если я нахожусь на заднем сиденье, разбирая продукты и пакеты, и случайно задену кнопки фиксатора ремня. Потребовалось немного времени на метод проб и ошибок, но примерно через 5 минут я зафиксировал/а его там, где хотел/а.

source_doc: Great console organizer! Even better with a few modifications! I got the one without the coin holder and USB ports! I did this for several reasons:1. I want to use a rapid charger for my phone2. I've read reviews about the coin holder being a knuckle buster when putting the car in park3. The USB ports could break later on meaning you'd need to replace the entire unit4. Better utilization of space to not have the USB ports taking up space in an already small compartment.So i made a few modifications to an already great console organizer. I used my dremel to cut a square in the top to allow the console light to enter the top compartment. I also cut 2 holes in the back of the organizer to allow me to run my apple charger through any compartment that I wanted. I chose the small upper right corner for my ear pod charger. Check out the photos.The unit fits tight and snug like a glove. I really don't have any complaints about this unit although it would have been better if it already came with the modifications that I did. Overall I'll give it 5 stars and I would highly recommend it!

source_doc: It worked great till it didn't. I have to say I don't have any complaints about this unit, except for the tire inflator. My first one I received wouldn't hold a charge and was sent back. The new one was perfect. I have had it for exactly 2 years. The only problem I ran into is that I have only used the inflator maybe 6 times. I pumped up a basket ball, my sons bike tires a few times, and my two front tires. Unfortunately in putting air into my tires it stopped (main reason for buying). I pumped one tire, let it rest, and started the other one. After about a minute, the compressor was running, but no air was going into the tire. It just stopped, not to sure what happened. This unit is still like brand new, and has been well kept. Everything else still works, and I can use it as an alternate power source. I am not happy that it doesn't inflate anymore, but I can still find uses for it as another power source. So there is that.

source_doc: Good inexpensive Shower Bench. This is not exactly what I wanted, but I needed a shower seat for the roommate immediately due to his recent leg surgery.  The roommate reported that it’s the perfect height for him, and that he likes it better than the adjustable bar stool he used previously.  (The stool began to rust.)  The shower bench is very sturdy with two bolts in major stress points, is easy to assemble and comes with an extra parts— an extra of everything except the hex wrench.  It even has an extra plastic no-slip cap for the leg bottom.  I was truly impressed by this foresight since one of the grommets didn’t allow the machine screw to go all the way in; I swapped it with the spare and presto— assembled.  The bench doesn’t wobble or shake; it’s a steal for the price I paid.  I have no idea about longevity, but I plan to replace with a stone bench if/when I find one since I was looking for a stone bench that would allow me to use a steamer ia the shower prior to this immediate need.  I almost purchased a bench 2-3x the price; I’m glad that I chose this one.  I will update this review in the future if my opinion changes over time due to longevity issues, but keep in mind it’s low price.  See the pictures for size and the box it arrives in.

source_doc: Work great. Good quality. I switched my trailer axle from a 7500 lb to a 2000 lb axle. I just don't need that big of one way overdone. I went to a couple local places to try to get the u-bolts in the plates but just couldn't find the right size.These are for inch and 3/4 round axle. I think I'm going to need to replace the leaf springs because there's four leaf springs. I need a little softer ride. The trailer is only going to be maybe 1500 lb so I need to switch out those as well.But what I'm getting at for the leaf springs is it fit around four leaf springs and the axle?. After I cranked and tighten the bolts, the bolts are nylon. No washers. But the fact that I have four leaf springs. The bolts barely make it through the nut. Just kind of flush with the top so once I replace the springs I should have a little bit more thread on top of the bolt. I think it would be fine even with three leaf springs.As for quality, definitely quality product, the u-bolts the plates, the nuts, even the coupler that goes between the shock leaf and the axle high quality. I definitely recommend it but it again it is for a inch and 3/4 axle or the 2000 lb load?.If this fits your axle, it's a good product. Get it.

source_doc: Wanted to like these but it doesnt work for my Jeep. I was so excited when I saw these because I was very ready for a different look for my TJ's tail lights and I liked the sort of modern look these gave. Unfortunately these don't work with my TJ because I have Rugged Ridge's heavy duty hinge kit for my tailgate and the tail lights are shorter in depth than the stock lights. I thought about cutting a 1/2 inch thick rubber sheet to shape but that also didnt work because the bolts didnt end up being long enough to also reach through the body with it. When I did test fit them though, they were bright and worked like they should so that's why I gave them 3 stars. I really liked them but I just wish they were similar to stock in depth so I could have used them.

source_doc: Was really hopeful but my hope burnt out. I bought these for my truck cargo lights as well as my door lights.  When I first put them in I was amazed at how bright they were.  It was amazing and I was excited.  Then about 2 weeks after having them in I noticed one of the cargo lights started blinking.  I thought it might be the wiring in the truck but then shortly after I noticed the other light started doing the same thing.  I had my little daughter push on the brake to see about the brake light and it seemed to still be okay.  So I took 2 of the bulbs out of the doors and put it back in the cargo lights.  It was about 2 days later that both of those started to struggle as well.  Then I noticed the one in the brake light started to flicker as well.  I was so hopeful for these bulbs and am quite saddened that they stopped working so quickly.  I would understand it if was 1 bulb then it could be a fluke but I now have 6 bulbs total that aren't working any longer or flickering really bad.  Thankfully they weren't too expensive so it didn't hurt too bad when I threw them away.

source_doc: Fantastic , portable amp. This is my second positive grid amp, I also own the the bigger 40 watt version. This one is much smaller, easier to carry and just as easy to use as its bigger brother. I love that it has a built in battery and charges via usb C. I haven’t charged it in almost a month and it still holds a charge. Given, I don’t play very often. I would say about 2 hours a week. So I imagine you’d be charging it more often if you play a lot. It only has a couple of built in presets, so you must have a tablet or smartphone to get the best use out of it, but that isn’t a huge deal for me. I like it. I like being able to search an almost infinite library of tones that people have shared. You can also play music and jam along with the app. I love it! I can even Connect my wah or flanger pedal to this without a hitch. I don’t regret buying this. It’s perfect for home jam sessions. If I had to pick between this and it’s bigger brother I’d go with this one, just because of the built in battery and usb C port.

source_doc: Looks nice, seems to blunt sounds. I used these in my office to reduce sounds from coming out and disturbing others in my house while I am working or just watching videos.  For that purpose it seems to work well, but I think I will need to get a few packages to make a nice design or add to the sound dampening effect since it only comes in a 12 pack.The panels themselves are pretty solid and feel dense as advertised.  I made a nice backdrop pattern behind my monitor, but eventually, I think I will buy a few more packs and add panels all over to match my current design and make my office a bit more visually exciting with the added benefit of more sound dampening.I do not do much recording so I can't speak to any increased audio quality on recordings of yet, but I can't imagine it not helping since it should cut down on echoes and dilute random sounds.7/10 I would recommend it.  I hope this review is helpful.

source_doc: This is a compact unit that will work with your existing ratchet wrench or breaker bar. This tool has a solid, compact storage case, and the unit will work with 1/4, 3//8, and a half inch drive.  The unit will display and work with numerous torque measurements and specifically inch-pounds and foot-pounds that I need. To test its functionality I loosened a wheel lug on the tractor.  I then connected the electronic torque tool to my existing click adjustable torque wrench.  I adjusted the electronic device to 83.5 foot-pounds and the click adjustable to 86 foot-pounds.  As I tightened the bolt, the electronic device began beeping at just under 80 pounds.  My initial thought was "this isn't good".  So I next set both to 86 foot-pounds.  The beeping began around 83 foot-pounds but I kept going.  At 86 foot-pounds I heard the click and the tone switched from beeping to solid simultaneously.  Great, I figured out the beep is "approaching" and solid means you're there.  I later went back to the manual and found a "note" explaining the beep means you're within 20% of the target.  So, I like the unit and the audible feedback.
