source_doc: Screw holes not machined well and doesn't fit handlebars or steer tube perfectly. I bought two of these. The first one broke as I was installing it. One of the handlebar screws popped out as I was screwing it in and the threads in the hole completely just stripped out. So I got a refund and wanted to give the benefit doubt to the product so I ordered another. It lasted me roughly 9 months and as I was removing the stem to take my fork off, the bolt hole snapped and stripped out again. For the price it isn't bad. If you don't intend on ever taking the stem off and you carefully install it, I think it could be good. But I travel with my bike and this happened as I was traveling so it nearly ruined my trip. Luckily it was just one hole so I was able to make due with it temporarily but I will not be buying this stem again. Another weird thing about this stem is that it didn't fit my handlebars perfectly and there was a gap between the front plate and the stem. It also didn't fit onto my steer tube very well and it  took a lot of effort to remove/install.

source_doc: This thing is wild. I have used a variety of TENS units and have really enjoyed them.  This thing is much more powerful so be advised.  I do wish that there were lower levels as I find 1 pretty powerful.  I have not been able to increase from level 1, but I am sure with time I will get used to it.  I'm just taking it easy in the beginning.  I like that is adjustable with a variety of modes.  The pucks that drive the system are easy t use and attached and I like that one cable will charge them all. The charge lasts quite some time as well.  I have mostly focused on toning my stomach and I know I need to use it for longer to see more results, but I am excited about the journey.

source_doc: Perfect for portioning out my slabs of salmon. I buy a big $40 slab of salmon at a club warehouse every time I go, then use a nice set of heavy duty kitchen scissors  to portion it out, so I can freeze what I won't use right away. Recently the selection has not been what it was, and getting it skinless isn't always possible. I needed a knife that would slice through that salmon like butter, not only to portion but also to remove the thin skin (I think it makes the fish taste fishier).This knife feels good in my hand and yes, slice through and gets the skin off like it's going through butter. I didn't know I needed this knife, but now that I have it, I can't imagine working in my kitchen without it. source_doc: Pickleball is tough but fun.  This set is great for beginners learning how to play. I used to play tennis in high school, and I loved it.  Over the years I've not played tennis nearly as much as I wanted to given work and life schedules.  Pickleball is something that I had heard of a couple of years ago but never really looked into it.  Now, it's the newest sports fad, and this set from Deerfamy is one that I ordered to get me back into something that is like tennis.  This set comes with two lightweight pickleball rackets, two indoor court (orange) and two outdoor court (yellow) balls.  There's also a carrying case that everything fits into.After my first attempt at playing pickleball, I have to say it's a tougher sport than I thought.  If you're familiar with tennis, there's a LOT of fast-paced volleying.  That was the part of tennis that I hated and the main reason I stayed back on the baseline.  I'm not a net player, but pickleball sort of forces you into that.  The equipment from Deerfamy was good at helping me practice.  It's lightweight and had a nice grip on the handle.  I had control of the racket when swinging, so I can't blame the racket.  I'm just not good at pickleball.... yet! :)

source_doc: My hair drank this up. I don't use a whole lot of product in my hair but every so often I think it's good to get shampoo like this just to strip out any gunk that has got deep into my hair. source_doc: sprays evenly, beachy aroma that lingers like cologne, light coverage, pretty good overall. Pleasant aroma, sprays well, no irritation.I use sunscreen all year round. I am fair and have sun sensitivities. Add in that I take a couple of meds that exacerbate this, and I just cover up. Currently dark and snowy in NY with no real use for body sunscreen, but I gave this a cursory try. It should be good for body use when the time comes. I buy the sprays for the ability to cover my back to reach places that a lotion cannot.Since I use sunscreen copiously, and spend a lot of time outside which warrants it, I tend to prefer a higher SPF (I dont down rate for this because I can clearly see what I am ordering; no suprises), and I also prefer healthy sunscreens that are good for body and environment. I can get giant bottles of cheap stuff which is fine in a pinch, but for every day use, multiple times a day.. I choose wisely.Keep in mind that this is aromatic. The other set I ordered came with an air freshener of this aroma. It is beachy and pleasant, but also a tad perfumy. If you like colognes and such then you will likely enjoy this. I dont mind it but it is something I am aware of when I have it on.
hypos: распыляется равномерно, пляжный аромат, который держится как одеколон, легкое покрытие, в целом довольно неплохо. Приятный аромат, хорошо распыляется, нет раздражения. Я пользуюсь солнцезащитным кремом круглый год. Я светлокожий/ая и чувствителен/льна к солнцу. Добавьте к этому то, что я принимаю пару лекарств, которые это усугубляют, и я просто закрываюсь одеждой. Сейчас в Нью-Йорке темно и снежно, и особой необходимости в солнцезащитном креме для тела нет, но я поверхностно его протестировал/а. Он должен хорошо подойти для тела, когда придет время. Я покупаю спреи из-за возможности обработать спину и дотянуться до тех мест, куда не нанести лосьон. Поскольку я обильно использую солнцезащитный крем и провожу много времени на улице, что этого требует, я обычно предпочитаю более высокий SPF (я не снижаю оценку за это, так как четко вижу, что заказываю; никаких сюрпризов), а также предпочитаю полезные солнцезащитные кремы, которые хороши для тела и окружающей среды. Я могу купить гигантские флаконы дешевого средства, которое сойдет в крайнем случае, но для ежедневного использования по несколько раз в день... я выбираю с умом. Имейте в виду, что это средство ароматное. Другой заказанный мной набор шел с освежителем воздуха с этим ароматом. Он пляжный и приятный, но также немного парфюмированный. Если вам нравятся одеколоны и тому подобное, то это средство вам, скорее всего, понравится. Я не против него, но это то, что я ощущаю, когда оно на мне.

source_doc: Very messy.  Needs a better applicator. This mascara went on really wet and clumpy.  I had to grab a cotton swab and use it multiple times to clean up around my lashes.  I feel like the applicator was partly to blame.  I couldn’t get good separation with this style of applicator.  The bristles weren’t very deep or thick.  Luckily, I had a spare applicator that I pulled out and used to clean up and separate my lashes.  Once I cleaned up the mess, my lashes were still a bit clumpy, but looked okay.  This mascara does add length to my lashes.Typically I need to reapply mascara at the end of my work day - and it smudges below my eyes.  With this mascara (if I applied it heavily), I had no smudging and I still had good coverage up to 12 hours after applying it. source_doc: Sleek flosser. I love this flosser.  Opening it up, it looks and feels like a quality piece.  What I love most about it, is its sleek and minimalist design. I'm a sucker for a good design, and It doesn't look like every other flosser you see out there.  It's well designed, and easy to hold and use.After I charged it up and cleaned all the necessary pieces, I tried it out for the first time.  Filling it is quick, with the reservoir at the top.  It's very easy to use, you can change the levels simply by pressing the power button. Mine was set at the strongest setting, and I quickly adjusted it to a lower setting.  Even at the lowest setting, It does a fantastic job at getting all the dirty bits out of my teeth, leaving my mouth feeling extra clean.  I've only felt the need to use the standard nozzle so far, but the others are there for when I need them.Verdict:  I'm so glad I got this. It's worth it's price in my opinion.  I love the design of it, I don't mind if it's sitting outside on the counter, and not put away. I would absolutely purchase this again if I ever needed to replace this one in a few years.

source_doc: Not bright, what timer function? I was excited about this great deal; batteries with the lights were enticing. I thought how easy it was all together.  I got the lights and put them together, put them up, and then got the remote to set the lights. The first night they were great, shining bright in the windows. The second night I noticed they were not all turned on, so I reset them and paid extra attention to the settings, so I wasn't making a mistake. I saw the next night that the lights were again not turning on together. I had to manually turn them on so many times, which was a nuisance. I don't know if the remote was not working correctly or if there is just something wrong with the lights, but they were so difficult to use. The lights were supposed to be on every night for 8hr max. (according to the remote setting) but they seemed like they would turn off after 2 to 4 hours, no matter how I adjusted them and redid the remote. The most upsetting part was that the batteries they came with didn't even last until Christmas. By Christmas day, more than half of the 12 lights I had in my windows were completely dead. I don't recommend these lights; very disappointed.

source_doc: Love this grinder and the bag it comes with. I've been getting into whole bean coffee here recently and I wanted something that I could fine-tune better than an electric grinder so I got this.  It came packaged just fine and I didn't see any defects or dings on the grinder.  In the package, you get the grinder, a storage bag, and two cleaning brushes. It is basically 3 main pieces the handle which has a nice wood knob, the grinder which has all the guts, and the collection bin which catches your grounds.  I got a whole bean that I hadn't tried before and loaded it up and got to grinding.  It was really easy to grind although I set it for a bit too fine on my first go-round so unless you are old hat at manual grinding you will probably have to play around with it to find your preferred setting.  Cleaning it was a breeze too, it says not to get it wet so I took it most way apart (I left the grinder guts in) and took my electronic duster, and just blew it out. What I really like about this one compared to the others I have is it comes with a storage bag so I don't have to keep it in a big bulky box.  All in all, I do really like this and its matte black color looks great.

source_doc: It works best for my neck and shoulders. I ordered this bath cushion realizing that the reviews were polar extremes. My tub is pretty uncomfortable so I thought I would give it a shot anyway. I took into consideration the review that said suction cups were necessary, so I put those on first. They were not as difficult to insert as I had anticipated. You just have to use two hands and pull one of the honeycomb openings apart, then using the thumb and finger on one of your hands insert it into the opening. I had no trouble doing it, but my mother with arthritis could never manage it.I first tried this on my lower back and it was comfortable but a little bulky. I know that my issue taking a bath is a scrunched neck so I slid the pillow up on the tub to my upper shoulders and lower neck and that gave me the support that I wanted and needed. While it is still a little more bulky than I I would have preferred, it really helps my neck. I'm pleased and glad I chose it.

source_doc: Like my 100W so much I might be upgrading my main tank. I actually got this to warm water change water, but I love the features so much I might get a 300W for my main tank. source_doc: I use it every day. I'm not a great photographer, and it's not like I can capture the "soul" of a water bottle because it's simply a water bottle. However, I am not exaggerating when I say that for the first two days that I had it, practically everyone at work questioned me about it. I'm not sure if it's because I had it full of ice water and everyone was thirsty and saw that my bottle was full of ice cold water and it just made it more desirable or what. I do, however, know that this water bottle has not yet leaked on me. I like how the ml of water is labeled on the side. Oh, and I'm reminded of how puzzled I was when I first tried to open this thing, but now I think it's one of the best aspects. So, when you go to drink, you press a little button in the front, and it flings your lid off. It is both quick and convenient. However, at first glance, it appears to be something that slides up and down. One of my friends told me they tried to drink from it, but they couldn't open it. (Fortunately, I didn't want their lips on my drink in the first place.)So, Basically I LOVE IT

source_doc: Handiest thing you never knew you needed! Absolutely loved these clips! I bought them originally because those hanging toys made for the car seats always slipped everywhere on the baby’s car seat handle. Drove me nuts! I looked for these and they did not disappoint! I use them for everything! I probably could have gotten a smaller pack but it’s fine because I keep a set in everything: car, stroller, car seat, house….. my favorite thing to use this for is as a shade for my baby while he’s in the stroller. His car seat clicks onto the stroller but the shade doesn’t help much most of the time. I would try and maneuver my head to block the sun but now I can just clip his Muslim blanket on the car seats handle and clip the other on the stroller handle and there you have it a shade that’s breathable and I’m the exactly place you need it. Can hand it off the side. Helps keep the blanket hooked over the car seat if it’s windy/dusty and it won’t move. Holds toys in place that can hang. I love these so many possibilities and I highly recommend to any parent! I can even use them for myself to block the sun in the car. I’ve used them before to clip a Muslim blanket to my shirt so I can nurse when I’ve forgotten my cover. So many things! They are durable and I have yet to break any.
hypos: Самая удобная вещь, о необходимости которой вы и не подозревали! Я абсолютно в восторге от этих зажимов! Изначально я купил/а их потому, что подвесные игрушки для автокресел постоянно соскальзывали по всей ручке автокресла ребенка. Это просто сводило меня с ума! Я нашел/ла эти зажимы, и они не разочаровали! Я использую их для всего! Наверное, мне бы хватило и набора поменьше, но все в порядке, так как у меня есть по комплекту везде: в машине, в коляске, у автокресла, дома... Больше всего мне нравится использовать их для создания тени для ребенка, когда он в коляске. Его автокресло крепится к коляске, но козырек большую часть времени не особо помогает. Раньше я пытался/лась крутить головой, чтобы загородить солнце, но теперь я могу просто прикрепить его муслиновое одеяло зажимом к ручке автокресла, а другим зажимом к ручке коляски — и вот вам тент, который пропускает воздух и находится именно там, где нужно. Можно повесить его сбоку. Помогает удерживать одеяло на автокресле в ветреную или пыльную погоду, и оно никуда не денется. Удерживает на месте игрушки, которые можно подвесить. Мне они очень нравятся, здесь так много возможностей, и я очень рекомендую их любому родителю! Я даже могу использовать их для себя, чтобы защититься от солнца в машине. А еще я использовал/а их, чтобы прикрепить муслиновое одеяло к своей футболке для кормления грудью, когда забывал/а свою специальную накидку. Столько вариантов применения! Они очень прочные, и я еще ни одного не сломал/а.

Мой самый любимый способ использования — делать из них навес от солнца для ребенка, пока он в коляске. Его автокресло ставится на коляску, но встроенный козырек чаще всего плохо защищает от солнца. Можно даже повесить его сбоку. Зажимы помогают удерживать одеяло на автокресле в ветреную или пыльную погоду, и оно не сползает. На них отлично держатся любые подвесные игрушки. source_doc: Poor Quality. I am extremely disappointed with this controller. I ordered this and the first one that arrived would lose connection from my Xbox Series X about every 10 minutes. I was about 5 feet from the console when using it, so there should be no reason for this. I actually have a second Xbox Series X in my living room, so I tried it there and experienced the same issue. I decided to exchange the controller and get a new one. Now that I have the second controller, this one has stick drift in the left thumb stick. I've tried every troubleshoot with Xbox support, but now they recommend that I send it to them for repair. I am just going to return it and go with a different option. Also, I did not play with the controller to cause the stick drift. I noticed it fresh out of the box, so it was not dropped or damaged and it is not dirty from use. It's literally brand new. Extremely disappointed, I wanted to really like this controller.

source_doc: Not really that bright. I got these for my 2002 F350 SuperDuty.  I installed them and was excited as I was replacing my old incandescent bulbs that seemed very dim and yellow.  I read the description and was looking forward to the bright new fog lamps.  I put them in and waited for nighttime to come.  As I was driving I turned them on waiting for the great reveal and I didn't even know they were on.  I actually at first thought that they didn't come on at all.  I actually waited to pull behind a car where I could see the reflection and saw they were indeed on.  Unfortunately it really doesn't make a different.  I'll leave them in for now though they really seem more like driving lights than fog lights to help see the road.  I won't buy these again.

source_doc: Works very well. Works very well to track steps, calories, distance and work outs. Data is accurate and battery life is excellent. I wear it 24 hours and the sleep data has been very helpful. I also use the smart wake feature so an alarm doesn't wake my partner since I get up a couple hours before him. The smart wake sends vibrations which buzz the arm. It works surprisingly well. Even though there is a water lock to allow user to wear in shower or swimming, I have not tried it yet, but plan to. The sensors on the sides are easy to use for the EDA scan and heart rhythm scan. I would prefer to have the apps in a different order but that is just a personal thing. The only other issue I have had is the phone app occasionally acts up and won't allow me to sync data. It self resolves but can be annoying. I chalk it up to consequence of having so much tech these days.  I am glad I chose the 5 over the 4 version for the built in GPS & water lock capabilities. I also recommend getting the fitbit premium account if you are serious about getting your health better. It has additional insights and data analyses that you won't have access to without it. Overall extremely happy with the Fitbit 5 and I do recommend it.

source_doc: CRUSHED green fuzz algae! For months I tried everything. Everything in my low-tech freshwater tank seemed right. I had my light down to 3 hours a day. I stopped feeding for periods.  I even blocked out the sides of the tank to prevent ambient light from getting in.  Nothing worked.  The green fuzz algae was all over my plants and surfaces.  I cleaned, I did water changes, got an algae eater & snails. This was trial and error over months and nothing I tried showed any result. The green fuzz got so bad I had to cut down all my plants. Wish I had tried this product sooner.  I dosed just as the directions stated and within 1 week the green fuzz algae had been noticeably diminished.  It went from being bright green to a dull brown color.  Hoping this restores balance so I can begin fertilizing again so my plants will regrow. Amazing product!

source_doc: Who owns a Karaoke machine? This guy! (Woohoo's with glee!) I have always thought that I would never have any reason to own my own karaoke machine, but now that I do, I can tell you that I can find a reason to own one almost every week. It is a party machine. I would say that is the biggest valid reason to own your own karaoke machine. If you sing, and love to sing in front a crowd, but you still don't have a recording contract, then this machine allows you to increase your odds of landing a contract by increasing the volume of your voice. I mean, it can't hurt, can it? Sing loudly and sing proudly. This machine is well made and has not had a single problem since I received it 6 months ago. It has been to the beach and back it did well. It sounds good, it gets loud, and the two microphones that it comes with are a cinch to use. They are up and running in less than a minute after I power up the speaker. It comes with a smartphone holder so that you can display a song's lyrics as you sing. The speaker rolls on two wheels, and it has a pull-out handle like a rolling suitcase. I have had a lot of fun using this machine and I have had zero problems with it. If you are looking for a karaoke machine, this is a good choice.

Я всегда думал/а, что у меня никогда не будет причин завести собственную караоке-систему, но теперь, когда она у меня есть, я могу сказать вам, что нахожу повод использовать ее почти каждую неделю. Это настоящий генератор вечеринок. Я бы сказал/а, что это самая главная веская причина для покупки собственной караоке-системы. Если вы поете и любите петь перед публикой, но у вас все еще нет контракта со звукозаписывающей компанией, то этот аппарат позволит вам повысить шансы на его получение, увеличив громкость вашего голоса. Я имею в виду, это ведь не повредит, верно? Пойте громко и пойте с гордостью. Этот аппарат отлично сделан, и с ним не возникло ни одной проблемы с тех пор, как я получил/а его 6 месяцев назад. Он побывал на пляже и вернулся обратно, отлично справившись с поездкой. Он звучит хорошо, играет громко, а два микрофона, которые идут в комплекте, невероятно просты в использовании. Они готовы к работе менее чем через минуту после того, как я включаю колонку. В комплекте идет держатель для смартфона, так что вы можете выводить на экран слова песни во время пения. Колонка катится на двух колесах, и у нее есть выдвижная ручка, как у чемодана на колесиках. source_doc: Clear, not colored. As much as I love these little guys, I feel the description is misleading. The photo shows these are colored, and I honestly would probably not have ordered had I known they were not. I hate when this happens, as a simple adjustment to the title, would have solved any misunderstanding of whether they were colored or not. Or switching the opening photo. Still, they are very cute, thicker, yet small Mason jars. They are the same size, thickness, etc that I imagined they would be when ordering, just not the color. Overall, these would be great for little gifts, or just cute little guys to have for no other reason than they are just cute. I had the idea of filling with glitter in my craft room. Give them the color I thought they had. I have not yet decided what I will do with these yet,  but if it's a good one, I would order more for sure. The quality is there, and again, just cute cute cute. Many uses. The only reason I deducted a star was for the misunderstanding of what I thought I was getting (colored) versus what I got (clear). It in no way reflects quality. Quality and usefulness would definitely recieve a 5 star rating.

source_doc: Nice! Recommended. This product was not the brand I thought I ordered but it is the same style and string number and I like it very well. Looks like the above picture of Byla 27-string lyre harp with accessories. I could not tune the strings as noted above the tuning pegs because they got too tight toward the high end, but I added an F# after every F and that has worked out very nicely for me. I play hymns and have used the F# strings for several hymns that I would not otherwise be able to play. With the F#s added, it has been very easy to tune. It is a lovely instrument and has good sound. I used sharpie markers to color code my tuning pegs and strings. I tried several other lyre harps before this one, but this is the one I really like. Glad I bought it. Shipping took a bit longer, but the seller contacted me about that through Amazon and I was willing to wait for it.

source_doc: I just wanted it to tell time with a red display. The first one I got was defective. It would not power on when plugged in. I returned it without issue and was sent a replacement. Second one was just fine. Simple to set time, I like that it has a red display. It isn’t too large but still able to see it from across the room. I purchased it so I could tell what the time was in the middle of the night without having to turn on a light or expose myself to blue light. I have a very difficult time sleeping and any other color display would be too stimulating and keep me from sleeping. I have to take medication at particular times during the night. I don’t use the alarm function but I do like that if I needed to, it has the ability to have a softer or louder alarm option. It also has a battery backup option. Simple, effective at telling time without being too bright or stimulating in the middle of the night. Bonus, my husband can see the time without looking at his phone and lighting up our bedroom. So nice not to have that happening anymore. Hopefully it lasts a long time.

source_doc: Bought for dog chew toy. I have a Australian Cattle Dog AKA "Blue Healer" puppy we got a couple months ago. He will shred through any dollar store toy you give him in a matter of days and I had read another person's review with the same kind of dog that he gave his dog a broken Diaphragm and the dog has been chewing it for over 10 years so for $8 bucks I think it was when I bought it, I said what the heck.Got the thing in the mail and the first thing I noticed was that it gets stuck because of the shape of it if lands with the round part up instead of landing like a dish shape with the edge accessible so I cut it in half and gave half of it to my Father In Law for his dog. So far they both love them and even after ripping and shredding at it, my healer hasn't even scratched it now after weeks of use and seems to really like it I assume because it's similar feeling to flesh. Anyway for the price and what I bought it for it's a great deal. Not sure how it'd be for it's designated use since I have nothing to test it for in that regard but it is heavy duty so I would imagine it would work well for that as well.

source_doc: Woks well for fine, straight hair. This is one of the better hair masks that I've found at this price point for my super fine, straight hair. While I wouldn't say it makes a hugely dramatic impact, it's noticeably stronger than regular conditioner. It adds a bit of shine, detangles, and makes my hair more manageable overall. I really struggle with volume, so the fact that this smoothes without flattening is a huge win for me. I also like that I can see its benefits while sticking to my extremely basic hair care routine. I use my normal shampoo and conditioner beforehand and simply comb and air dry afterwards.It does work a bit slower than similar treatments I've used, so I always make sure to thoroughly saturate my hair and leave it on for at least 7 minutes. If I rinse it much sooner, I don't notice the full effects. A little goes a long way though. I start with a small glob to avoid wasting it and usually add a little extra to my ends, as they tend to dry out. It doesn't magically fix split ends, but they do seem to occur less often when I use this mask a few times a week. One tub lasts me several months that way. I think it's a good value overall and will continue purchasing it!
hypos: Хорошо подходит для тонких, прямых волос. Это одна из лучших масок для волос, которые я нашел/шла в этой ценовой категории для моих супертонких, прямых волос. Хотя я бы не сказал/а, что она дает колоссальный эффект, она заметно сильнее обычного кондиционера. Она добавляет немного блеска, облегчает расчесывание и делает мои волосы более послушными в целом. Я очень борюсь за объем, поэтому тот факт, что это средство разглаживает волосы, не лишая их объема, — огромная победа для меня. Мне также нравится, что я вижу эффект от нее, придерживаясь своего крайне простого ухода за волосами. Перед этим я использую свой обычный шампунь и кондиционер, а после — просто расчесываю волосы и сушу их естественным путем. Она действует немного медленнее, чем аналогичные средства, которыми я пользовался/лась, поэтому я всегда тщательно пропитываю волосы и оставляю ее как минимум на 7 минут. Если я смываю ее гораздо раньше, то не замечаю полного эффекта. При этом расходуется она очень экономично. Я начинаю с небольшой капли, чтобы не тратить средство впустую, и обычно наношу чуть больше на кончики, так как они склонны к сухости. Она не избавляет волшебным образом от секущихся кончиков, но они, похоже, появляются реже, когда я использую эту маску несколько раз в неделю. При таком использовании одной баночки мне хватает на несколько месяцев. В целом, я считаю, что это выгодная покупка, и буду продолжать ее приобретать!

source_doc: My cats love this bed! I just ordered 2 more! The bed arrived in great condition and was easy to fluff up. My cat immediately left her old bed and climbed into this one. I just ordered one more in the 20 inch size so the cats don't have to share, and one in the 24 inch sized for my dogs - 2 chihuahuas that snuggle together. source_doc: It works fast!! Awesome product. My dog had these raw dark splotches in the creases by her legs. She was constantly licking. It was driving me crazy, plus making her miserable! I already had her on allergy supplements,  so I tried mixing organic coconut oil in her dry food. And putting pure aloe gel on those areas. All she did was want to lick it off(aloe is non-toxic but still). I also started bathing her weekly myself with an antifungal shampoo. But I think it's because of having the heat on, and blankets and the creases are where she sweats(I assume). Or air doesn't get to that area enough. I ordered this stuff as a last resort before a costly vet bill, and I was floored. Not only does it smell great, immediately after spraying those areas, I could tell she felt immediate relief!! She has never once even tried to lick the area. She doesnt like me fussing over her, but when I go to spray her, she pulls her leg back so I can get to it better!! lol which tells me she knows it is helping. I've only used it for 3 days. One side has cleared about 70%, the other about 50%. She is no longer miserable, she's back to playing. And I'm only on day 3 twice a day. Pretty amazing. I'm so thankful that I found this, I immediately just ordered more. Game changer!!!

source_doc: A complete waste of time and money!! Do yourself a favor and look at other tankless rv units by OTHER manufacturers! The listing says that it will fit and opening but this is false! I originally purchased this to go in a travel trailer but it was entirely too small to fit in the opening. I never installed it but decided to hold on to it for my next RV. I recently purchased another RV and the existing water heater was shot so I got this unit out and placed it in the RV. The first time that I used it, it worked great!! I was pleased. The next morning when I tried to do dishes I kept getting an error code and the hot water would immediately shut down. source_doc: Nice!! This is my first experience with a pet water fountain. At first I was unsure where the cord went because it didn't really show it with part in the water. But I figured it out. It's very sleek and looks perfect where I have if. Luckily there was an outlet where the animals eat anyhow. It's quiet and the little fountain goes along keeping the water fresh. I haven't caught our cats drinking it but my dog really drank! I did have to find a spare bathroom rug and I put the cat food bowl, dog food, and the fountain on it. I found my dog dripped water more than usually drinking from this fountain. One more thing, I used half cold water from our fridge dispenser and half from the faucet. I was very surprised that, about 5 hours later, the water still seemed pretty chilled, which is nice. It isn't stainless steel or anything so I am not sure how it maintained its temp but I am glad.I looked at several water fountains and landed on this especially because it had a viewing area to see the level of the water. Again, I am very impressed with this little machine!

I think the price of this supplement might be a little high, but with the quality ingredients used in this product and how well it works, I think it’s worth it. source_doc: Nice, but I don't feel like it cleans my teeth as well. I had a really nice electric toothbrush, but it stopped working. I decided to give this one a try. I have super sensitive teeth, so the different vibrations of this one bothered me at first. I guess I've gotten used to it now, though. The bristles are super soft, which I think I like. I don't feel like it cleans my teeth as well as my old one, though. I've had to use this one longer at a time to make up for it, and hope that it doesn't make me end up with cavities. I brush well at least twice a day, floss at least once a day, use a flouride mouthwash every night, and go for my cleanings every 6 months. (I'm also careful with sugar and take vitamins.) Cavities are still a struggle for me, so I don't know if I'll keep using this toothbrush and take the risk. If I didn't have to be so careful with my teeth, I'd be happy with it, though. It works well otherwise and it looks nice and durable. I also love that it comes with 8 replacement heads. Those can get expensive with other brands.

source_doc: What is going on with these keyboards? My daughter got one of these keyboards for Christmas. The 1st keyboard we had types randomly into text boxes on the screen. Just random characters. It was freaking them out so I contacted the mfgr. They said that I should update the software. I downloaded the tool to do so, but it's all in Chinese (I assume)? I don't know which button is update and which button is identify but I poke around and figure it out. The SUCCESS/FAIL text box is also not in English so I don't know the status and the window doesn't close. Either way, nothing fixes it. The company sends out a new keyboard and this one turns off randomly while in use. Since this is a gaming keyboard, you KNOW that can't happen, or GAME OVER. They suggested I update the software, but we had already plugged in the old keyboard in the meantime. I finally get the chance to do that and now the thing is dead. Like dead dead. I plug it into another computer, still won't light up. Uninstall/Reinstall/Repair/Update software, hardware (in DevMgr), restart over and over and over...and nothing. Now it's just a brick. Guess we're stuck with the ghost keyboard. Side note: Customer service was responsive in their attempt to help, but they couldn't solve the problem. Ended up offering a $20 credit, but I didn't purchase it, so that didn't make sense. I just want something that works!
hypos: Что вообще происходит с этими клавиатурами? Моя дочь получила одну из таких клавиатур на Рождество. 1-я клавиатура, которая у нас была, хаотично вводит символы в текстовые поля на экране. Просто случайные символы. Это их жутко пугало, поэтому я связался/лась с производителем. Они сказали, что мне нужно обновить программное обеспечение. Я скачал/а утилиту для этого, но она вся на китайском (я так предполагаю)? Я не знаю, какая кнопка означает «обновить», а какая — «определить», но я потыкал/а наобум и разобрался/лась. Текстовое поле с результатом «УСПЕХ/ОШИБКА» тоже не на английском, так что я не знаю статус, а окно не закрывается. В любом случае, ничего не помогло. Компания присылает новую клавиатуру, и эта произвольно отключается во время использования. Поскольку это игровая клавиатура, вы ПОНИМАЕТЕ, что такого происходить не должно, иначе это КОНЕЦ ИГРЫ. Они предложили мне обновить ПО, но тем временем мы уже подключили старую клавиатуру. Наконец-то у меня появилась возможность сделать это, и теперь эта штука мертва. Прямо совсем мертва. Я подключаю её к другому компьютеру, она всё равно не светится. Удаление/переустановка/восстановление/обновление ПО, оборудования (в Диспетчере устройств), перезагрузка снова, снова и снова... и ничего. Теперь это просто кирпич. source_doc: Love the Zero Water concept; Filter Quality Control Is A Problem. Normally I try to be positive with my reviews of products, however with these replacement Zero Water filters it is a struggle. Love the 23 cup Zero Water I purchased. The  original Filter that came with the dispenser worked perfect. Came time to replace the filter, I purchased the 6 pack, (I was committed). First filter I tried I let set overnight to give it "a chance". Next morning, no filtered water, surprise, surprise. Opened a second filter and installed it. Fourteen hours later I had 8 cups of water. 2 for 2 bad. Too late smart, I looked on the web for other people having a similar experience. I found I was not alone, in fact I was one of many, many people experiencing quality issues with the Zero Water filters. Since I purchased them as a 6 box set, I have to return them as a set. I can't begin to tell you how disappointed I am with this whole experience. And by the way, they were original equipment manufacturer with the name proudly emblazoned on the side. Love/hate, you have to be ready for a measure of both with this product.

source_doc: I wonder about the quality. The connector should work ok for lighter duty applications.  I dont think I would use it on a car or truck.  The contact surface at the base of the black knob is nowhere near the contact surface of the battery post connector, although it is about the same as where you would connect the cable.  the connector is two parts with just a plastic bushing/insulator between the two parts.  I was able to move the two parts some, but did not try and seperate them, but I think I could if i used more pressure.  The square headed bolt is too small to self hold as it is designed to, or the ridge designed to hold the flat side of the bolt is to far away.  The square head will spin and not hold against the flat side as you can see in the pictures.  The unit does appear to be brass or at least a brass alloy.  I did file a small amout off one edge and got the same color underneath.  The cable connector end has a short area with threads but I tried the clamp bolt in there and it fit but was a really sloppy fit.  When I install the switch I will most likely drill out those threads and just clamp the battery cable eyelet with a bolt and nut.

source_doc: Had a horrific allergic reaction - swollen eyes, teary… Is this even FDA approved?? I had a terrible allergic reaction to this product - and I even wore gloves the whole time I was handling it! My eyes were so swollen I debated going to the ER but I decided to take some Benadryl and wait it out (after I tossed the cleaning gel in the trash!) I was feeling better the next morning, thankfully, but the ordeal made me realize that I have no idea what is in this stuff or if any of it is toxic. It reminded me of the slime my daughter used to make in elementary school (if not identical.) Some of those recipes use Borax, which is indeed toxic, so perhaps that is what I reacted to… It did a great job cleaning some used camera gear I was prepping to trade in though, I have to say… Next time though, I will look up a recipe for nontoxic slime instead.

source_doc: I actually doubted I would like this but I do! I have neck problems and had surgery for scoliosis many years back. I still sometimes sleep with my arm underneath while I'm on my side. That's still pretty comfy but I'm trying to get myself to be mostly on my back 🤦‍♀️

source_doc: Mind blown. These were easy to get setup. Fill water to the fill line then drop one of the tubes in and stick the sprayer in and twist tight until you hear it click. It's fun to watch the concentrate go in the water. Each one has its own scent and are for certain areas and materials. It suggests spraying the soiled areas and let them soak for 10 minutes. Then I take the color coordinated cloths that came with them and wipe up the mess. It literally works really well. So far I've used the kitchen one my countertop. I purposely left my cupcake mess from the night before and just cleaned it and I could not believe how easy it was to wipe off( and there was hard frosting on there). Then I used the glass and sprayed the mirrors. I've always used a foam and paper towels but I used the cloth and I seriously couldn't believe it. There were NO streaks and I didn't have to go back over the areas. The last one I used tonight was the shower. I didn't go all gung-ho on the shower but I sprayed it on some areas that get build up quite often and let it sit for a little bit. Again, I couldn't believe how easy the grossness comes off. Tomorrow I'm tackling the bathroom with a blacklight and will update with video!
hypos: В полном восторге. Их было легко настроить. Налейте воду до линии наполнения, затем опустите одну из капсул, вставьте распылитель и плотно закрутите до щелчка. Забавно наблюдать, как концентрат растворяется в воде. У каждого средства свой запах, и они предназначены для определенных зон и материалов. Рекомендуется распылить средство на загрязненные участки и оставить на 10 минут. Затем я беру подходящие по цвету салфетки, которые шли в комплекте, и вытираю грязь. Это буквально работает очень хорошо. На данный момент я использовал/а средство для кухни на своей столешнице. Я специально оставил/а грязь от капкейков с прошлого вечера и только что убрал/а ее, и просто не мог/ла поверить, как легко все оттерлось (а там была засохшая глазурь). Затем я взял/а средство для стекол и разбрызгал/а на зеркала. Я всегда использовал/а пену и бумажные полотенца, но тут использовал/а салфетку, и я, серьезно, не мог/ла в это поверить. Не осталось НИКАКИХ разводов, и мне не пришлось протирать эти места снова. Последнее средство, которое я опробовал/а сегодня вечером, было для душевой. Я не стал/а усердствовать на всю душевую, а просто распылил/а его на некоторые участки, где часто образуется налет, и оставил/а на некоторое время. Опять же, я не мог/ла поверить, как легко отходит вся эта грязь. Завтра я займусь ванной комнатой с ультрафиолетовым фонариком и выложу обновление с видео!

source_doc: Good product for my dogs. First I want to start by saying that I tought this was CBD, I didn't know hemp is a bit different. I still don't fully get it. Before I was giving my elderly dog CBD tincture from med terra, but 1oz is about $28 plus tax and shipping. Expensive! I decided to give this a try but did wonder why it was so cheap. Anyway, my dogs dont mind it as I put it on their food. It has helped my elderly dog with her anxiety as she is blind and has gotten very anxious. I am giving it to all my dogs daily and I see they sleep better and are more calmed as my babies tend to be anxious and have lots of separation anxiety. My elderly dog has Glaucoma and although it is a condition the vet will most likely need to remove the eye. I noticed that upon giving her the hemp oil, the inflammation of the eye has reduced a lot. I don't know if its helping the pain as my dog can't tell me but I definitely noticed her eye that was about to pop, did sink down a lot. Meanwhile I save for the very expensive eye removal. source_doc: SMELLS SO BAD, that’s the only flaw. I bought this car seat because after getting in an accident, I realized I wanted the most safe infant car seat I could find, rather than my previous cheap one with very little padding, that easily pops out of the base. So I got this MaxiCosi after talking with several friends about their favorite brands, and I love everything about it EXCEPT the smell, oh my gosh it is so strong smelling of chemicals, almost a burning plastic type smell, and it makes my baby and her clothes stink so much I bathe her and wash the clothes first thing when we get home. I’m grateful for the extra padding, and that it’s still in a great price range (on the higher end though), but please be aware even after washing & then soaking the car seat fabric parts in borax, it will still be overwhelmingly strong. I also used my Bissell fabric cleaning machine and it still smells… just an FYI, maybe not all of them are like that and I got a defective one, I’m not sure, but if I didn’t absolutely need to have a good car seat in my car right now, I would return it.

source_doc: How the...I LOVE IT. I LOVE IT. Basically, I have 5 tanks and at first was using really amazing usb pumps. They work great but after getting my 3rd tank and then a hospital tank and plant tank... so yeah... Here I am.Pros:- Can be used on 4 tanks and you can control the air flow for each one without it making the strength more/less on a different tank.- Pretty Quiet! I have my tanks in my living room and I don't hear it. I can hear the clicking on my keyboard more than the pump.- Easy to set up, comes with some airline tubing, and I just cut a bit and worked like a charm. Can't speak for the quality or longevity, but free anything is a plus nowadays.-Easy to hide in with the rest of my fish messCons:- Can get hot (but not hot to where I'm concerned though we shall see how it holds up)*will update if I have other issues*Overall - At the $39 I love it. Wish it came in black so I could hide it better but honestly I don't care. If I get more tanks I'll probably end up buying another.

source_doc: I'm impressed ! Honestly I was a bit skeptical when I bought it but I am pleasantly surprised.  It feels very sturdy !  I like how you can rotate the brush head. The padded grip is pretty nice.  The main bar is metal, then there is a plastic brush head and a plastic that clips on each end with a sliding pin system. The plastic feels pretty heavy as well as main metal piece. The scraper head is nothing special but I think it will work just fine.  It's not looking like I'm going to get to use this ice a rapper this year as I ordered it late in the season but my old one just recently broke.  It didn't help that it took 3 weeks to get here but that's not the seller's fault. Amazon was the shipper so I had to wait a week before they even shipped it, then I'm not sure what the hold up was w the shipping company. At some point they passed it off to USPS.  I have no clue why.  Anyways I honestly was impressed when I put it together, it has a good comfortable, sturdy feel to it.  It's pretty cool for as far as I've scrapers go I guess lol

source_doc: Day 3 and I am Hopefull. I was skeptical because for a year, nothing had worked except LOTS of medication to control the pain from the herniated disc that was causing severe sciatic pain. I have spent hundreds of dollars on pillows, creams, braces, etc and nothing has worked out.I see this on here and I decide to give it a chance. I figure if it didn't work, I'll send the sucker back. I put it together and use it for a few minutes and almost immediately, the pain was less. I do it again a couple of times the same day for just a few minutes. With each time, the pain was less and less. By the second day, I only took the Meloxicam and had alomost no pain through the day. I used it twice the next day and I had no pain. Day 3, I am not even taking the Meloxicam and I am having no pain. I am NOT saying to stop your medications! Do what your doctor says but I personally think that this is worth a try if you can afford it. It doesn't have to be this brand. There are cheaper and conversely, more expensive versions, but this partiicular one is sturdy and does what it says (for me anyway).

source_doc: If you put together many items, this is a great addition to your toolbox. I have a couple of wrenches - ratcheting ones - that I have used to hold nuts in place while screwing bolts down tight.  I mean, if you have ever bought "easy to assemble" furniture, you have probably cursed halfway through and wanted to throw the mess in the dumpster, right?  They give you this cheap-o "wrench" to hold the nut while you wrestle with a single "stick" Allen wrench to tighten the bolt.  That is WHY I have this set!  I throw out the "helpful" tools the manufacturer sends with their chair/table (whatever).  I have a drill with hex bits and this ratcheting wrench set - it shaves about half the time to put the item together, for real!  The last set I put together was a gliding outdoor chair that I love, but had I used the included items, I know putting the glider chair together would have taken me at least 4 hours to complete.  I believe it took me just under 2 hours (reading, checking, then doing) to complete the chair and with this wrench set holding the nuts while the drill tightened the hex-head bolts, I finished with no cursing at all!  Woo-hoo!  Thank you drill and ratcheting wrenches for that!  The heads included should help with most of the items you will encounter in household item builds and for me, that's enough!
hypos: Если вы часто собираете мебель или технику, это отличное дополнение к вашему набору инструментов. У меня есть пара ключей — накидных трещоточных, — которые я использовал/а для удержания гаек на месте при плотном затягивании болтов. Я имею в виду, если вы когда-либо покупали мебель «легкой сборки», вы, вероятно, матерились на середине пути и хотели выбросить весь этот хлам в мусорный контейнер, верно? Вам дают этот дешевенький «ключ», чтобы держать гайку, пока вы боретесь с одним лишь Г-образным шестигранным ключом-«палкой», чтобы затянуть болт. Вот ПОЧЕМУ у меня есть этот набор! Я выбрасываю «полезные» инструменты, которые производитель присылает со своим стулом/столом (или чем угодно). У меня есть дрель с шестигранными битами и этот набор трещоточных ключей — это сокращает время сборки изделия примерно вдвое, серьезно! Последнее, что я собирал/а, — это полюбившееся мне уличное кресло-качалка, но если бы я использовал/а входящие в комплект инструменты, я знаю, что сборка этого кресла заняла бы у меня не менее 4 часов. Думаю, у меня ушло чуть меньше 2 часов (чтение инструкции, проверка, затем сборка), чтобы закончить кресло, и благодаря этому набору ключей, удерживающему гайки, пока дрель затягивала болты с шестигранной головкой, я закончил/а вообще без мата! Ура! Спасибо за это дрели и трещоточным ключам! Входящие в комплект головки должны помочь с большинством крепежей, которые встретятся вам при сборке бытовых предметов, и лично мне этого вполне достаточно!

source_doc: Skeptical at first, but I will not play without them again! I had just seen these grips on social media when a friend who had a set  recommended I give them a try. I was skeptical at first, but after my first three-hour gaming session, I will never play without them again.I play Fortnite almost every night, often for a few hours at a time. Usually my hands get sweaty after about an hour or so, but that did not happen with c2 Gripz, even after three hours. I bought the mediums, and my hands fit perfectly around the contoured grooves. This helped separate my fingers and naturally placed my hand over the controller. The ridge at the bottom gave my fingers support and being above the controller also gave me better control.I have also noticed less strain on my hands after long gaming sessions. I have carpal tunnel, so sometimes I get flare ups during longer sessions, but I have noticed a big improvement with less strain on my hands and forearms since using C2 Gripz.I have been using them for almost two months, and I will never play without C2 Gripz again. Oh yeah! As a bonus, I like how the controller can stand on its own because of the base of the gripz. This is a perfect added feature for people who like to use their controller as a tv remote. I highly recommend this product 10/10.

source_doc: Not a lot of head pressure. I use this to pump diesel out of canisters into my car. I was hoping that I would be able to place the canisters on the ground and simply pump into the car, which is not very far up. I have been using a siphon, and I wanted a setup that was a little cleaner. To make sure that I had maximum power coming from D cell batteries, I also ordered a set of rechargeable lithium d cells to go with this. The pump does work, but don't have any high expectations for flow rates. If I have the container on the ground and I am filling to a fuel cap near my waist, the flow rate at max is barely more than a trickle. However, lifting the source canister up two or three feet brought the flow to a satisfactory level. Ultimately, I decided to place the canisters on the roof of the car, as I had done with the siphon. That works very well but if the pump falls out of the canister, it can be a bit messy, which is what I was trying to avoid. It is a very slick product, but needs a larger pump or more power.
hypos: Не очень большой напор. Я использую этот насос, чтобы перекачивать дизельное топливо из канистр в машину. Я надеялся/лась, что смогу поставить канистры на землю и просто закачивать топливо в машину, которая находится не очень высоко. До этого я использовал/а сифон и хотел/а получить более чистый процесс. Чтобы обеспечить максимальную мощность от батареек типа D, я также заказал/а в комплекте перезаряжаемые литиевые батарейки этого типа. Насос работает, но не стоит ожидать высокой скорости потока. Если канистра стоит на земле, а я заправляю бак, горловина которого находится на уровне моей талии, скорость потока на максимуме едва превышает струйку. Однако подъем исходной канистры на две или три ступни вверх довел поток до удовлетворительного уровня. В конце концов я решил/а ставить канистры на крышу машины, как делал/а это с сифоном. Это работает очень хорошо, но если насос выпадет из канистры, все может испачкаться, а ведь именно этого я и пытался/лась избежать. Это очень классный прибор, но ему нужен насос побольше или больше мощности.

Чтобы выжать максимум мощности из батареек типа D, я также заказал/а к нему комплект литиевых аккумуляторных батареек D-типа. Однако, стоило приподнять канистру-источник на два-три фута, как напор стал вполне удовлетворительным. В итоге я решил/а ставить канистры на крышу машины, как делал/а это и с сифоном. source_doc: It seems to do the job well... I have an existing pedal board powered by Zuma Strymon; I am using this Strich to power the pedals I have in my studio (that are not on the pedal board.)  I am not an electrical engineer, yet I do know the differences between 110v and 220v - how can this pedal supply automatically differentiate the two?  There are no switches to for this setting.  Additionally, I do have one 24v pedal for this power supplier; I must plug in the 24v's transformer into the polarized outlets on the top of this unit.  So far, so good, but...This unit is very light in weight, yet every output had an independent kill-switch to prevent overload.  The outlets on top can power up to a 600v demand. source_doc: Color not the same as description. This does work great for storing a carseat and holds our Graco infant to toddler one perfect. The straps also make it easy to use for traveling or anywhere you need to bring it with you. Having said that, I almost removed a star because the color I recieved is purple, but not dark like I thought it would be. I specifically chose this one for the color, and had I known it would be this light, I would have gotten a black one instead.  For me, this matters as a someone who chooses things by specific colors a lot.  I wanted it to match another item, and it does not. Having said that, I am still happy with the quality of this, and it will definitely still get used. But I struggled to give a full 5 stars for something I was harshly disappointed with when I initially opened. The good thing is, it is super easy to put the carseat in and take it out as well. Other than the color being different, it really has no other issues. I added a photo of what I expected so you can see what I mean on the color difference.

source_doc: Works The Best Of Anything I've Ever Used. I have very calloused feet from wearing flipflops all the time.  My heels are always pretty rough. I have tried lots of methods to get my feet smooth, and I have to say, this glass foot file is amazing!  I used it at the end of my shower, when my skin had softened up.  I soaped up my foot, used the coarse side first, then finished up with the smoother side.  It made my feet really smooth, really quickly.  It works much better than my rechargeable rotary foot file.  I like that you don't have to charge it.  The one I had that you had to charge always seemed to be not sitting just right on the charger and then it wouldn't work when you went to use it.  It is a little big and bulky, but I just put it in the cabinet when I'm not planning on using it.  When I plan on using it, I put the stand right next to the tub on the floor.  The stand seems a little rickety, and I don't want it to tip over and scratch my tub.  The file is quite coarse on one side, and I'm afraid it would leave scratches.  This works the best of anything I have ever used to smooth my feet.  I highly recommend it.  It seems like it will last for a long time too.

source_doc: Great for Gross Garden Feet! I take baths instead of showers, and I just never cared for bath mats. But when I saw this one is machine washable and has the foot massage nubs and rectangular soft nubby foot-cleaning area, I decided to get it. I work out in the garden a lot, sometimes in clogs that get red-clay muddy (along with my feet!) and sometimes barefooted (even worse), and I can't believe how easy it is to just run a little water into the tub, sit on the side, and scrub/clean/massage my feet. I don't even have to take my clothes off. Easy to drain and rinse off with a sprayer, and then I can fill the tub with water and epsom salts for a nice soothing soak. I even enjoy the feel of the nubs on my butt! LOL! It remains to be seen if this will stain from red clay over time and not come clean, but I don't care about that. I'm the only one who has to look at it.Be sure to follow the directions for flattening it and sticking it down. I put mine on the bathroom floor with a bottle of vinegar on top of the most-curled end for a day or so before using. If you have a smooth floor, you could even use it as a floor mat in front of your toilet so you can massage your feet every time you have to go.
hypos: Отлично подходит для грязных садовых ног! Я принимаю ванну вместо душа и никогда особо не любил/а коврики для ванной. Но когда я увидел/а, что этот коврик можно стирать в машине, и что на нем есть массажные пупырышки и прямоугольная мягкая текстурированная зона для мытья ног, я решил/а его приобрести. Я много работаю в саду, иногда в сабо, которые покрываются грязью из красной глины (вместе с моими ногами!), а иногда босиком (что еще хуже), и я поверить не могу, насколько это просто — набрать немного воды в ванну, сесть на край и потереть/очистить/помассировать ноги. Мне даже не нужно снимать одежду. Его легко осушить и ополоснуть из душа, а затем я могу наполнить ванну водой с английской солью для приятного успокаивающего расслабления. Мне даже нравятся ощущения от пупырышек под попой! Ха-ха! Время покажет, окрасится ли он со временем от красной глины и перестанет ли отмываться, но мне все равно. Я единственный/ая, кому приходится на него смотреть. Обязательно следуйте инструкциям, чтобы распрямить его и прикрепить. Я положил/а свой коврик на пол в ванной, поставив бутылку уксуса на самый загнутый край примерно на день перед использованием. Если у вас гладкий пол, вы даже можете использовать его как коврик перед унитазом, чтобы массировать ноги каждый раз, когда вам нужно отойти.

source_doc: Silky finish, covers decent. It was hard for me to get a clear picture, of the difference but this works just like mixing your foundation with lotion. It has a nice silky feel after, but it covers better, and without making the fine lines pop out worse. I only used one squirt and it was enough to do my whole face. It is a little on the pale side, but i honestly could mix this with a darker shade of foundation and I think I'd be just fine. I was pleasantly surprised at the coverage and the overall ease of application. I literally just rubbed it on like I would sunscreen and i did not need to do anything else. If I took the time to apply it, I think it would look even nicer and I would be even happier. This is definitely a brand I personally would be interested in seeing what other products they have, because I was immediately impressed with this, and I usually can not say that when trying new products. I am extremely happy with this, and definitely will be ordering more when this bottle is gone. Took a photo of the color it is, as that was a question I had  before ordering. Hope it helps.

If I buy another sequoia I will buy this air spring delete instead of working on the air suspension every 6 months.

source_doc: Skunk odor shampoo. This product did not work. It was night of course when my dog got sprayed by a skunk. I did not have this shampoo,  so I did a quick Google search on how to remove the skunk smell. It was recommend to use peroxide,  baking soda and a drop of dish soap. I left my dog outside,  and grabbed a bucket. I quickly mixed solution in a bucket and grabbed a rag. I gave my dog a sponge bath outside with this solution. I left it on for about 15 minutes and  then brought her inside to shower to rinse off. I applied some conditioner,  then gave her another good rinse. It really worked well. I could barely smell any odor. I then ordered this shampoo. I received it 2 days later. I gave my dog a bath again using the shampoo straight from the bottle on dry coat, I then added water and began lathering it up well. I let it sit on for 10-15 minutes. She now smells like a skunk again,  I was very disappointed,  I am returning the shampoo,  waste of time and money.

source_doc: Very useful and best of all, small and light. Talk about timing, this battery came just in time for when I was due in a VR meeting and I forgot to charge the headset.  The battery fastens very easily to the side of the headstrap, but I wonder how long the battery strap will last.  I pulled it tight to prevent sagging, and it seemed like I might stretch out the strap holes and eventually it might break apart.  Aside from that, the battery worked perfectly.  I was in VR for two hours using this battery, but I will say that I think it charged my HMD very slowly.  I didn't think to look at the battery status until it had 94%, and it seemed like it took forever to get to 100%.  Then again, I was using it at the same time so maybe that's normal.This battery is light and small, much unlike the 3rd party batteries that I used to have to wear for the Quest 1.  I would highly recommend this battery to anyone who needs one for their headset.

source_doc: Worth every penny. I was skeptical that this would work as well as people have said but we had a small grease fire and I decided to give it a try since entering else had cleaned the stove very well. I had read it is best to smear it on and let it sit for a few minutes before scrubbing so I smeared it all over the stove and under the lid making it really thick in the bad areas. Almost everything wiped clean and I only needed a little elbow grease in a couple spots. Even the spots I had to scrub didn't need much effort. As you can see in the pictures that the stove is spotless! Next came the metal drip pan under the burner that caught fire. Included is a before and after picture. I did two rounds of smearing it on, letting it sit for about 5 minutes and scrubbing. As you can see it cleaned most of the burn off! I am amazed. Im sure if I continued a couple more times it would have removed the remainder (but honestly this was good enough for me as im going to cover it with foil anyway). I am amazed and highly recommend this for the tough jobs! Oh also, I didn't notice a strong offensive scent and I was elbows deep in this stuff.

source_doc: A game changer for hunting. I used to talk smack on hunting accessories like this, but now I am older and wiser and want to take ethical long distance shots more often that free hand. I haven't used this to reach way out and hit targets, but I did use it in a stand to take a fox this year. The shot was about 90 yards with a 17 WSM. Could I have done it free hand? Most likely. Was I more confident in my shot placing with this stick? You're darn right.It makes a little bit of noise when adjusting the height with the thumb button. I plan on doing a light disassembly and lubing up the spring inside. Either way, it barely makes any noise. It may scare a deer that's less that 15 yards out, but they normally don't get a chance to get that close to me, so it doesn't affect my hunt at all.I sit in a chair, I am 6'3" and the stick has plenty of adjustability to meet my needs. I have not tried adjusting it to full length to see if I can use it comfortably standing. When I have used it out walking, I just kneel and adjust the stick with the thumb button accordingly.If you are looking for a solid rest that packs down tight, this should fit your needs.

source_doc: So perfect, except.. I love so many things about this bag, but I didn’t end up keeping it because while it is beautiful and functional, I don’t feel like it will stay beautiful for long haha. The inside is a white satin - so pretty - but I have a 3 yo and 1 yo and my diaper bag is regularly filled with crumbs and wrappers and other things they throw in there on occasion, but to keep it short, I don’t want to stress about my beauty diaper bag getting dirty when it is my messiest season of life.Here are some things I absolutely loves though:- so pretty, obviously- so functional. I LOVE the inside space and how easy it is to see everything. I wish so much I could duplicate it on a less luxury bag lol- the hidden magnetic closure on the side pockets to keep them minimal when you’re not using them- the little front pocket for easy access to my keys/phone, though the opening kind of tight and hard to get intoOverall I love it, so much. But I can’t justify the spending for something that will ultimately be more or less trashed by the season of life that I’m in, and I don’t want to be stressin about the appearance of the inside of my diaper bag lol. hopefully one day I can come back for it :)

source_doc: Great for reptile enclosure!! I got this lock for a 4x2x2 Dubia reptile enclosure for my Uromastyx. She does a lot of window surfing and I wanted to be sure she couldn't slide it open and get out. I also wanted peace of mind to prevent me from leaving the enclosure open. It was very simple to install. My husband screwed it on for me while I held it in place. Probably don't even need two people to do it. I just wanted to make sure it was exactly where I wanted it placed. It comes when two keys. We just leave the keys in it at all times. We don't have children in the home so don't need to worry about that. The price is great. I had seen some locks that were cheaper, but went with this one because I read a review stating it was longer. I keep it all the way to the last locking point. So even if the enclosure gets opened, my Uro can't get out. I have made a routine so that once I finish spot cleaning or feeding, I put the lock back on ASAP. So no more being at work suddenly wondering did I close it all the way. I would get this again. If I get another Uromastyx I will get this lock.

source_doc: Comfortable. I am not a woman of color and have very fine hair, but I do have issues with keeping my hair out of the way at night. I usually put it in a topknot when I go to sleep so I don't roll over and pull it. That has a couple issues - the hair band slipping and sleeping with a hard bump under my head, and putting ponytail ridges in my hair. I also thought I'd get this for my daughter who has long, curly, thick, red hair that is often dry and frizzy. I had heard that bonnets help keep your hair moisturized so I thought between us we'd give it a try.The bonnet is comfortable and the band is not constricting. It is easy to put on. Maybe because my hair is so fine it didn't stay on all night, but it seems that it was on most of the night. (when I woke up in the middle of the night it was still on). My hair feels soft and not dry, so I'll try it again. I couldn't get my teen daughter to try it, though I think it would be helpful for her hair and I'll keep trying. My other daughter tried it and she recommends it highly for keeping the cat from chewing on her hair every night!
hypos: Удобно. Я не цветная женщина, и у меня очень тонкие волосы, но у меня действительно есть проблемы с тем, чтобы убирать волосы на ночь. Обычно перед сном я завязываю их в пучок на макушке, чтобы не ложиться на них и не тянуть. С этим связано пара проблем: резинка сползает, приходится спать с жесткой шишкой под головой, а на волосах остаются заломы от хвоста. Я также подумал/а, что куплю этот чепчик для своей дочери, у которой длинные, кудрявые, густые рыжие волосы, часто сухие и пушащиеся. Я слышал/а, что чепчики помогают удерживать влагу в волосах, поэтому подумал/а, что мы обе попробуем его. Чепчик удобный, а резинка не сдавливает. Его легко надевать. Возможно, из-за того, что мои волосы очень тонкие, он не продержался всю ночь, но, похоже, большую часть ночи он был на мне (когда я проснулся/лась посреди ночи, он все еще был на голове). Мои волосы мягкие и не сухие, так что я попробую еще раз. Мне не удалось уговорить свою дочь-подростка примерить его, хотя я думаю, что он был бы полезен для ее волос, и я буду продолжать попытки. Моя другая дочь попробовала его, и она очень рекомендует его для того, чтобы кошка не грызла ее волосы каждую ночь!

source_doc: Not Worth Purchasing. I am a 52 year old hobby drummer and am not a rough player. I figured these would be cheap but thought that with my easy playing they would be good enough to last a year and save the $20-$25 for Vic Firth Rute's or Promark Hot Rods. I sent these back after playing with them 3x. The first time I used them I noticed after about 10 minutes that the rods started coming out. I would push them back down but then they were uneven. Play a little more and push them down. It only became worse with each time playing so I sent them back.The rods themselves seemed just as durable as the more expensive ones but I will never know for sure since I returned them. All they have to do is put some glue in the end piece before putting it on and the rods would stay in place. I have had a pair of VF Rute 606's for over a year and they are still going strong. The rods have never moved and they show only a little wear. The ends are spreading out some but it just makes them quieter. I guess there is a reason they cost more and I will not mess with the cheap one's in the future. Save your time and money, unless you want to mess around fixing these yourself.

source_doc: This thing went on so incredibly easy. I never leave reviews but I need EVERYONE to know how easily and beautifully this screen protector went on my Switch OLED. When smart phones and screen protectors first came out, it was like doing surgery to handle them and get them on correctly, and maybe, maybe after three tries you got it right.I am no expert, so when I got my Switch today, the absolute last thing I wanted to do was put the screen protector on. I’ve had the people at the store do them for my phones, because I just worry I’m going to get bubbles or dust under it.But this went on like butter. I used the wet wipe and then the dry and then peeled off the first step layer and I was careful in positioning it (having a case on helped) and then all I did was drop it down gently and it smoothed itself out, and then I pressed gently with my finger to make sure. After peeling the second layer off, it was PERFECT. No bubbles. No dust. I did it on a whim because you can’t let the screen protector see your fear — and I cannot be more amazed at how utterly effortlessly it went on.Plus, you get three for this price and should something ever happen to it, I have backups. I cannot recommend this product enough.

source_doc: Didn't think I needed it until I got it ... I have an organization problem.  No matter what I try, I always seem to lose track of things, only to discover them weeks/months later.  This happens with small things mostly -- things that have a tendency to disappear behind other things.I use processed American cheese for grilled cheese sandwiches mostly -- it melts better than anything else and tastes great (I grew up on it, so ... ).  I especially like the individually wrapped variety as it stays fresher longer.  That is, until I lose track of the last few slices in a package and find it months later as part of an unintended science project in the back of the fridge.Enter this little box.  And that's all it is, really -- a cute box made to fit exactly the individually-wrapped slices of cheese.  I simply put the slices in the box, the box in the door of the fridge, and I know exactly where it is.  No more errant slices hiding in the far corners of the fridge.It's sturdy, well made, nice hinge, and a slight "snap" to the lid so it doesn't come open until I want it to.Just about perfect, really.  Glad I purchased it!  Solid 5 stars: it does what it's supposed to do, does it well, and has proven to be of benefit in helping me stay organized.

source_doc: I don’t think this product was tested. My Indie is drinking gallons of water in her old age so I ordered the 4 gallon size to keep up. Chewy had one cheaper but I liked the idea of filtered water for my dog. At first fill I did notice the water bowl wasn’t really filling with water well. My dog would drink and it would not refill the bowl. So I took the filter out which helped…. But wait I paid more for this bc I wanted the filter! I had accidentally ordered two of these so I had given one to a friend for his houseful of furry paw friends so I called him to see if he had the same issue. He said he did until he modified the holes to be larger so the water could flow better. So, as suggested I drilled more holes to increase the water flow. It worked, I guess. But the water never fills past about 1/2 inch and my indie prefers a deeper bowl. I don’t think this product was tested before production. I might return it but unlikely they’ll give me a refund since I’ve now added 5 more holes to it!

source_doc: Capstar. I have 6 cats and they all came down with fleas. Considering they are all indoor cats and I live in a building they have no option to escape. Either way, we have fleas! 2 of my boys recently went to the vets. I think that's where they picked up a flea or 2. I didn't realize it until this week. That's when I went into action. 3 of my cats are semi feral and I have no ability to put drops on them. So I opted for an oral flea killer. I just gave them a dose tonight. Unfortunately I opted for a food that is heavily gravied,  next time it will be a pate. I used a pill crusher to mask the pill. I think that one of them did not get a full dose. He ateat least 85% of his dose. What he didn't finish the rest of his food his sister did, she has fleas too. Now, I'm just waiting to find dead fleas. My adults get drops tomorrow so I'm not worried about them. It's almost bedtime so I don't want to find fleas jumping off the cats and onto me! Bad enough I had 1 bite me inside my eye muscle. I guess my eye got in the way of its jump. LOL

source_doc: Better than expected. I used this as a junction box on my utility trailer. My trailer doesn't have brakes so I didn't need all the lugs but I wanted a box like this to use in wiring the trailer and didn't find anything like it for a four wire setup so I went ahead and got this one and I'm glad I did. I did add a rubber gasket and I sealed around the wires with silicone RTV where I brought them into the wiring box through the rubber plugs that came with the box.The box itself is pretty stout but the strain relief clamps on the ends of the box could definitely stand some beefing up. It would be a better product if the side enty ports also had strain reliefs.In spite of its shortcomings, I like this box well enough that I bought another one which I intend to use when I rewire another trailer of mine next summer.

source_doc: Soooo much easier than I thought. My slider was in such bad shape it took Rocky to open it. I didn’t want to pay megabucks for a repair man so I decided to try myself. I am a 56 yr woman but I am handy. I did need help getting the door on and off because it is heavy. You lift and pull out from the bottom. Now that’s the hardest part! With my particular door I only needed to take out 2 screws on each side and the rollers removed in a slot next to the screws. Replace the rollers and screws that’s it. One of the screws gives you the ability to raise and lower door. I wish I had done this a year ago. I can not tell you about how long this item will last but I can tell you I can open my door with 1 finger now. Hint.. when putting the door back on be sure the rollers are level with the door, not sticking out.The product itself seemed flimsy to me. Not as solid as I thought but it was I believe $20 and works great. Now If I need to replace it soon I won’t cry over my $20If your a newbee like me. Just do it.

source_doc: Maiden voyage success. I was looking for an affordable sleep system that didn't frustrate me like the perpetual tangled mess I was in my mummy bag but that would still be cozy and warm. I'm a toss-n-turn sleeper from side to tummy to side and mummy bags are too tight around the legs and don't let you roll over. I tried this for the first time tent camping at Valley of Fire in late December and it worked out great. Temps were in the mid-'30s to low '40s and I was plenty warm with this and my r4 sleeping pad. I did pull it up over my head for added warmth during the night when it got windy. (I'm 5'7", 155 lbs) It has slick fabric on both sides so that was the only minor drawback. It slipped off my body when I rolled over but I was wearing silky long johns so I will revisit my sleep clothes for future trips. I swapped the compression sack it came with for one that has four straps and was able to decrease the packable size.
