source_doc: Works great for me! As I have gotten older and I suppose less active, I seem to have more trouble going and staying asleep. I did not want to take a prescription sleep aid, so I tried the Nature’s Renewal sleep herbs with melatonin. supplement, and I am glad that I did. I have tried other melatonin supplements but really did not have good results. This product not only helped me get to sleep faster, but I stayed asleep most of the night with the exception of having to get up to go to the bathroom as usual. I also suffer from restless leg syndrome and even that is better when I take this supplement. I believe that it is because of the addition of Tryptophan, passion flower and St john’s wort, among other herbs that has helped with the restless legs. The suggested usage is two capsules and since this bottle has 60 capsules this product will last 30 days if used every day. I think the price of this supplement might be a little high, but with the quality ingredients used in this product and how well it works, I think it’s worth it. I am very impressed with the results I am getting from this sleep aid, and I highly recommend it.

source_doc: Perfect For Our Dim Evening Light In Bedroom. I have a beautiful light which I love in our bedroom.  We have it attached to the switch so that when you walk into the room, you are not blinded by the bright lights in the room all on.  It takes chandelier bulbs and I was having trouble finding one for it that I liked.HOW THESE COMEThese come in a thick box with plenty of padding to protect the bulbs.DO THEY FIT?These fit my light perfectly.COLORThese are what I call warmer lighting.  I tend to like daylight for most of my lights when I want to see.  This is warmer for that glow that allows us to see, but it does not make it difficult to go to sleep when I want to.DIMMINGThis is not a dimming light so I do not have a way to test this for dimming yet.THE BOTTOM LINEThese bulbs are perfect for my low light light in the bedroom.  It is a warm light that shines through the shade, but still keeps the light lower for a more restful evening.MY RATINGSo far, this is a FIVE STAR for us.  I don't see me running out of these anytime soon as we only have the one light.  However, if I get a dimmer light uses them, I will update.
hypos: Идеально для нашего тусклого вечернего света в спальне. У меня есть красивый светильник, который я очень люблю, в нашей спальне. Он подключен к выключателю так, чтобы при входе в комнату вас не слепил сразу весь включенный яркий свет. Для него нужны лампы для люстры, и мне было трудно найти ту, которая бы мне понравилась. КАК ОНИ ПОСТАВЛЯЮТСЯ Эти лампы поставляются в плотной коробке с большим количеством защитного материала для сохранности ламп. ПОДХОДЯТ ЛИ ОНИ? Они идеально подошли к моему светильнику. source_doc: My cat love this water fountain! I used to buy my cat bottled water for her water dish (yes, I know I am a little over the top, but everyone's pipes are gross). When I work sometimes I would forget to check my cats water bowl. I always knew my cat was out of water because she would follow me and my boyfriend to the bathroom to drink from the faucet. Ever since I got this fountain my cat has totally stopped trying to drink out of the faucet, and I have saved money on buying bottled water. The first day I think my cat was a little apprehensive, but she soon grew comfortable with the fountain! I have had it now for three weeks and it hasn't ran out of charge. You can run a 10 min cycle that will purify all the water. I have not found a water filter that this company makes, but I have found others that I cut in half. They work great. I will never go back to a plain water dish because I love this water fountain asich as I am sure my cat does!!! If you love your animals like I do than buy this fountain. The first picture shows you all the parts that come with this fountain. The only thing you will need to start is a charging block, and eventually you will need to buy more filters.
hypos: Моя кошка обожает этот питьевой фонтанчик! Раньше я покупал/а своей кошке бутилированную воду для ее миски (да, я знаю, что я немного чересчур заморачиваюсь, но у всех трубы грязные). Когда я работаю, я иногда забывал/а проверить миску с водой моей кошки. Я всегда знал/а, что у моей кошки закончилась вода, потому что она шла за мной и моим парнем в ванную, чтобы попить из-под крана. С тех пор как у меня появился этот фонтанчик, моя кошка вообще перестала пытаться пить из-под крана, а я сэкономил/а деньги на покупке бутилированной воды. В первый день, думаю, моя кошка была немного насторожена, но вскоре она привыкла к фонтанчику! Он у меня уже три недели, и зарядка еще не закончилась. Вы можете запустить 10-минутный цикл, который очистит всю воду. Я не нашел/шла фильтра для воды, который производит эта компания, но нашел/шла другие, которые я разрезаю пополам. source_doc: Not just for toys! I saw this over the door hanger for kids toys, and I immediately thought that it would be great for my craft room! source_doc: A sweet different flavor which I enjoy drinking. This is not your typical flavor for a super green mixture but I enjoy it.  It is sweet which I like but I don’t think it is excessive in my opinion.  Ingredients are what I expected and want in a produce like this. I was skeptical if it would taste like cinnamon apple but to me it does. Reminds me of an apple fritter and it actually calms my sweet tooth when I have a craving. Now, I admit this may not be for everyone but I think it worth a try if you are into drinking super greens mixtures and what to try a different flavor.Overall, I have no complaints it is a good product and priced fair.Lastly, my preparation is simple.  I do not mix it with anything else.  It is just 14oz if water and one scoop.

I would say it obviously helps if you have solid ground to put them in and I also liked that it came with retention straps so you could secure it to a fence or post. source_doc: Back to basic, it’s what works! Who ever said newer and more technical is better was wrong. When I had my daughter 20 years ago we used the basic bulb sucker at home but this style in the hospital where I worked as a nursing student. I had my second child this year and saw that nasal aspirators had advanced, they’re electric with lights and sounds now. I of course got one immediately but when my baby got his first stuffy nose I came to realize they don’t offer very much suction and it was more work than it was worth. I tried a few others before going back to the basics. I remembered the one at the hospital working better than my bulb sucker so when I saw this I decided to try one more. This nasal aspirator works great! It has wonderful suction and I like that you control just how much. There aren’t a ton of parts that need cleaned afterward and nothing has to be done before using it in the middle of the night with a scared crying baby. You can tell it’s made with quality material and the little etching of the bunny is a cute addition. I’m very happy with this purchase and relieved I have a way of helping my baby breathe easier.

source_doc: Make my eyes feel weird, so must be working. These patches are drowning in liquid, and I made a mess not realizing that when opening. They definitely sit in place properly,but it's hard to get them correct without feeling like the stuff is getting in your eyes. They honestly make my eyes feel very weird. Almost puffy. So I do not know if this is a bad reaction, or just the patch doing its job. Honestly,  I see no visible results, so I have no idea. I suppose these are like any other beauty product out there, and what may work for one, may not work for another. So far, they are not working on me, but I have only been using for a few days as well. I am sort of in the middle on these. If I change my mind and I like them, I will update my review. If I do not update, it means they Never worked. Will use these to the end of the container.

source_doc: A simple lamp that brings beauty! Since receiving & writing my original review of the defective lamp I received the seller contacted me & offered a replacement. source_doc: Does not stay on well. I need to preface this review by saying that I am new to doing my nails at home. I have always been a nail biter and picker. So, before spending money on going to a salon and have my nails professionally done only to tear them up, I thought I would try it at home. I used this gel in particular to attach nail extensions to my natural nails. I then used a dip powder to polish them. During the entire process three nails came off very easily. I simply figured I had not used enough of the gel and replaced the nails using more gel. However, once all was said and done, and I was finished with the manicure, the nails still popped off quite easily. So in my very unexperienced opinion, this gel does not seem to stay on your natural nails very well. I still gave it three stars because it could entirely be user error on my part.

source_doc: Excellent USB Hub. I work in IT and needed to get rid of all the USB adapters I carry for one dependable/portable hub. I think I found that hub. This hub is made of metal is looks very durable. Looks to have good ventilation but it is a little on the big size for me. I guess it has to be with everything it does. I connected it to my Surface Pro 7 and away I went. No drivers needed which is very important to me. I tested the VGA port, Micro SD port, USB 3.0 ports, and the ethernet port and all worked flawlessly. I tried to connect my USC-C thunderbolt docking station to the 100w PD port, but power didn’t pass through. I’m not saying it didn’t work, it just didn’t work with what I had. I could buy a 100w USB-C charger if needed but this hub passed my tests for the ports I really needed. Now, I would be willing to trade the VGA port for a serial port. I guess I have to keep carrying my USB to Serial adapter. All in all, this hub rocks.

source_doc: FINALLY - no more tangled hair or itchy scalp. Name a shampoo and I have probably tried it over the years.  My hair is thin and wavy, so it tangles very easily.  I HATED shampooing because once I dried my hair, I had so many tangles, I was brushing out handfuls of hair.  I am not sure what is magic about Viori but my hair is MUCH more manageable AND I have way less tangles. This is my first experience with a bar shampoo.  After 2 months of use, my hair is now thicker!  I used to have to wash my hair much more frequently but again, the magic of Viori, once a week is perfectly fine.  My hair styles easier and so far, after 8 uses, the bar is barely used, will probably get at least 20 washings from one bar, if not more.  I have below the shoulder length hair.  I can travel with this bar shampoo as it can be carried onto airlines AND is much easier than having at bottles of shampoo at home and camping.  Also better for our planet!  I want to try the Viori conditioner next!
hypos: НАКОНЕЦ-ТО — больше никаких спутанных волос и зуда кожи головы. Назовите любой шампунь, и я, скорее всего, пробовал/а его за эти годы. Мои волосы тонкие и волнистые, поэтому они очень легко путаются. Я НЕНАВИДЕЛ/А мыть голову, потому что, как только волосы высыхали, они так сильно путались, что я вычесывал/а их горстями. Не знаю, в чем магия Viori, но мои волосы стали НАМНОГО послушнее, И у меня гораздо меньше колтунов. Это мой первый опыт использования твердого шампуня. После 2 месяцев использования мои волосы стали гуще! Раньше мне приходилось мыть голову гораздо чаще, но, опять же, благодаря магии Viori, одного раза в неделю вполне достаточно. Мои волосы легче укладываются, и пока, после 8 использований, брусок почти не уменьшился, его, вероятно, хватит как минимум на 20 умываний, если не больше. У меня волосы длиной ниже плеч. Я могу путешествовать с этим твердым шампунем, так как его можно брать с собой в самолет, И это гораздо проще, чем возиться с бутылками шампуня дома и в походах. А еще это лучше для нашей планеты! Дальше я хочу попробовать кондиционер Viori!

source_doc: i love these diapers but they’re not perfect. i love these diapers but i can’t give them 5 stars. my baby turned 4 months old today and i just finished my first box of 68 size 3 diapers… they fit her but they’re on the verge of being to small, to the point of me being unsure wether or not i should order a size up on our next box. I had to buy a pack of pampers in the mean time and noticed a significant size difference between pampers size 3 and these size 3s, i think it’s safe to say these run small. These are also the first diapers my baby has managed to pee through and have a “blow out” with but it may just be because they’re on the smaller size. i’ll have to see how the size 4 does for her. i will continue to buy these diapers though bc they’re so stinkin cute, after 2 boys, i ended up having a surprise pregnancy that has given me a baby girl & im fully enjoying all things girly.. including these slightly overpriced, not the best functioning, but ridiculously cute diapers! i love the girly bright prints, they’re so much prettier than any of the others i’ve come across! I did try Hello Bello diapers and they’re a definite no, they’re cute but way worse on the absorbency, her skin would be visibly wet when i’d change her diaper with those!

source_doc: Best Wipers I Ever Owned. My 2004 Toyota Avalon XLS had squeaky wiper since the day I bought it. Car is in excellent condition and I replaced the wipers originally with something like Bosch. They still dragged and squeaked horribly. I thought perhaps the motor was bad so I replaced the wiper motor, still squeaked. I bought another "Silicone" type wiper blade and they squeaked. I though maybe my wiper linkage was bad so I replaced the entire mechanical arms. Still squeaked. I lived with this for about 2 years and driving to work in the rain one morning, my wipers were squeaking when I noticed that about 8 inches of the passenger wiper blade peeled off from the frame. The wipers instantly stopped squeaking. Crazy.I ordered the "Rain-X 830124 Silicone Endura Wiper Blades", which is a bit misleading because it is only one blade. I assumed there were two since the cost was enough for two, but it was only one. I ordered the other blade as well and these things are buttery smooth, no squeaking at last!Highly recommended.

source_doc: Works for Me But Hard to Inflate. I got this for my small older dog. He sleeps on the bed with me but sometimes he gets up and moves around on the bed and once he fell off the bed onto the hard floor. I got this bumper so that when he moves around, he won't fall off the bed. I found the directions to inflate it a bit difficult to follow since there is minimal directions. It took me a few tries to get it all set up correctly to inflate but once I did, it worked. It stays inflated on the bed. I like the little carry bag that is include in case I would need to take it with me but I don't know if I could get it all packed neatly back into the bag. I have not tried to deflate this once I got it inflated. The plastic flaps that are supposed to fit under the mattress were too short for my bed so I wasn't able to secure it that way. I put it under my fitted sheet and so far it has stayed in place. My dog walked over to the side of the bed where I have it installed and he was under the covers but once he go to the bumper, he turned around and walked away from that side so I hope this will work for him to keep him safe on the bed.

source_doc: I Love love LOVE this! Oh man, let me tell you; I awaited this very anxiously. I was so excited I could hardly stand it, a friend has one for her daughter and she’s 4 and she still plays in it, my dogs are older and it’s nice not to have to monitor them, lovely that I don’t have to worry about electrical outlets or the glass entertainment center I got 6 years ago… I watched the updates like a child on Christmas, every update I swear..7 stops away… 6 stops away…. 5 stops away… all the way to my door! And let me tell you, easiest children’s toy I ever assembled! I thought it was going to be so tough and as I was putting it together I realized I was flying through it. source_doc: 5 stars isn’t enough! I have a 1968 Yamaha F230 12 string that I bought brand new and the strings have over time raised up off the neck and made it very difficult to play. Now I plan to take it to a luthier to get it worked on but in the mean time wanted to pick up something cheap. So I took a chance on this Tario. I figured if this was junk it would make a beautiful wall hanger, and it is beautiful. The strings that came with it were junk so I put a set of Elixirs on it. This guitar has exceeded my expectations 10 fold. It plays beautifully and sounds fantastic. I had a buddy play it who owns a Goodall and he looked at me with a smile and said this thing is great. If I could have given it ten stars I would have. I try to stay away from buying things made in china but I have to admit this thing is worth ten times what I paid for it. I then bought a Gator hard shell case for it.

source_doc: Love it. 40LB great beginner weight to lift heavy. I'm a pretty out-of-shape woman I wanted to start lifting heavy meaning going as heavy as I could reasonably handle as a beginner but also without hurting myself or just being psycally unable to lift it.  I chose this 40LB kettlebell.  I think it's perfect. I do my squats with two 15 LB barbells so I went back and forth between the 40, 50, and 95 LB weights.  After getting this one I think 40 is perfect.  50 is the max I realistically prob could have handled and anything over that would have been a mistake for me. I can lift it with one arm, over my head, and do all my squat sets comfortably I get winded at the end but it feels good. I bought it used at 43bucks which is a great deal.  I had to sand the handle a bit because of some sharp bits and it arrived busted out of the box since the box the shipper chose was way too big for this item and it knocked around during transit.  That said it did not sustain any damage in transit. It was bubble wrapped well.  It has a few miner scuffs and chipped paint but I don't care about any of that stuff just mentioning it for the people who are concerned.  I made an awesome choice.

source_doc: Serious Stomach/Gas Issues. I purchased my bulk unflavored canister directly from the Armra website about 4 weeks ago. I took it once a day for a week and then twice a day (morning and night). The main positive effect I had was that I slept more soundly through the night and my Fitbit recorded more deep sleep and REM sleep.  I agree with the commenters who find the taste of the unflavored product similar to powdered milk - I thought it was fine.  I was pleased enough with the sleep improvements to want to continue using the product, but I developed serious stomach pain and gas issues on my left side in the area of the pancreas. The pain was severe enough across several days to consider going to the doctor but I finally remembered I had started this new product and I stopped taking it during week 3. Fortunately the pain and gas eased within 24 hours and was gone in 3 days. I rarely react to foods and supplements so this was unexpected. I checked the ratings here and see a small but notable group of users reporting similar gastrointestinal issues. I don’t know why some of us have such a significant reaction but it is something to be aware of.

source_doc: Teachers, this is a game changer for your students. I am a professional cellist and teacher. I had the mother of my 6 year old student order this for our little cellist. I have not been impressed with other products in the past, but this looked like it was worth a shot. It's much easier to assemble and lighter than a similar animal themed product- hint, hint. Despite the bulk, it was comfortable in my hand and in her tiny hand. You can pop it on and off with ease. I will never use the beginner thumb on the ferrule bow hold again. I will forever start my students with this gadget. In her 30 minute lesson she graduated to a "real" bow hold with and without the grip aid. I could see the instant change from her fingers to her elbow and shoulder positioning. Hallelujah!! I am ordering one or two for my studio. I think it will be a wonderful aid for my experienced students struggling with bad habits they developed before getting into private lessons. If I was still teaching orchestra in the public schools I would purchase a classroom set. I will definitely be recommending this to my Youth Orchestra cellists.

source_doc: ---Buyers BEWARE they don't stand behind WARRANTY-- Very rarely have I had issue's with sellers warranty.After 2 months the temperature light stopped working. It did work atill I put another Thermometer in the tank and adjusted the correct temperature. A couple month's later I had to adjust again. I had to keep changing it  to bring up the 70 to 78 degrees temp. At 4 months I contacted the company about there 1 year warranty.  They did repond and I told them i appreciate that they responded.  First off they offered 50% coupon.They raised there price. Even at 50% I said I could find one cheaper last longer.  Now there respone send it in to repair.Wait what??It's winter and my tank would be without a heater. That just funny. I've already lost a snail. I live in the high desert so our temperature changes 115 to below 0. My house stays 62 to 80. Yes this heater needed to function for the changes.I bought a higher power for the size of the tank thinking this heater would be the best for my tank for the area.When I purchased this heater it had 5 stars.I hope I helped someone to stay away,because company 12 month warranty only works if you send it in.What a joke. Buyer BEWAREI paid for this heater with my own monies no one paid me.
hypos: ---Покупатели, ОСТЕРЕГАЙТЕСЬ, они не выполняют ГАРАНТИЙНЫЕ обязательства--- Очень редко у меня возникали проблемы с гарантией продавцов. Через 2 месяца перестал работать световой индикатор температуры. Сам прибор все еще работал, пока я не поместил/а другой термометр в аквариум и не настроил/а правильную температуру. Через пару месяцев мне снова пришлось ее регулировать. Мне приходилось постоянно менять настройки, чтобы поднять температуру с 70 до 78 градусов. Через 4 месяца я связался/лась с компанией по поводу их годовой гарантии. Они ответили, и я сказал/а им, что ценю их быстрый ответ. Во-первых, они предложили купон на скидку 50%. Но они подняли цену. Я сказал/а, что даже с 50% скидкой смогу найти вариант дешевле, который прослужит дольше. Теперь их ответ — отправьте его в ремонт. Погодите, что?? Сейчас зима, и мой аквариум останется без обогревателя. Это просто смешно. Я уже потерял/а улитку. Я живу в высокогорной пустыне, так что наша температура колеблется от 115 до ниже 0. В моем доме держится от 62 до 80. Да, этому обогревателю нужно было работать с учетом этих изменений. Я купил/а более мощный прибор для объема своего аквариума, думая, что этот обогреватель будет лучшим для моего аквариума в этой местности. Когда я покупал/а этот обогреватель, у него было 5 звезд. Надеюсь, я помог/ла кому-то держаться от него подальше, потому что 12-месячная гарантия компании работает только в том случае, если вы отправите товар им. Что за шутка. Покупатель, ОСТЕРЕГАЙСЯ, я оплатил/а этот обогреватель своими собственными деньгами, никто мне не платил.

source_doc: Fantastic beginners microphone. I purchase this microphone to make videos for my YouTube channel. The reason I went with the ATR is because it is a dynamic microphone. Apparently, this type of microphone is very good at isolating only your voice, and not picking up background noises. Since I am making these videos in a non-soundproofed room, it only made sense to get this microphone. There are newer, looking and cooler looking microphones if you’re a neophyte like me and it would’ve been easy to choose them however, I am very happy with the choice I made.I wish I purchased the boom package as well as I now recognize that the boom makes it so that there are no extraneous sounds making it into the recording. Tapping noises, if close enough to the microphone will unfortunately make it into the recording. So now, I am looking for a boom.Are use this microphone with my iPad Pro 2021 and also with an OWC thunderbolt hub. It works well. I did not choose to go down the XLR option but instead I am using the USB-C option. I highly recommend this microphone.I also purchased a wind blocking cover for the microphone head it seems to be helping.

source_doc: So far, So good  a tip. I don't know about anyone else, but always hated those old mercury thermometers.And I knew if I was going to get a digital one, I wanted one you didn't have to touch skin.This one seems to give a good and LIGHTNING fast reading.Also comes with batteries, but I don't know how good they are, so will keep some to change out.And I also like you can read temp in a dark room!TIPS:  Let it get to room temp before using.  Mine had been in my cold mailbox awhile, but whether in cold or heat, just try to give it time to really adjust to room temp.  I was in no hurry, I waited an hour, but probably didn't need to wait that long.ALSO LOOK at example of WHERE to place it, not too close or too far from forehead and I place above the center of my eyebrows.BOTTOMLINE:  GLAD I got it.  In these times, one NEEDS a thermometer and I am pleased with this one.  Will UPDATE if anything changes.  Oh, and for older peeps, which I am one, our temps can be below 98.6.  NORMAL temps can range for different people, different ages.  I'm concerned more with how HIGH my goes.
hypos: Пока всё хорошо, дам совет. Не знаю, как другие, но я всегда ненавидел/а эти старые ртутные градусники. И я знал/а, что если и буду покупать цифровой, то хочу такой, которым не нужно касаться кожи. Этот, кажется, дает хорошие и МОЛНИЕНОСНО быстрые показания. Также в комплекте идут батарейки, но я не знаю, насколько они хороши, поэтому приберегу запасные для замены. А еще мне нравится, что можно измерять температуру в темной комнате! СОВЕТЫ: Дайте ему нагреться до комнатной температуры перед использованием. Мой какое-то время пролежал в холодном почтовом ящике, но будь то на холоде или в жаре, просто постарайтесь дать ему время по-настоящему адаптироваться к комнатной температуре. Я никуда не спешил/а, подождал/а час, хотя, вероятно, не нужно было ждать так долго. ТАКЖЕ ПОСМОТРИТЕ на пример того, КУДА его прикладывать, не слишком близко и не слишком далеко от лба, я прикладываю над центром бровей. ИТОГ: РАД/А, что купил/а его. В наше время градусник НЕОБХОДИМ, и я доволен/льна этим прибором. ОБНОВЛЮ отзыв, если что-то изменится. Да, и для пожилых людей, к которым я отношусь, наша температура может быть ниже 36,6 (98,6). source_doc: Very beautiful. This pool cue has no flaws, and is very beautiful. The brown has an almost tigers eye look to it under the light, which makes it that more stunning. It has a nice feel in your hands, and is pretty good quality. I was surprised I liked it even better than I thought I would. The case is also pretty well made and I see no flaws with that either. The cue fits nicely in it without any issues. For the price, I did not expect it to be one of my favorites, but alas, it might just be my favorite pool cue to date, mostly due to the look, yes, but the fact it also has a nice feel, and works as good as any as I've used, plays in that as well.  I will note I am not an avid pool player, but I have played with a league team (as a stand in) previously, and have some experience beyond being new to the sport or just messing around. So I am only giving my review as an in the middle player, not a professional. Regardless, I think this would be a nice addition to any players collection, be it a beginner, or all the way to a pro.

source_doc: Reliable, versatile and an extra 9 string... Decades ago I had to re-learn a new playing style due to a slight HAND-icap. I have found that hybrid sets work best for me. In this time, I have tried many brands, materials and gauges, and still, I keep falling back to Rotosound Nickel Hybrid Electric Guitar String sets (9 11 16 26 36 46). I have a couple fallback brands that are very good...but this is where I land these days. As long as I keep them Clean, they're bright, they maintain their tone over time, and stay in tune. (and you get an extra high E string)To clarify, I'm not a guitar or string snob and I'm not rich, but maybe I may have experience that might be useful to others. That said, my baseline for strings is that <I use the strings I can afford and that get the job done.>I don't have expensive guitars but I have had several for 20 years or longer...and I know how to adjust the neck, string height, properly install the strings on the posts and make sure there's no hang-ups in the nut, yatta yatta. In short, with as much bending and hammering strings I do they, for the most part, stay in tune.

source_doc: Please don’t try and use these for more than a few months. These have been great, I got a set , then had a another set gifted to us for our daughter less than a year ago. They stain with some pasta sauces which I thought was the only downside. If you’re using a dishwasher DISPOSE OF THEM AFTER A MONTH OR SO!! I noticed my daughters requests for dinner changed. She went from eating everything I made, steak, chicken, pork, spinach, quiche, to over time she would eat just pb&j or soup. I tried one of her spoons and they’re either porous and they hold on to the dishwasher chemicals or they’re leeching themselves. Like burns your throat. DO NOT USE THESE THINGS IN A DISHWASHER.I use cascade in a 2 year old Frigidaire dishwasher, I don’t use high heat so I’m not cooking them a couple times a week. It isn’t the only way I wash these utensils, it’s 50/50 with hand washing but something is not ok. Please ONLY use these short term. I thought I was doing something good getting a recycled item but I feel like I screwed up getting these.

source_doc: Two pieces! Can use both at same time or just lumbar, just seat. I took a 4587 mile road trip a few months ago for ministry. Oh how I wish I had this then! The one I had slipped and slid every time I got in and out of the car and—  lost it’s cushioning. Sore bottom!  I love the fact that I can choose to use just the seat or just the lumbar or both at the same time. Very comfortable. VERY comfortable!  I have a lumbar seat in my CRV but this gives even more solid support. My biggest problem has been my seat after several hours of long distance driving. This seat is WONDERFUL!  It doesn’t slide around when you get in and out of the car due to several details. The raised pimples on the bottom with a material that doesn’t slide. Also the space separation for each leg. Each one has an elastic strap that can be clipped around the seat. I took a 3 hour, (6 hours round trip)  the day I received this. No pain. No fatigue. No slipping and sliding. I absolutely feel much less fatigued with this support. I love this!!!  Needed it years ago!  Glad to finally have it now. Highly recommend.

source_doc: Great replacement and easy to install - All tools were included. I've had my Aeron chair for nearly ten years. I picked it up used to replace my crappy old chair from one of the big box stores when it finally gave up the ghost. So recently I heard a "crack" and saw that the back frame of the seat had finally worn down and broken.I was beside myself. I didn't want to buy another chair, so I looked for repair shops in the area. One of the shops referred me direct to this product page and said, "order this, and if you want, I can install it." So I did.Fast forward and, still sitting on the broken seat, busy with work, I decided to look up what the repair entailed. I found a tutorial on youtube. Four bolts for the seat. Two nuts to transfer the j-bars. I figured I could handle it.This replacement seat kit came with the hex wrench needed to undo the seat, and a fitted wrench and a T25 torx driver to quickly transfer the j-bar. It took a few minutes, and a bit of leaning in because the bolts were really in there, but the replacement was easy. I literally didn't take out my toolbox because I had everything I needed in the kit.Really well designed chair and replacement was super easy. Five stars.
